tickets.subject: Unable to log in after password reset
tickets.description: Customer reset their password via the email link but the new password is rejected as incorrect on the login page.
tickets.resolution_notes: Password reset tokens were case-sensitive but the reset confirmation email displayed the temporary password in all caps due to email client styling. Advised customer to copy-paste rather than retype, and flagged the email template for a fix.

tickets.subject: SSO login redirects to blank page
tickets.description: Customer using Okta SSO is redirected back to the app after authenticating, but the page is completely blank with no error.
tickets.resolution_notes: SAML assertion was missing the expected 'email' attribute mapping in the customer's Okta app configuration. Walked customer through remapping the attribute in Okta admin console.

tickets.subject: 2FA code not being received via SMS
tickets.description: Customer enabled two-factor authentication but says the SMS verification code never arrives on their phone.
tickets.resolution_notes: Customer's carrier was blocking messages from our SMS provider's short code. Switched their account to app-based authenticator (TOTP) as a workaround.

tickets.subject: Account locked after multiple failed login attempts
tickets.description: Customer is locked out after entering the wrong password a few times and wants to know how to unlock their account.
tickets.resolution_notes: Explained the 30-minute automatic lockout window and manually unlocked the account after verifying identity. Recommended enabling password manager to avoid repeat lockouts.

tickets.subject: Login session expires too quickly
tickets.description: Customer reports being logged out every 15 minutes even while actively using the dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: Customer's org-level session timeout setting had been set to 15 minutes by a previous admin. Updated the setting to 4 hours per customer's request.

tickets.subject: Salesforce data not syncing into dashboard
tickets.description: Customer's Salesforce opportunity data hasn't updated in the revenue dashboard for the past 3 days.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's Salesforce API token had expired after a security policy change on their side. Had them regenerate the token and re-authorize the integration.

tickets.subject: Sync job stuck at 'in progress' for 2 days
tickets.description: The nightly data sync job for a customer's integration has shown 'in progress' status for over 48 hours with no completion.
tickets.resolution_notes: A malformed record in the source data caused the sync worker to silently hang rather than fail. Added row-level error handling and manually restarted the job.

tickets.subject: Duplicate records appearing after re-sync
tickets.description: After manually triggering a re-sync, the customer now sees duplicate entries for the same accounts in their dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: The manual re-sync didn't check for existing records before inserting. Ran a deduplication script scoped to the customer's account and added an upsert-by-external-id check going forward.

tickets.subject: Missing recent transactions after nightly sync
tickets.description: Customer notices the last 2 days of transactions are missing from their dashboard even though the sync ran successfully.
tickets.resolution_notes: The sync window was calculated using UTC while the customer's source system exports in local time, causing a boundary gap. Adjusted the sync window to overlap by 6 hours as a buffer.

tickets.subject: Integration with HubSpot throwing authentication error
tickets.description: Customer's HubSpot integration started failing with an authentication error after working fine for months.
tickets.resolution_notes: HubSpot had rotated their OAuth scopes and the customer's connected app needed re-authorization with the updated scopes. Walked them through reconnecting the integration.

tickets.subject: Revenue chart shows blank instead of bars
tickets.description: The main revenue chart on the dashboard renders as an empty white box with no bars or axis labels.
tickets.resolution_notes: A recent filter combination produced a zero-row result set, and the chart component didn't handle the empty-data case gracefully. Added an explicit 'no data for this range' state.

tickets.subject: Dashboard widgets overlap on smaller screens
tickets.description: On a laptop with a smaller resolution, several dashboard widgets visually overlap and are unreadable.
tickets.resolution_notes: The dashboard grid layout used fixed pixel widths instead of responsive breakpoints. Filed as a known limitation and recommended a minimum 1440px display width in the interim.

tickets.subject: Pie chart percentages don't add up to 100%
tickets.description: Customer noticed the segments of a category breakdown pie chart sum to 97% instead of 100%.
tickets.resolution_notes: Rounding was applied per-segment before summing rather than distributing the rounding remainder. Adjusted the rendering logic to allocate the remainder to the largest segment.

tickets.subject: Custom date range filter not updating chart
tickets.description: When the customer selects a custom date range, the chart continues showing the previous default range's data.
tickets.resolution_notes: A caching layer was keying on the filter's display label instead of its actual date values, so custom ranges collided with the cached default. Fixed the cache key to use the resolved date values.

tickets.subject: Dashboard fails to load, spinning indefinitely
tickets.description: The main dashboard shows a loading spinner that never resolves, even after refreshing the page.
tickets.resolution_notes: One widget's data query was timing out and blocking the rest of the dashboard from rendering. Made widget loads independent so a single slow widget no longer blocks the page.

tickets.subject: Invoice shows incorrect seat count
tickets.description: Customer's latest invoice bills for 25 seats but they say they only have 18 active users.
tickets.resolution_notes: Several deactivated user accounts hadn't been removed from the billing seat count due to a sync delay between the user admin panel and the billing system. Issued a prorated credit and fixed the sync delay.

tickets.subject: Unable to update credit card on file
tickets.description: Customer gets a generic error when trying to update their payment method in account settings.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's new card's billing zip code format (Canadian postal code) wasn't accepted by the payment form's validation. Updated the form to accept international postal code formats.

tickets.subject: Charged twice for the same billing cycle
tickets.description: Customer noticed two identical charges on their card statement for what should be a single monthly charge.
tickets.resolution_notes: A retry mechanism for a previously failed payment double-charged after the original payment actually succeeded on the processor's side. Refunded the duplicate charge and added idempotency keys to the retry logic.

tickets.subject: Downgrade request not reflected in next invoice
tickets.description: Customer requested a plan downgrade last month but was billed at the old, higher rate again.
tickets.resolution_notes: The downgrade was recorded in the CRM but never propagated to the billing system due to a missing webhook subscription. Manually corrected the invoice and added the missing webhook.

tickets.subject: Annual plan discount not applied at checkout
tickets.description: Customer selected the annual billing option expecting a 15% discount, but the checkout total shows the full monthly-equivalent price.
tickets.resolution_notes: The discount code was only auto-applied for new signups, not existing accounts switching billing cycles. Manually applied the discount and fixed the eligibility check.

tickets.subject: CSV export missing last week of data
tickets.description: Customer's CSV export of transaction history is missing the most recent 7 days of records.
tickets.resolution_notes: The export job's date range used the same UTC/local timezone gap as the sync issue in T-1104. Applied the same buffer fix to the export query.

tickets.subject: PDF report export times out for large date ranges
tickets.description: Exporting a PDF report for a full year of data fails with a timeout error after about 30 seconds.
tickets.resolution_notes: PDF rendering was done synchronously in the request thread. Moved large exports to an async job with an email notification when the file is ready.

tickets.subject: Scheduled weekly report email stopped arriving
tickets.description: Customer used to receive a weekly summary report by email every Monday, but hasn't gotten one in 3 weeks.
tickets.resolution_notes: The scheduled report job silently failed after the customer's dashboard was renamed, since the job referenced the dashboard by its old name instead of its ID. Fixed the job to reference dashboards by ID.

tickets.subject: Exported numbers don't match dashboard totals
tickets.description: The total revenue figure in an exported CSV is noticeably different from what's shown on the live dashboard for the same period.
tickets.resolution_notes: The export used a slightly different filter default (including cancelled orders) than the dashboard view. Aligned both to exclude cancelled orders by default and documented the distinction.

tickets.subject: Export button greyed out for read-only users
tickets.description: A customer with a 'viewer' role reports the export button is disabled and they can't download reports they need for a meeting.
tickets.resolution_notes: This was expected behavior per the permission model, but the customer wasn't aware exports required editor-level access. Clarified the permission model and upgraded the specific user's role at the admin's request.

tickets.subject: New team member can't see any dashboards
tickets.description: A newly invited team member logs in successfully but sees an empty dashboard list with no error message.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new user was auto-assigned to a role with no dashboard permissions by default. Assigned them to the correct team role and recommended reviewing the default role for new invites.

tickets.subject: Admin unable to revoke access for former employee
tickets.description: Customer's admin tried to deactivate a former employee's account but the user still appears able to log in.
tickets.resolution_notes: The deactivation only revoked dashboard access but didn't invalidate existing active sessions. Manually terminated the user's active sessions and added session invalidation to the deactivation flow.

tickets.subject: Viewer role can edit dashboards, shouldn't be able to
tickets.description: Customer noticed a user with 'viewer' permissions was able to rearrange and edit widgets on a shared dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: A permission check was missing on the drag-and-drop widget reordering endpoint specifically (other edit actions were correctly restricted). Added the missing permission check.

tickets.subject: Custom role permissions not saving
tickets.description: Customer created a custom role with specific dashboard permissions, but the settings revert after saving.
tickets.resolution_notes: The custom role form silently failed validation when more than 10 dashboards were selected, due to an undocumented limit. Removed the limit and added a clear error message for edge cases.

tickets.subject: SSO user provisioned with wrong default role
tickets.description: New users signing in via SSO are all being given admin access instead of the standard member role.
tickets.resolution_notes: The SSO provisioning configuration had a leftover default-role setting from initial account setup testing. Corrected the default role and audited existing SSO-provisioned users.

tickets.subject: Dashboard takes over 30 seconds to load
tickets.description: Customer with a large account reports their main dashboard consistently takes 30+ seconds to become interactive.
tickets.resolution_notes: A widget was running an unindexed query against a table that had grown significantly for this customer. Added the missing index and introduced query result caching for that widget type.

tickets.subject: Filtering by date range is extremely slow
tickets.description: Applying any custom date filter on the dashboard takes 10-15 seconds to update, compared to under a second previously.
tickets.resolution_notes: A recent schema change removed a covering index used by the date-range filter query. Restored an equivalent index and validated the query plan improved.

tickets.subject: Application becomes unresponsive with large datasets
tickets.description: Customer with over 2 million records reports the entire application becomes sluggish across all pages, not just one dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: A shared metadata query used by the navigation sidebar scanned the full dataset on every page load for this customer's scale. Cached the metadata and refreshed it on a schedule instead of per-request.

tickets.subject: Report generation queue backed up during peak hours
tickets.description: Customer's scheduled reports are arriving hours late during the company's peak usage window each morning.
tickets.resolution_notes: The report generation queue had a single worker shared across all customers, creating contention at peak times. Scaled out to multiple workers with per-customer fairness.

tickets.subject: Search feature times out on large ticket history
tickets.description: Customer with years of historical ticket data reports the in-app search feature times out instead of returning results.
tickets.resolution_notes: The search query performed a full-text scan without an index for accounts with very large historical volumes. Added a full-text search index and a result limit with pagination.

tickets.subject: Webhook deliveries failing intermittently
tickets.description: Customer's endpoint receives webhook events successfully most of the time but silently misses some events during high-traffic periods.
tickets.resolution_notes: Webhook delivery had no retry logic for transient failures on the customer's endpoint. Added exponential backoff retries and a delivery log the customer can inspect.

tickets.subject: API rate limit reached during normal usage
tickets.description: Customer's integration started receiving 429 rate-limit errors even though their usage pattern hadn't changed recently.
tickets.resolution_notes: A newly added background sync job was making redundant polling calls instead of using the existing webhook events. Recommended switching to webhooks and temporarily raised their rate limit.

tickets.subject: API returns 500 error for valid requests
tickets.description: Customer's integration reports intermittent 500 errors on an endpoint that otherwise works fine most of the time.
tickets.resolution_notes: A specific combination of optional query parameters triggered a null-reference error in an edge case the endpoint hadn't been tested against. Added handling for the missing case and expanded test coverage.

tickets.subject: Webhook payload missing expected fields
tickets.description: Customer says a recently added field they rely on is sometimes missing from the webhook payload they receive.
tickets.resolution_notes: The field was only populated for certain event subtypes but the webhook schema didn't document this distinction clearly. Updated the documentation and added a null-safe default in the payload.

tickets.subject: API key regenerated but old key still works
tickets.description: Customer regenerated their API key for security reasons but noticed the old key still authenticates successfully.
tickets.resolution_notes: Key revocation was queued for asynchronous processing with up to a 15-minute propagation delay that wasn't communicated to the customer. Clarified the expected delay and added a real-time revocation option for security-sensitive cases.

tickets.subject: Coffee bar transactions short on busy mornings
tickets.description: A grocery customer's in-store café shows fewer transactions than the registers between 7 and 9 am, with the biggest gap on weekdays.
tickets.resolution_notes: The transaction dedupe rule treated records with the same store, amount and timestamp (to the second) as duplicates, so identical $4.50 coffees rung up simultaneously on different registers were dropped. Added register ID and transaction number to the dedupe key and reprocessed 120 days. Morning transaction counts now match the register journals exactly.

tickets.subject: New IP allow-list blocks most of the office, but not everyone
tickets.description: After an admin enabled the IP allow-list, some staff can reach the app from the office while most colleagues on the same network are blocked, and who gets in changes from hour to hour.
tickets.resolution_notes: The office egresses through a pool of NAT addresses, but the allow-list entry was typed as 203.0.113.10/32 instead of the pool's 203.0.113.0/28, so only connections leaving through that one address were allowed. Corrected the entry to the full range. All office users have access.

tickets.subject: Fiscal year label one year behind finance
tickets.description: Finance calls the year from February 2025 to January 2026 'FY2026', but the dashboards label it FY2025.
tickets.resolution_notes: The fiscal year label convention was 'Year in which the fiscal year starts'. Switched it to 'Year in which the fiscal year ends'. Filters and labels now show FY2026 for that period.

tickets.subject: Recently onboarded managers get 'No data for your access scope'
tickets.description: Store managers onboarded during the last month see 'No data for your access scope' on all dashboards; long-standing managers are unaffected.
tickets.resolution_notes: The newer managers were provisioned via SSO without the store_id attribute that the row-level rule depends on. Mapped the attribute in the SSO configuration and re-synced the users. Confirmed each manager saw their own store's figures.

tickets.subject: Every quarter tile changed overnight
tickets.description: This morning each quarter-based tile shows different numbers from yesterday, and Q3 now starts in a different month.
tickets.resolution_notes: Settings history showed the fiscal year start month was changed from February to March the previous evening, apparently by mistake while an admin explored settings. Restored February from settings history. Quarter tiles match yesterday's values again.

tickets.subject: Chart lines disappear in high-contrast mode
tickets.description: A staff member with low vision uses Windows high-contrast mode; every chart line and bar disappears, leaving only the axes.
tickets.resolution_notes: In forced-colours mode the browser overrode our series stroke and fill colours to the background colour. Added forced-colours styles so series use system highlight colours plus distinct patterns. Charts are visible in high-contrast mode, which the staff member confirmed.

tickets.subject: Paused subscription still showing a monthly fee
tickets.description: A seasonal garden retailer paused their subscription for the winter and was surprised that a smaller charge kept appearing each month.
tickets.resolution_notes: Paused subscriptions keep a data retention fee of 10% of the plan price, disclosed only in a footnote of the pause dialog, so the charge was valid. Explained the fee, applied a one-time courtesy credit for the first paused month and raised a request to show the fee on the confirmation step. Confirmed the credit appeared on the next statement.

tickets.subject: Reporting tool gets certificate name mismatch from the data API
tickets.description: The customer's on-prem reporting tool connecting to api.example.net reports that the certificate was issued for a different hostname.
tickets.resolution_notes: The tool's old runtime did not send SNI, so the product's edge returned its default certificate instead of the one for api.example.net. The customer updated the tool to a runtime version that sends SNI. The correct certificate was presented and the connection validated.

tickets.subject: Order times from API are hours off
tickets.description: Customer in a UTC-5 region says order timestamps pulled from the API are five hours later than the times shown in the dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: The API returns timestamps in UTC with a trailing 'Z', while the dashboard displays workspace local time. The customer's parser discarded the 'Z' and treated values as local. Updated their parsing to honour the offset and convert to local time. The converted values now match the dashboard.

tickets.subject: OIDC configuration test times out
tickets.description: When the customer's admin clicks 'Test configuration' for OIDC, it fails after 15 seconds with 'timed out fetching /.well-known/openid-configuration'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's identity gateway only accepts requests from allow-listed networks, and the product's auth service egress range 198.51.100.192/28 was not included. The customer added that range for the discovery and key endpoints. The configuration test passed and test users signed in.

tickets.subject: Webhooks failing with HTTP 301
tickets.description: Agent summary: all deliveries to https://hooks.example.com/analytics have failed since Thursday. The delivery log shows status 301 for each attempt.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer reorganised their routes so the URL now redirects to a version with a trailing slash. Webhook delivery does not follow redirects, by design, to avoid sending signed payloads to unexpected hosts. Updated the subscription to the final URL, then replayed the failed events, which all returned 200.

tickets.subject: Drill-down opens a different category than the one clicked
tickets.description: Clicking 'Footwear' in the category chart to drill down opens the detail view for 'Accessories'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The chart sorted categories by value for display, but the click handler used the unsorted order, so drill-downs went to whichever category had held that position before sorting. The handler now uses the clicked bar's category value. Drill-downs open the correct category.

tickets.subject: Average product rating dragged down by unrated items
tickets.description: The product reviews widget shows an average rating of 2.1 stars, while the reviews platform reports 4.3 for the same catalogue.
tickets.resolution_notes: Products without reviews had a null rating, and the average treated nulls as zero, pulling the mean down. Changed the calculated metric to ignore nulls in averages and to show the count of rated products alongside. The widget now shows 4.3, matching the reviews platform.

tickets.subject: Alert resolves itself while the problem is still happening
tickets.description: A 'card payments failing' alert keeps resolving and re-opening even though payment failures continued the whole time, according to the customer.
tickets.resolution_notes: The payment data arrived in bursts, and evaluation windows with no data were treated as a recovery, closing the alert until the next burst re-opened it. Set the rule to keep its current state when a window has no data. The alert now stays open until failures actually drop below the threshold.

tickets.subject: Access requests unanswered for three weeks
tickets.description: Several store managers asked for access to the Regional Margins dashboard three weeks ago and have heard nothing.
tickets.resolution_notes: Access requests were routed only to the dashboard owner, whose account had been deactivated, so the requests sat unseen. Reassigned ownership to the regional lead, who approved five requests and declined two; requests on content with a deactivated owner now fall back to the folder's owners. Confirmed a new request reached the regional lead.

tickets.subject: Hourly refresh falling behind, slower dashboards all afternoon
tickets.description: Customer's hourly incremental refresh has been taking longer than an hour since they started importing late returns, so refreshes overlap and dashboards are slow most afternoons.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each late-arriving return caused the hourly refresh to recompute 30 days of aggregates, so refreshes overlapped. As a workaround, limited the hourly lookback to 7 days and added a nightly full recompute of the last 30 days; a smarter refresh that only recomputes affected days is scheduled for a future release. Hourly refreshes now complete in about 12 minutes.

tickets.subject: Logo looks blurry on high-resolution screens and in PDFs
tickets.description: Customer says their logo looks fuzzy on newer laptops and noticeably pixelated in PDF report headers.
tickets.resolution_notes: The uploaded logo was a 120×40 PNG, which gets upscaled on high-density displays and in print-resolution PDFs. Recommended an SVG or a PNG at least three times the display size, and the customer uploaded an SVG. The logo is crisp on screen and in PDFs.

tickets.subject: order.updated arrives before order.created
tickets.description: Customer's consumer logs 'order not found' errors because it sometimes receives an order.updated event before the order.created event for the same order.
tickets.resolution_notes: Webhook delivery is parallel and does not guarantee ordering between events, as documented. Advised making the consumer upsert by order ID and use the event's sequence number to ignore older states. After the change the consumer stopped logging lookup errors.

tickets.subject: Stock alert opens and closes 30 times a day
tickets.description: Customer's 'stock below 100 units' alert for their central distribution site toggles between firing and resolved roughly 30 times per day, flooding the team with messages.
tickets.resolution_notes: Stock hovered around 100 as picks and replenishments alternated, and the rule had no separate recovery threshold. Added a recovery threshold of 120 units and a 15-minute pending period. The rule now fires once when stock drops and resolves only after a real replenishment; the next day produced two notifications in total.

tickets.subject: Store-credit refunds not reducing net revenue
tickets.description: Customer says refunds issued as store credit never reduce net revenue, so stores that push store credit look better than they are.
tickets.resolution_notes: The netting logic only treated refunds paid back to card or cash as deductions and ignored the 'credit_note' refund method. As an interim fix we added a workspace-level rule that treats credit notes as refunds and recomputed the quarter; a product change to include all refund methods by default is scheduled for the next release. Net revenue for the five store-credit-heavy stores now matches their refund ledger.

tickets.subject: Product catalog sync hangs at 99%
tickets.description: The product catalog sync progress bar sits at 99% for hours. It finishes after a restart, then hangs again the next day.
tickets.resolution_notes: The final step rebuilds category hierarchies, and a category set as its own parent created a loop the step never left. Added cycle detection that skips and logs the offending record, and the customer corrected the category in their e-commerce admin. The catalog sync has completed in under 20 minutes every day since.

tickets.subject: Till data stopped for nine hours and no alert fired
tickets.description: The customer's point-of-sale feed stopped overnight and for most of the morning. Their 'hourly sales below 100' rule should have caught it, but nobody was alerted.
tickets.resolution_notes: With no data at all, each evaluation window was empty, and the rule used the default setting of treating no data as OK. Changed the rule's no-data behaviour to 'alert' after two empty hourly windows. A test pause of a sandbox feed raised the alert after the second empty window.

tickets.subject: Active filter chips look empty in dark theme
tickets.description: In the dark theme, active filter chips across the top of the dashboard look like empty pills; the text only shows when highlighted with the mouse.
tickets.resolution_notes: The chip's selected state used white text, and the dark theme had changed the selected background to white as well. Switched the chip colours to theme tokens. Active filters are readable in the dark theme.

tickets.subject: Full-year dashboards fail at exactly 60 seconds from the office
tickets.description: Dashboards with a full-year date range fail with a gateway error after exactly 60 seconds for users in the office, yet load in about 75 seconds when the same users work from home.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's proxy enforced a 60-second response timeout and returned its own 504 page before the product finished the query. The network team raised the response timeout for app.example.net to 180 seconds, and we suggested enabling pre-aggregation on the heaviest dashboard to shorten its queries. Full-year dashboards now load from the office.

tickets.subject: Excel export stops at about a million rows
tickets.description: A grocery chain exported a full year of line-item sales to Excel; the file ends abruptly at row 1,048,576 with no warning, while the on-screen count shows 1.4 million rows.
tickets.resolution_notes: Excel worksheets are capped at 1,048,576 rows, and the exporter truncated silently instead of continuing on another sheet. As an immediate workaround we advised exporting this volume to CSV; the exporter was later changed to spill onto additional sheets and display a notice. Confirmed the CSV contained all 1.4 million rows.

tickets.subject: Only processing one change per webhook since enabling batching
tickets.description: Since the customer turned on webhook batching to reduce request volume, their consumer seems to lose most inventory changes during busy periods.
tickets.resolution_notes: With batching on, each delivery carries an events array, but the consumer only read the first element. Updated the consumer to iterate the full array and acknowledge the batch only after all items are stored. Change counts in their system now match the delivery log.

tickets.subject: Regional managers lost editor rights overnight
tickets.description: A dozen regional managers who sign in through SSO were all downgraded to Viewer overnight, with no change on the customer's side that they know of.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's IT team had renamed the directory group 'Regional-Managers' to 'regional-managers', and our group-to-role mapping compared names case-sensitively, so it stopped matching and users fell back to the default role. Updated the mapping to the new name. Confirmed the managers had Editor again on their next sign-in.

tickets.subject: Add-in sign-in window closes immediately
tickets.description: Clicking 'Sign in' in the desktop spreadsheet add-in opens a small window that closes straight away. No error appears and the add-in stays signed out. The customer uses SSO.
tickets.resolution_notes: The add-in host blocked the pop-up that the SSO redirect needed, closing it before the identity provider page loaded. Workaround: the user signed in with the add-in's device-code option, which completes sign-in in a normal browser; a permanent fix that opens SSO in a supported dialog is planned for the next add-in version. The user was signed in and refreshing data the same day.

tickets.subject: 'View all dashboards' role can't see personal spaces
tickets.description: Auditors were given a custom role with 'View all dashboards', yet they cannot see dashboards in colleagues' personal spaces.
tickets.resolution_notes: 'View all dashboards' covers shared and team spaces; personal spaces are excluded by design. Rather than granting admin rights, the owners moved the dashboards the auditors needed into a team folder the auditors can view. Confirmed the auditors could open them.

tickets.subject: Printed recovery code not accepted
tickets.description: User is typing a recovery code from a printed sheet saved two years ago, and the login page says it is invalid.
tickets.resolution_notes: Codes generated in the older format mixed the digit zero and the capital letter O, and the user had typed the wrong one. After verifying the user, we pointed out the ambiguous character and they signed in with the code. They then generated a fresh set of recovery codes, which now use an alphabet without look-alike characters.

tickets.subject: Users removed in identity provider still active a week later
tickets.description: People removed from the app assignment in the customer's identity provider are still listed as active members of the workspace a week later.
tickets.resolution_notes: The identity provider sent SCIM updates setting 'active' to false, but our connector configuration ignored that attribute and handled only delete requests. Mapped the active attribute so deactivations are processed, and deactivated the nine affected users after confirming the list with the admin. Confirmed the next removal in the identity provider deactivated the user within minutes.

tickets.subject: One store had zero sales all day but no alert
tickets.description: A store's card terminals failed and it took almost no sales for a whole day. The customer's 'sales 30% below forecast' alert never fired.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule evaluated the total of all stores, and one store's loss barely moved the chain-wide figure. Enabled per-store evaluation ('for each store') so each store is compared with its own forecast. A replay of that day produced an alert for the affected store by mid-morning.

tickets.subject: Can't convert trial: 'Subscription cannot be created'
tickets.description: Customer wants to keep using the product after the trial, but the workspace locked on day 15 and the upgrade button returns 'Subscription cannot be created'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Trials started from a partner referral link were created with a billing account that had no currency set, so subscription creation failed. Set the billing currency and completed the upgrade. Confirmed the workspace unlocked with all trial dashboards intact.

tickets.subject: Auto-approval rule also approved contractors
tickets.description: An auto-approval rule meant for store managers has also been approving access requests from contractors.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule matched on email domain rather than group membership, and contractors share the company domain. Changed the rule to match the Store Managers group and, with the admin's approval, revoked the four contractor grants it had created. Confirmed a contractor's new request now waits for manual review.

tickets.subject: Conditional formatting colours lost in Excel export
tickets.description: Red and green conditional formatting on the margin table does not carry over into the Excel export.
tickets.resolution_notes: Cell styling is not exported by default, to keep files small. Enabled the 'Include cell styling' option on the widget. Confirmed the export showed the same red and green highlights.

tickets.subject: Recipients get the Monday KPI report twice
tickets.description: Store leads receive two identical copies of the Monday KPI report a few minutes apart.
tickets.resolution_notes: The dashboard had been duplicated, and the copy kept the original's schedule, so both dashboards emailed the same recipients. Removed the schedule from the copy at the owner's request. Confirmed recipients received a single report the following Monday.

tickets.subject: Basket analysis went from seconds to minutes overnight
tickets.description: Customer imported four years of historical transactions on Friday. From Monday, the basket analysis report takes about three minutes instead of five seconds.
tickets.resolution_notes: Table statistics had not been refreshed after the bulk import, so the planner still assumed the transactions table was small and chose nested-loop joins. Ran a statistics refresh on the affected tables and confirmed the planner switched to hash joins. The report loads in 5 seconds again.

tickets.subject: Stock levels lag a day after quarterly key rotation
tickets.description: Inventory on the store dashboard now trails reality by about a day. The customer's IT team mentions rotating integration keys in their commerce platform last week under a quarterly policy.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rotation included the event signing secret, so the connector rejected every inventory event and only the daily scheduled sync delivered changes. Updated the secret and added a connector-page warning when more than 5% of events fail verification within an hour. Inventory changes now arrive within two minutes.

tickets.subject: Replies to invitation emails bounce from no-reply
tickets.description: New users reply to invitation emails with questions, and their replies bounce back from the no-reply address.
tickets.resolution_notes: No reply-to address was configured for the workspace. Set it to the customer's helpdesk, helpdesk@quillfeather.example.com, once the verification email was confirmed. Replies now reach the helpdesk.

tickets.subject: Order notes with line breaks split rows in ERP import
tickets.description: Order notes that contain line breaks spread single orders across several rows when the CSV is loaded by the customer's ERP import tool.
tickets.resolution_notes: Fields containing newlines were quoted correctly, but the ERP importer does not support quoted newlines. Enabled the export option that replaces line breaks inside fields with spaces for this scheduled export. Confirmed the ERP import loaded one row per order.

tickets.subject: 'Trust this device' ignored, 2FA asked every morning
tickets.description: Users at a grocery chain tick 'Trust this device for 30 days' but still get a code prompt every single morning.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's managed browser policy deletes all cookies when the browser closes, which removed the device-trust cookie each evening. The customer's IT team added the app domain to the policy's list of sites allowed to keep cookies. Users were not prompted on the following two mornings.

tickets.subject: UK storefront absent from global sales dashboard
tickets.description: The global sales dashboard includes the US and Canadian storefronts but nothing from the UK site, which launched under the same organization account in the spring.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each storefront is a separate shop on the platform, and the organization-level connection only covered shops that existed when it was authorized. Re-authorized at organization level to include the UK shop and backfilled from its launch date. UK orders now appear and the global total matches the platform's organization report.

tickets.subject: Added seats prorated at new list price, not grandfathered rate
tickets.description: After the spring price change, a customer's newly added seats were prorated at the new per-seat price while all their existing seats remain on the grandfathered rate.
tickets.resolution_notes: The proration calculation looked up the current list price instead of the subscription's grandfathered price tier. Re-rated the added seats at the grandfathered price and credited the difference. Confirmed the corrected line matched the existing per-seat rate.

tickets.subject: Subscription renewed after we clicked Cancel
tickets.description: Customer says they clicked Cancel in Plan & Billing two weeks before renewal, got no confirmation, and were then charged for another year.
tickets.resolution_notes: Cancellation requires a confirmation step on a second screen, and the audit trail showed the customer opened the flow but closed the tab before confirming. Processed a full refund within the renewal refund window and cancelled the subscription as requested. Confirmed the refund was issued and the subscription status reads Cancelled.

tickets.subject: 'Your connection is not private' on our branded address
tickets.description: Customer's staff report a privacy warning when opening their branded analytics address, while the default app.example.net address works.
tickets.resolution_notes: The managed certificate for the custom domain had lapsed because its validation record was removed in a DNS tidy-up. Restored the record, re-triggered issuance and had the customer mark the record as required in their DNS inventory. The branded address now loads with a valid certificate.

tickets.subject: Store manager can see every store in the region
tickets.description: A store manager reported that she can see sales for every store in the North region, not just her own.
tickets.resolution_notes: She was also a member of the Regional Leads team for a temporary project, and that team's row-level rule allows all stores in the region; the most permissive rule applies. Removed her from Regional Leads at the admin's request. Confirmed she now sees only her own store.

tickets.subject: 422 on 'granularity' parameter
tickets.description: Customer gets 422 'granularity must be one of day, week, month' when sending granularity=Weekly in their report request.
tickets.resolution_notes: Enum values are lower-case and use the singular period name, so 'Weekly' does not match 'week'. Corrected the client's mapping and pointed the customer to the enum list in the reference. The weekly request now succeeds.

tickets.subject: Board pack email bounces as too large
tickets.description: The scheduled board pack with five PDF attachments bounces with '552 Message size exceeds fixed maximum message size'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The combined attachments reached 31 MB, over the recipient server's 25 MB limit. Switched the schedule to send one merged, compressed PDF and to send a link instead whenever a delivery exceeds 20 MB. Confirmed the next board pack was delivered at 9 MB.

tickets.subject: Cancelled export still emailed the file
tickets.description: A user cancelled a very large export in Export Center, but an hour later the file arrived by email anyway.
tickets.resolution_notes: Cancelling only hid the job from the list; the worker did not check for cancellation between chunks, so it finished and delivered the file. A cancellation check between chunks was added and the stale job was purged. Verified that a test export cancelled mid-run stopped and sent nothing.

tickets.subject: Live sales tiles stuck on 'Reconnecting…' at head office
tickets.description: Everyone at the customer's head office sees the real-time sales tiles show 'Reconnecting…' indefinitely, while the rest of each dashboard loads normally.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's explicit proxy did not permit HTTP Upgrade requests, so the WebSocket connection to live.example.net used by real-time tiles was refused. The proxy team enabled WebSocket upgrades for live.example.net. Live tiles now update within five seconds of a test sale.

tickets.subject: Confidential watermark missing from exported PDFs
tickets.description: Compliance requires a 'Confidential - internal' watermark on exported PDFs, but recent exports have none.
tickets.resolution_notes: The watermark was configured on the legacy export profile, while the new PDF renderer reads the current export policy, where the watermark was empty. Copied the watermark setting into the export policy. Confirmed new PDFs carry the watermark on every page.

tickets.subject: Forecasting add-on billed after removal
tickets.description: The Forecasting add-on was removed in Plan & Billing in January, but the February invoice still charges for it.
tickets.resolution_notes: The removal applied only to the workspace the admin had open; the add-on was also enabled on a second workspace under the same subscription. Removed it there too and credited February's charge as goodwill, because the screen implied account-wide removal. Confirmed the add-on no longer appears on the next invoice preview.

tickets.subject: No opportunities for the APAC region
tickets.description: The pipeline dashboard shows no APAC opportunities at all, although the CRM has hundreds. Every other region looks complete.
tickets.resolution_notes: The integration user in the customer's CRM had a role that only saw records shared within its own region hierarchy, which excluded APAC. The CRM admin granted the integration user read access to all regions. A full resync brought in 642 APAC opportunities.

tickets.subject: Internal users reach a retired page via our analytics subdomain
tickets.description: Staff on the corporate network opening analytics.copperleaf.example.com land on a retired intranet page, while external users reach the dashboards.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's internal DNS held an authoritative zone for copperleaf.example.com with an old A record for 'analytics', overriding the public CNAME to the product. The customer replaced the internal record with the same CNAME used publicly. Internal resolution now matches public DNS and staff reach the dashboards.

tickets.subject: 415 Unsupported Media Type when creating annotations
tickets.description: A low-code automation tool used by the customer gets 415 when posting annotations, though the same body works from their developer's command line.
tickets.resolution_notes: The automation tool sent the body as form-encoded data without a JSON content type. Configured the tool's HTTP step to send a raw JSON body with Content-Type: application/json. Annotations were created successfully from the tool afterwards.

tickets.subject: Stock-take corrections from store app never appear
tickets.description: Stock counts corrected through the e-commerce platform's mobile stock-take app never make it into our inventory dashboards. Edits made in the platform's web admin come through normally.
tickets.resolution_notes: The stock-take app writes adjustments without updating the product's 'updated at' field, so the incremental sync skipped them. Changed this connector to read the platform's inventory-adjustment feed as well as product updates. Corrections from the next store stock-take appeared within one sync cycle.

tickets.subject: No admin can reach the workspace after office IP change
tickets.description: Agent summary: the customer's only office changed public IP overnight, and every admin is now blocked by the workspace IP allow-list, so nobody can update it.
tickets.resolution_notes: The allow-list held only the previous office address. After verifying the request through the customer's registered security contact, support added the new address as a temporary entry with a 72-hour expiry; the customer then entered their confirmed permanent range and the temporary entry lapsed. Admin and user access were confirmed from the new address.

tickets.subject: Anomaly alerts silent for two weeks after editing the metric
tickets.description: Customer tweaked the definition of their 'net sales' metric to exclude gift cards, and afterwards their anomaly alerts on it didn't fire for two weeks, including during an obvious dip.
tickets.resolution_notes: Changing a metric's definition resets its anomaly baseline, and the rule silently went back into a 14-day learning period. We now show a 'learning' badge and notify the rule owner when this happens, and we retrained the baseline from historical data recomputed with the new definition. The rule was active the same day, and replaying the dip produced an alert.

tickets.subject: Discount amounts always one cent lower than the promotion engine
tickets.description: On percentage-off promotions, the discount amount in reports is exactly one cent below the promotion engine's figure on roughly half of orders.
tickets.resolution_notes: The calculated discount field truncated to two decimals instead of rounding, so any fraction of a cent was dropped. Changed it to round half-up, matching the promotion engine's documented behaviour, and recomputed promotion metrics. A sample of 500 orders now matches line by line.

tickets.subject: Two-week-old export no longer in Export Center
tickets.description: A user went to re-download an export from two weeks ago and it is no longer listed.
tickets.resolution_notes: Export Center keeps files for 7 days by default, and the customer's plan allows up to 30. The admin raised retention to 30 days; files already removed could not be recovered, so we re-ran the export. Confirmed the new file was listed with a 30-day expiry.

tickets.subject: Alert keeps bouncing between warning and critical
tickets.description: Customer's shrinkage alert sends a stream of 'escalated to critical' and 'downgraded to warning' messages through the day.
tickets.resolution_notes: The warning and critical thresholds were set at 90% and 92%, so normal variation crossed between severities constantly. Widened the gap (warning at 90%, critical at 97%) and enabled severity hysteresis so downgrades need the value to fall 2 points below the boundary. Severity changes dropped from dozens a day to one or two.

tickets.subject: One director sees revenue in the wrong currency
tickets.description: A sales director reports dashboard revenue in GBP while everyone else sees EUR, and suspects the conversion is broken.
tickets.resolution_notes: The director had a personal display currency of GBP, which overrides the workspace reporting currency. Reset it to 'Workspace currency' at the director's request. The director now sees EUR, matching colleagues.

tickets.subject: Custom domain 'not working' for most staff
tickets.description: The customer says their custom domain is broken because only admins get branded links, while everyone else still gets default-domain links.
tickets.resolution_notes: DNS and certificate checks were healthy. The custom domain was still in 'Preview for admins' rollout mode, which limits branded links to admins during testing. Switched the rollout to 'All members', and non-admin users now receive branded links.

tickets.subject: Reports due at 9:00 sharp arrive between 9:20 and 10:00
tickets.description: Customer schedules dozens of store reports for exactly 09:00 local time and says they trickle in over the next hour instead of arriving together.
tickets.resolution_notes: Many workspaces in the same time zone scheduled reports at exactly 09:00, creating a burst far above sustained capacity at that minute. Added pre-emptive scale-up ahead of known schedule peaks and began rendering data for fixed-time reports a few minutes early so delivery happens at the scheduled time. The customer's 09:00 reports now all arrive by 09:04.

tickets.subject: 28 February compared against 29 February last year
tickets.description: Customer noticed the day-over-year view pairs 28 February 2025 with 29 February 2024, while 28 February 2024 is never used as a comparison.
tickets.resolution_notes: Calendar-mode comparisons shifted dates by exactly 365 days, which mis-pairs dates around a leap day. Changed calendar-date alignment to match the same month and day, mapping 29 February to 28 February when comparing into a non-leap year. 28 February 2025 now compares with 28 February 2024.

tickets.subject: Brand palette not applied to charts
tickets.description: The admin entered the company brand colours in workspace branding. The navigation bar uses them, but every chart still has the default palette.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's dashboards had been created with an explicit 'Default' palette, which overrides the workspace brand palette. Changed their dashboards to 'Workspace brand' and made that the default for new dashboards. Charts now use the brand colours.

tickets.subject: Store office TV shows the sign-in page every morning
tickets.description: A sales dashboard left running on a TV in a store office is back on the sign-in page each morning. It was signed in with a manager's account the evening before.
tickets.resolution_notes: The dashboard's automatic refresh did not count as user activity, so the manager's session hit the idle timeout overnight. The admin created a TV display link, a read-only and revocable link meant for unattended screens, and opened it on the TV instead of a personal session. The display stayed live through the next three days.

tickets.subject: Like-for-like sales include a store that opened in March
tickets.description: The customer's comparable-store growth looks strong, but the comp set includes the new Riverside store, which only opened this March.
tickets.resolution_notes: Comp-store eligibility was based on the date the store record was created in the workspace, and the Riverside record had been created a year early during planning. Changed eligibility to use the store's actual opening date field and recalculated the comp set. Like-for-like growth fell from 5.1% to 3.4%, matching the customer's own comp calculation.

tickets.subject: Report link says 'This link has already been used'
tickets.description: Store managers clicking the download link in the weekly report email see 'This link has already been used', even the first time they open it.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's email security gateway opens every link to scan it, which consumed our single-use download tokens before the managers clicked. Rather than asking IT to relax scanning, switched the workspace to reusable links that last 7 days and require sign-in. Confirmed managers could open the next report's link.

tickets.subject: Dashboard date filter ignored by two widgets
tickets.description: When the customer sets the dashboard date filter to last quarter, most widgets update, but the 'Top stores' table and the 'Returns rate' chart keep showing the current month.
tickets.resolution_notes: Those two widgets had their own date range pinned in widget settings, which overrides the dashboard filter, and the small lock icon signalling this was easy to overlook. Unpinned the ranges at the customer's request and replaced the icon with a visible 'Fixed range' badge. All widgets now follow the dashboard date filter.

tickets.subject: Signature mismatch only for stores with accented names
tickets.description: The customer says webhook signatures validate for most events, but events about stores like 'Café Lumière' always fail verification.
tickets.resolution_notes: A body-parsing middleware in their receiver parsed the JSON and re-serialized it, escaping non-ASCII characters as \u sequences, so the bytes being verified differed from the signed bytes only when accented characters were present. Moved signature verification ahead of the middleware so it uses the raw request body. Events for accented store names now verify correctly.

tickets.subject: Agent uploads time out during the evening batch
tickets.description: Agent uploads from the customer's cloud-hosted server time out only during the 8 pm batch, when 40 stores upload at once.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's cloud NAT gateway ran out of source ports when the agent opened many parallel connections, so new connections were dropped. Enabled connection reuse in the agent and reduced parallel streams, and the customer increased the NAT port allocation. The evening batch has completed without timeouts for a week.

tickets.subject: Editors adding groups to dashboard share lists
tickets.description: The customer expected only owners to change sharing, but editors have been adding new groups to dashboards' share lists.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace setting 'Editors can manage sharing' was on, the default for workspaces created before last year. Turned it off at the admin's request. Confirmed editors could still edit content but the share dialog was read-only for them.

tickets.subject: ERP connector fails authentication after password rotation
tickets.description: Right after the customer's ERP admin changed their password as part of a quarterly rotation, the ERP connector began failing with 'Authentication failed (401)'.
tickets.resolution_notes: This ERP connector used basic credentials, so the stored password became invalid after the rotation. The admin updated the stored credentials and, at our suggestion, switched the connection to the ERP's token-based authentication, which does not depend on password rotation. The next sync succeeded and pulled the full day's sales invoices.

tickets.subject: Annotation create fails with unknown_field 'notes'
tickets.description: Customer's integration adds a 'notes' property when creating chart annotations and receives 400 'unknown_field: notes'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The annotation endpoint validates strictly and does not accept extra top-level properties. Advised placing free text in the 'description' field and custom values in the metadata object. Their integration now creates annotations with the notes preserved in description.

tickets.subject: Active stores tile says 219 for a 212-store chain
tickets.description: Customer has 212 stores but the 'Active stores' tile shows 219; the extra entries look like existing stores spelled in capitals.
tickets.resolution_notes: The tile counted distinct store names, and two sources supplied some names in upper case ('MAPLE RIDGE' versus 'Maple Ridge') or with stray spaces. Counting now uses distinct store IDs, and labels are normalised for case and whitespace on load. The tile shows 212.

tickets.subject: Half the ultra-wide monitor left empty
tickets.description: On a 3440-pixel-wide monitor the dashboard fills only the left half and the right side stays blank.
tickets.resolution_notes: The grid had a 1920-pixel maximum width intended to keep charts readable on large screens. Added a 'Fit to width' view option that lets the grid expand on wide displays. The customer's analysts enabled it, and the dashboard now fills their monitors.

tickets.subject: Chat alert cut off halfway through the store list
tickets.description: When many stores breach at once, the customer's chat alert stops mid-sentence partway through the store list, so they can't see which other stores are affected.
tickets.resolution_notes: The message included every breaching store and exceeded the chat tool's message length limit, so it was truncated. Changed the chat format to show the top 10 stores with a count of the rest and a link to the full list in the app. A test with 60 breaching stores posted a complete message.

tickets.subject: Promotions report adds up to more than total sales
tickets.description: The revenue column of the Promotions report sums to 112% of the store's total revenue for the same period.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each order was attributed in full to every promotion code applied to it, so stacked promotions double-counted revenue. Switched the report to allocate an order's revenue across its codes in proportion to each code's discount, with unallocated attributed revenue available as a clearly labelled option. Allocated totals now sum to 100% of promoted-order revenue.

tickets.subject: 'Invalid reset token' when link is copied from plain-text email
tickets.description: User reads mail in a plain-text client and copies the reset URL into the browser; the page says the token is invalid. The link in the same email works when tapped on their phone.
tickets.resolution_notes: The plain-text version of the email wrapped the long reset URL onto two lines, so the user only copied the first part of the token. Shortened reset URLs so they fit on one line in plain-text mail and advised copying the full link in the meantime. The user's next reset link worked from the desktop client.

tickets.subject: App unreachable for a day after maintenance window
tickets.description: After our scheduled edge maintenance, the customer's offices could not reach app.example.net for about 24 hours, while their remote staff were unaffected.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's internal resolvers enforced a minimum cache time of 24 hours, overriding the record's 5-minute TTL, so they kept serving retired edge addresses after the maintenance. Their DNS team flushed the cache and removed the minimum-TTL override for external zones. Resolution now follows the published TTL.

tickets.subject: Only the icon part of the logo shows; wordmark missing
tickets.description: After uploading the brand-kit SVG, only the leaf icon appears in the header and on shared dashboards, without the company wordmark beside it.
tickets.resolution_notes: The wordmark in that SVG was a linked image pointing at a file on the designer's machine, and linked resources are stripped during upload sanitisation. Exporting the SVG with the wordmark embedded as paths fixed it. The full logo now appears in the header and on shares.

tickets.subject: Same shopper counted as two customers
tickets.description: Customer's CRM manager found that shoppers who once typed their email with a capital letter are counted as separate customers, inflating new-customer counts.
tickets.resolution_notes: Email comparison in identity matching was case-sensitive, so 'Shopper.One@example.org' and 'shopper.one@example.org' produced two profiles. Lower-cased and trimmed emails before matching and re-resolved profiles. New-customer counts for the last quarter fell by 3.8%, and a sample of 50 merged pairs was confirmed as the same person in the CRM.

tickets.subject: Bulk job never calls our callback URL
tickets.description: Customer passes callback_url when starting bulk jobs and says their endpoint is never called when jobs finish, so they poll instead.
tickets.resolution_notes: The callback_url parameter was removed in v2 and is ignored; job completion is now signalled through the bulk_job.completed webhook event. Subscribed their endpoint to that event and removed the parameter from their requests. The next bulk job triggered the event within seconds of finishing.

tickets.subject: Hourly chart shows 01:00 twice on the night clocks changed
tickets.description: On the hourly footfall chart for the night the clocks went back, the axis shows 01:00 twice and the bars look duplicated. Store staff assumed the counter had double-counted.
tickets.resolution_notes: The data held two distinct hours, before and after the change, but the axis showed the local hour without its offset, so the repeated hour looked like a duplicate. Labels for repeated hours now include the offset, such as '01:00 BST' and '01:00 GMT'. The chart for that night reads clearly, and its totals matched the counter's own export.

tickets.subject: Alert emails quarantined by customer's mail gateway
tickets.description: Customer's IT team reports our alert emails started landing in quarantine on Monday with the reason 'sender authentication failed'. Other emails from us are fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: Alert emails had moved to a new sending subdomain, alerts.example.com, which was missing DKIM signing on our side, so strict receiving policies quarantined them. Enabled and published DKIM for the subdomain. The customer's gateway accepted the next test alert with authentication passing, and no exemption was needed on their side.

tickets.subject: Editor can't edit the dashboard she created yesterday
tickets.description: An editor gets 'You don't have permission to edit this dashboard' on a dashboard she created the day before.
tickets.resolution_notes: She had created it in a folder where her team has Contribute rights, and that folder was set so creators keep only view access after creation. With the folder owner's agreement, enabled 'Creator keeps edit rights'. Confirmed she could edit her dashboard.

tickets.subject: Monthly sales export ends with 'Export limit reached'
tickets.description: A Starter-plan customer's monthly sales export stops at 50 MB with 'Export limit reached' written in the last row; they did not know any limit existed.
tickets.resolution_notes: Starter exports are limited to 50 MB per file, a limit shown in Plan & Billing but not in the export dialog. Helped the customer split the export by region so each file stays under the limit, and requested that the limit be shown in the dialog. Confirmed four regional files covered the full month.

tickets.subject: Low stock alert never triggers
tickets.description: A store ran out of a top-selling item over the weekend and nobody was notified, although the customer has a low-stock alert on that product family set to 20 units.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule's operator was 'greater than 20' instead of 'less than 20'. Stock had been above 20 since the rule was created, so the rule sat in the alerting state after a single notification months earlier, and the stock-out actually moved it back to OK. Corrected the operator to 'less than'. Confirmed the alert fired once when a test store's stock was set to 15.

tickets.subject: Alerts fired during planned overnight store maintenance
tickets.description: Customer scheduled a maintenance window from 01:00 to 04:00 local time for a till system upgrade, but the store teams still got 'no transactions' alerts at 01:30.
tickets.resolution_notes: The maintenance window was saved in UTC rather than the rule's time zone (UTC+2), so it ran from 03:00 to 06:00 local. Fixed the schedule editor to store windows in the rule's time zone and corrected the customer's existing windows. A test window created afterwards suppressed alerts at the intended local time.

tickets.subject: Store metrics endpoint fails for newly opened stores
tickets.description: Customer's integration gets 500 from /v2/stores/{id}/metrics for three stores that opened this week. Established stores return fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: Average basket value divided revenue by transaction count, and stores with zero transactions caused an unhandled division by zero. As a temporary workaround the customer requested only the totals fields for stores without trading history, which avoids the average calculation; the permanent fix returning null averages for zero-transaction stores was deployed nine days later. All three stores now return 200 with the full field set.

tickets.subject: Usage page shows 2 million queries a day for 40 users
tickets.description: The customer's admin noticed in the usage page that the workspace runs roughly 2 million queries per day even though only about 40 people use it, and dashboards have felt slower lately.
tickets.resolution_notes: Several dashboards had a 30-second auto-refresh and were left open in background tabs, which kept refreshing even when nobody was looking. Changed the product to pause auto-refresh when the tab is hidden and resume on focus, and raised the refresh interval on those dashboards. Daily queries fell to around 300,000 and dashboard latency improved.

tickets.subject: Only the export endpoint returns 429
tickets.description: Customer reports POST /v2/exports returns 429 after about ten calls, while all other endpoints work normally. They create one export per store, around 300 per night.
tickets.resolution_notes: Export creation has its own lower limit of 10 requests per minute because each request starts a heavy job. Showed the customer the multi-store export request that accepts a list of store IDs and produces one file per store. Their nightly run now needs 3 requests instead of 300 and completes without throttling.

tickets.subject: Weekly inventory shows seven times the stock
tickets.description: Switching the Inventory module from the daily to the weekly view multiplies stock on hand by about seven.
tickets.resolution_notes: Stock on hand is a snapshot measure, but the weekly rollup summed the daily snapshots instead of taking the last day of the week. Set the measure's time aggregation to end-of-period and recomputed rollups. Weekly stock on hand now equals the closing Sunday snapshot.

tickets.subject: Some users never prompted after 2FA became mandatory
tickets.description: The admin made 2FA mandatory a week ago, but the enrollment report still lists 17 users without a second factor, and those users say they were never asked.
tickets.resolution_notes: Enforcement took effect at each user's next sign-in, and those users still had long-lived sessions from before the change. After notifying staff, the admin used 'Sign out all sessions' so everyone re-authenticated, and enforcement now also ends existing password-only sessions within 24 hours. All 17 users had enrolled within two days.

tickets.subject: Loyalty figures frozen after connector owner changed roles
tickets.description: Loyalty points and member counts stopped updating. The agent found the connection was owned by a marketing manager whose loyalty-platform login was disabled when they moved to another department.
tickets.resolution_notes: Disabling the manager's login on the loyalty platform revoked the token our connector used. The customer re-authorized under a shared integration login with read-only scope. The next scheduled sync completed and member counts matched the platform's own report.

tickets.subject: Year-two invoice missing multi-year commitment discount
tickets.description: Procurement flagged that the 20% discount for their three-year commitment appears on the first year's invoice but not on year two's.
tickets.resolution_notes: Year two was generated as a new subscription term, and the commitment discount, held on the first term's record, did not carry over. Because migrating contract discounts to account level was still in progress, applied a manual credit equal to the discount as an interim measure; the permanent migration was scheduled for the next billing release. Confirmed the net amount due matched the order form.

tickets.subject: Invitation emails link to the default domain
tickets.description: New users invited this week receive emails linking to app.example.net instead of the customer's own analytics address, which their security training tells them to distrust.
tickets.resolution_notes: The custom domain was active, but link generation still used the default domain because the custom-domain link setting was off. Turned on 'Use custom domain in links and emails' and sent a fresh invitation to confirm. The invitation link uses the custom domain.

tickets.subject: Checkout latency alert jumps on and off
tickets.description: Customer's web checkout latency alert, evaluated per minute, goes on and off many times an hour during normal trading.
tickets.resolution_notes: Per-minute latency values are naturally noisy, so single slow minutes repeatedly crossed the threshold. Changed the rule to evaluate a 10-minute rolling average and kept per-minute values available on the dashboard. The alert now fires only for sustained slowdowns, confirmed during a planned load test.

tickets.subject: New Singapore workspace uses US dates and a Sunday week start
tickets.description: The workspace set up last week for the Singapore team shows MM/DD dates and weeks starting on Sunday, unlike the team's previous workspace.
tickets.resolution_notes: It was created from the corporate workspace template, which carries English (US) date and week settings into every new workspace. Set this workspace to English (Singapore) with a Monday week start; the customer chose to leave the template unchanged for now. The team confirmed dates and weeks look as expected.

tickets.subject: Nightly integration fails with 401 invalid_api_key
tickets.description: Customer's nightly job that pulls sales into their planning tool started failing with 401 'invalid_api_key' on Tuesday. Nobody changed the job.
tickets.resolution_notes: The key had been created by an analyst who left the company on Monday; deactivating their account revoked all keys they owned, as designed. Helped the admin create a service account with only the read scopes the job needs and issue a new key from it. The job ran successfully that night.

tickets.subject: Store closed for refit still in the comparable-store set
tickets.description: Customer's comp sales dropped two points in August, and they traced it to the Elm Street store, which was closed for six weeks for a refit.
tickets.resolution_notes: Comp-store logic only excluded stores by opening date and ignored temporary closures recorded in the store calendar. Added exclusion of stores closed longer than the customer's 7-day threshold in either the current or comparison period and recalculated. August comp growth is now 2.9%, in line with the customer's finance pack.

tickets.subject: 'Uncategorized' share jumped after spring collection launch
tickets.description: About 14% of revenue fell into 'Uncategorized' on the Merchandising dashboard within a week of the customer launching their spring collection.
tickets.resolution_notes: Category assignment relied on a SKU-prefix lookup table, and the new collection used a prefix (SS26-) that was not in it. Switched the mapping to the category attribute supplied on each product record, keeping prefixes only as a fallback, and reclassified the affected products. The Uncategorized share dropped to 0.3%, all of it genuinely uncategorised gift cards.

tickets.subject: Live order ticker now updates only overnight
tickets.description: The live sales ticker used to update within a minute of each online order. Since Wednesday, new orders only appear after the nightly sync.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer rotated the webhook signing secret in their e-commerce admin, and our connector still verified events against the old secret, so it rejected every one. Updated the secret in the connector settings. Live orders began appearing within a minute again and the rejected-events counter returned to zero.

tickets.subject: No webhook when scheduled reports are delivered
tickets.description: Customer wants their workflow tool to react when a scheduled report is sent, but no events arrive. Their subscription does receive export events.
tickets.resolution_notes: The subscription included export.completed but not report.delivered, which is a separate event type. Added report.delivered to the subscription. The next scheduled delivery triggered the event and the workflow ran.

tickets.subject: Deploy pipeline creating duplicate chart annotations
tickets.description: Customer's release pipeline posts an annotation for each deployment. Some charts now show two or three identical 'Release' markers for the same deploy.
tickets.resolution_notes: The pipeline's HTTP step had a 5-second timeout and retried the POST without an Idempotency-Key, so slow but successful requests were repeated. Added an Idempotency-Key derived from the deployment ID and raised the client timeout. The next ten deployments each created exactly one annotation; we also removed the duplicates.

tickets.subject: Phone push alerts stopped after getting a new phone
tickets.description: A district manager gets alerts by email but no longer gets push notifications in the mobile app since switching to a new phone.
tickets.resolution_notes: Alert pushes were still being sent to the old device's push token, and the new phone had notifications disabled for the app at the operating system level. The manager enabled notifications and signed in again, which registered the new device, and we cleaned up the stale token. A test alert arrived on the new phone within seconds.

tickets.subject: Every webhook fails signature check since moving behind new gateway
tickets.description: Customer's team moved their webhook receiver behind a new API gateway last week. Since then, every event fails their HMAC signature verification and is discarded.
tickets.resolution_notes: The gateway's request transformation step parsed the JSON body and re-serialized it, changing whitespace and key order before the receiver computed the HMAC. Advised verifying the signature against the raw body bytes before any parsing, or disabling the transformation for that route. After they disabled it, signatures validated for all test and live events.

tickets.subject: Accented store names garbled after daily file upload
tickets.description: Store names with accents such as 'Café Central' appear as 'CafÃ© Central' after each daily file upload, even though the file looks right in the customer's spreadsheet tool.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's export saved files in Windows-1252 encoding, while the upload connection assumed UTF-8. Added encoding detection to file uploads and set this connection to Windows-1252 explicitly. Reprocessed the last 30 days of files, and all 214 store names now read correctly.

tickets.subject: Departed manager's public dashboard link still opens
tickets.description: A security review found that a public link to the margin dashboard, created by a manager who left last month, still opens without sign-in.
tickets.resolution_notes: Deactivating a user did not revoke the public links they had created. Revoked the link at the admin's request and gave the admin a list of six other active links created by deactivated users, which they also revoked; the deactivation flow was later changed to disable a departing user's public links. Confirmed the margin dashboard link returns 'Link disabled'.

tickets.subject: Queries got slower after we deleted most of our old data
tickets.description: Customer purged data older than two years to meet their retention policy, removing about 70% of rows, and expected dashboards to get faster. Instead several got slower.
tickets.resolution_notes: Statistics still described the pre-purge table, so the planner overestimated row counts and chose plans suited to a much larger table. Refreshed statistics and changed the automatic refresh trigger to fire on large deletes as well as inserts. Dashboards are now faster than before the purge.

tickets.subject: User still locked out after admin unlock
tickets.description: The customer's admin unlocked a user on the users page, but the user still sees 'Your account is locked' when signing in through SSO.
tickets.resolution_notes: The message came from the customer's identity provider, which had its own lockout after failed password attempts; the workspace lock had already been cleared. The customer's IdP administrator unlocked the directory account. The user signed in through SSO immediately afterwards.

tickets.subject: Store managers' reset tokens redeemed seconds after delivery
tickets.description: Store managers at a pharmacy chain click the reset link and land on an error page. Agent review of the audit log showed each token had been redeemed from 198.51.100.23 within five seconds of the email being sent, long before anyone clicked.
tickets.resolution_notes: The address belonged to the link-protection service in the customer's mail platform, which fetches every URL in inbound mail. This release changed reset links to open a confirmation page that redeems the token only when the user presses 'Set new password', so automated fetches no longer invalidate it. Sent fresh reset emails after the update and confirmed three store managers completed the reset on the first attempt.

tickets.subject: Alerts went quiet after dataset migration
tickets.description: Customer moved their sales reporting to a new dataset last month. Since then their margin alerts haven't fired once, and the rules show a grey 'No data' badge.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rules still pointed at the archived dataset, which no longer receives data, and their no-data setting was OK, so nothing fired. Repointed the 14 rules to the new dataset after confirming metric names matched, and the rules list now warns when a rule's source dataset is archived. The rules evaluated normally on the next run and one fired for a real margin drop.

tickets.subject: Trading-hours alert firing an hour before stores open
tickets.description: Since the clocks went forward, the customer's 'no sales during trading hours' alert fires at 08:00 every day, an hour before their stores open at 09:00.
