tickets.resolution_notes: The rule's active hours were stored as a fixed UTC offset from when it was created in winter, so after the daylight saving change the window started an hour early. Converted the rule to use a named time zone so it follows daylight saving automatically. The next morning the rule became active at 09:00 local time.

tickets.subject: Pivot table freezes browser tab
tickets.description: When the customer expands all rows on a pivot of sales by store and SKU (about 80,000 rows), the browser tab freezes for close to a minute. The request itself shows complete in the network panel after about a second.
tickets.resolution_notes: The pivot component rendered every row into the page at once rather than only the visible rows. Enabled row virtualization for pivots above 1,000 rows. Expanding all rows now responds in under 2 seconds and scrolling is smooth.

tickets.subject: Plan badge and invoice still say Business after downgrade request
tickets.description: Customer asked to downgrade on 3 March. The April invoice was at the Business rate and the workspace still shows the Business badge.
tickets.resolution_notes: The downgrade was held in a pending state because the workspace still used two premium connectors that Growth does not include, and the warning was only visible to the admin who submitted the request. Helped the admin replace the premium connectors, after which the downgrade completed, and credited April's price difference because the request date was documented. Confirmed the May draft invoice used Growth pricing.

tickets.subject: Chart zoom resets on every auto-refresh
tickets.description: Analysts zoom into a two-week window on the live sales chart, but every five minutes the auto-refresh zooms back out to the full month.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each refresh rebuilt the chart from scratch and discarded the zoom state. The chart now keeps the user's zoom range across refreshes until they reset it. Zoom stayed fixed through an hour of refreshes in testing with the customer.

tickets.subject: Store managers receiving other stores' alerts
tickets.description: Customer's store managers complain they get alerts for every store in their region, not just their own. The customer was worried it might be a permissions problem.
tickets.resolution_notes: The route used the {region} placeholder for the recipient lookup instead of {store}, so each alert went to all managers in the region. Changed the placeholder to {store}. Each manager now receives only their store's alerts; dashboard access had been correct throughout.

tickets.subject: Cloned role can't create alerts though the original can
tickets.description: The admin cloned the Analyst role to create Senior Analyst, but users with the new role cannot create alerts, although Analysts can.
tickets.resolution_notes: Cloning copied permissions from a cached role template that predated the 'Create alerts' permission. Added the permission to Senior Analyst, and the clone function was fixed to read the live role. Confirmed Senior Analysts could create alerts.

tickets.subject: Historical load blocks yesterday's sales from arriving
tickets.description: A newly connected store group's historical load is still running on day three, and yesterday's sales aren't appearing because the daily sync is queued behind it.
tickets.resolution_notes: Backfill and incremental syncs shared one queue per connection, so the long historical load blocked daily updates. Enabled incremental sync to run alongside a backfill, writing recent data first. Yesterday's sales appeared within the hour, and the backfill finished the next day.

tickets.subject: London store sales counted as dollars without conversion
tickets.description: The customer's regional controller noticed the London flagship's sales enter the USD rollup at face value, so £10,000 of sales appears as $10,000.
tickets.resolution_notes: Orders from that store arrived with an empty currency code, and the conversion step defaulted empty codes to the workspace reporting currency instead of the store's currency. As a workaround we added a per-store currency default (London = GBP) and recomputed 60 days of aggregates; a permanent fix that derives currency from the store record whenever the order field is blank is scheduled. The London store's July total now converts correctly against the controller's ledger.

tickets.subject: Staff can't choose their own interface language
tickets.description: Spanish-speaking store staff can't find a language option in their profile, so the interface is English for everyone.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace had 'Enforce workspace language' enabled, which hides the personal language picker. Changed the language policy to 'Workspace default, users may override'. Staff can now select Spanish while the default remains English.

tickets.subject: Android app signs users out whenever it is backgrounded
tickets.description: On some Android phones the app demands a fresh sign-in every time users switch away and come back. iPhone users at the same customer stay signed in for days.
tickets.resolution_notes: The app saved its refreshed session token only on a clean exit, and aggressive battery management on those devices killed the app before that happened. An app update now writes the token as soon as it is refreshed. Affected users stayed signed in after repeatedly backgrounding the updated app.

tickets.subject: Days-to-target pacing too optimistic since the new year
tickets.description: Store target pacing has looked too rosy since January because it assumes more working days than the stores actually have.
tickets.resolution_notes: The custom business calendar only listed holidays up to December 2025, so the new year had no holidays and more working days than reality. Imported the 2026 holiday list and set a reminder in calendar settings to load the next year's dates each November. Pacing now uses the correct working-day count.

tickets.subject: Barcodes lose their last digits after product file import
tickets.description: After importing the product master file, many barcodes end in 000 and several unrelated products now share the same barcode.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's spreadsheet tool had written the 13-digit barcode column in scientific notation (5.01234567891E+12), and our importer parsed those values as numbers with only 12 significant digits. The customer re-exported the file with the column formatted as text, and the importer now rejects identifier columns containing scientific notation with a clear error. After reloading, all 8,410 barcodes are unique and match the shelf labels.

tickets.subject: Need invoice lines split by store region cost center
tickets.description: The customer's finance team needs the seats on each invoice grouped by cost center, one per store region, so they can allocate the subscription internally.
tickets.resolution_notes: Enabled cost-center tagging on users in Billing Center, helped the admin tag the 64 seats by region and turned on invoice grouping by cost center. Confirmed the next invoice preview listed the seats under four cost centers with subtotals.

tickets.subject: Pivot widget exports as a long flat list
tickets.description: Exporting a pivot widget to Excel produces a long flat list instead of the cross-tab layout seen on the dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: Pivot widgets exported their underlying rows by default. Selected 'Export as displayed' for the pivot widget. Confirmed the Excel file kept the cross-tab layout with row and column headers.

tickets.subject: Two managers see identical weekly totals despite different week starts
tickets.description: Two regional managers with identical access compare the same shared dashboard. One has weeks starting on Sunday and the other on Monday, yet both see exactly the same weekly totals, and for the Sunday-start manager they do not match her own Sunday-to-Saturday figures.
tickets.resolution_notes: The results cache key ignored each user's 'week starts on' preference, so a manager whose week starts on Sunday was served results cached for a Monday-start week. Added the preference to the cache key. Each manager now sees totals matching their own week start, and the week boundaries are shown in the widget subtitle.

tickets.subject: Products listed twice after catalog re-import
tickets.description: A sporting goods retailer re-imported their catalog in their e-commerce admin to fix descriptions. The product performance dashboard now lists many items twice, one row holding all historic sales and another holding only recent ones.
tickets.resolution_notes: The re-import gave every product a new platform ID, and the connector keyed products on that ID, so re-imported items looked like new products. Switched the key to SKU for this connection and merged the duplicate pairs so their sales history stays together. Each product now appears once with its complete history.

tickets.subject: Australian store revenue more than doubled after enabling multi-currency
tickets.description: Right after the customer switched on multi-currency reporting, revenue for their two Sydney stores jumped to roughly 2.3 times the POS totals while every US store looked normal.
tickets.resolution_notes: The AUD row in the rate table was stored as AUD per USD, but the conversion treated it as USD per AUD, so amounts were multiplied by the inverse rate. Corrected the rate orientation, added a check that rejects rates whose orientation disagrees with the provider's base currency, and recomputed the affected days. Sydney revenue now matches the POS Z-reports to within a cent per day.

tickets.subject: Weekly reports landing in spam after sender change
tickets.description: After report emails moved to a new sending subdomain (reports.example.com), the customer's recipients started finding the weekly report in their spam folders.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's mail system had a rule trusting only our previous sender address. Provided the new sending domain and its authentication records so their mail team could update the rule. Confirmed the next week's reports reached inboxes.

tickets.subject: Some webhook deliveries rejected with 413
tickets.description: Customer sees intermittent 413 Payload Too Large responses from their own endpoint for catalog.updated events. Small updates go through fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: Large catalogue updates produced payloads up to 4 MB, above the 1 MB body limit configured on the customer's receiving proxy. Enabled thin payloads for the subscription, which send the event metadata plus a link to fetch the full change list through the API. All catalog.updated deliveries now succeed and their consumer fetches details on demand.

tickets.subject: All SSO users fail with signature validation error
tickets.description: On Monday morning every user at the customer gets 'Signature validation failed' when signing in through SSO. It worked on Friday.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's identity provider rotated its SAML signing certificate over the weekend, and the workspace SSO settings still held the old certificate. The admin downloaded the new IdP metadata and uploaded it on the SSO settings page. SSO sign-in succeeded for the admin and a sample of users immediately afterwards.

tickets.subject: Renewal confirmation quotes standard rate for campus store
tickets.description: A university bookstore received its renewal confirmation email at the standard price; the education pricing it has always had is gone.
tickets.resolution_notes: Education pricing was stored only on the expired subscription term, so the newly generated term fell back to standard rates. Applied the education discount at account level, voided the standard-rate invoice and re-sent the renewal confirmation. The customer confirmed the new confirmation matched last year's price.

tickets.subject: Weekly store KPIs frozen; connector paused with no warning
tickets.description: Weekly store KPIs stopped updating and the customer's analytics lead received no warning at all. The status page reads 'Paused – too many errors'.
tickets.resolution_notes: A series of expired-credential failures auto-paused the connection, and the only notification recipient was a deactivated user, so the warnings went unseen. Re-authorized, resumed and backfilled the connection, and notifications now also go to all workspace admins whenever the listed recipient is inactive. KPIs updated the next morning.

tickets.subject: Conditional formatting visible in editor, not on dashboard
tickets.description: The analyst set red and green conditional formatting on the margin column. It shows in the widget editor but not on the published dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: The published view loaded the table from a saved snapshot of widget settings that predated the formatting rules. Saving a widget now also refreshes the published snapshot. Red and green cells now appear on the dashboard.

tickets.subject: Agent uploads but never picks up configuration changes
tickets.description: The customer changed the agent's schedule in the product a week ago, but the on-prem agent keeps running the old schedule and shows 'unmanaged' in the console.
tickets.resolution_notes: The egress allow-list included the data hostname but not agents.example.net, which the agent uses to fetch its configuration, so it kept running on cached settings. The network team added the control-plane hostname. The agent showed 'managed' and applied the new schedule.

tickets.subject: German-language users receive no password reset email
tickets.description: Only users whose interface language is German never get password reset emails, according to the customer. English and French users at the same company are unaffected.
tickets.resolution_notes: A template refresh omitted the German variant of the reset email, and the send job failed for those users instead of falling back. Restored the German template and added an English fallback whenever a localized template is missing. A German-language user received the reset email within a minute and completed the reset.

tickets.subject: Download CSV always returns exactly 100,000 rows
tickets.description: Customer says the Download CSV button on the Transactions table returns exactly 100,000 rows, although the table reports 340,000.
tickets.resolution_notes: Instant downloads are capped at 100,000 rows; larger tables need the 'Export full dataset' option, which runs as a background job, and the cap was only documented in the help centre. Showed the admin the background option, and a banner now appears when the cap is hit. Confirmed the background export delivered all 340,000 rows.

tickets.subject: Real-time orders stopped after app reinstall
tickets.description: After the store owner reinstalled our app in their e-commerce admin, the live order feed went quiet. Scheduled syncs still work.
tickets.resolution_notes: Reinstalling the app removed its event subscriptions in the store, and the install flow did not recreate them. Recreated the order and inventory subscriptions and changed the install flow to register them automatically. Live orders resumed immediately, and the subscriptions survived a test reinstall.

tickets.subject: Portuguese interface uses European terms for Brazilian users
tickets.description: Brazilian users report the interface says 'ecrã' and 'utilizador' instead of 'tela' and 'usuário'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace language was set to Portuguese (Portugal) instead of Portuguese (Brazil). Changed it to pt-BR. Users now see Brazilian Portuguese terms throughout.

tickets.subject: Gift card liability shows the opening balance at month end
tickets.description: Finance says the 'Outstanding gift card balance' tile for June shows the balance as of 1 June rather than 30 June.
tickets.resolution_notes: The balance measure had been configured with a 'first value' time aggregation instead of 'last value', so each period showed its opening balance. Switched it to last value and recomputed history. June now shows the 30 June balance, matching the gift card ledger.

tickets.subject: Alert emails show '{{metric.vlaue}}' instead of the number
tickets.description: Customer customised their alert email template and now every email shows the literal text {{metric.vlaue}} where the metric value should be.
tickets.resolution_notes: The template variable was misspelled, and unknown variables were rendered as literal text. Corrected it to {{metric.value}} and the template editor now validates variable names before saving. The next alert email showed the correct value.

tickets.subject: Year-over-year compares Black Friday with last year's Thanksgiving
tickets.description: With the retail 4-5-4 calendar enabled, the customer's daily YoY comparison still lined up 28 November 2025 against 28 November 2024, which was Thanksgiving Day, so Black Friday showed +180%.
tickets.resolution_notes: The day-level comparison used calendar-date alignment even though the workspace calendar was retail 4-5-4, which should align on the same fiscal week and weekday (364 days back). Fixed the comparison to honour the workspace calendar's alignment rule and recomputed. Black Friday 2025 is now compared with Black Friday 2024 and shows +6.4%.

tickets.subject: Indian digit grouping and lakh/crore abbreviations
tickets.description: The customer's Mumbai team wants revenue shown as 12,34,567 and abbreviated in lakh and crore rather than K and M.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace used international digit grouping. Set the number format to English (India) and compact notation to 'Indian (L/Cr)'. Tiles show values like ₹1.2 Cr and tables use 12,34,567 grouping.

tickets.subject: Subsidiary workspace's currency reverts to EUR on save
tickets.description: The UK subsidiary admin changes reporting currency to GBP and saves, but after a reload the setting shows EUR again.
tickets.resolution_notes: Child workspaces inherit reporting currency from the parent organisation, where the setting was locked, so the child's change was discarded. The parent organisation admin unlocked currency for child workspaces and the subsidiary admin set GBP. The setting now persists after reload.

tickets.subject: Loyalty tier stops updating; warning cites unknown column
tickets.description: Every CRM sync now ends 'Completed with warnings', and customer records no longer update their loyalty tier. The warning text mentions an unknown column.
tickets.resolution_notes: A CRM admin deleted the loyalty_tier field and recreated it with the same label but a different internal name, which broke the existing mapping. Mapped the new internal name and made mapping errors appear on the connector page instead of only as a log warning. Loyalty tiers updated on the next sync for all 12,600 customers.

tickets.subject: Daily revenue alert firing in the middle of the afternoon
tickets.description: Customer's 'daily revenue below 10,000' alert keeps going off at odd times like 14:00, when the day is far from finished.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule used a rolling 24-hour window evaluated hourly, so at 14:00 it compared the last 24 hours, which could dip below the threshold after a slow previous evening. The customer wanted calendar-day revenue, so switched the rule to calendar-day aggregation evaluated after closing time. Over the next week it fired only on one genuinely weak day.

tickets.subject: Card statement amount differs from GBP estimate at checkout
tickets.description: Checkout showed an estimated price in pounds, but the subscription was charged in dollars and the pound amount on the card statement came out higher.
tickets.resolution_notes: Checkout shows a converted estimate to browsers in the UK, while the subscription is priced in USD and the card issuer applied its own exchange rate. Explained the difference and offered GBP pricing from renewal, which the customer accepted. Confirmed the renewal preview shows GBP.

tickets.subject: Authenticator codes rejected every time
tickets.description: User says every six-digit code from their authenticator app is refused with 'Incorrect code', even when typed the moment it appears.
tickets.resolution_notes: Automatic time was switched off on the user's phone and its clock had fallen about three minutes behind, so codes were generated for the wrong time window. The user re-enabled network time on the phone. The next code was accepted.

tickets.subject: Short promo spikes page the team for nothing
tickets.description: Customer's 'refund requests above 30 per 5 minutes' rule pages the team whenever a promotion email goes out, but the spike always fades within a few minutes.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule fired on the first breaching evaluation, so brief, expected spikes triggered pages. Added a 15-minute pending period so a breach must persist before notifying. During the next two campaign emails the rule stayed pending and cleared without paging, and a longer test breach still alerted.

tickets.subject: Promoted buyer stays read-only until next day's login
tickets.description: After the admin promoted a buyer to Editor, the buyer still saw read-only dashboards until signing out and back in the next morning.
tickets.resolution_notes: Permissions were evaluated at sign-in and cached for the session, so the role change applied only to a new session. Explained the behaviour to the admin; a change refreshing permissions every 5 minutes was released later that quarter. Confirmed after the release that a test promotion applied within 5 minutes.

tickets.subject: No 'Your export is ready' notification
tickets.description: Background exports finish in Export Center, but the users who requested them never get the 'Your export is ready' email or in-app notification.
tickets.resolution_notes: Users who had muted activity digest emails were also excluded from export-ready notifications, because both shared one preference flag. Split the preference so export notifications follow their own setting. Confirmed the affected users were notified for their next exports.

tickets.subject: Adding 'channel' breakdown made the sales board slow
tickets.description: Customer added a breakdown by sales channel (store, web, marketplace) to their sales board and it went from loading in 2 seconds to around 25 seconds.
tickets.resolution_notes: The pre-aggregated rollup did not include the channel dimension, so any widget split by channel bypassed the rollup and queried raw transactions. Added channel to the rollup definition and rebuilt it. The board with the channel breakdown now loads in about 2 seconds.

tickets.subject: Deactivated user still listed as Editor on 14 folders
tickets.description: Compliance wants a clean access list, but folder sharing settings still show a deactivated user as Editor on 14 folders.
tickets.resolution_notes: Deactivation removed workspace access but left the user's explicit folder grants in place as inactive entries. Ran the cleanup action that removes grants held by deactivated users, and the deactivation flow was extended to remove them automatically. Confirmed the folder access lists no longer show the user.

tickets.subject: Lower half of scheduled PDF is grey placeholders
tickets.description: Scheduled PDF reports show the top widgets correctly, but everything below the first screen height is grey placeholder boxes.
tickets.resolution_notes: Widgets outside the initial viewport load only when scrolled into view, and the headless renderer captured the page without triggering them. Disabled lazy loading for export rendering on the workspace. Confirmed the next scheduled PDF showed all 18 widgets.

tickets.subject: Customer lookup by email is very slow
tickets.description: Agent summary: support staff at a pet supply retailer search shopper profiles by email in the Customer 360 page and each search takes 15-30 seconds. Searching by shopper ID is instant.
tickets.resolution_notes: Email search wrapped the column in a lower-case function to make matching case-insensitive, which prevented the existing email index from being used. Added an expression index on the lower-cased email and confirmed email lookups now return in about 200 ms with the same results as before.

tickets.subject: Excel export fails with 'Invalid sheet name'
tickets.description: Exporting a multi-table dashboard to Excel fails with 'Invalid sheet name'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each table becomes a sheet named after its widget title; two titles were longer than Excel's 31-character limit and one also contained a slash. The exporter now truncates and sanitises sheet names. Confirmed the workbook generated with all six sheets.

tickets.subject: Members of a nested group don't get the Store Ops role
tickets.description: Users who belong to a sub-group of 'Store Ops' in the directory get the default role, while direct members of Store Ops get the right one.
tickets.resolution_notes: Our provisioning integration receives direct group memberships only and does not expand nested groups. Added the sub-group to the role mapping directly. Confirmed its members received the Store Ops role after the next sync.

tickets.subject: Accountant asks for reverse-charge wording on invoices
tickets.description: A German retailer's accountant flagged that our invoices add VAT and lack the reverse-charge statement their bookkeeping requires.
tickets.resolution_notes: The VAT ID stored on the account contained spaces copied from the customer's letterhead; our validator rejected it and the account defaulted to charging VAT. Normalised the ID, revalidated it and reissued the last two invoices. Confirmed both reissued invoices carry the reverse-charge statement with no VAT.

tickets.subject: Drill-down table exports only category level
tickets.description: Exporting a drill-down table returns only the category rows, not the products underneath them.
tickets.resolution_notes: Drill-down tables export the currently displayed level by default. Enabled 'Include all levels' on the widget, which adds a level column. Confirmed the export contained both category and product rows.

tickets.subject: 'Anyone with the link' option has disappeared
tickets.description: An editor wants a public link for a supplier meeting, but the 'Anyone with the link' option no longer appears in the share dialog.
tickets.resolution_notes: The admin had disabled public links workspace-wide in the security policy. The admin preferred to keep that policy, so the supplier was invited as a guest with access to that one dashboard. Confirmed the supplier could open it after signing in.

tickets.subject: Sales tax still uses old state after headquarters move
tickets.description: A US customer moved its headquarters to another state, but the latest invoice is still taxed at the previous state's rate.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer had updated the billing address, but tax is calculated from the separate service address, which still pointed to the old office. Updated the service address, recalculated tax and reissued the invoice. Confirmed the reissued invoice used the new state's rate.

tickets.subject: Axis labels invisible in dark mode
tickets.description: With dark mode on, axis labels and gridlines on all line charts are black on a near-black background and impossible to read.
tickets.resolution_notes: Line charts used a hard-coded dark grey for axes instead of theme colours. Switched axes and gridlines to theme tokens. Labels are readable in both light and dark mode.

tickets.subject: 'Query exceeded memory limit' grouping by store and SKU
tickets.description: Customer's category manager built a table grouped by store and SKU for the full year and gets 'Query exceeded memory limit (code Q-MEM-02)' every time it runs.
tickets.resolution_notes: Store by SKU for this customer produced about 14 million groups, which exceeded the per-query memory budget before sorting. Changed the widget to a top 500 by revenue with an 'all other' row and provided a scheduled export for the full breakdown. The widget now loads in about 5 seconds and the full detail arrives as a nightly file.

tickets.subject: No credit after removing ten seats mid-term
tickets.description: Customer removed 10 seats halfway through their annual term and expected a prorated credit on the next invoice, but nothing appeared.
tickets.resolution_notes: On annual contracts, seat reductions take effect at renewal rather than producing mid-term credits, as set out in the customer's order form. Shared the clause with the admin and scheduled the reduction for the renewal date. Verified the renewal preview showed the lower seat quantity.

tickets.subject: New users see dashboards but every widget says 'No access to data source'
tickets.description: Users invited since last month can open dashboards, but every widget shows 'No access to data source' instead of a chart.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace default role was a custom role cloned before dataset permissions existed, so it lacked 'Use dataset'. With the admin, added 'Use dataset' for the retail datasets only to that role. Confirmed new users saw the charts.

tickets.subject: Merged header rows block pivot tables in Excel
tickets.description: Finance cannot build a pivot table from the Excel export because the first two rows are merged group headers.
tickets.resolution_notes: Exports from grouped tables include merged header rows by default. Enabled 'Flat header' export mode for that widget, which writes a single header row with combined labels. Confirmed a pivot table could be created directly from the export.

tickets.subject: Anomaly detection missed a real sales drop in January
tickets.description: A store's sales fell by about 40% for three days in mid-January because of a broken entrance door, but the customer's anomaly alerts stayed silent.
tickets.resolution_notes: The baseline included the volatile holiday weeks, which made the expected range so wide that a 40% drop still looked normal. Removed the holiday period from the training window and retrained. Replaying the affected days with the new baseline produced an alert on the first day of the drop.

tickets.subject: Report link opens the wrong client workspace
tickets.description: A consultant who belongs to two client workspaces opens a report link and lands in the other workspace with 'File not found'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Download links did not carry the workspace context, so they resolved against the user's last-used workspace. As a workaround the consultant switched workspaces before clicking; the link format was then updated to include the workspace identifier. Confirmed new links opened in the correct workspace.

tickets.subject: Five new European workspaces created in English (US) format
tickets.description: The customer created five European regional workspaces from their template, and all of them came up with US dates, US number format and English.
tickets.resolution_notes: The template copies its settings into each new workspace and still held English (US) locale defaults. Updated each regional workspace's locale and corrected the template so future workspaces start with region-appropriate defaults. The five workspaces now use their local formats.

tickets.subject: No way to request access, just 'Dashboard not found'
tickets.description: Users without access to a dashboard see only 'Dashboard not found', with no option to request access.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace had 'Hide restricted content' enabled, which replaces the request page with a not-found message. The admin kept it for the HR folder only and turned it off elsewhere. Confirmed users saw the Request access page on non-HR dashboards.

tickets.subject: Delegated coordinator can invite but not set roles
tickets.description: A custom HR coordinator role can invite users, but every invitation defaults to Viewer and the role dropdown is disabled.
tickets.resolution_notes: Assigning roles needs the separate 'Assign roles up to' permission, which sets the highest role a delegate can grant. Added 'Assign roles up to Editor' to the coordinator role. Confirmed the coordinator could invite users as Viewer or Editor but not Admin.

tickets.subject: Negative stock on hand for bottled beverages
tickets.description: The Inventory module shows negative on-hand quantities for most bottled water and soda SKUs, while store teams count full shelves.
tickets.resolution_notes: Receipts for these SKUs arrive from the supplier feed in cases of 12, but they were added to stock as single units while POS sales were subtracted in single units, so stock went negative within days. Applied the pack-size conversion from the product master to supplier receipts and recomputed stock positions. On-hand for 40 sampled SKUs now agrees with cycle counts within normal shrink.

tickets.subject: Product autocomplete lags while typing
tickets.description: Customer says typing in the product search box is painful: each letter takes a second or two to appear and suggestions jump around.
tickets.resolution_notes: Autocomplete sent a query on every keystroke using a leading-wildcard match, which could not use an index on product names. Added a 250 ms debounce and a trigram index for substring matches. Suggestions now appear within about 200 ms of the user pausing.

tickets.subject: Remote staff blocked even though the VPN address is allowed
tickets.description: Customer allowed their VPN egress address in the workspace IP allow-list, but remote employees connected to the VPN are still blocked.
tickets.resolution_notes: The VPN uses split tunnelling, so traffic to the product went straight out of employees' home connections instead of through the allowed VPN address. The customer added the product's domains to the VPN's tunnelled routes. Remote users on VPN now egress from the allowed address and can sign in.

tickets.subject: Large merchandising dashboard fails with 'Render limit exceeded'
tickets.description: A merchandising team's dashboard with more than 60 widgets fails to export to PDF with 'Render limit exceeded'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The PDF exporter had a hard limit of 50 widgets per document. Helped the team split the dashboard into two tabs and export each; the limit was later raised to 120 with automatic pagination. Confirmed both tab exports succeeded.

tickets.subject: Leading zeros stripped from store codes
tickets.description: Store codes such as 00427 become 427 in Excel exports, which breaks lookups in the customer's spreadsheets.
tickets.resolution_notes: The Excel writer inferred a numeric type for the code column. Marked the store_code field as text in the data model so exports write it as a text cell. Confirmed the Excel export shows 00427.

tickets.subject: Spreadsheet add-in fails after password reset
tickets.description: A pricing analyst reset their password on Tuesday, and since then the spreadsheet add-in returns 'Token revoked' whenever it refreshes data.
tickets.resolution_notes: Resetting a password revokes all of the user's personal access tokens by design, and the add-in still held the old token. The analyst signed out of the add-in and authorized it again, after which it refreshed data normally. We also updated the reset confirmation email to say that connected tools must be re-authorized.

tickets.subject: Brief 503 errors every Tuesday afternoon
tickets.description: The customer's monitoring shows a burst of 503 responses lasting about 30 seconds most Tuesdays around 14:00 UTC.
tickets.resolution_notes: Tuesday is our regular release window, and API instances were stopped without draining in-flight connections. Enabled graceful shutdown with connection draining and readiness checks during deploys. The customer's monitoring showed no 503s during the next two releases.

tickets.subject: Reporting login locked every night around 02:00
tickets.description: The customer's reporting login is found locked each morning. The audit log shows a burst of failed password attempts at about 02:00 from 192.0.2.40.
tickets.resolution_notes: A scheduled script on the customer's reporting server still signed in with the password that had been rotated the week before, and each run tripped the lockout threshold. The customer moved the script to an API key held in their secrets manager instead of a password. No lockouts occurred over the following week.

tickets.subject: Need add-on activations without another proration overcharge
tickets.description: The customer is about to enable the Forecasting add-on on three more workspaces and asked how to avoid being overcharged like on their previous mid-cycle addition.
tickets.resolution_notes: The permanent fix for mid-cycle additions being prorated from the cycle start had not shipped yet. As a workaround, enabled the add-on immediately as a complimentary period and set the paid start to the next cycle boundary; the proration fix was scheduled for the following billing release. Confirmed each activation produced no overlapping charge on the draft invoice.

tickets.subject: Viewers can suddenly export to CSV
tickets.description: The customer's security team noticed that viewers can now download CSV exports, which their internal policy forbids.
tickets.resolution_notes: An admin had switched the workspace export policy to 'All roles' while trying to enable exports for the analysts group only. Reverted the policy to 'Editors and above' and added an export exception for the analysts group. Confirmed viewers no longer see the export menu and analysts can still export.

tickets.subject: 'Page unresponsive' warning on per-minute traffic chart
tickets.description: Customer gets the browser's 'Page unresponsive' prompt when opening a line chart of per-minute footfall for a full year. Shorter ranges work.
tickets.resolution_notes: A year of per-minute data sent roughly 525,000 points per series to the browser. Enabled server-side downsampling that keeps the visual shape while sending at most 2,000 points per series, with full resolution returned when the user zooms in. The full-year chart now opens in about 2 seconds without the warning.

tickets.subject: SAML metadata auto-refresh failing
tickets.description: Workspace SSO settings have shown 'Could not fetch metadata from https://idp.corp.tidewater.example.com/metadata' for several days.
tickets.resolution_notes: The metadata URL resolves only on the customer's internal DNS, so the product's auth service could not reach it to refresh. The customer published the metadata on their externally reachable federation hostname and the workspace was updated to that URL. The refresh succeeded and the last-refreshed timestamp updated.

tickets.subject: Tax-exempt museum shop still charged sales tax
tickets.description: A nonprofit museum shop sent its tax-exemption certificate months ago, but every invoice still includes sales tax.
tickets.resolution_notes: The certificate had been attached to a support conversation rather than to the billing account's tax profile, so the exemption was never applied. Added the certificate to the tax profile and refunded the tax on the four affected invoices. Confirmed the next draft invoice shows zero tax.

tickets.subject: Switching tabs between client workspaces forces re-login
tickets.description: An agency analyst who manages three clients' workspaces keeps landing on the sign-in page when moving between tabs, and is tired of juggling separate browser profiles.
tickets.resolution_notes: All workspaces shared a single session cookie, so each new sign-in displaced the previous one. This release scopes sessions per workspace so several can be active in one browser. After the update the analyst kept three workspaces open in tabs for a full day without being signed out.

tickets.subject: Webhooks rejected as 'timestamp outside tolerance'
tickets.description: Customer's receiver logs 'signature timestamp outside tolerance' for every event since Monday, even though signatures are computed correctly.
tickets.resolution_notes: The receiving host's clock had drifted about seven minutes after its time-sync service stopped, so our timestamps looked older than the 5-minute replay tolerance. The customer restored time synchronisation on the host. Verification passed again for new events, and we suggested monitoring clock drift on webhook receivers.

tickets.subject: Want an alert when someone changes workspace settings
tickets.description: After an accidental change, the customer wants owners told whenever a workspace-level setting is modified.
tickets.resolution_notes: Settings-change notifications are an organisation option and were off. Enabled 'Notify owners of settings changes' and added the IT group mailbox as a recipient. A test change produced a notification within a minute.

tickets.subject: Saved layout reverts to the old arrangement on reload
tickets.description: An analyst rearranges widgets and saves. The change holds until they reload, when the previous arrangement comes back for about ten minutes.
tickets.resolution_notes: The dashboard definition endpoint returned a cacheable response, so the browser reused the old definition after a reload. Marked the endpoint as no-store and added a version number to definition requests. Saved layouts now appear immediately on reload.

tickets.subject: Bulk import says completed but about 500 rows are missing
tickets.description: Customer's bulk upload of 10,000 store attributes reports success, but 500 stores still show old values in the app.
tickets.resolution_notes: The job finished with status 'completed_with_errors', and the error file listed 500 rows rejected for store codes that do not exist in the workspace. Their client only checked that the job was no longer running. Updated the client to treat 'completed_with_errors' as needing attention and to read the error file; the corrected rows imported cleanly on resubmission.

tickets.subject: Snoozing one alert silenced every rule
tickets.description: A regional manager snoozed a noisy alert for 24 hours on Friday. On Saturday a genuine stock-out alert from another rule never reached anyone.
tickets.resolution_notes: The alert list had a 'select all' checkbox already ticked from a previous filter, so the bulk snooze applied to all 46 rules. Ended the snoozes, and the bulk action now shows a confirmation listing how many rules will be affected. The manager confirmed single-rule snoozes now affect only that rule.

tickets.subject: One widget spins forever the morning after an update
tickets.description: The morning after an update, some store managers have a single widget on the trading dashboard that never stops loading while the rest are fine. A browser refresh clears it.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their tabs had stayed open since before the release and requested the cohort chart's code file, which the release had removed. Advised refreshing open tabs after releases as the workaround; keeping old release files available after deployment was tracked as the permanent fix. All managers' widgets loaded after a refresh.

tickets.subject: 'Top 50 stores' alert doesn't include this year's best performers
tickets.description: Agent summary: customer's rule watches the 'Top 50 stores' segment, but two stores that became top performers this year never generate alerts.
tickets.resolution_notes: The segment had been saved as a static list when it was created, freezing the top 50 at that time. Recreated it as a dynamic segment recalculated weekly on trailing 12-month sales. The two stores now appear in the rule's scope and one was alerted on a weekend shortfall.

tickets.subject: Period labels don't sort in planning spreadsheets
tickets.description: Planning wants period labels like '2026-Q1' and '2026-M03' so they sort correctly in their spreadsheets, but dashboards show 'Q1 2026' and 'Mar 2026'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Period label style is a workspace date setting and was set to 'Descriptive'. Switched it to 'Sortable (ISO-style)'. Charts and tables now label periods as 2026-Q1 and 2026-M03.

tickets.subject: Manual sync refused: 'run already active'
tickets.description: The customer's store analytics lead tries to start a manual sync and gets 'A sync is already running for this connection', although history shows the last run was cancelled yesterday afternoon.
tickets.resolution_notes: Cancelling that run did not release its job lock, so the connection still looked busy. This release makes cancellation release the lock and automatically expires any lock older than the maximum run time. The lock cleared after deployment and the manual sync completed in 14 minutes.

tickets.subject: Weekly totals don't match the finance week
tickets.description: Weekly revenue never matches finance's weekly report, and the customer suspects data is missing.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace week started on Sunday, while finance reports Monday-to-Sunday weeks. Changed 'Week starts on' to Monday. Weekly totals now match finance's report.

tickets.subject: Retrying the initial load doubled January
tickets.description: During onboarding the customer clicked 'Retry' after the historical load hit an error. The first month of history now shows double sales.
tickets.resolution_notes: Retrying a failed backfill restarted it from the start date without removing the rows already loaded for the first segment. Removed the duplicate segment and changed retries to resume from the last completed segment. January totals now match the source, and a test retry resumed correctly.

tickets.subject: Alerts lost after old chat channel was archived
tickets.description: Agent summary: the customer reorganised their chat channels and archived #ops-alerts-old. Rules still pointing to it have silently stopped delivering.
tickets.resolution_notes: Posts to an archived channel are rejected, and the affected rules still referenced it. Updated the 11 affected rules to the new channel and enabled the channel-health warning that flags archived destinations on the rule list. Test alerts from each rule reached the new channel.

tickets.subject: Forced password change keeps coming back
tickets.description: When the 90-day expiry prompt appears, the user changes their password successfully, signs in, and is immediately told the password has expired again.
tickets.resolution_notes: For accounts with a pending email-change verification, the password change saved the new hash but skipped updating the 'last changed' date, so the expiry check kept firing. Fixed the update so the date is always recorded and corrected it for the five affected accounts. The user signed in without another expiry prompt.

tickets.subject: Backdated phone orders never appear
tickets.description: The customer's finance team sometimes enters phone orders with an earlier order date. Those orders never show up in the sales dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: Incremental sync filtered on order date rather than creation or modification time, so orders entered later with an earlier date fell behind the cursor. Changed the filter to the order's modification time and reloaded the past 60 days. All 37 backdated orders now appear on their correct dates.

tickets.subject: Revenue from new web store connector 100x too high
tickets.description: Two days after connecting their new web store, the customer's online revenue tile shows $4.1M for a weekend that actually brought in about $41,000.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new connector delivers amounts in minor units (cents), and the source was set up with the major-unit amount format, so 4,100,000 cents was read as $4.1M. Set the amount format to minor units for that source and reprocessed its orders. Weekend revenue now shows $41,037.62, matching the store's payout report.

tickets.subject: Belgian stores' revenue imported a hundred times too high
tickets.description: After each weekly file drop, sales for the customer's Belgian stores look one hundred times larger than reality. Files from other countries import correctly.
tickets.resolution_notes: The Belgian team's spreadsheet tool writes decimal commas, and the importer stripped the comma as a thousands separator, turning 1234,50 into 123450. Configured that team's feed for comma decimals and semicolon separators and reprocessed the last eight weekly files. Belgian revenue now matches the stores' till reports.

tickets.subject: Bulk invite: 9 of 60 staff never got an invitation
tickets.description: Admin bulk-invited 60 store employees from a CSV file. Nine say no invitation ever arrived, and the user list shows them as 'Invite failed'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Those rows had trailing spaces after the email address, which made the addresses invalid and the invitations undeliverable. Changed the bulk import to trim whitespace and flag invalid rows before sending, then resent the nine invitations. All nine employees activated their accounts the same afternoon.

tickets.subject: Scheduled PDFs use month-first dates while the app shows day-first
tickets.description: A UK admin sees day-first dates in the app, but the scheduled PDFs the team receives show month-first dates, such as 03/04/2026 for 4 March.
tickets.resolution_notes: The admin had a personal DD/MM/YYYY preference, but scheduled PDFs are not tied to a single viewer and use the workspace default, which was MM/DD/YYYY. Changed the workspace default date format to DD/MM/YYYY. The next scheduled PDF used day-first dates.

tickets.subject: SSO says email already in use in another workspace
tickets.description: Following a rebrand, one of the customer's planners gets 'An account with this email already exists in another workspace' when signing in through SSO.
tickets.resolution_notes: The identity provider began sending the planner's new address, which did not match their existing login, and that address had once been used for a personal trial workspace. With the planner's approval we closed the old trial and set the new address as the login email on their existing account. SSO sign-in then went straight to the customer's workspace.

tickets.subject: Phone browser shows a shrunken desktop layout
tickets.description: Store managers opening the dashboard in their phone browser get the full desktop layout scaled down, with unreadable text and pinch-zoom needed for everything.
tickets.resolution_notes: The dashboard had been saved with 'Lock desktop layout' turned on, which disables the single-column mobile layout. The admin turned the option off for the store dashboard. On phones the widgets now stack in one readable column.

tickets.subject: Data agent shows offline after security gateway rollout
tickets.description: The agent status page shows 'offline, last heartbeat 3 days ago' for the customer's agent, which lines up with their security team rolling out a new web gateway.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new gateway intercepts TLS and signs certificates with a corporate CA the agent did not trust, so heartbeats failed validation. Installed the corporate root CA in the agent's trust store; heartbeats resumed within a minute and the upload backlog drained.

tickets.subject: Gross margin % shows millions of percent after editor upgrade
tickets.description: After the calculated-field editor upgrade, the customer's custom 'Gross margin %' metric shows values like 1,204,331% for every category.
tickets.resolution_notes: The migration to the new formula engine rewrote '(revenue - cogs) / revenue' as 'revenue - cogs / revenue', so the result became revenue minus a small fraction. Restored the original expression from the pre-migration snapshot, fixed the migration serializer to preserve grouping and re-checked every calculated field in the workspace. Gross margin % is back to 38-46% by category, matching the customer's spreadsheet.

tickets.subject: Renewal quote doesn't reflect price protection
tickets.description: Procurement received the 60-day renewal notice, and the quoted amount does not include the multi-year price protection in their agreement.
tickets.resolution_notes: Price protection was stored as a single-term override, and renewal quotes fall back to list price when no override applies to the next term. Extended the override to the remaining contract term and regenerated the quote. Confirmed the new quote matched the contracted rate.

tickets.subject: SFTP files arrive zipped after compression was enabled
tickets.description: Since an admin turned on compression to shrink emailed reports, the files dropped into the customer's SFTP folder also arrive as .zip, and their importer rejects them.
tickets.resolution_notes: The compression setting applied to every destination of the schedule. Set compression per destination, on for email and off for SFTP. Confirmed the next SFTP drop was a plain CSV.

tickets.subject: Real outage at 10:00 produced no alerts
tickets.description: A payment terminal outage at 10:00 went unnoticed for an hour. The customer's rules were active and breached, but no notifications were sent.
tickets.resolution_notes: A recurring early-morning mute window had been saved in UTC instead of the rule's time zone (UTC-5), so it actually suppressed alerts from 09:00 to 11:00 local time. Corrected the window to the intended local hours, and the schedule editor now stores windows in the rule's time zone. A test breach at 10:00 the next day alerted immediately.

tickets.subject: Unique customers fell 30% after identity resolution was enabled
tickets.description: The customer turned on cross-channel identity resolution and their unique customer count dropped by almost a third overnight, though order volume was unchanged.
tickets.resolution_notes: The matching rule merged profiles on email alone, and the POS records receipt-only shoppers with the placeholder address receipts@lumengrocers.example.com, so tens of thousands of walk-in shoppers collapsed into one profile. Added a placeholder and shared-address exclusion list, put that address on it and re-ran resolution. Unique customers recovered to within 2% of the pre-change count, the remaining reduction coming from genuine cross-channel matches.

tickets.subject: Backfill keeps restarting after 429 responses from POS
tickets.description: While backfilling a year of transactions for a newly connected store group, the connector log fills with 429 'Too many requests' responses and the backfill starts over from the beginning.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector retried throttled requests immediately and, after repeated failures, restarted the whole backfill instead of resuming. Added exponential backoff that honours the platform's Retry-After header, plus a checkpoint every 1,000 transactions. The backfill finished in about six hours with all 1.4 million transactions.

tickets.subject: Reconciliation job flags one-cent breaks on busy days
tickets.description: The customer runs an automated reconciliation between our API totals and their ledger and gets a handful of $0.01 breaks every week, always on high-volume days.
tickets.resolution_notes: Aggregates were computed with binary floating-point sums, which drift by fractions of a cent when many transactions are added and occasionally round the wrong way. After the aggregation engine moved to decimal arithmetic and history was backfilled, two weeks of reconciliation runs completed with no breaks.

tickets.subject: Pivot totals row labelled 'West' instead of 'Total'
tickets.description: The pivot widget's totals row carries the last region's name, 'West', so readers assume West is the grand total.
tickets.resolution_notes: When the row field had a custom display name, the pivot reused the last row label for the totals row. Fixed the labelling logic. The totals row now reads 'Total'.

tickets.subject: 'Who has access' report lists users removed yesterday
tickets.description: The 'Who has access' report for the Finance folder still lists three users the admin removed the previous day.
tickets.resolution_notes: That report is built from a nightly snapshot, while the live access list was already correct. Showed the admin the live Access tab, and the report now shows when its snapshot was taken. Confirmed the three users were absent from the live list and from the next snapshot.

tickets.subject: Only the first 10,000 customers imported
tickets.description: The customer's CRM holds about 38,000 customer records, but our dashboards show exactly 10,000.
tickets.resolution_notes: The CRM's list endpoint stops returning results beyond offset 10,000, and the connector used offset pagination. Switched the connector to cursor-based pagination for that object. A full resync imported all 38,214 records.

tickets.subject: All 30 schedules shifted an hour after the clock change
tickets.description: The admin reports that every one of their 30 scheduled reports moved by an hour after the daylight saving change and asks whether they have to re-save each one by hand.
tickets.resolution_notes: The older schedules carried a fixed UTC offset. As an immediate workaround, support re-saved all 30 schedules in bulk with the named time zone using an internal tool; a migration converting every fixed-offset schedule platform-wide was scheduled for the following week. Confirmed the next deliveries ran at the intended local times.

tickets.subject: Conversion-rate widget is an empty frame on Sundays
tickets.description: A store manager says the conversion-rate chart is just an empty frame whenever they pick a Sunday, the day the footfall counters are switched off.
tickets.resolution_notes: With the counters off, conversion divides by zero visitors and returns null for every hour, and the line chart drew nothing for a series made only of nulls. Added handling that keeps the axes and shows a 'No traffic data' note for the period. Choosing a Sunday now shows the note instead of an empty frame.

tickets.subject: Monthly invoice email stopped arriving
tickets.description: The customer no longer receives the monthly invoice email, although new invoices still appear in Billing Center.
tickets.resolution_notes: Invoice emails go only to billing contacts, and a contact cleanup had removed the finance mailbox from that list while leaving it as a workspace user. Re-added the mailbox as a billing contact and resent the last two invoices. The customer confirmed both arrived.

tickets.subject: Upgrade proration showed up an invoice later than expected
tickets.description: The customer's accounts payable team says an upgrade made on the evening of 30 April appeared on the June invoice instead of May's, which breaks their monthly accrual.
tickets.resolution_notes: Subscriptions bill on UTC, and the upgrade at 23:40 local time was already 1 May in UTC, so it fell into the next period and was invoiced in June. The amount itself was correct; we sent a statement explaining the timing for their auditors and recorded the UTC billing anchor in the account's billing profile. The customer confirmed this settled their accrual question.

tickets.subject: Morning stand-up board slow for every regional manager
tickets.description: About 40 regional managers open the same daily KPI board at 8:00 for a stand-up call. The customer's admin reports that every one of them waits around 20 seconds, which makes the call start late each day.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each manager's request produced a distinct cache entry because the cache key incorporated the session ID, so 40 identical queries ran at once. Rolled the corrected cache key, built from the query fingerprint plus the user's permission scope instead of the session, out to all workspaces. During the next stand-up only the first request ran a query and the remaining managers loaded the board in 1-2 seconds.

tickets.subject: Toronto store opening alerts arrive in the middle of the night
tickets.description: A head-office admin in London set up a 'store not opened on time' rule for the customer's Toronto stores. Toronto managers get the alert at around 4:00 local time, hours before opening.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule's active hours took the personal time zone of the admin who created it (London) rather than the stores' time zone, so the opening check ran on London time. Set the rule's time zone to Toronto's, and the editor now defaults new rules to the stores' time zone when all stores in scope share one. Toronto managers now receive the alert only when a store is actually late opening.

tickets.subject: Click-and-collect orders counted as in-store sales
tickets.description: The customer created a mapping rule so 'store_pickup' orders count in the Online channel, but the channel report still puts all click-and-collect revenue under In-store.
tickets.resolution_notes: Mapping rules are evaluated top-down with the first match winning, and the rule editor appended the new rule below an older catch-all (fulfilment contains 'store' → In-store), so it never fired. Moved the specific rule above the catch-all and added an editor warning when a new rule is shadowed by an earlier one. Click-and-collect revenue now appears under Online and the channel split matches the order-management report.

tickets.subject: Inventory sync shows 'Running' after its worker died
tickets.description: The status page showed the inventory sync as 'Running' for 30 hours. No log lines had been written since shortly after it started.
tickets.resolution_notes: The worker handling the run was terminated during a platform node replacement, and with no heartbeat check the run's status was never updated. Added a heartbeat so runs without progress for 15 minutes are marked failed and retried automatically. Restarted the inventory sync, which completed for all 46 store locations.

tickets.subject: Daily sales differ from POS by the evening trade
tickets.description: Every day's sales on the dashboard come in below the POS report by roughly what was sold after 6 or 7 pm, and the following day is higher by the same amount.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace time zone was left at the UTC default, so days were cut at UTC midnight; the aggregation engine behaved correctly for that setting. Set the workspace time zone to America/Chicago, since all of this workspace's stores are in Central time. Daily sales now match the POS reports.

tickets.subject: Viewer renamed widgets with a keyboard shortcut
tickets.description: A viewer found that pressing F2 on a widget title let them rename it, and the new title was saved for everyone.
tickets.resolution_notes: The context menu was hidden for viewers, but the inline-rename shortcut called an endpoint that had no server-side permission check. Added the check and reverted the renamed titles from the audit log. Confirmed the shortcut now returns 'Forbidden' for viewers.

tickets.subject: Self-signups from company domain get Editor rights
tickets.description: People from the customer's email domain who join on their own through domain auto-join are getting Editor rights instead of view-only access.
tickets.resolution_notes: Domain auto-join had been configured with Editor as its default role during the initial rollout. Changed the auto-join default to Viewer and reviewed the 23 auto-joined users with the admin, who moved 19 of them to Viewer. Confirmed the next auto-joined user received Viewer.

tickets.subject: Fiscal-year total doesn't match the annual report
tickets.description: The customer's finance team says the fiscal-year total on the Executive Summary differs from their published annual figure, although every individual month matches.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace fiscal year began in January, while the customer's runs February to January, so the total covered the wrong 12 months. Updated the fiscal start month to February. The fiscal-year total now matches the annual report.

tickets.subject: 2FA code accepted on website but refused in mobile app
tickets.description: Same user, same authenticator: pasting the code works on the website, but the mobile app answers 'Code must be 6 digits'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The authenticator copies codes with a space in the middle ('123 456'), and the mobile app's input validation counted the space instead of stripping it. The user typed the digits manually as an immediate workaround, and a mobile app update now removes whitespace before validating. Confirmed the user signed in with a pasted code on the updated app.

tickets.subject: Return rate doubled after enabling in-store exchanges
tickets.description: Since the customer started offering in-store exchanges, their return rate has roughly doubled, though operations says actual refunds are flat.
tickets.resolution_notes: Exchanges come through as a return transaction paired with a new sale, and the return-rate metric counted the return leg like any refunded return. Changed the metric to exclude return lines linked to an exchange sale via the exchange reference ID and to report exchanges separately. Return rate went back to 8.2%, consistent with refunds issued.

tickets.subject: redirect_uri mismatch for new regional workspace
tickets.description: The customer created a second workspace hosted in our EU region. OIDC sign-in there fails at the identity provider with 'redirect_uri does not match a registered value'; the original workspace is fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: Only the callback URL for the original region was registered in the customer's IdP app. The admin added the EU workspace's callback URL shown on its SSO settings page. Sign-in to the EU workspace succeeded for the test users.

tickets.subject: Old region's alerts doubled after setting up the new region
tickets.description: Customer created the dashboard for their new West region by copying the East region dashboard, choosing to include its alerts, and then editing the dashboard filters. Now East managers get every East alert twice, and West has no alerts at all.
tickets.resolution_notes: The cloned rules kept their own East region scope and East recipients, because editing a dashboard's filters does not change the scope of rules attached to it, so East alerts were duplicated and nothing watched West. Re-scoped the copied rules to the West region and West recipients instead of deleting them. East managers now get one alert each, and a West test breach alerted the West managers.

tickets.subject: Password with accented letter fails at login after reset
tickets.description: User set a new password containing 'é' through the reset page on their Mac. The reset reported success, but the login page rejects the very same password.
tickets.resolution_notes: The reset page and the login page normalized Unicode differently, so the accented character was stored in one form and submitted in another. Both pages now apply the same normalization before hashing and comparison. The user reset once more and signed in with the accented password.

tickets.subject: KPI tiles show a dash after switching display currency
tickets.description: When one user switches the dashboard's display currency to EUR, every KPI tile shows '—' instead of a number. Switching back to USD brings the numbers back.
tickets.resolution_notes: The KPI tile formatter had no currency pattern for EUR combined with the user's English (Canada) locale and returned an empty string, which the tile shows as a dash. Added a fallback to the currency's default pattern. The tiles now show euro values for that user and for the other locale combinations we tested.

tickets.subject: Last year's regional totals changed after store reorganisation
tickets.description: After the customer moved four stores from Northeast to Mid-Atlantic in the store hierarchy, last year's Northeast revenue dropped sharply, although those stores really were Northeast last year.
tickets.resolution_notes: The store-to-region mapping was not effective-dated, so reassigning stores rewrote their history into the new region. Enabled effective-dated hierarchy mapping, set the move to apply from 1 July and recomputed regional aggregates. Last year's Northeast total returned to its published value while current figures reflect the new structure.

tickets.subject: System emails sent as 'Analytics Notifications'
tickets.description: Staff ignore the product's system emails because the sender shows a generic product name instead of the customer's company.
tickets.resolution_notes: The sender display name had never been customised. Set the workspace sender name to 'Saffron Street Insights'. New notification and invitation emails show that sender name.

tickets.subject: Sorting a large table takes ~10 seconds per click
tickets.description: Customer says each click on a column header in their 60,000-row stock table locks the page for about ten seconds before the new order appears.
tickets.resolution_notes: Tables below an outdated size threshold were sorted in the browser, and the threshold had been set far too high, so 60,000 rows were sorted client-side with a slow comparison for mixed text and numbers. Lowered the threshold so large tables sort on the server and return only the visible page. Header sorts now complete in under a second.

tickets.subject: Member file upload blocked by data-loss prevention page
tickets.description: Uploading the loyalty member file through the browser returns the customer's DLP block page: 'Upload of personal data to unsanctioned application'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's DLP policy blocks uploads containing email addresses to applications not on the sanctioned list, and the product had never been added. The customer's security team added the product's ingestion domain as a sanctioned destination, so uploads are still inspected and logged but allowed. The member file uploaded successfully.

tickets.subject: Order IDs off by a few digits in our web app
tickets.description: Customer's front-end developer reports that order IDs displayed in their internal web app differ from ours in the last two or three digits, for newer orders only.
tickets.resolution_notes: Order IDs are 64-bit integers returned as JSON numbers, and the app's JavaScript parser rounded values above 2^53. Advised using the id_str field that every object also returns, or a big-integer-aware parser. After switching to id_str the displayed IDs matched exactly.

tickets.subject: 403 insufficient_scope when creating exports via API
tickets.description: Customer's developer can list dashboards with their key but gets 403 'insufficient_scope: exports:write' when calling POST /v2/exports.
tickets.resolution_notes: The key was issued with read-only scopes. Created a new key for the integration with exports:write added to its existing read scopes, keeping other write scopes off. Export creation then succeeded and the old key was revoked.

tickets.subject: Conversion rate from API is 100 times smaller than the dashboard
tickets.description: Customer's analyst says the API returns conversion_rate as 0.034 while the dashboard shows 3.4%, and asked which one is correct.
tickets.resolution_notes: Both are correct: the API returns ratios as fractions, and the dashboard applies percentage formatting. Pointed them to the field metadata that marks ratio fields, and their report now multiplies by 100 for display. Figures now agree with the dashboard.

tickets.subject: SAML response lands on 404 after subdomain change
tickets.description: Users completing SSO are sent to a 'Page not found' error. The admin moved the workspace to a custom subdomain the day before.
tickets.resolution_notes: The identity provider was still posting assertions to the assertion consumer service URL on the old subdomain, which no longer routes to the workspace. Gave the admin the new ACS URL from the SSO settings page and they updated the IdP app. SSO sign-in worked for all users from the next attempt.

tickets.subject: Bulk status updates in CRM never reach the dashboard
tickets.description: Sales operations closed about 600 stale opportunities with their CRM's bulk update tool, but a week later the pipeline dashboard still shows them as open.
tickets.resolution_notes: The bulk tool changes records without touching their last-modified timestamp, and the connector's incremental sync only fetches records whose timestamp has moved. Ran a full refresh to pick up the changes and enabled the weekly full reconciliation option for this connection. The 600 opportunities now show as closed.

tickets.subject: Old office address in system email footers
tickets.description: The footer of the product's system emails still shows the customer's previous head office address.
tickets.resolution_notes: Email footers use the organisation profile address, which was never updated after the move. Updated the address in the Organisation profile. Footers show the new address.

tickets.subject: Canadian business wants figures in CAD, not USD
tickets.description: All of the customer's dashboards show USD, but their Canadian leadership team reports in CAD.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace reporting currency was USD, chosen during onboarding. Changed it to CAD, and the background recompute reconverted history at transaction-date rates. Dashboards now show CAD totals that match the finance team's CAD reports.

tickets.subject: Quarterly active loyalty members triple the monthly figure
tickets.description: The Loyalty module shows 2.4 million active members for Q1, while each month on its own shows about 800,000.
tickets.resolution_notes: The active-members measure is a monthly snapshot, and the quarterly rollup summed the three monthly snapshots. Configured it as a semi-additive measure that takes the latest month in the period and recomputed. Q1 now reports 812,000, the March closing count.

tickets.subject: Anomaly alerts every promotion weekend
tickets.description: Customer gets 'unusually high sales' anomaly alerts every time they run a weekend promotion, which they plan weeks ahead.
tickets.resolution_notes: The baseline had no knowledge of planned promotions, so expected uplift looked anomalous. Connected the rule to the customer's promotions calendar as known events, which widens the expected range during those periods. The next promotion weekend produced no alerts, while an unplanned spike on a normal weekday still did.

tickets.subject: Overage warning for rows from archived sources
tickets.description: The customer received the 'You will be billed for excess data rows' notice a week after archiving two regional sources and believes they are well under the cap.
tickets.resolution_notes: Archived sources' rows were still counted while they were in the retention period. As a workaround until the meter change that excludes retained rows was deployed, applied an overage waiver for the current cycle. Confirmed the billing preview showed no overage line.

tickets.subject: Monthly chart skips the February label
tickets.description: The monthly revenue chart labels January, March, April and so on; February's bar is there but has no label.
tickets.resolution_notes: The axis tick generator placed ticks every 30 days, which jumped over February's start date. Switched monthly axes to calendar-based ticks. Every month is now labelled.

tickets.subject: Bulk job download works in testing, fails in nightly run
tickets.description: Customer's developer says downloading bulk job results works whenever they test by hand, but the nightly pipeline fails at the download step with an expired-request error.
tickets.resolution_notes: The nightly pipeline fetched the job status, then waited about 30 minutes for another stage before downloading, by which time the 15-minute pre-signed URL had expired; manual tests downloaded immediately. Moved the status call to just before download. The pipeline has completed every night since.

tickets.subject: Password reset link reports 'already used' on first click
tickets.description: Customer reports that password reset links open to 'This link has already been used' even when clicked within a minute of the email arriving. Several colleagues at the same company see the same message.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's inbound email security gateway opens every link in incoming mail to scan it, which redeemed the single-use reset token before the user clicked. As a workaround the user entered the six-digit reset code from the same email, which a link scanner cannot consume; a permanent change so that opening the link no longer redeems the token is tracked for a later release. Confirmed the user signed in with the new password.

tickets.subject: Customer emails show as asterisks in exports
tickets.description: Loyalty analysts see full customer email addresses on the dashboard, but exports show values like '****@example.com'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace's data protection policy masks fields tagged as personal data in all exports, while on-screen viewing is governed separately, so this was working as configured. The admin chose to keep the policy, and for the team's matching task we added a hashed email key column, which is not masked. Confirmed the export contained the hashed keys.

tickets.subject: Prepaid row credits expired after six months
tickets.description: Customer bought a block of prepaid data-row credits in January and found the balance zeroed in July, though they understood credits last 12 months.
tickets.resolution_notes: The credit block had been created with a 6-month expiry, contrary to the 12 months on the order form. Reinstated the expired balance with the correct expiry date. Confirmed the Usage page shows the credits valid until the following January.

tickets.subject: Script only ever gets the first 1,000 products
tickets.description: Customer's script requests page_size=5000 from the products endpoint and always ends with exactly 1,000 products, although the catalogue has about 18,000. No error is returned.
tickets.resolution_notes: The maximum page size is 1,000 and larger values are capped. The script treated a page with fewer rows than requested as the last page and stopped. Changed the loop to continue while a next_cursor is present, and we added a warning header when page_size is capped. The script now retrieves all 18,214 products.

tickets.subject: JPY to USD revenue off by hundreds of dollars on large days
tickets.description: For the customer's Tokyo stores, converted USD revenue differs from treasury's calculation by $200-$900 on busy days, even though the correct daily rates are being used.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rate table stored exchange rates truncated to four decimal places, so a JPY-USD rate of 0.006694 was held as 0.0066, about 1.4% low on every yen. Increased stored rate precision to ten significant digits, reloaded the rate history and recomputed. Daily converted totals now match treasury within one cent.

tickets.subject: No map pins for any Canadian store
tickets.description: On the store map, US stores have pins but none of the 18 Canadian stores appear, even though the store table lists them with full addresses.
tickets.resolution_notes: The map placed pins with a postal-code lookup that only recognised five-digit codes, so Canadian postal codes returned no coordinates. Added international postal-code support and made the map use latitude and longitude from store records where present. All 18 Canadian stores now appear.

tickets.subject: Annual billing discount skipped the Connector Pack add-on
tickets.description: Customer switched to annual billing and the 15% discount applies to the platform fee but not to the Connector Pack add-on line, though their order form covers both.
tickets.resolution_notes: Add-ons purchased before the last price book update were excluded from the annual discount rule by default.
