Applied the discount to the add-on line as specified in the order form and updated the subscription so it persists at renewal. Confirmed the reissued invoice discounted both lines.

tickets.subject: Signature validation fails during first SSO setup
tickets.description: A customer configuring SSO for the first time gets 'Signature validation failed' on every test sign-in, even though the certificate was copied from the identity provider minutes earlier.
tickets.resolution_notes: The admin had uploaded the IdP's encryption certificate rather than its signing certificate, so signatures could never verify. Pointed them to the signing certificate in the IdP metadata and they replaced it on the SSO settings page. Test sign-ins succeeded and SSO was switched on for the workspace.

tickets.subject: Chat test message fails with 'not_authed' after app cleanup
tickets.description: The customer's IT team cleaned up unused apps in their chat tool last week. Now sending a test alert to chat fails with 'not_authed'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Our app had been removed during the cleanup, revoking its token. The chat admin re-approved the app and the customer reconnected the channel in alert settings. The test alert posted successfully and alerts have been delivered since.

tickets.subject: 'Working days left this month' counts New Year's Day
tickets.description: In the first days of January the customer noticed the 'Working days left' tile counts 1 January and the other public holidays.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's custom holiday calendar had been imported for 2025 only, so 2026 had no holidays. As a workaround we entered January's holidays manually so pacing was right immediately; the customer imported their full 2026 calendar the following week as the permanent fix. The tile now excludes 2026 holidays.

tickets.subject: 200 store alerts at once when the till feed went down
tickets.description: When the point-of-sale feed for the whole chain paused for 20 minutes, every store manager received a 'no sales' alert simultaneously, around 200 messages in total.
tickets.resolution_notes: There was a chain-wide 'feed delayed' rule, but store-level rules were not configured to be suppressed while it was firing. Set the store rules to depend on the feed rule so they are held back during a feed outage. In a test pause only the single feed alert was sent.

tickets.subject: Not every status change produces a webhook
tickets.description: Customer expected one event per status change on fulfilment records, but when a record goes through several statuses within a few seconds they only receive the final one.
tickets.resolution_notes: Event coalescing was enabled on their subscription, which merges rapid successive updates to the same object within 5 seconds into one event carrying the latest state. Since they need every transition, we disabled coalescing for their subscription. Each status change now arrives as its own event.

tickets.subject: Query API returns 504 when grouping by transaction
tickets.description: Customer's internal script calls the query endpoint with group_by=transaction_id for a quarter and receives HTTP 504 after 120 seconds. The same call grouped by day works.
tickets.resolution_notes: Grouping by transaction ID returned one group per transaction (about 40 million), which is row-level extraction rather than aggregation and exceeded the query time budget. Advised the customer to use the bulk export job for row-level data and kept their dashboards on daily grouping. Their script now finishes the quarterly extract in about 12 minutes through the export job.

tickets.subject: 'Manage schedules' role also lets users edit layouts
tickets.description: Users with a custom role meant only for managing report schedules can also move and resize widgets.
tickets.resolution_notes: The role had been created under the legacy permission model, where 'Manage schedules' was bundled with 'Edit dashboard'. Migrated the role to the granular model, where schedule management is separate. Confirmed the users could manage schedules but not edit layouts.

tickets.subject: Embedded charts dark on a white partner portal
tickets.description: In the customer's partner portal, embedded charts sometimes appear on a dark background against the white page. It seems to depend on the viewer's computer.
tickets.resolution_notes: Embedded views followed each viewer's operating-system colour scheme, so viewers using dark mode got the dark theme. Added a 'theme' parameter to embed links and set the customer's embed to the light theme. Charts now match the portal for every viewer.

tickets.subject: 429 burst limit errors from parallel batch job
tickets.description: Customer's batch job fires 200 requests at once at 02:00 and about two thirds fail with 429 'burst limit exceeded', although they are far below their hourly quota.
tickets.resolution_notes: Besides the hourly quota there is a per-second burst limit of 50 requests, which the job exceeded by launching everything concurrently. Recommended capping client concurrency at 20 with a small queue. The job now completes in about 30 seconds with no 429 responses.

tickets.subject: Hourly sales chart white on MacBooks, fine on Windows
tickets.description: The full-year hourly sales chart is a white rectangle on the finance team's MacBooks in Safari. Colleagues on Windows laptops see it normally.
tickets.resolution_notes: A year of hourly points on a high-resolution display pushed the chart's canvas beyond Safari's maximum canvas size, and Safari silently declined to draw it. Changed the chart to downsample to the visible pixel width and cap canvas size on high-density screens. The chart now renders in Safari on the MacBooks with no visible loss of detail.

tickets.subject: Product cost empty for every item from ERP
tickets.description: Margin widgets have no data because product cost is empty for every item, even though the merchandising team can see costs in the ERP.
tickets.resolution_notes: Field-level security in the ERP hid the unit cost field from the integration account, so the API returned it empty. The customer's ERP admin granted that account read access to the field. After a resync, unit costs populated for all 8,200 products and the margin widgets displayed.

tickets.subject: 500 error listing dashboards with emoji in titles
tickets.description: GET /v2/dashboards returns 500 for one customer but works for others. The customer recently renamed several dashboards with emoji in their titles.
tickets.resolution_notes: A legacy summary field truncated titles by byte count, splitting multi-byte emoji and producing an invalid string that failed serialization. Fixed the truncation to respect character boundaries. The customer's dashboard list now returns 200 with titles intact.

tickets.subject: SSO fails for users with an apostrophe in their surname
tickets.description: Two users at an apparel retailer cannot sign in via SSO and see a generic 'Sign-in failed' page while everyone else signs in normally. Both have an apostrophe in their last name.
tickets.resolution_notes: Our SAML parser rejected attribute values containing an escaped apostrophe entity and failed the whole assertion. Fixed the parser to decode standard XML entities and added test cases for punctuation in names. Both users signed in after the fix was deployed.

tickets.subject: Euro signs and quotes turn into odd symbols after export
tickets.description: Merchandisers say degree signs, curly quotes and euro symbols in product descriptions become strings like 'â‚¬' in the exported file.
tickets.resolution_notes: The file was valid UTF-8 but had no BOM, so the desktop spreadsheet decoded it as Windows-1252. Set BOM output as the workspace default and showed the merchandisers how to import with UTF-8 explicitly in their older templates. Confirmed the symbols displayed correctly in a fresh export.

tickets.subject: Delivery map screen slows to a crawl by evening
tickets.description: A logistics team keeps a delivery map dashboard open all day. By evening panning is very slow and the browser uses several gigabytes of memory.
tickets.resolution_notes: The map widget cached every map tile it had ever fetched with no size limit. As an interim workaround we enabled the scheduled nightly reload option for that display; a bounded tile cache is scheduled for an upcoming release. With the nightly reload in place the screen stayed responsive through the next week.

tickets.subject: Archived products still show stock
tickets.description: Products archived in the e-commerce admin last season still have stock levels in the inventory dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: Archived products are left out of the platform's default product listing, so the connector stopped seeing them and kept their last stock values. The connector now requests archived products and marks them inactive with zero sellable stock. After the next sync 320 archived products dropped out of the inventory dashboard.

tickets.subject: Can't find invoices for a marketplace purchase
tickets.description: The customer bought their subscription through their cloud provider's software marketplace and cannot find any invoices in Billing Center.
tickets.resolution_notes: Marketplace purchases are invoiced by the marketplace operator, and Billing Center lists only subscriptions we bill directly. Explained where the invoices appear in the marketplace console and set the account flag that shows a 'Billed via marketplace' banner in Billing Center. Confirmed the banner displayed for the admin.

tickets.subject: Alert created from dashboard ignores the dashboard's filter
tickets.description: Customer created an alert from a widget on their 'Outlet stores' dashboard. The alert fires on figures for the whole company instead of outlets only.
tickets.resolution_notes: The widget had no filter of its own; the outlet restriction was a dashboard-level filter, which alerts created from a widget do not inherit. Added the outlet segment to the rule scope, and the create-alert dialog now offers to copy dashboard-level filters. The rule's next evaluation matched the outlet dashboard's figures.

tickets.subject: Exported totals include a channel I filtered out
tickets.description: Paraphrasing the user: 'I excluded wholesale with the quick filter and the screen total dropped, but the export total is still the higher number.'
tickets.resolution_notes: Quick-filter selections lived only in the browser session and were not passed to the export request, which applied the saved filters instead. Applied the same exclusion as a saved filter on the user's personal view. Confirmed the exported total matched the on-screen figure.

tickets.subject: Catalogue connector: 'certificate has expired' since Saturday
tickets.description: The customer's product catalogue connector has failed every run since Saturday with 'certificate has expired' from their catalogue API.
tickets.resolution_notes: The certificate on the customer's catalogue API host had reached its expiry date without renewal because the reminder went to a former team mailbox. The customer renewed and installed the certificate and updated the reminder contact. The connector resumed and caught up within an hour.

tickets.subject: Line chart export only gives a PNG
tickets.description: A user wants the numbers behind a line chart, but the chart's export menu seems to offer only a PNG image.
tickets.resolution_notes: The data download sat under 'View as table' in the chart menu, which the user had not found. Showed them the option, and the export menu now lists 'Download data (CSV)' directly. Confirmed the user downloaded the chart's data.

tickets.subject: Every webhook event arriving twice
tickets.description: Customer's consumer receives each event twice, consistently, with different delivery IDs but identical event IDs.
tickets.resolution_notes: Two subscriptions pointed at the same URL: an old one created during a pilot and a newer one from the production setup. Removed the pilot subscription after confirming it covered no extra event types. Each event now arrives once.

tickets.subject: Duplicate tickets created by alert webhook to our automation
tickets.description: Customer's automation platform receives our alert webhooks and opens a work ticket for each. Many alerts now produce two or three tickets, and our alert log shows timeouts for those deliveries.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their automation ran the whole ticket creation before responding, taking over 10 seconds, so our alert channel timed out after 8 seconds and retried. Advised them to acknowledge immediately and create the ticket asynchronously, and to use the alert's dedup key to ignore repeats. After the change no timeouts or duplicate tickets were seen over a week.

tickets.subject: Outgoing admin can't demote themselves
tickets.description: The outgoing admin tries to change their own role to Editor and gets 'Workspace must have at least one admin'.
tickets.resolution_notes: They were the only admin, and the last-admin protection blocked the change. At the customer's request they first promoted their designated successor to Admin and then changed their own role. Confirmed the successor was the workspace's admin.

tickets.subject: Renewal quote includes people who never joined
tickets.description: The customer's finance lead says the annual renewal quote lists 42 seats, but only 35 people have ever signed in. The difference matches a group of colleagues invited during a pilot who never accepted.
tickets.resolution_notes: A seat-counting rule change in the billing service had started treating users in 'invited' status as billable, so the seven unaccepted invitations were included in the quote. Revoked the stale invitations at the admin's request, regenerated the quote and logged the counting defect with the billing team. Confirmed the revised quote showed 35 seats.

tickets.subject: Analyst locked out every Monday before starting work
tickets.description: Finance analyst reports finding their account locked every Monday morning, although they haven't typed their password since Friday.
tickets.resolution_notes: A shared reporting PC ran an old version of the spreadsheet add-in that stored the analyst's previous password, and its weekend refresh kept retrying until the lockout policy triggered. Upgraded the add-in on that PC, which uses a personal token instead of a stored password, and had the analyst sign in again. The following Monday the account was not locked.

tickets.subject: Same region, different colour in neighbouring charts
tickets.description: On the customer's executive dashboard, North is orange in the map legend but purple in the bar chart right beside it, and board members found it confusing.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each chart chose colours by the order of regions in its own result, and the bar chart left out a region with no sales, which shifted the order. Switched both charts to colour by region value from a shared palette. North is now orange in both.

tickets.subject: March GBP figure in board deck no longer matches dashboard
tickets.description: Per the customer: 'Our board deck quoted £1.84M for March, and the same Sales Overview tile now says £1.79M for March.' Nobody has changed any March orders.
tickets.resolution_notes: USD orders were converted to GBP with today's rate on every query rather than the rate in effect on each order date, so an already reported month kept moving with the market. Applied transaction-date conversion and rebuilt the monthly aggregates. March returned to £1,841,302 and did not move after the next daily rate refresh.

tickets.subject: Webhooks to legacy receiver fail with 'protocol version'
tickets.description: Deliveries to the customer's older order-routing service fail immediately with 'tlsv1 alert protocol version'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The receiver only supported TLS 1.0, while the webhook sender requires TLS 1.2 or later. The customer enabled TLS 1.2 on the service's reverse proxy. Deliveries succeeded on the next retry cycle.

tickets.subject: Agency wants its logo removed from client-facing share links
tickets.description: An agency customer shares dashboards with its own clients and wants those pages unbranded, but the agency logo appears at the top of every public link.
tickets.resolution_notes: This workspace applied branding to public links. Turned off 'Apply workspace branding to public links' and set the share-page header to 'None'. Public links now show no logo or brand colours, while internal views keep the branding.

tickets.subject: Inherited dashboards' calculated fields are read-only
tickets.description: A category analyst who inherited a colleague's dashboards can edit the layouts but gets 'Read-only dataset' when changing calculated fields.
tickets.resolution_notes: The handover moved only the dashboards; the underlying datasets were still owned by the previous analyst's deactivated account. Transferred dataset ownership with the admin's approval. Confirmed the analyst could edit the calculated fields.

tickets.subject: Staff portal frame returns to sign-in on every page view
tickets.description: Store managers open the weekly sales dashboard inside the customer's staff portal (portal.example.net). Signing in within the frame appears to work, then the frame reloads to the sign-in form.
tickets.resolution_notes: Session cookies set within the cross-site frame were being dropped by the browser. Enabled signed embed links, released this quarter, which hand the frame a short-lived embed token instead of relying on a cookie. Store managers reloaded the framed dashboard repeatedly without any sign-in prompt.

tickets.subject: Alert emails arrive up to an hour after the alert
tickets.description: Customer's team sees alerts in the app immediately, but the matching emails come in batches, sometimes 50 minutes later.
tickets.resolution_notes: The email channel had been switched to hourly digest mode by a colleague to reduce inbox noise, which groups alerts into one email per hour. Set critical-severity alerts to send immediately while keeping warnings in the digest. Critical test alerts now arrive within a minute.

tickets.subject: 'Payment failed' email for an invoice paid against a PO
tickets.description: Customer received a payment failure email for an invoice their accounts payable team had already paid by transfer against a purchase order.
tickets.resolution_notes: The account was on invoiced terms but still held an old card, and the system tried that card before the transfer had been allocated, which generated the failure email. Removed the stale card, confirmed the invoice shows as paid by transfer and voided the failed charge attempt. Verified that no further dunning emails were scheduled.

tickets.subject: Still suspended three days after paying by transfer
tickets.description: Customer paid the overdue balance by bank transfer three days ago, but the workspace remains suspended.
tickets.resolution_notes: Transfers are matched to invoices using the invoice number in the payment reference, and this one carried only the company name, so it sat unallocated. Matched the payment to the invoice manually, which lifted the suspension, and asked the customer to quote invoice numbers in future references. Confirmed the account returned to Active.

tickets.subject: Second online store never appears in real time
tickets.description: The customer connected a second online store to the same workspace. Its orders appear after the nightly sync but never live.
tickets.resolution_notes: The second store was added through 'Add shop' on the existing connection, which skipped event registration, so subscriptions existed only for the first store. Registered subscriptions for the second store and fixed 'Add shop' to register them too. Orders from both stores now reach the live feed within a minute.

tickets.subject: AccessDenied when downloading bulk export result
tickets.description: Customer's integration starts a bulk export, waits for it to complete, and then gets 403 'AccessDenied: request has expired' when downloading the file about an hour later.
tickets.resolution_notes: Result URLs are pre-signed and valid for 15 minutes from the status call that returns them. The integration stored the URL and downloaded it later. Changed it to call the job status endpoint immediately before downloading to get a fresh URL. Downloads now succeed regardless of delay.

tickets.subject: Subscription email buttons go to the generic product address
tickets.description: Customer's admin noticed that the 'Open dashboard' buttons in subscription emails point to the generic product address rather than their branded domain.
tickets.resolution_notes: Email buttons are built with the workspace's link domain, which was still the default because the custom-domain link setting was off. Enabled it, and the buttons in the next subscription email used the branded domain.

tickets.subject: CRM connector stopped syncing after an admin left
tickets.description: Customer reports opportunity data in the pipeline dashboard has not changed since last Thursday. The connector page shows 'Authorization invalid'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The CRM connection had been authorized by an admin who has since left the company, and deactivating their CRM user revoked the refresh token. The customer re-authorized the connector with a dedicated integration user in their CRM. A manual sync completed and pulled in four days of opportunity changes.

tickets.subject: Mobile app says 'User not found' for some accounts
tickets.description: A handful of users can sign in on the web, but the mobile app tells them 'User not found'. Every one of their login emails contains capital letters.
tickets.resolution_notes: Those accounts came from an old import that kept the original capitalization, and the mobile sign-in endpoint compared emails case-sensitively. Normalized stored login emails to lowercase and made the lookup case-insensitive. The affected users signed in on mobile successfully.

tickets.subject: Legend covers the line chart when many stores are selected
tickets.description: With more than about 25 stores selected, the legend grows until it hides most of the line chart.
tickets.resolution_notes: The legend had no maximum height and expanded with every series. Limited it to a scrollable area of one third of the widget and added a 'Top N plus Other' option for charts with many series. With 40 stores selected the lines are fully visible and the legend scrolls.

tickets.subject: Command-line report tool rejects credentials after password change
tickets.description: An analyst who pulls weekly figures with our command-line tool says it began failing with 'invalid credentials' on the day they changed their password. Their scripts are untouched.
tickets.resolution_notes: The tool authenticates with the analyst's personal token, and changing the password revoked every personal token on the account as designed. The analyst generated a new personal token and updated the tool's configuration file. The next scheduled run downloaded the figures successfully.

tickets.subject: Source connection fails: hostname does not match certificate
tickets.description: After the customer pointed the connector at their new hostname orders-api.northwind.example.com, runs fail with 'Hostname/IP does not match certificate's altnames'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The server's certificate still listed only the old hostname among its subject alternative names. The customer reissued the certificate with both hostnames as SANs. The connector validated the new hostname and the next run completed.

tickets.subject: Signed out after 12 hours even while working
tickets.description: Users on long store-opening shifts are forced to sign in again partway through the day, sometimes in the middle of a task.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace policy sets a 12-hour absolute session lifetime that applies regardless of activity, unlike the idle timeout users expected. The admin chose to keep the limit for security reasons, so we added a warning banner ten minutes before expiry so users can save their work. Users confirmed seeing the banner before the next forced sign-in.

tickets.subject: Widgets stay grey placeholders after browser policy rollout
tickets.description: Since the customer's IT rolled out a new browser policy, dashboards show grey placeholder boxes that never fill in, with no error message.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new policy blocked web workers, which the chart engine used to prepare data, and the engine waited indefinitely for a worker that never started. Added a fallback that prepares data on the main thread when workers are unavailable. Widgets now fill in on the managed browsers, slightly slower for the largest charts.

tickets.subject: Can't send alerts to private chat channel
tickets.description: Customer created a private channel for loss-prevention alerts. Selecting it in alert settings and sending a test returns 'channel_not_found'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Our app can only post to private channels it has been invited to. The customer invited the app to the loss-prevention channel, and the test alert then posted correctly. Added this step to the channel setup help text.

tickets.subject: Weeks of supply in the hundreds for core lines
tickets.description: Weeks of supply for basic t-shirts reads 312 weeks on the planning dashboard, but planners know there's about six weeks of stock.
tickets.resolution_notes: Weeks of supply divides stock on hand by average weekly sales, and the stock input was summed over every day of the selected 8-week range. After setting on-hand to use the closing value of the range, the metric reads 5.8 weeks, matching the planning system.

tickets.subject: Channel blank for every order since last weekend
tickets.description: Orders synced since last weekend have an empty channel value, so the channel breakdown on the sales dashboard lumps them under 'Unknown'. Older orders are fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer replaced the custom order attribute 'sales_channel' with a new one called 'order_channel' in their e-commerce admin, and the connector mapping still pointed at the old attribute, which now returns nothing. Re-mapped to the new attribute and re-synced orders since the change. The channel breakdown shows no 'Unknown' orders for the period.

tickets.subject: IdP rejects sign-in requests after our certificate renewal
tickets.description: SSO stopped for a customer whose identity provider requires signed authentication requests. Users see an error from their own IdP, 'Request signature invalid', before they ever reach a login form.
tickets.resolution_notes: We had renewed the service-provider certificate used to sign authentication requests, and the customer's IdP still trusted only the old one. The customer imported our updated service-provider metadata, and admins now receive an email 30 days before such renewals. Sign-ins worked as soon as the import completed.

tickets.subject: Live orders ticker freezes the tab after a few hours
tickets.description: Customer's e-commerce team keeps the live orders ticker open during promotions. After 3-4 hours the tab freezes and must be closed.
tickets.resolution_notes: The ticker kept every received order event in memory for the whole session, reaching hundreds of thousands of events during promotions. Changed it to keep only the most recent 500 events in a ring buffer, with older ones available through the order explorer. The ticker ran through a 10-hour promotion without issue.

tickets.subject: Product unreachable only while connected to VPN
tickets.description: Customer's remote staff can use the product until they connect to the corporate VPN, at which point the app stops loading with a DNS error.
tickets.resolution_notes: The VPN pushes internal DNS servers that did not forward external queries for split-tunnel clients, so app.example.net could not be resolved once connected. The customer configured conditional forwarding for the product's domains on the VPN resolvers. Users stay connected to the app when the VPN comes up.

tickets.subject: Store-traffic feed sometimes imports only part of a file
tickets.description: On some days the store-traffic feed imports only a fraction of the rows. Re-uploading the same file the next day always imports it completely.
tickets.resolution_notes: Large files were still being written to the SFTP folder when the connection polled, so it read a partial file and marked it processed. The connection now waits until a file's size is stable across two checks, and we suggested the customer upload under a temporary name and rename on completion. Every daily file over the following two weeks imported in full.

tickets.subject: Dashboards never seem to use the cache
tickets.description: The customer's operations team says their dashboards always behave like a cold load, 10-15 seconds per view, all day long. Their connected point-of-sale source sends small updates every two minutes.
tickets.resolution_notes: Every incoming micro-batch invalidated the entire workspace cache rather than only the datasets that changed, so the cache was cleared roughly every two minutes. Scoped invalidation to the affected dataset and added a 5-minute minimum freshness window, which the customer agreed to. Cache hit rate rose from under 5% to about 80% and typical loads are now under 3 seconds.

tickets.subject: Hourly sync option greyed out after plan change
tickets.description: After the customer changed plans, their e-commerce connection dropped from hourly to daily syncs without anyone touching it, and the hourly option is now greyed out.
tickets.resolution_notes: The plan change re-applied connector defaults, and the workspace's entitlement for hourly syncs had not been refreshed for the new plan. Refreshed the entitlements and restored the hourly schedule. Hourly runs resumed the same afternoon.

tickets.subject: Quebec stores see English despite French workspace language
tickets.description: The workspace language is French, but staff at Quebec stores see the interface in English on the shared store PCs.
tickets.resolution_notes: The language source was set to 'Detect from browser', and the store PCs' browsers were set to English. Changed the language source to 'Workspace default' so French applies unless a user explicitly chooses otherwise. Store PCs now show French.

tickets.subject: Store sales dashboard slow only for the current quarter
tickets.description: Customer reports the store sales dashboard loads in about 3 seconds when they pick last year, but anything that includes the current quarter takes 35-45 seconds.
tickets.resolution_notes: Since the orders table moved to automatic monthly partitions, the partitions created for the current quarter had been built without the (store_id, order_date) index, so recent months were scanned in full. Created the missing index on the affected partitions and fixed the partition template so new partitions inherit it. The current-quarter view now loads in under 4 seconds.

tickets.subject: Codes rejected after moving authenticator to a new phone
tickets.description: Customer migrated their authenticator app to a new phone from a backup. The entry for our app shows codes, but none are accepted.
tickets.resolution_notes: The backup restored an entry from an earlier enrollment that had since been replaced, so its secret no longer matched the account. After the customer's admin verified the user's identity, we reset 2FA for that single user and they enrolled again from the new phone. Sign-in with the new code succeeded.

tickets.subject: Can't tell whether '$' means USD, CAD or AUD
tickets.description: Dashboards for the customer's three dollar markets all show '$', and executives assume some figures are in the wrong currency.
tickets.resolution_notes: The currency display style was 'Symbol', which renders USD, CAD and AUD identically. Changed it to 'ISO code' so values are labelled USD, CAD and AUD. Executives confirmed the figures were correct once labelled.

tickets.subject: New lead source value dropped during sync
tickets.description: The customer added a lead source value 'Pop-up Store' in their CRM. Leads with that source appear in the dashboard with no source at all.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector validated picklist values against a list cached when the connection was created and silently cleared values it didn't recognize. Changed it to refresh picklist definitions on every run and to keep unrecognized values. Re-synced the affected leads, and 'Pop-up Store' now shows 148 leads in the source chart.

tickets.subject: Source API gateway returns 403 to EU connector workers
tickets.description: After the customer moved their order API behind a new API gateway, pulls from our EU region fail with '403 Forbidden - region not permitted', while their US workspace using the same API works.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new gateway had a geo-restriction policy that blocked requests from outside North America, which included the product's EU connector egress addresses. The customer added the product's published EU egress ranges to the gateway's geo-policy exceptions for the order API path only. Pulls from the EU workspace succeeded on the next run.

tickets.subject: Size breakdown widget slow after adding regex calculated field
tickets.description: Customer created a calculated field that pulls the garment size out of the product name with a regular expression. Any widget using it takes 30+ seconds.
tickets.resolution_notes: The regex was evaluated on every transaction row at query time, roughly 200 million evaluations per load. Materialized the extracted size as a derived product attribute computed once when products are loaded, and pointed the widgets at it. The values were identical and the widgets now load in about 2 seconds.

tickets.subject: New hires see 'This dashboard is no longer available' on first login
tickets.description: HR onboarding reports that every new hire's first screen is an error saying the dashboard is no longer available.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new-member home setting pointed to a dashboard archived last month, so first-time users were sent to missing content. Pointed the new-member default at the current onboarding dashboard and added a warning before archiving any dashboard used as a default. New hires now land on the onboarding dashboard.

tickets.subject: Bar chart is a grey box after calculated fields were tidied
tickets.description: After an analyst cleaned up old calculated fields, the 'basket size by region' bar chart shows only a grey box with no axes or bars.
tickets.resolution_notes: The widget still referenced a calculated field that had been deleted, and the chart received an undefined measure that it silently failed to draw. Widgets now show 'This field no longer exists' with a link to edit, and the analyst re-pointed the chart to the replacement field. The chart drew correctly afterwards.

tickets.subject: Embedded dashboard tiny inside a narrow portal tile
tickets.description: Inside a narrow tile on the customer's portal, the embedded dashboard shows the full desktop layout shrunk so far that nothing is legible.
tickets.resolution_notes: Responsive breakpoints were based on the browser window width rather than the frame width, so the embed always picked the desktop layout. Changed the breakpoints to use the container width. In the narrow tile the dashboard now switches to its single-column layout.

tickets.subject: Custom webhook receiver never validates any signature
tickets.description: A customer building their first webhook receiver says none of the signatures match, including on the test event sent from settings.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their code computed the HMAC over the parsed 'data' object only, while signatures cover the timestamp, a period, and the full raw body, as documented. Shared the reference verification snippet and walked through the signed-content format. Their receiver validated the test event and subsequent live events.

tickets.subject: 'Remember me' does nothing on store PCs
tickets.description: Store staff tick 'Remember me' but must sign in again every time the browser is reopened.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace has 'Allow persistent sessions' turned off, which overrides the 'Remember me' option; the admin confirmed this is intentional for shared store computers. We now hide the checkbox when the policy disables it so staff are not misled. The admin verified the checkbox no longer appears on the store PCs.

tickets.subject: Settings import blanked our branding
tickets.description: After an admin imported a settings file to standardise locale across workspaces, the logo and brand colours disappeared from the main workspace.
tickets.resolution_notes: The exported settings file contained empty branding fields, and the import treated empty values as 'clear' rather than 'leave unchanged'. Restored branding from settings history, and the import now skips empty fields unless clearing is explicitly requested. Logo and colours are back.

tickets.subject: Onboarding services package invoiced twice
tickets.description: Customer received two invoices for the one-time onboarding services package: a line on the subscription invoice and a separate services invoice.
tickets.resolution_notes: The account team had added the package both to the subscription order form and to a standalone services order. Voided the standalone services invoice. Confirmed the subscription invoice carried a single onboarding line and the customer's balance was correct.

tickets.subject: New store manager only sees the training sandbox
tickets.description: A store manager invited by the regional lead logs in fine but sees only a handful of demo dashboards from the training sandbox.
tickets.resolution_notes: The invitation had been sent from the sandbox workspace the regional lead happened to have open, so the user joined only that workspace. Added the user to the production workspace with the Store Manager role and, at the lead's request, removed the sandbox membership. Confirmed the manager saw the production store dashboards.

tickets.subject: Live dashboard missed orders during flash sale
tickets.description: During a two-hour flash sale, the live dashboard missed about 8% of orders until the nightly sync filled the gap.
tickets.resolution_notes: Our event intake endpoint returned errors when its processing queue was full, and the platform gave up on those events after three attempts. Increased intake capacity and changed the endpoint to accept and queue events before processing them. During the next flash sale every order appeared on the live dashboard.

tickets.subject: External supplier never receives sell-through report
tickets.description: A supplier contact added as a recipient of the weekly sell-through report never gets it, while internal recipients do.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace delivery policy allows report recipients only on the customer's verified domains, and the supplier uses a different domain. After their data-sharing review, the admin added the supplier's domain to the allowed recipient domains. Confirmed the supplier received the next report.

tickets.subject: Analyst explorations slowing store dashboards
tickets.description: Customer says store staff dashboards become very slow whenever the central analytics team is running ad-hoc explorations, usually mid-morning.
tickets.resolution_notes: Ten analysts each running heavy multi-year explorations consumed all of the workspace's concurrency slots, leaving store dashboards waiting. Configured workload classes so dashboards keep reserved slots and ad-hoc explorations queue among themselves. Store dashboards stayed under 4 seconds during the next analytics session.

tickets.subject: Saved views menu takes ages to open
tickets.description: Customer reports that the 'Saved views' menu on the sales dashboard takes 10+ seconds to open for one service user and freezes briefly for everyone else.
tickets.resolution_notes: An internal script at the customer had been creating a new saved view on every run, leaving over 3,000 near-identical saved views, and the menu loaded all of them at once. Helped the customer remove the redundant views and fix their script, and added pagination to the menu. The menu now opens immediately.

tickets.subject: Personal tokens stop working after 90 days
tickets.description: Users of the spreadsheet add-in are surprised to find it asking for authorization again roughly every three months.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace security policy sets a 90-day maximum lifetime for personal tokens, and nothing warned users before expiry. Added a reminder email seven days before a token expires and a clear 'token expired' message in the add-in; the admin kept the 90-day limit. Users received the reminder before the next expiry and re-authorized without opening a support request.

tickets.subject: Supplier reps land on 'Access expired' mid-quarter
tickets.description: Supplier representatives can still sign in but land on an 'Access expired' notice instead of the shared sell-through dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their guest access had been created with the default 30-day expiry. Set an expiry matching the supplier agreement, the end of the quarter, and turned on a 7-day reminder to the inviter before expiry. Confirmed the representatives could open the dashboard.

tickets.subject: Alerts arrive by email but not in our chat tool
tickets.description: Since Tuesday the customer gets alerts by email and in-app as usual, but nothing in their chat tool. They didn't change any alert settings.
tickets.resolution_notes: The chat delivery log showed authorization failures starting Tuesday, when the customer's chat admin reinstalled the app and invalidated the previous token. Reconnected the channel in alert settings. Chat posts resumed with the next alert, and we now email rule owners when a chat channel loses authorization.

tickets.subject: Edits to shipped orders not reflected
tickets.description: When staff edit a shipped order to remove a damaged item and refund it, the dashboard keeps showing the original basket and total.
tickets.resolution_notes: The platform stores post-fulfilment edits as separate adjustment records linked to the order, and the connector only read the original order record. Added adjustment records to the order sync and applied them to the last 60 days. Edited orders now show their final baskets and totals.

tickets.subject: Old workspace name still shown after rebrand
tickets.description: The customer renamed their workspace from 'Granite Retail' to 'Granite Peak Outdoor', but a day later some users still see the old name in the browser tab and the workspace switcher.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace display name was cached in each user's session profile and only refreshed at the next sign-in. As an immediate workaround we triggered a workspace metadata refresh for active sessions; a permanent change to read the name live instead of from the cached profile is scheduled. All users saw the new name after the refresh.

tickets.subject: Report list sync failing since 1 July and we got no warning
tickets.description: Customer reports their scheduled pull of report metadata fails every run since 1 July. They say they were never told anything would change.
tickets.resolution_notes: The job still used v1 report endpoints, which were sunset on 1 July; deprecation notices had gone to a technical contact who had left the company. Helped them migrate the job to v2 and update the workspace's technical contact. The job has run cleanly since, and future notices reach the current team.

tickets.subject: Older invoice PDFs show 'Document unavailable'
tickets.description: Clicking Download PDF on any invoice more than 12 months old returns 'Document unavailable'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Invoice PDFs older than 12 months had been moved to archive storage, but the download links still pointed to the original location. Regenerated the requested PDFs for the customer, and the archive link mapping was corrected. Confirmed the customer could download every invoice from 2024.

tickets.subject: Store filter dropdown takes 12 seconds to open
tickets.description: Customer reports the store filter on every dashboard shows 'Loading values...' for about 12 seconds before the list of stores appears.
tickets.resolution_notes: The filter built its value list by selecting distinct store names from the transactions table instead of from the store dimension. Switched the filter source to the dimension table. The dropdown now opens in under half a second with the same list of stores.

tickets.subject: Monthly charge rose by four seats with no new hires
tickets.description: Agent summary: Growth plan invoice went from 20 to 24 seats. Admin says nobody new uses the product and the member list shows 20 active people.
tickets.resolution_notes: The four extra seats were invitations sent to a shared store-operations mailbox that nobody had accepted; since the recent counting change, invited users were billed as seats. Cancelled the invitations, credited four seats for the period and linked the account to the open counting defect. The next draft invoice showed 20 seats.

tickets.subject: Month-to-date KPI tiles time out at the start of each month
tickets.description: Customer says the month-to-date revenue and units tiles on their executive board started timing out with 'Query exceeded 60s' at the beginning of this month. Prior-month tiles on the same board are fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new month's partition had been auto-created on a database shard where the earlier partition template correction had not yet been applied, so it lacked the (store_id, order_date) index and month-to-date queries hit an unindexed partition that grew all day. Added the index online and applied the corrected template to the remaining shards. Confirmed the MTD tiles load in about 2 seconds and verified next month's pre-created partition already has the index.

tickets.subject: Stores in one region need a Friday-Saturday weekend
tickets.description: The customer's stores in one region observe a Friday-Saturday weekend, but working-day metrics treat Saturday and Sunday as the weekend.
tickets.resolution_notes: Weekend days are defined per business calendar, and the region used the default Saturday-Sunday calendar. Created a calendar with a Friday-Saturday weekend and assigned it to that store group. Working-day counts for those stores now exclude Fridays and Saturdays.

tickets.subject: Refund alert didn't fire at exactly 50 refunds
tickets.description: Agent summary: customer's refund spike rule is 'refunds greater than 50 per hour'. One hour had exactly 50 refunds and no alert went out; they expected one.
tickets.resolution_notes: 'Greater than' excludes the threshold value itself. The customer wanted the boundary included, so changed the operator to 'greater than or equal to'. A test with a 50-refund sample hour now triggers the alert.

tickets.subject: Billing Center seat counter higher than Users page
tickets.description: Customer compared the Users page filtered to Active with the seat counter in Billing Center and found 11 more seats billed. They asked us to list exactly who they are paying for.
tickets.resolution_notes: The Billing Center counter includes users whose invitation is still pending, which the Active filter on the Users page hides, and pending invites had become billable after a counting rule change. Sent the admin the list of pending invitations; they withdrew nine, and the release that excluded unaccepted invitations from billing removed the remaining two later that month. Verified the counter matched the Active user count after the release.

tickets.subject: Invoice total off by one cent from sum of lines
tickets.description: The customer's accounting system flags a 0.01 difference between the sum of line items and the invoice total on invoices that have several prorated lines.
tickets.resolution_notes: Tax was calculated on the unrounded subtotal while each line was rounded to two decimals, so totals could differ by a cent. Switched the account to line-level tax rounding, which was being rolled out to all accounts, and reissued the affected invoice. Confirmed the reissued invoice reconciled exactly.

tickets.subject: 'Exports are disabled during data review' for every user
tickets.description: All users suddenly get 'Exports are disabled for this workspace during data review' whenever they try to download anything.
tickets.resolution_notes: An admin had turned on an export freeze for an internal audit without setting an end date. Once the admin confirmed the audit had finished, lifted the freeze and showed how to schedule one with an end date. Confirmed exports worked again.

tickets.subject: Mobile app opens on a different dashboard than the web app
tickets.description: After the home dashboard was changed, web users land on the new one but the mobile app still opens on the old dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: The mobile app uses a separate 'Mobile home dashboard' setting, which still pointed to the old dashboard. Updated it to match the web home. The mobile app opens on the new dashboard after a refresh.

tickets.subject: Usage page still over limit after deleting test source
tickets.description: The admin deleted a 3-million-row test data source to stay within the Growth plan's row allowance, yet the Usage page still shows them over the limit.
tickets.resolution_notes: Deleted sources sit in a 30-day soft-delete window, and the usage meter included those rows. With the admin's confirmation, permanently purged the source, and the meter recalculated. Confirmed the Usage page showed 2.1 million rows against the 2.5 million allowance.

tickets.subject: Order timestamps in CSV five hours ahead of dashboard
tickets.description: Order timestamps in CSV exports appear five hours later than the same orders on the dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: Exports wrote timestamps in UTC without an offset, while the dashboard shows them in the workspace time zone. Enabled the export option that converts timestamps to the workspace time zone and appends the offset. Confirmed exported times matched the dashboard.

tickets.subject: Delivery delay alerts unreliable because carrier data arrives at random times
tickets.description: Customer's carrier status data arrives anywhere between 10 and 50 minutes past the hour, so their 'late deliveries above 5%' alert sometimes evaluates on incomplete data and sometimes doesn't.
tickets.resolution_notes: Fixed-time evaluation cannot adapt to irregular arrival. As a workaround we set a 55-minute evaluation delay, which makes alerts reliable but later than ideal; evaluation triggered by data arrival is on the roadmap and the customer was added to its early access list. Since the change there have been no false alerts in two weeks.

tickets.subject: Revenue rounded to '1.2M' on KPI tiles
tickets.description: Finance thinks revenue is being rounded incorrectly because tiles show $1.2M instead of $1,234,567.89.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace default 'Compact numbers on tiles' was on, which abbreviates large values on display; the stored values were exact. Turned compact numbers off for the workspace. Tiles now show full values that match the source.

tickets.subject: Reset emails work for personal mailbox but not company address
tickets.description: The customer's admin says head-office staff get 'Link expired or invalid' whenever they open a password reset email at their work address. A test account using a personal mailbox resets without any trouble.
tickets.resolution_notes: Audit logs showed each reset token redeemed from a scanning service a few seconds after delivery; the customer's mail filter pre-opens links only in messages to corporate mailboxes. Walked the affected staff through entering the reset code from the email instead of following the link, and attached the case to the scheduled change that will stop link opens from redeeming tokens. All four staff members confirmed they could sign in.

tickets.subject: Embedded dashboard blank inside the store kiosk app
tickets.description: The embedded dashboard that works in desktop browsers shows only a white panel inside the customer's in-store kiosk app.
tickets.resolution_notes: The kiosk app's webview enforces its own domain allow-list, which included the intranet but not embed.example.net or cdn.example.net. The customer's device team added both hosts to the kiosk configuration profile. The dashboard now appears inside the kiosk app.

tickets.subject: Everyone lands on an empty home page after login
tickets.description: Since yesterday, users who sign in see a blank home page reading 'No dashboard selected' instead of their usual Sales Overview.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace home dashboard had been archived during a clean-up, leaving no valid default. Set the new 'Sales Overview 2026' dashboard as the workspace home. Users land on it after sign-in.

tickets.subject: One manager stopped receiving alert emails
tickets.description: A regional manager says alert emails stopped arriving three weeks ago, while colleagues on the same rules still get them. Nothing in spam.
tickets.resolution_notes: Her mailbox had been full for a week, so our sends bounced repeatedly and the address was added to the bounce suppression list. After she confirmed the mailbox was cleared, removed the address from suppression and sent a test alert, which she received. Admins now see suppressed recipients flagged in the rule's recipient list.

tickets.subject: Webhooks stopped completely last week
tickets.description: Customer says they have not received a single webhook since last Wednesday. Their endpoint had problems during a server migration but has been healthy since Friday.
tickets.resolution_notes: During the migration the endpoint failed every delivery for over 72 hours, so the subscription was automatically disabled and stayed disabled after the endpoint recovered. Re-enabled the subscription and replayed the missed events from the event log. The customer confirmed receipt of the backlog and new events.

tickets.subject: Weekly unique loyalty shoppers exceed total membership
tickets.description: The Loyalty module reports 182,000 unique member shoppers last week, but the program only has 140,000 members in total.
tickets.resolution_notes: The weekly figure was produced by adding up each day's distinct shopper count, which counts a member who shopped on three days three times. Changed weekly and monthly grains to count distinct members over the whole period from the underlying visits. Last week now shows 96,400 unique member shoppers, matching a direct count from the transactions.

tickets.subject: Report set for day 30 never sent in February
tickets.description: A report scheduled for 'day 30 of every month' did not go out at all in February.
tickets.resolution_notes: The scheduler skipped months that lack the configured day instead of falling back to the last day. Switched the schedule to the 'last day of month' option, which matched the customer's intent, and the scheduler was updated to fall back automatically. Confirmed a catch-up run for February was sent and the March run was queued for the 31st.

tickets.subject: POS API connector shows 'host unreachable' on some runs
tickets.description: The store POS integration alternates between successful runs and 'EHOSTUNREACH 192.0.2.40:443' errors, and the customer says nothing changed on their POS gateway.
tickets.resolution_notes: Runs failed whenever they were picked up by workers in the product's newer egress range, which the gateway's access list did not include. We shared the full published egress list and the customer added 198.51.100.32/28 to the gateway allow-list for port 443. Every run over the next 48 hours succeeded from both worker pools.

tickets.subject: Nightly 'daily sales below target' alert for the online shop
tickets.description: Customer's online shop triggers the 'daily sales below target' alert just after midnight almost every night, but the next morning's report shows the target was met.
tickets.resolution_notes: The online shop's final daily figures come from a settlement file that arrives around 02:00, but the rule evaluated at 00:15. Changed the rule to evaluate once the dataset's freshness marker shows the day is complete, with 03:00 as the latest fallback. The false nightly alerts stopped and a below-target test day still alerted.

tickets.subject: SFTP inventory files ignored after server move
tickets.description: The customer's IT team moved the inventory export to a new server, and nothing from the SFTP folder has been imported since. There are no errors; the files just sit there.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new server names files 'inventory-2026-07-01.csv' instead of 'inventory_20260701.csv', which didn't match the connection's file pattern, so they were never picked up. Updated the pattern to accept both formats and imported the nine waiting files. The next morning's file was picked up within the 15-minute polling window.

tickets.subject: 'Sales per open hour' assumes 9-to-5 for every store
tickets.description: The customer's stores trade from 8 am to 10 pm, but 'Sales per open hour' divides by eight hours per day.
tickets.resolution_notes: Store trading hours had never been configured, so the business calendar's default of 09:00-17:00 applied. Entered trading hours for each store group in the business calendar. Sales per open hour now divides by 14 hours on standard days.

tickets.subject: PATCH dashboard crashes with 500 instead of a validation error
tickets.description: Customer's automation sends a PATCH to update dashboard widgets and sometimes gets 500. They found the failing requests contain an empty item in the widgets array.
tickets.resolution_notes: A null entry in the widgets array reached code that assumed every entry was an object, causing an unhandled exception. Added validation so null or malformed entries return 400 with the offending index. The customer fixed their automation and receives clear validation errors for bad input.

tickets.subject: People added to Pricing team can't see team dashboard
tickets.description: People who joined the Pricing team this month cannot see a dashboard that was shared with the team last autumn.
tickets.resolution_notes: At the time of sharing, the share dialog had expanded the team into its individual members, so the dashboard was shared with those people rather than with the team. Re-shared it with the team itself. Confirmed new team members could see it.

tickets.subject: Franchise owners can't see stores opened this quarter
tickets.description: Franchise owners can see their existing stores but none of the locations they opened this quarter.
tickets.resolution_notes: The row-level rule used a static list of store IDs per franchisee that nobody had updated. Rewrote the rule to match on the franchisee_id field of each store record. Confirmed new stores appeared for their franchise owners automatically.

tickets.subject: Rate-limit errors started when the status wall went live
tickets.description: Customer noticed that 429 errors across their integrations began the same day their marketing team launched a live status wall that reads campaign metrics from our API.
tickets.resolution_notes: The status wall polled six endpoints every second, consuming the organisation's shared request quota that every integration draws from. Reconfigured the wall to refresh once a minute and subscribe to metric update events instead. The other integrations stopped receiving 429s the same afternoon.

tickets.subject: Share links still use app.example.net although our custom domain is live
tickets.description: The customer's custom domain analytics.brightline.example.com is verified and works, but 'Copy link' still produces app.example.net URLs.
tickets.resolution_notes: The domain was verified, but 'Use custom domain in links and emails' remained off, so generated links used the default domain. Enabled the setting. New share links use analytics.brightline.example.com.

tickets.subject: Embedded dashboard ignores the period passed in its link
tickets.description: The customer's portal adds a period parameter to the embed link so the dashboard opens on last week, but the embedded view always opens on the current month.
tickets.resolution_notes: Embed links only accepted filter parameters with the 'f_' prefix, and the portal used the plain name from an outdated guide. Updated the guide and made embeds accept both forms. The embedded dashboard now opens on last week.

tickets.subject: Sales increase alert goes off every Monday
tickets.description: Customer's 'sales up more than 40% vs previous day' alert fires every Monday morning for their high-street stores.
tickets.resolution_notes: Most of those stores are closed or have very short hours on Sundays, so comparing Monday with the previous day always shows a large increase. Changed the comparison baseline to the same weekday in the previous week. No Monday alerts fired the following two weeks, while a genuine Thursday spike was still caught.

tickets.subject: Conversion rate exported as 0.034 instead of 3.4%
tickets.description: A conversion rate displayed as 3.4% on the dashboard appears as 0.034 in the CSV.
tickets.resolution_notes: Display formatting is not applied to raw CSV values by design, so the underlying number is identical. Offered the 'Export formatted values' option, which writes '3.4%' but turns the column into text, and the customer chose it for that report. Confirmed the next export showed percentages.

tickets.subject: Promo code from trade show flyer says expired
tickets.description: Checkout rejects a promotional code with 'This code has expired', although the flyer handed out at a retail trade show says it is valid until the end of the quarter.
tickets.resolution_notes: The promotion's end date had been configured as the first day of the quarter's last month rather than its final day. Corrected the expiry in the promotions configuration, after which the customer applied the code. Confirmed the checkout total showed the 10% reduction.

tickets.subject: Shipping income multiplied by number of items
tickets.description: Shipping income in the fulfilment view is far higher than what customers paid; a three-item order with $7 shipping shows $21.
tickets.resolution_notes: The order-level shipping fee was attached to every line item when order lines were joined to orders, then summed across lines. Moved shipping to the order grain so it is counted once per order and recomputed. The example order now shows $7 and monthly shipping income matches the payment processor.

tickets.subject: PDF shows last month although I picked this week
tickets.description: Customer set the date picker to 'This week' and exported to PDF, but the PDF shows the dashboard's default 'Last month' range.
tickets.resolution_notes: The PDF exporter rendered the dashboard with its saved filter state, so the unsaved date change was ignored. As a workaround we saved a personal view with 'This week' and exported from it; the permanent change to carry session filters into exports shipped in the next release. Confirmed the PDF header showed the selected week.

tickets.subject: OIDC sign-ins fail: IdP key endpoint certificate expired
tickets.description: SSO through OIDC fails for the whole workspace, and the auth log shows 'certificate has expired' when retrieving the IdP's signing keys.
tickets.resolution_notes: The TLS certificate on the customer's IdP host serving the JWKS endpoint had expired, so the product could not fetch signing keys. The customer renewed the certificate on the IdP host. Key retrieval succeeded and sign-ins recovered without any change to the OIDC client settings.

tickets.subject: Sandbox settings copied into production
tickets.description: The production workspace suddenly uses the experimental locale and default dashboard from the customer's sandbox.
tickets.resolution_notes: An admin used 'Copy settings' intending to copy production into the sandbox but selected the opposite direction. Restored production's settings from history as of the previous day, and the copy dialog now names source and target and asks for confirmation. Production locale and default dashboard are back.

tickets.subject: German finance team wants decimal commas
tickets.description: Finance users in the Hamburg office misread 1,234.56 and asked for numbers to appear as 1.234,56.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace number format was English (US). Set the number format to German (1.234,56) for the workspace. Dashboards and tables now show German separators.

tickets.subject: Manually promoted SSO users revert to Viewer at every login
tickets.description: The admin promoted several SSO users to Editor by hand, but each time they log in their role resets to Viewer.
tickets.resolution_notes: Role mapping from the identity provider was set to 'enforce on every sign-in', which overwrites manual role changes. The admin chose to manage roles through groups and created an Editors group mapping. Confirmed the users kept Editor across sign-ins.

tickets.subject: Sync agent logs '407 Proxy Authentication Required'
tickets.description: The on-prem sync agent installed on a new server cannot connect, and its log shows '407 Proxy Authentication Required' on every attempt; the customer assumed their product credentials were wrong.
tickets.resolution_notes: The 407 came from the customer's proxy, which requires authentication for server-originated traffic, and the agent had no proxy credentials configured. Configured the agent's proxy settings with the dedicated proxy service identity the network team issues for server tools. The agent registered and completed a test upload.

tickets.subject: Desktop upload tool times out, browser upload works
tickets.description: Customer's analyst can upload the weekly CSV through the browser, but the desktop upload tool on the same machine fails with 'connect ETIMEDOUT'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The browser picked up the corporate PAC file and used the proxy, while the upload tool tried to connect directly and was dropped by the egress firewall. Configured the tool's proxy setting with the corporate proxy address from the PAC file. Uploads from the tool now complete in the same time as through the browser.

tickets.subject: Slow dashboards every afternoon with no change in usage
tickets.description: Customer reports dashboards become two to three times slower between roughly 14:00 and 15:30 each weekday. Their own usage and data volume are flat across the day.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's workspace shared a compute pool with another tenant whose large daily batch analysis started at 14:00, saturating shared CPU. Moved the customer to a less contended pool and tightened per-tenant CPU limits on shared pools. Afternoon load times now match the morning baseline.

tickets.subject: Tooltip appears far from the cursor after browser zoom
tickets.description: On the trend chart, after the user zooms the browser, tooltips pop up about a centimetre away from the mouse pointer.
tickets.resolution_notes: Tooltip position was calculated from unscaled page coordinates. Switched the calculation to the chart container's bounding box. Tooltips stay next to the pointer at every zoom level tested.

tickets.subject: Unique shopper count tile takes minutes
tickets.description: Customer reports the 'unique shoppers, last 3 years' tile is so slow that it often hits the 120-second limit. Other tiles on the board are quick.
tickets.resolution_notes: The tile performed an exact distinct count across roughly 900 million transactions. With the customer's agreement switched it to the approximate distinct count option (typically within 1%), with an exact recount available as a scheduled job. The tile now loads in about 3 seconds and the nightly exact figure matched the approximation within 0.4%.

tickets.subject: Average shipping fee jumped to $899
tickets.description: The fulfilment dashboard's average shipping fee went from about $9 to $899 after the customer added a second checkout source.
tickets.resolution_notes: Shipping amounts from the new checkout source arrive as integer cents and were read as dollars because the source's amount format was left at the default. Set the source to minor units and reprocessed. Average shipping fee is back to $8.99, consistent with the carrier invoice average.

tickets.subject: Order line drill-down takes 20+ seconds
tickets.description: Clicking an order in the new order detail drill-down shows a spinner for 20-25 seconds before the line items appear. The order list itself is fast.
tickets.resolution_notes: The drill-down introduced a lookup of line items by order_id, but the line items table had no index on that foreign key, so each click scanned roughly 90 million rows for this customer. Added an index on order_id and confirmed drill-downs open in under a second for the customer's largest orders.

tickets.subject: Idempotency key didn't prevent a duplicate after a day
tickets.description: Customer expected their re-run of a failed job to be harmless because it reused the same idempotency keys, but it created duplicate segments. They thought the key prevented duplicates permanently.
tickets.resolution_notes: Idempotency keys are retained for 24 hours, and the re-run happened about 30 hours later, so the keys were treated as new. Recommended using the create-or-update endpoint keyed on their own external_ref for long-lived deduplication. Removed the duplicate segments and confirmed a re-run with external_ref updated rather than created.

tickets.subject: SSO users get 'We couldn't match your account'
tickets.description: After the customer replaced their SAML app, all users authenticate at the identity provider and then see 'We couldn't match your account to a user in this workspace'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new app sent a persistent opaque NameID instead of the user's email address, so no existing user matched. Walked the admin through setting the NameID format to email address in the customer's Okta tenant. Every user the admin tested was matched to their existing account.

tickets.subject: 'Unsupported field type: geo_point' on CSV export
tickets.description: Exporting the store locations table to CSV fails with 'Export failed: Unsupported field type: geo_point'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The CSV writer had no serializer for geographic point fields. As a workaround the customer added calculated latitude and longitude columns and excluded the geo field; native support, writing points as 'lat,lon' text, shipped two weeks later. Confirmed the original table exported successfully after the release.

tickets.subject: Filtering to the online store is slow, physical stores are fast
tickets.description: Customer reports that every dashboard filtered to their web store takes 20+ seconds, while filtering to any physical store is instant.
tickets.resolution_notes: The web store accounts for about 60% of transactions, but the planner used a uniform per-store estimate and chose an index lookup that suits small stores. Increased the statistics detail on the store column so the skew is captured, and the planner now uses a scan for the web store. Web store dashboards load in about 3 seconds.

tickets.subject: Pacific stores' Sunday evening sales showing on Monday
tickets.description: Regional manager says late Sunday transactions from the Pacific-time stores appear under Monday in the daily sales table, while the POS end-of-day report has them on Sunday.
tickets.resolution_notes: Daily store aggregates were bucketed on UTC midnight rather than each store's configured local time zone, so anything rung up after 4-5 pm Pacific rolled into the next day. Rebuilt daily aggregates using per-store time zones and backfilled 90 days. Sunday totals for three sample stores now match their POS Z-reports exactly.

tickets.subject: Till refunds missing from net sales
tickets.description: Net sales for one store look too high. The store manager says refunds processed at the till without the original receipt never show up.
tickets.resolution_notes: Receipt-less refunds are stored as standalone refund transactions in the POS, which the connector did not request. Added standalone refunds to the connector and backfilled them. The store's net sales now match the POS end-of-day reports for the past month.

tickets.subject: 'Loading chunk failed' when adding a funnel widget
tickets.description: Users who have had the app open since yesterday get 'Loading chunk 47 failed' when adding a funnel widget; after a reload it works.
tickets.resolution_notes: An overnight release replaced the app's code files, and tabs opened before it asked for a file name that no longer existed. Previous releases' files now stay available for 72 hours, and the app reloads itself if a chunk fails to load, replacing the manual refresh workaround. Users with old tabs added widgets without errors after this change.

tickets.subject: Three unrelated scripts all broke on the same morning
tickets.description: Customer reports three different internal scripts (a stock alert script, a finance pull, and a wallboard) all started returning authentication errors on Monday morning.
tickets.resolution_notes: All three keys were owned by the same former IT employee, whose account was deactivated on Friday afternoon, which revoked the keys. Set up two service accounts with scopes matched to each script's needs and reissued keys. All three scripts were confirmed working, and the admin now reviews key ownership during offboarding.

tickets.subject: Dashboard gets slower the longer it stays open
tickets.description: Customer says if they leave the KPI dashboard open all day, hovering and scrolling become sluggish by afternoon. Reloading the page fixes it until the next day.
tickets.resolution_notes: Browser profiling showed thousands of detached chart tooltip elements and duplicate resize handlers, one set added per auto-refresh. The chart component patch released on 30 July cleans up handlers and tooltips when it re-renders. After the release, memory use stayed flat over a full working day.

tickets.subject: Older kiosk browsers can't open dashboards after maintenance weekend
tickets.description: Kiosks running the customer's older thin-client image show 'secure connection failed' for the product since our maintenance weekend; newer devices are fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: As announced, TLS 1.0 and 1.1 were disabled on the product's endpoints that weekend, and the thin-client image's browser only supported those versions. The customer updated the kiosk image to a browser build with TLS 1.2. Kiosks connected normally after the update.

tickets.subject: Hidden cost columns appear in CSV export
tickets.description: Columns the author hid in the table widget for readability, cost price and supplier code, still appear in the exported CSV.
tickets.resolution_notes: Column visibility in the widget was a display setting only, and the export used the widget's full query. With the author, set the widget's export option to 'Visible columns only'. Confirmed the exported file contained only the displayed columns.

tickets.subject: No tooltips on touch-screen tills
tickets.description: Store staff using the dashboard on touch-screen tills cannot see tooltips; tapping a point does nothing, although the same chart works with a mouse.
tickets.resolution_notes: Tooltips were triggered only by mouse hover events. Added tap-to-show tooltips that close when the user taps elsewhere. Staff on the touch-screen tills can now see values by tapping.

tickets.subject: Hovering over SKU scatter plot is laggy
tickets.description: Customer plots margin against sell-through for all 120k SKUs. The chart appears quickly, but moving the mouse across it stutters and tooltips lag several seconds behind the cursor.
tickets.resolution_notes: The scatter plot used vector rendering and checked every point on each mouse move to find the nearest one for the tooltip. Switched large scatter plots to canvas rendering with a spatial index for hover lookups. Tooltips now follow the cursor without visible lag.

tickets.subject: Company-wide average basket on Executive Summary looks too high
tickets.description: The CFO's office says the chain-level average basket on the Executive Summary is several dollars above what their BI team calculates from the same order data.
tickets.resolution_notes: The chain-level figure was the mean of store-level averages rather than total revenue over total transactions, so a handful of high-ticket boutique stores pulled it up. Switched the tile to a weighted calculation from summed revenue and transaction counts and recomputed. The tile now agrees with the BI team's figure to the cent.

tickets.subject: Real-time order counter frozen on corporate laptops
tickets.description: Per the customer: 'The order counter never moves on our work laptops, but on our phones it ticks up all day.' Both use the same accounts.
tickets.resolution_notes: Corporate laptops route web traffic through the company proxy, which was stripping the Upgrade and Connection headers, so the live channel could not open; phones on mobile data bypass the proxy. After the network team allowed WebSocket upgrades to live.example.net, the counter updated on laptops as well.

tickets.subject: Webhook delivery log full of timeouts but our endpoint received the events
tickets.description: Customer's developer says their delivery log shows most order.updated events as 'failed - timeout after 10s', yet their service did receive and process them, some more than once.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's handler enriched each event with several downstream lookups before responding, taking 12-20 seconds, so our 10-second timeout recorded failures and scheduled retries. Advised returning 2xx immediately after storing the event and processing it asynchronously, and shared the documented timeout. After their change, the delivery log showed 100% success over two days with no repeat deliveries.

tickets.subject: Mixed currencies an hour after switching reporting currency
tickets.description: The customer switched reporting currency from GBP to EUR, and an hour later some dashboards show EUR while others still show GBP.
tickets.resolution_notes: A reporting currency change triggers a background recompute of cached aggregates, which can take up to two hours in large workspaces, and dashboards switch as their caches are rebuilt. Confirmed the recompute was progressing and prioritised the remaining dashboards. All dashboards showed EUR 40 minutes later, and the settings page now shows recompute progress.

tickets.subject: Low-sales hours vanish from heatmap in dark theme
tickets.description: In the hour-by-day heatmap, cells with low sales disappear when a user switches to the dark theme, making it look as if the store sold nothing at those times.
tickets.resolution_notes: The heatmap's colour scale started at the page background colour, so in the dark theme low-value cells blended into the page. The scale now starts from a visible tint in both themes, and non-empty cells get a thin outline. Low-sales hours are visible in the dark theme.

tickets.subject: Outlet SKUs counted under full-price categories
