tickets.description: Merchandising says the outlet-only products they flagged last month still roll into full-price Footwear and Outerwear instead of the Outlet category.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's new 'outlet flag → Outlet' rule sat underneath an existing department rule that matched first, so it was never evaluated for those products. Reordered the rules, re-ran classification and showed the admin the new shadowed-rule warning. Outlet now holds 412 SKUs, the same count as the customer's outlet price list.

tickets.subject: Renewal notice for a workspace we cancelled
tickets.description: Customer cancelled a regional workspace last quarter but has just received a 30-day renewal notice for it and fears another charge.
tickets.resolution_notes: The cancellation had been recorded correctly; the notice job read a cached subscription list that had not been refreshed. No charge was scheduled, since the subscription status was Cancelled and its invoice preview empty. Suppressed further notices for the workspace, and the cache refresh was fixed.

tickets.subject: Store map has pins but no streets or borders
tickets.description: The store map shows pins floating on a plain grey background with no streets, coastlines or borders.
tickets.resolution_notes: After a configuration move the app still requested background tiles from an outdated tile service address, and every request returned 404. Updated the tile address and added a fallback base map. The street map background now loads behind the pins.

tickets.subject: Transaction scatter plot empty in Safari
tickets.description: The basket-value scatter plot, which plots every transaction for the month, is empty in Safari. Chrome draws it, though slowly.
tickets.resolution_notes: Scatter plots were not covered by the existing canvas size cap, so on Retina screens their canvas exceeded Safari's limit and was never drawn. Extended the cap to scatter plots and switched those above 50,000 points to density rendering. The plot now renders in Safari and loads faster in Chrome.

tickets.subject: IP allow-list blocks office users after IPv6 rollout
tickets.description: The day the customer enabled IPv6 at their main office, users there started getting the network-policy block page, even though the office IPv4 range is on the allow-list.
tickets.resolution_notes: Browsers preferred IPv6 once it was available, so requests arrived from the office's IPv6 prefix, which was not on the allow-list. The admin added the office prefix 2001:db8:4c2::/48 alongside the IPv4 range. Users are allowed over both protocols.

tickets.subject: Gradual slowdown over several weeks
tickets.description: Customer says nothing changed on their side, but dashboards have been getting a little slower every week for about six weeks.
tickets.resolution_notes: Automatic statistics maintenance had been paused on the database shard hosting this customer during an earlier maintenance and was never re-enabled, so estimates drifted as data grew. Re-enabled it, refreshed statistics, and added an alert when automatic maintenance is off for more than a day. Load times returned to their level of two months earlier.

tickets.subject: SSO breaks every time the IdP rotates its certificate
tickets.description: Customer's admin wants a lasting solution: SSO has broken twice this year when their identity provider's signing certificate rolled over, and each time they had to upload the new certificate by hand.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace used a static certificate upload, so each rotation broke signature validation until someone replaced it. Switched the workspace to read the IdP metadata URL nightly, which picks up new and overlapping certificates automatically and replaces the manual-upload workaround. During the customer's next planned rotation in their test tenant, the new certificate was picked up overnight and sign-ins continued without interruption.

tickets.subject: False 'revenue dropped to zero' alerts at the top of every hour
tickets.description: Customer receives a 'store revenue is 0 this hour' alert for many stores at roughly :00 most hours. When they look at the dashboard a few minutes later, revenue for that hour is normal.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule evaluated at :00, but the customer's point-of-sale batch for the previous hour lands between :05 and :10, so the hour was empty at evaluation time. Added a 15-minute evaluation delay to the rule. Over the next two days there were no zero-revenue alerts while normal hourly data was present.

tickets.subject: Table header scrolls away in full-screen mode
tickets.description: When a table widget is expanded to full screen, the header row scrolls off with the data and users lose track of the columns.
tickets.resolution_notes: Full-screen mode used a different scrolling container from the inline widget, and the sticky header was attached to the original one. The header now attaches to whichever container scrolls. It stays visible in full screen.

tickets.subject: Date format update reaches new users but not long-standing ones
tickets.description: New users see the new DD/MM/YYYY format, but users who joined before last year still see MM/DD/YYYY.
tickets.resolution_notes: Users created before the profile redesign had been given an explicit personal date format copied from the old default, and that copy now overrides the workspace setting. Cleared the copied personal value so those users inherit the workspace default. All users show DD/MM/YYYY.

tickets.subject: Auditor can't find last month's daily snapshots in storage bucket
tickets.description: An auditor asked for last month's daily inventory snapshots, but the customer's storage bucket holds only one file for that report.
tickets.resolution_notes: The scheduled file drop used a fixed filename, so each delivery overwrote the previous snapshot. Added a timestamp token to the filename template and regenerated the missing month from historical snapshot tables for the auditor. Confirmed 30 dated files were present.

tickets.subject: Margin % metric makes the whole board slow
tickets.description: The customer's finance analyst says the gross margin dashboard became sluggish (15-20 seconds) after they defined a margin % metric that looks up unit cost for each sale.
tickets.resolution_notes: The metric used the per-row LOOKUP function against the cost table, which executes as a separate lookup for each sale. Rewrote the metric to use a modelled join between sales and the cost table, giving the same results. The dashboard now loads in 3 seconds.

tickets.subject: Long-range trend charts blank on area managers' iPads
tickets.description: Area managers on iPads see empty spaces where the long-range trend charts should be. On their desktops the same dashboards look fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The iPad browser has a lower canvas memory ceiling, and the trend charts at full Retina resolution exceeded it, so drawing failed without any error. Extended the downsampling and canvas size cap to these trend charts. The charts now display on the area managers' iPads.

tickets.subject: Store managers see empty charts after move to SSO
tickets.description: Since the company moved to SSO sign-in, store managers see every chart on the Store Daily dashboard empty, while regional leads see data normally.
tickets.resolution_notes: The row-level rule filters by the user's store_id attribute, and accounts created through SSO just-in-time provisioning had no store_id because the attribute was not mapped from the identity provider. Added the store_id claim to the attribute mapping and backfilled it for existing SSO users. Confirmed a store manager saw only their own store's data.

tickets.subject: Repriced SKUs still show last month's prices
tickets.description: The pricing dashboard still shows old prices for about 2,000 SKUs that the pricing team changed in one spreadsheet import on the 1st.
tickets.resolution_notes: Prices changed through the platform's import tool keep their original modification time, so the incremental sync never saw them. Triggered a full product resync and turned on a nightly full scan of price fields for this connection as a lasting safeguard. Repriced SKUs now show current prices, and the nightly scan also caught the next import.

tickets.subject: Two regional leads see different company-wide totals
tickets.description: Two regional leads viewing the same company-wide KPI tile see different totals and suspect a calculation error.
tickets.resolution_notes: The tile queried the transaction dataset, so each lead's row-level rule limited the total to their own region. With the data owner's approval, pointed the tile at the company summary dataset that both leads are allowed to see. Confirmed both saw the same total.

tickets.subject: Occasional records skipped at page boundaries
tickets.description: Agent summary: customer pages through stock movements sorted by created_at and occasionally loses a record exactly at a page boundary, even with cursor pagination and no concurrent writes.
tickets.resolution_notes: Movements are imported in batches that share the same created_at second, and the cursor encoded only the timestamp, so ties at a boundary could be skipped. Added the record ID as a tiebreaker to the sort and cursor on our side. A full walk over a test period with many ties returned every record exactly once.

tickets.subject: Daily inventory report arriving before the overnight data
tickets.description: Agent summary: US retailer, daily inventory report set for 06:00 has been arriving at 05:00 since early November, so regional managers get a snapshot that misses the overnight receiving batch.
tickets.resolution_notes: Schedules created before a scheduler change saved a fixed offset, so when daylight saving ended the run moved to 05:00 local time, before the receiving batch had loaded. Re-saved the schedule with the named time zone and sent a one-off delivery with complete data. Confirmed the following morning's report arrived at 06:00 including the overnight receipts.

tickets.subject: Phone column blank in scheduled export after policy change
tickets.description: A scheduled export of loyalty sign-ups started arriving with an empty phone column right after the admin turned on the data protection policy.
tickets.resolution_notes: The policy applies to scheduled exports as well as manual ones, and the phone field's masking style was 'remove', which blanks the column. The admin confirmed masking was intended and switched the field to partial masking, showing the last four digits for store follow-ups. Confirmed the next export showed partially masked numbers.

tickets.subject: Filtering by custom 'region code' attribute is slow
tickets.description: Since the customer started using a custom attribute called region code as a dashboard filter, every widget on their inventory movement dashboard takes 10+ seconds to refresh when the filter is applied.
tickets.resolution_notes: Custom attributes are stored in a flexible attribute column that is not indexed, so filtering on region code inspected every row. Promoted region code to a dedicated indexed column for the workspace and backfilled it. Filtered refreshes now complete in 1-2 seconds; documented that heavily filtered custom attributes can be promoted on request.

tickets.subject: App shell shows 'Failed to load application resources'
tickets.description: Since this morning the customer's employees see the empty app shell with 'Failed to load application resources' and no dashboards.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's secure web gateway had classified our new asset host cdn.example.net as newly registered and blocked it. The customer added the product's documented domains to the gateway's allow policy and submitted a recategorisation request. The app loaded normally across the office.

tickets.subject: Ampersand in workspace name shows as '&' in invitations
tickets.description: Invitation emails for the 'Harbor & Pine' workspace read 'You've been invited to Harbor & Pine'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The invitation template HTML-escaped the workspace name twice, once when saving and again when rendering. Removed the duplicate escaping and tested names containing ampersands, angle brackets and quotes. A fresh invitation shows 'Harbor & Pine' correctly.

tickets.subject: Long product names cut off with no way to read them
tickets.description: In the top-products bar chart, names longer than about 20 characters end in '…' and hovering shows nothing, so the merchandising team can't tell similar products apart.
tickets.resolution_notes: Category labels were truncated to fit and the shortened text had no tooltip. Added a hover tooltip with the full name and an option to wrap labels onto two lines. The team can now read full product names on hover or with wrapping on.

tickets.subject: Shared dashboard recipients can't change filters
tickets.description: Recipients of a shared promotions dashboard can view it, but the filter bar is greyed out with the tooltip 'Filters locked by owner'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The dashboard had been shared with the 'View only, locked filters' option. The owner changed the share to 'View with interactive filters'. Confirmed recipients could change the date and store filters.

tickets.subject: Embedded dashboard blocked after intranet moved to a new domain
tickets.description: The customer moved their intranet from portal.alderash.example.com to hub.alderash.example.com, and embedded dashboards now show a blocked-frame message.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace's allowed embed origins, which the product sends as its frame-ancestors policy, still listed only the old intranet origin. The admin added https://hub.alderash.example.com as an exact origin rather than a wildcard. Embeds load on the new intranet and remain blocked elsewhere.

tickets.subject: Response format changed after we created a new key
tickets.description: Customer's client started receiving a different response shape for dashboards after they rotated their API key. Their code hasn't changed.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their client did not send a version header, so requests were pinned to the API version current when each key was created; the new key defaulted to a newer version. Advised sending an explicit version header on every request. With the header set, both old and new keys returned the expected format.

tickets.subject: Bookmarked dashboard links broken after workspace URL change
tickets.description: After the admin shortened the workspace URL name from 'kestrel-sports' to 'kestrel', staff bookmarks and intranet links return 'page not found'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Changing the workspace URL name invalidates links that use the old one unless 'Redirect previous URL name' is enabled, and it had been left off. Enabled the redirect, which keeps old links working for 12 months, and advised updating intranet links in the meantime. Old bookmarks now open the same dashboards.

tickets.subject: Date columns in Excel export are text
tickets.description: Date columns in XLSX exports are left-aligned text, so finance cannot filter or group them by month.
tickets.resolution_notes: Dates were written as preformatted strings to preserve the workspace date format. Enabled native date cells for Excel exports, with the workspace format applied as cell formatting. Confirmed the columns sorted and grouped as dates.

tickets.subject: Online average basket value 9% above order-management report
tickets.description: Store operations compared average basket value for online orders with their order-management report and found the dashboard figure about 9% higher every week, consistently across regions.
tickets.resolution_notes: Average basket value is derived from net revenue, which was mapped to the order total including shipping fees and tax rather than the merchandise subtotal. Correcting the revenue mapping brought the metric in line; the last eight weeks now match the order-management report within 0.2%.

tickets.subject: Webhook URL on port 9000 never receives events
tickets.description: The webhook delivery log shows 'destination port not permitted' for the customer's receiver at https://hooks.copperleaf.example.com:9000/events.
tickets.resolution_notes: The product's webhook sender only connects to ports 443 and 8443, as documented, and refuses other destination ports. The customer exposed the receiver on 443 through their existing reverse proxy and updated the URL. Test events were delivered and acknowledged.

tickets.subject: 'Insufficient permission on destination folder' when moving dashboard
tickets.description: An editor gets 'Insufficient permission on destination folder' when trying to move a dashboard into Regional Reports.
tickets.resolution_notes: Moving content requires edit rights on the destination, and the editor had only view access there. The folder owner granted the editor's team the narrower Contribute permission, which allows adding content without editing others' dashboards. Confirmed the move succeeded.

tickets.subject: Critical alerts going to email instead of on-call channel
tickets.description: Customer's critical payment alerts were only emailed, though they had set up a route to send critical alerts to the on-call channel.
tickets.resolution_notes: Routes are evaluated top to bottom and stop at the first match; a catch-all 'all severities to email' route sat above the critical route. Moved the critical route to the top. A critical test alert went to the on-call channel and warnings continued to go by email.

tickets.subject: File uploads from one store server stall at 0%
tickets.description: Uploads from one store's back-office server stall at 0% and eventually time out, but small test files of a few kilobytes go through.
tickets.resolution_notes: That store sits behind a site-to-site tunnel with a reduced MTU, and the ICMP messages needed for path-MTU discovery were filtered, so full-size packets never arrived. Enabling MSS clamping on the tunnel interface fixed it, and a 400 MB upload completed in the normal time.

tickets.subject: Finance wants negative numbers in parentheses
tickets.description: The finance team asked for negative variances to appear as (1,234) instead of -1,234 in all tables.
tickets.resolution_notes: Negative number style is a workspace setting and was at the default minus sign. Switched it to accounting style. Variance tables now show negatives in parentheses.

tickets.subject: Nobody can open dashboards owned by a removed category manager
tickets.description: After the admin removed a departed category manager, the team found that none of the dashboards she had built can be opened by anyone.
tickets.resolution_notes: Private dashboards owned by a removed user are hidden until they are reassigned. Used the transfer step of the removal tool to assign her 11 dashboards to the new category manager. Confirmed the team could open them again.

tickets.subject: Store map lags when panning
tickets.description: The customer's store map shows about 30,000 pickup points. Dragging or zooming the map stutters badly and sometimes takes a few seconds to catch up.
tickets.resolution_notes: Every marker was drawn individually and redrawn on each pan event. Enabled marker clustering for maps with more than 2,000 points and throttled redraws during drag. Panning and zooming are now smooth, with individual markers shown once the user zooms in to a city level.

tickets.subject: Tooltip shows another store's figures
tickets.description: Hovering the bar for Store 12 shows Store 21's sales in the tooltip, but only on the right-hand half of the chart.
tickets.resolution_notes: After the chart was scrolled horizontally, the tooltip looked up bars by their original index rather than their scrolled position. Fixed the lookup to use the bar under the pointer. Tooltips now match the hovered bar across the whole chart.

tickets.subject: Holiday revenue inflated by gift card sales
tickets.description: Customer's December revenue was about 6% above the ERP and January also ran high; finance suspects gift cards are involved.
tickets.resolution_notes: Gift card sales were counted as revenue when sold and the same value was counted again when redeemed against merchandise. Reclassified gift card sales as a liability movement excluded from net revenue, kept redemptions as revenue and recomputed both months. December and January now match the ERP's recognised revenue within 0.05%.

tickets.subject: Revenue with a promotion filter exceeds unfiltered revenue
tickets.description: Customer filtered the Sales Overview to orders 'with any promotion' and got a higher revenue figure than the unfiltered total for the same week.
tickets.resolution_notes: Orders were joined to their promotion codes one-to-many, so an order using two codes contributed its revenue twice. Changed the model to apply promotion filters through an existence check rather than a direct join, and to allocate revenue per code only inside the promotion breakdown. The filtered total is now a subset of the unfiltered total.

tickets.subject: Forecast chart vanishes for newly launched products
tickets.description: On the demand forecast dashboard, picking a newly launched product makes the forecast chart disappear and leaves a hole in the layout. Established products are fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: New products have only null forecast values until enough history exists, and the forecast chart treated the all-null series as an error and collapsed. Applied the same empty-series handling used by line charts, so the widget keeps its frame and explains that a forecast needs eight weeks of sales. New products now show that explanation.

tickets.subject: Store managers should land on the store dashboard
tickets.description: The customer wants store managers to open Store Performance after login, while head-office users keep the Executive Summary.
tickets.resolution_notes: Only a single workspace-wide home dashboard was configured. Set a team-level home dashboard for the 'Store Managers' team, which takes precedence over the workspace default. Store managers now land on Store Performance and everyone else is unchanged.

tickets.subject: Reports endpoint now returns 410 Gone
tickets.description: Customer's integration that lists reports through /v1/reports suddenly returns 410 Gone for every request.
tickets.resolution_notes: The v1 reports endpoints reached their announced sunset date. Walked the customer through the equivalent v2 endpoint, which uses cursor pagination and nests owner information. Their updated integration returned the full report list from v2.

tickets.subject: 'Certificate expired' error for everyone in the office
tickets.description: From Monday morning every user on the customer's corporate network gets a certificate-expired warning when opening the product, and the customer believed our certificate had lapsed.
tickets.resolution_notes: The product's certificate was valid; the warning came from the customer's inspection appliance, whose signing CA expired over the weekend, so every re-signed certificate chained to an expired CA. The customer renewed the inspection CA and redeployed it to managed devices. Users reported normal access after the push.

tickets.subject: Double payment after clicking Pay twice on overdue invoice
tickets.description: The admin paid an overdue invoice from the payment page; it looked frozen, so they clicked Pay again, and both payments were taken.
tickets.resolution_notes: The payment page did not disable the button while waiting for the processor's response, so two submissions were accepted for the same open invoice. Refunded the second payment, and the page was changed to lock an invoice while a payment is in progress. Confirmed the invoice shows one payment and sent the refund reference to the customer.

tickets.subject: Same alert repeated every 10 minutes
tickets.description: Customer says they get the same 'returns rate above 8%' alert over and over, every 10 minutes, for hours, and assumed it was a duplicate bug.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule's re-notify interval was set to 10 minutes while the condition stays breached, which is working as configured. Changed re-notification to every 4 hours and enabled a resolved message so the team knows when it clears. The customer confirmed they now get one alert plus a reminder only if the issue persists.

tickets.subject: Same shopper appears on two different pages
tickets.description: The customer's developer noticed their CRM import of shoppers from our API sometimes contains the same shopper twice, on consecutive pages.
tickets.resolution_notes: The import used offset paging sorted by last update, and shoppers updated during the import moved to later positions and were read again. Moved the import to cursor-based pagination, which keeps a consistent position. The next full import produced no duplicate shopper IDs.

tickets.subject: Mobile SSO stuck on a 'Redirecting…' page
tickets.description: When store managers sign in with SSO in the mobile app, the identity provider page accepts their credentials and then sits on 'Redirecting…' without ever returning to the app.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's device management profile stops the browser from opening custom URL schemes, so the hand-back to the app never happened. Switched the app's SSO return to a verified https app link, which the profile permits. Store managers completed SSO sign-in and returned to the app normally.

tickets.subject: Tax collected spikes during promotion weekends
tickets.description: The finance team asked why 'Tax collected' nearly triples on promotional weekends when no tax rates have changed.
tickets.resolution_notes: When the source added a separate promotions field, the order-level discount amount was mapped into the tax metric instead of the discount metric. Corrected the mapping so discounts and tax are separated and recomputed the affected periods. The Black Friday weekend tax figure now matches the tax filing worksheet.

tickets.subject: New password rejected with no explanation
tickets.description: User choosing a new password gets 'Password does not meet requirements', but the form never says which requirement.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace policy requires at least one symbol, and the error message did not list unmet rules. Updated the form to show each requirement with a live check mark. The user set a compliant password on the next try.

tickets.subject: Monday sales report arrived almost five hours late
tickets.description: Customer's 7:00 weekly sales report did not land in inboxes until 11:40. They rely on it for a 9:00 meeting and want to know why it was delayed.
tickets.resolution_notes: A full-history export from another workspace had been running for over four hours on the shared report worker pool, and because jobs were processed strictly in arrival order, every scheduled report behind it waited. A separate pool for long-running exports, together with per-workspace fair scheduling, went live on 18 June. The following Monday the report was delivered at 7:03.

tickets.subject: Inbound events discarded with 'signature mismatch'
tickets.description: The event log for the Northwind Commerce connection shows hundreds of 'Signature mismatch – event discarded' entries an hour. The dashboard only catches up after each scheduled sync.
tickets.resolution_notes: During a security review the store owner regenerated the shared secret used to sign events, while the connector still held the previous value. Entered the new secret and replayed the discarded events from the platform's event history. Event ingestion resumed with no further mismatches.

tickets.subject: Finance assistant needs invoices but not admin rights
tickets.description: The finance assistant needs to download invoices, and the customer's admin asks whether she must be made an admin.
tickets.resolution_notes: Granted the narrower Billing Viewer role, which allows viewing and downloading invoices without workspace admin rights. Confirmed she could download invoices and could not open user management.

tickets.subject: Export menu missing on the payroll-cost dashboard only
tickets.description: Editors can export every dashboard except the payroll-cost dashboard, where the export menu does not appear at all.
tickets.resolution_notes: The dashboard owner had enabled 'Restrict export' on that dashboard, which overrides role-level export rights. The owner kept the restriction but added the two finance editors to the dashboard's export exception list. Confirmed those editors could export and others still could not.

tickets.subject: Analyst downloaded a colleague's export instead of her own
tickets.description: Two analysts exported the same dashboard with different filters on the same morning, and one of them got the other's file from Export Center.
tickets.resolution_notes: Export files were stored under a path built from the dashboard and the date, so the second export overwrote the first and both links pointed to the same location. File paths now include the job identifier. Confirmed each export downloads its own file.

tickets.subject: Repeated lockout notices for a regional admin
tickets.description: The customer keeps receiving lockout notices for one regional admin. Failed logins in the audit log come from 203.0.113.45, which the customer traced to a back-office PC in one of their stores.
tickets.resolution_notes: That PC's browser autofilled the admin's outdated password and reloaded the sign-in page on a timer. The store team removed the saved credentials, and the screen now shows the store dashboard through a read-only TV display link instead of the admin's account. Lockout notices stopped the same day.

tickets.subject: West region average order value doesn't match finance
tickets.description: The customer's finance team computes West region AOV as total revenue divided by total orders and gets $62.40; the regional tile shows $71.15.
tickets.resolution_notes: The regional rollup averaged each store's AOV instead of dividing regional revenue by regional orders, giving small low-volume stores the same weight as flagships. Changed ratio metrics to recompute from numerator and denominator at every level. The West tile now shows $62.40.

tickets.subject: Overdue reminders bouncing off a departed colleague's address
tickets.description: The customer only learned their invoice was 45 days overdue when their account manager phoned; our reminder emails had been going to an address that bounces.
tickets.resolution_notes: The billing contact is stored separately from workspace admins and still pointed at a deactivated mailbox, and bounces on dunning emails were not surfaced to anyone. Updated the billing contact to the finance team's shared address and added a secondary contact. Confirmed the next reminder was delivered and the invoice was paid the same day.

tickets.subject: Sync fails: mapped field 'sales_region' not found
tickets.description: The CRM sync has failed on every run since Tuesday with 'Mapped field sales_region does not exist on object Account'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's CRM admin renamed the custom field to sales_territory, and our field mapping still referenced the old API name. Updated the mapping to the new field and backfilled the last week. The sync completed and region filters on the account dashboard show values again.

tickets.subject: Weekly sales tax a few cents off from the ERP
tickets.description: Accounting reports that weekly sales tax in the Finance pack differs from the ERP by 3 to 12 cents almost every week.
tickets.resolution_notes: Tax was rounded to two decimals on each order line before summing, whereas the ERP rounds once per invoice, so rounding residues accumulated. Changed the calculation to keep full precision per line and round at invoice level, mirroring the ERP. Weekly tax now matches the ERP to the cent for the last 26 weeks.

tickets.subject: FTPS pickup fails handshake after server migration
tickets.description: Following the customer's move to a new FTPS server, the connector reports 'certificate verify failed' on the control connection before it can list any files.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new server was configured with the leaf certificate only, omitting the intermediate the old server had served. The customer added the intermediate to the server's certificate file, after which the connector validated the chain and collected all pending files.

tickets.subject: 'Sharing outside your team is restricted' for editors
tickets.description: Editors get 'Sharing outside your team is restricted' when they try to share a dashboard with another department.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace sharing policy limits editors to sharing within their own team, with cross-team sharing reserved for admins. Instead of loosening the policy, the admin added both departments to a shared Commercial team. Confirmed editors could share the dashboard with that team.

tickets.subject: Marketplace channel revenue far below the settlement statement
tickets.description: Customer reports monthly revenue from their Mexican marketplace channel is far lower than the marketplace's own settlement statement, by much more than fees could explain.
tickets.resolution_notes: The marketplace connector delivered order amounts already converted to USD but kept the original currency code MXN on each order, so the platform converted them a second time and divided totals by roughly 17. Mapped the connector's settlement-currency field as the amount currency and reprocessed the channel's history. The October channel total now matches the settlement statement within 0.3%, the remainder being marketplace fees.

tickets.subject: Login loop only on the custom analytics domain
tickets.description: Customer serves the app at analytics.retail.example.com. Users sign in, briefly see the home page and are sent back to sign-in; the default app address works.
tickets.resolution_notes: Another internal application on the customer's parent domain set a cookie named 'session' for all of .retail.example.com, which collided with our session cookie on the custom domain. Renamed our cookie with a host-only prefix so parent-domain cookies cannot overwrite it. Sign-in on the custom domain worked for every tested user.

tickets.subject: File drop names carry yesterday's date
tickets.description: Files delivered at 00:30 local time are named with the previous day's date, which confuses the customer's archive process.
tickets.resolution_notes: The {date} token in the filename template used UTC. Switched the template to the {date_local} token, which follows the workspace time zone. Confirmed the next file was named with the correct local date.

tickets.subject: Mobile app says workspace not found after rename
tickets.description: Store staff typing their workspace name on the mobile app's sign-in screen get 'Workspace not found' ever since the workspace was renamed last week.
tickets.resolution_notes: The app looked the workspace up by the old identifier it had cached at first sign-in, which the rename retired. Cleared the cached value through a server-side flag, and the app now finds the workspace from the user's email domain. Staff signed in after restarting the app.

tickets.subject: Bank approval prompt never appears when adding card
tickets.description: Admin says their bank normally asks for approval in its mobile app for online card use, but adding the card on our billing page triggers no prompt and the old card stays on file.
tickets.resolution_notes: The strong customer authentication step launched in a popup, and the customer's managed browser policy blocks popups. Since their IT team could not change the policy, we sent a hosted payment-method link that runs the authentication in the same tab. The approval prompt appeared, and the card was saved and verified.

tickets.subject: Half the team can't see the new waterfall chart
tickets.description: Some of the customer's team see the new waterfall chart option in the widget editor and others don't, even after signing out and back in.
tickets.resolution_notes: Users without the option were running an application bundle cached by the service worker before the release, and signing out does not clear it. Advised closing all app tabs or doing a hard refresh, after which everyone saw the waterfall option; automatic detection of new releases was scheduled as the permanent fix.

tickets.subject: Webhook log shows TLS handshake failure; endpoint fine in browser
tickets.description: The webhook delivery log for the customer's endpoint shows 'TLS handshake failed: unable to verify certificate', but the customer can open the endpoint URL in a browser.
tickets.resolution_notes: The receiver's load balancer served the leaf certificate without the intermediate, which the browser supplied from its cache but our webhook sender cannot. The customer uploaded the full chain to the load balancer. Test deliveries succeeded and the failed events were replayed.

tickets.subject: Hourly chart labels in 12-hour format
tickets.description: Operations staff in the European stores want 24-hour labels on hourly charts and schedules rather than '2 PM'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The time format setting was '12-hour'. Set it to '24-hour' for the workspace. Hourly charts and scheduling screens show 14:00-style times.

tickets.subject: Custom domain stuck on 'Certificate pending'
tickets.description: Customer set up insights.ridgeview.example.com and the domain status has said 'Certificate pending' for three days.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's zone had a CAA record allowing only their internal certificate authority, which prevented the CA used by the product from issuing. The customer added a CAA entry for the CA named in the custom-domain guide. The certificate issued within an hour and the domain went active.

tickets.subject: Median items per basket shows 2.47
tickets.description: Customer questions how 'median items per basket' can be a fraction when every basket holds a whole number of items.
tickets.resolution_notes: For large datasets the median was computed with an approximate percentile sketch that interpolates between values, producing non-integer results for discrete data. Switched medians of discrete counts to an exact calculation, which this dataset easily allows, and disabled interpolation for integer metrics. The tile now shows 2, matching an exact median computed from the raw baskets.

tickets.subject: Customer lifetime value doubled for shoppers with two addresses
tickets.description: In the Customer module, lifetime value for shoppers who saved both a home and a work address is exactly twice what their order history adds up to.
tickets.resolution_notes: Customer profiles were joined to the address table to support region filters, and customers with several addresses fanned out, duplicating their order totals. Changed the region filter to use the default billing address only and removed the address join from value calculations. Lifetime value now equals each customer's summed order history.

tickets.subject: Dashboard with pasted images takes 30 seconds to open
tickets.description: The customer's marketing dashboard includes several text widgets with pasted campaign images. It takes about 30 seconds to open even before any charts start loading.
tickets.resolution_notes: Pasted images were stored inline in the dashboard definition, making it about 15 MB that had to download before rendering. Moved the images to asset storage and replaced them with references loaded lazily. The dashboard definition is now 40 KB and the page appears in under 2 seconds.

tickets.subject: Test webhook arrives, real events never do
tickets.description: Customer clicks 'Send test event' and their endpoint receives it immediately, but no real events have arrived for two weeks.
tickets.resolution_notes: The subscription was in the auto-disabled state after an earlier run of failures, and test events are sent regardless of subscription state. Re-enabled the subscription, and we updated the settings page to show the disabled status next to the test button. Real events resumed within a minute.

tickets.subject: Units sold ignores multi-quantity purchases
tickets.description: Customer noticed that when a shopper buys six of the same candle, units sold only goes up by one.
tickets.resolution_notes: The units metric was mapped to the count of order lines instead of the line 'quantity' field, so multi-quantity lines counted once. Remapped units sold to the sum of quantity and reprocessed the last 13 months. A test order of six units now raises the metric by six, and monthly units match the inventory depletion report.

tickets.subject: Broken image instead of trend chart in alert emails
tickets.description: Alert emails at a customer show a broken image icon where the small trend chart should be. Recipients outside the office see it fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The trend chart was loaded from a remote link, and the customer's internal mail client blocks remote images by policy. Switched their email channel to embed the chart image in the message instead of linking it. Office recipients now see the chart in test alerts.

tickets.subject: User Manager role promoted someone to Admin
tickets.description: A user with the User Manager role promoted a colleague to Admin, which the customer never intended that role to allow.
tickets.resolution_notes: The User Manager role came from a legacy template with 'Assign roles up to Admin'. Changed it to 'Assign roles up to Editor' and, at the admin's request, reverted the promotion. Confirmed User Managers can no longer grant Admin.

tickets.subject: Reset link opens the sign-in page instead of the reset form
tickets.description: After the customer renamed their workspace, users clicking password reset links are dropped on the normal sign-in page with no reset form and no error.
tickets.resolution_notes: Reset emails still used the workspace's previous subdomain, and the redirect from the old subdomain to the new one discarded the query string carrying the reset token. Fixed the redirect to preserve query parameters and changed reset emails to use the current subdomain. A fresh reset link opened the reset form and the user set a new password.

tickets.subject: No events for the stores we opened this year
tickets.description: Customer's integration receives sales events for older stores but nothing for the eight stores opened since January.
tickets.resolution_notes: When the subscription was created, a filter listing specific store IDs had been added, so new stores were excluded. Replaced the store list with a region filter that covers current and future stores in those regions. Events for the new stores started arriving immediately.

tickets.subject: 'Session expired, please try again' on the login form
tickets.description: One user always gets 'Session expired, please try again' when submitting the login form, however quickly they type. It started after they installed a privacy browser extension.
tickets.resolution_notes: The extension blocked session storage on our domain, so the login form's anti-forgery value was missing on submit. As an immediate step the user allowed site storage for our domain in the extension; we then added a cookie-based fallback so the form works even when storage is blocked. Verified sign-in with the extension in its default mode after the release.

tickets.subject: Week-to-date target alert fires every Monday morning
tickets.description: Customer's 'week-to-date sales below 20% of weekly target' alert fires every Monday morning, even though their reporting week starts on Monday.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule had been created before the workspace switched to Monday-start weeks and kept its own Sunday-start week setting, so on Monday morning it was comparing a nearly complete week with only a day of sales counted from Sunday. Changed the rule to inherit the workspace fiscal week. Monday morning alerts stopped the following week.

tickets.subject: Late-evening outage missed after clocks went back
tickets.description: A till outage at 21:30 went unalerted. The customer's rule is active until 22:00, and the same rule caught a similar issue in the summer.
tickets.resolution_notes: Active hours had been captured as a fixed UTC offset during summer time, so after the clocks went back the window ended at 21:00 local. Switched the rule to a named time zone and checked the customer's other rules for the same pattern, fixing nine more. A test breach at 21:30 now alerts.

tickets.subject: Agent can't connect but a browser on the same server can
tickets.description: The on-prem agent on a newly built server fails with 'connect timeout', while a browser on that server opens the app quickly.
tickets.resolution_notes: The server received an IPv6 address but the network's IPv6 default route was missing; browsers fell back to IPv4 quickly, while the agent tried IPv6 only and timed out. The network team added the missing IPv6 default route on the edge router. The agent connects over IPv6 and uploads complete.

tickets.subject: Deleted dashboards reappear in our catalogue
tickets.description: Agent summary: customer keeps a catalogue of dashboards fed by webhooks. Dashboards deleted in our app occasionally come back in their catalogue a few seconds later.
tickets.resolution_notes: An update event emitted just before deletion was delivered after the dashboard.deleted event, and the consumer recreated the entry. Advised keeping a tombstone for deleted IDs and ignoring older updates for them. No deleted dashboards reappeared during the following week.

tickets.subject: Approved request gave edit rights instead of view
tickets.description: A dashboard owner approved an access request and the requester ended up with edit rights, though they had only asked to view.
tickets.resolution_notes: The approval dialog defaulted to the approver's own permission level. The owner changed the requester to Viewer, and the dialog now defaults to Viewer. Confirmed the requester could view but not edit.

tickets.subject: 'Last 7 days' filter much slower than 'Last year'
tickets.description: The customer's analyst noticed something odd: filtering the order explorer to the last 7 days takes far longer than filtering to all of last year, even though it returns a fraction of the rows.
tickets.resolution_notes: The query plan showed full scans on the two newest monthly partitions, which had been created without the store and date index after the partitioning change; older partitions still had it, which explained why the larger historical range was faster. Added the index to all partitions created since the change and added a nightly check that every partition carries the expected indexes. The 7-day filter now returns in about a second.

tickets.subject: Dashboards never finish loading at the Dublin branch
tickets.description: At the Dublin branch, login and the dashboard list work, but dashboards with many widgets hang forever; the same dashboards load in seconds at other offices.
tickets.resolution_notes: Dublin connects through a tunnel with a 1400-byte MTU, and the branch firewall blocked ICMP 'fragmentation needed' messages, so large responses were silently dropped (a path-MTU black hole). The network team enabled TCP MSS clamping on the tunnel and allowed the required ICMP type. Dashboards load normally at the branch.

tickets.subject: Ownership transfer handed over personal drafts too
tickets.description: After an ownership transfer, the new owner found the departed user's personal draft dashboards, including salary planning notes, in their own space.
tickets.resolution_notes: The transfer tool included personal-space drafts by default. With the admin, moved the drafts to an admin-only archive folder, and the transfer dialog now excludes personal drafts unless they are selected. Confirmed the new owner no longer had access to them.

tickets.subject: Workspace number format reverts every night
tickets.description: The admin changes the number format each afternoon, and by the next morning it is back to the old value.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's own automation script calls the admin API nightly and re-applies a stored configuration that still contained the old number format. The customer updated the stored configuration in their script. The setting has stayed on the new value for a week.

tickets.subject: Quote dashboard empty; sync warns about object access
tickets.description: The quote conversion dashboard is empty. Each CRM sync completes 'with warnings', and the details read 'Insufficient access rights on object Quote'.
tickets.resolution_notes: During a security review the customer had moved the integration user to a restricted profile that no longer included read access to quotes. Their CRM admin restored read-only access to quote objects for that user. The next sync imported 2,215 quotes and the dashboard populated.

tickets.subject: Net sales tile higher than ERP net sales
tickets.description: Customer's controller reports that 'Net sales' on the dashboard runs consistently above the ERP's net sales, by roughly the shipping and sales tax collected each week.
tickets.resolution_notes: The storefront connector's default mapping fed the order 'total' field, which includes shipping and tax, into the net revenue metric. Remapped net revenue to the merchandise subtotal after discounts, moved shipping and tax to their own metrics and recomputed history. Weekly net sales now reconcile to the ERP within 0.1%.

tickets.subject: Transactions export returns only 500 rows
tickets.description: Exporting the Transactions table gives exactly 500 rows, the same number visible on the first page of the on-screen table.
tickets.resolution_notes: The table widget had 'Export visible page only' selected in its export settings, an option the dashboard author had enabled to keep files small. With the author's agreement, switched the widget to 'Export all rows'. Confirmed the export returned all 62,300 rows.

tickets.subject: Wall display browser crashes overnight
tickets.description: The customer runs the sales dashboard on a wall-mounted screen in their head office. Every morning the screen shows the browser's out-of-memory error page.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each auto-refresh created new chart tooltips and resize listeners without removing the old ones, so memory grew steadily until the browser ran out. Enabled the nightly page reload option for the display as a stopgap until the chart component fix, which disposes of previous instances on refresh, shipped on 30 July. After the fix a test screen stayed at a stable memory level for 72 hours.

tickets.subject: Lockout lasts far longer than 30 minutes
tickets.description: User was told lockouts clear after 30 minutes but has now been locked out for more than two hours.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each sign-in attempt made during the lockout restarted the 30-minute timer, and the user had kept trying every so often. Unlocked the account after identity verification and changed the lockout page to show the remaining time and warn that further attempts extend it. The user signed in successfully.

tickets.subject: No sync on the night the clocks went forward
tickets.description: No sync ran on the night daylight-saving time began, so the next day's dashboards showed the previous day's data until the following night.
tickets.resolution_notes: The schedule was set for 02:30 local time, which did not exist that night, and the scheduler skipped the non-existent time instead of running at the next valid one. Ran a manual catch-up sync and changed the scheduler to run skipped times immediately afterwards. A simulated run against the next transition date started at 03:00 as expected.

tickets.subject: Deeply nested calculated metrics time out
tickets.description: Agent summary: a customer's 'contribution margin after returns' metric is built from five other calculated metrics, each built on others. The KPI tile using it now times out after 60 seconds.
tickets.resolution_notes: The nested definitions expanded into a query that recomputed the same intermediate subtotals many times. Flattened the metric chain into a single definition and enabled reuse of shared subexpressions. The tile returns the same value in 4 seconds; we also documented the recommended nesting depth for calculated metrics.

tickets.subject: KPI tiles print 'Loading…' in exported PDF
tickets.description: Some KPI tiles in the exported PDF literally show the text 'Loading…' instead of their numbers.
tickets.resolution_notes: The renderer captured the dashboard before the slower tiles' queries had returned. As a workaround the author moved the slow tiles to the top so they started loading first; the permanent change, making the renderer wait for every widget's ready signal, followed in a later release. Confirmed the tiles showed values after the workaround and again after the release.

tickets.subject: fields=* request returns 500 for one workspace
tickets.description: Agent summary: requesting all metric fields with fields=* fails with 500 for one customer workspace only. Listing specific fields works.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace's metric catalogue still listed a calculated metric whose definition referenced a deleted field, and expanding the wildcard tried to evaluate it. Changed wildcard expansion to skip invalid metrics and report them in a warnings array, and helped the customer repair the metric. fields=* now returns 200.

tickets.subject: Large report downloads freeze partway at one branch
tickets.description: PDF and Excel downloads larger than about 1 MB freeze partway through for users at the customer's Lisbon branch, while smaller downloads are fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The branch tunnel's MTU was below standard and its firewall discarded ICMP fragmentation-needed messages, creating a path-MTU black hole for large responses. MSS clamping on the branch tunnel resolved it; a 25 MB PDF downloaded successfully.

tickets.subject: Fingerprint unlock stopped working after phone update
tickets.description: Since updating their phone's operating system, a district manager is asked for a password every time they open the mobile app, and the fingerprint option has disappeared.
tickets.resolution_notes: The OS update invalidated the device key that protected the stored credential for biometric unlock, and the app did not offer to set it up again. Released an app update that re-prompts biometric setup after one password sign-in when the key is invalid. After updating, the manager re-enabled fingerprint unlock and it worked on the next launch.

tickets.subject: All alerts sent twice for about an hour on Saturday
tickets.description: Customer noticed every alert between 14:00 and 15:00 on Saturday was sent twice, across email and chat. Before and after that it was normal.
tickets.resolution_notes: During a scheduler failover both the old and new evaluator instances ran for about an hour, and each sent notifications. Added a lock on rule and period so only one evaluator can process a rule for a given period, plus a send-side dedup key. A failover test in staging produced single notifications.

tickets.subject: Confidential pricing dashboard visible to all staff after move
tickets.description: A confidential pricing dashboard became visible to all staff after an editor moved it into the shared Company folder.
tickets.resolution_notes: Moving it replaced its restricted explicit permissions with the folder's inherited 'All members: View'. Moved the dashboard into a restricted subfolder for the pricing team, and the move dialog now warns when permissions will change. Confirmed only the pricing team could open it.

tickets.subject: 900 separate notifications during a chain-wide promotion glitch
tickets.description: When a pricing mistake affected every store for an hour, the customer's per-store margin rule sent about 900 individual notifications to the same channel.
tickets.resolution_notes: Per-store evaluation is correct for their use case, but each breaching store produced its own notification. Enabled notification grouping for the rule, which sends one summary listing affected stores when more than 10 breach in the same evaluation. A test with 50 breaching stores produced one summary message.

tickets.subject: Duplicate order events double-counted in partner system
tickets.description: Customer's partner portal showed some orders twice on one afternoon. Their logs show the same event ID received two times about a minute apart.
tickets.resolution_notes: A delivery worker failover re-sent a batch of events whose acknowledgements had not yet been recorded, which at-least-once delivery permits. Recommended deduplicating on the event ID with a short retention store. The customer added the check and corrected the double-counted orders.

tickets.subject: Viewer duplicated a restricted dashboard and edited the copy
tickets.description: A viewer duplicated a restricted dashboard into their personal space and was then able to edit and share the copy.
tickets.resolution_notes: The duplicate action checked only view permission. Added a check requiring the Duplicate permission, held by Editor and above, and removed the copy with the admin's approval. Confirmed viewers no longer see the Duplicate option.

tickets.subject: Widget editor slow to open in workspace with thousands of fields
tickets.description: In a workspace where teams have created around 4,000 custom fields, opening the widget editor takes 8-10 seconds every time.
tickets.resolution_notes: The editor downloaded the complete field catalogue, around 8 MB, on every open and did not reuse it between edits. Changed the catalogue to load on demand by folder, compressed it, and cached it in the browser with a version check. The editor now opens in about a second after the first use.

tickets.subject: Charts break for new owner after dashboard transfer
tickets.description: After transferring a departed analyst's dashboards to her replacement, every chart shows 'Data source unavailable' for the new owner.
tickets.resolution_notes: The ownership transfer tool moved the dashboards but not the six private datasets they were built on, which stayed with the deactivated account. Transferred the datasets to the new owner with the admin's approval. Confirmed the charts loaded.

tickets.subject: Company-wide SSO outage with error SAML-SIG-002
tickets.description: Nobody at the customer can sign in through their identity provider; the error page shows reference SAML-SIG-002. The break-glass admin account with a local password still works.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's identity team replaced the IdP signing certificate during scheduled maintenance, so the fingerprint stored in the workspace no longer matched incoming assertions. The break-glass admin pasted the new certificate into the SSO settings, and we recommended pointing the workspace at the IdP metadata URL so future changes are picked up. Sign-ins resumed within minutes for all users.

tickets.subject: PDFs come out with black backgrounds for dark-mode users
tickets.description: Users who work in dark mode get PDF exports with black backgrounds, which are hard to read when printed.
tickets.resolution_notes: The exporter inherited the requesting user's display theme. Set a print-friendly light theme as the default for PDF exports regardless of the user's theme. Confirmed a dark-mode user's export rendered on a white background.

tickets.subject: Japanese product names unreadable in exports
tickets.description: A customer with stores in Japan sees product names turned into strings of accented Latin characters whenever they open a CSV export.
tickets.resolution_notes: Exports were UTF-8 without a BOM, which their spreadsheet software did not detect, so the multi-byte characters were misread. Switched the workspace default to include a BOM. Confirmed the product names displayed correctly in the next export.

tickets.subject: Incidents never auto-resolve when the alert clears
tickets.description: Our alerts open incidents in the customer's on-call tool correctly, but when the alert resolves the incident stays open and someone has to close it by hand.
tickets.resolution_notes: The payload template built the dedup key from the alert timestamp, so the resolve event carried a different key from the trigger and the on-call tool treated it as a new event. Changed the dedup key to the rule ID plus group (store) ID. Triggered and cleared a test alert, and the incident resolved automatically.

tickets.subject: Large orders show only their first 50 line items
tickets.description: Order headers are all present, but orders with more than 50 products show only the first 50 in the basket analysis dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector read line items from the order payload, which the source truncates at 50 items with a 'has more' flag that the connector ignored. Updated the connector to follow the line-item link whenever the flag is set and re-synced the last 90 days of orders. Large wholesale orders now show their full baskets, the largest with 212 lines.

tickets.subject: Store filter selection has no effect after store renames
tickets.description: Choosing a store in the dashboard's store filter updates the filter chip, but every chart keeps showing all-store totals. This began after the customer renamed several stores.
tickets.resolution_notes: The filter matched widgets by store name, and the renamed stores no longer matched the cached filter options, so the condition resolved to nothing and was dropped. Changed store filters to match on store IDs and refreshed the cached options. Selecting any store, renamed or not, now filters all charts.

tickets.subject: Duplicate customer accounts after CRM record merge
tickets.description: The customer's account count in the dashboard jumped by about 300 overnight, and many accounts now appear twice with slightly different names.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's CRM team merged duplicate accounts, and the surviving records received new IDs, so our upsert by external ID inserted them as new rows while the old IDs remained. Processed the CRM's merge events to retire the old IDs and removed 312 orphaned rows. The account count now matches the CRM report.

tickets.subject: Agreed trial extension not applied
tickets.description: Sales agreed to extend the customer's trial by two weeks to finish a pilot, but the trial ended on the original date.
tickets.resolution_notes: The extension was recorded in the sales notes but never applied to the trial end date in the billing system. Extended the trial by 14 days and restored access. Confirmed the trial banner shows the new end date.

tickets.subject: Account put on hold before contract payment terms ended
tickets.description: The contract specifies net 30 payment terms, but the account went on hold 14 days after the invoice date.
tickets.resolution_notes: The account had been created with self-serve dunning settings, which use a 14-day grace period, and was never switched to contract terms when the order form was signed. Lifted the hold and set payment terms to net 30. Confirmed the dunning schedule now places the first reminder at day 30.

tickets.subject: Card on file ends in digits nobody recognises
tickets.description: An admin opened Plan & Billing and found a card ending in four digits that nobody on the current finance team recognises.
tickets.resolution_notes: The audit log showed the card had been added eight months earlier by the previous billing contact and was a company card issued in that person's name. Helped the admin add the current company card and remove the old one. Confirmed only the new card remains and the change is recorded in the audit log.

tickets.subject: Invite link says it belongs to a different workspace
tickets.description: An external consultant who already uses the product for another client gets 'This invitation belongs to a different workspace' when clicking a new invitation.
tickets.resolution_notes: The consultant's browser was signed in to their other client's workspace, and the accept flow compared the invitation with the active session's workspace instead of the invited email address. The accept page now asks the user to confirm or switch accounts before accepting. The consultant accepted the invitation and can switch between both workspaces.

tickets.subject: Connector still reading the retired CRM instance
tickets.description: Pipeline numbers stopped changing a month ago. The customer migrated to a new CRM instance in April, yet our connector keeps reporting successful runs.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connection still pointed at the old instance, which became read-only after the migration, so runs succeeded but found no changes. Connected the new instance, mapped old record IDs to new ones using the migration's ID mapping file, and backfilled. Pipeline numbers now track the new instance with history preserved.

tickets.subject: Report backlog grows while workers look idle
tickets.description: Customer escalated that multiple scheduled reports were 1-2 hours late on Tuesday morning. Our status page showed no incident.
tickets.resolution_notes: The report renderer autoscaled on CPU usage, but workers were mostly waiting on database queries, so CPU stayed low and the autoscaler removed capacity while the queue kept growing. Changed scaling to use queue depth and oldest-job age. Queue age stayed under 5 minutes through the next peak and the customer's reports arrived on time.

tickets.subject: Integration stays throttled for minutes after one 429
tickets.description: Once the customer's sync script receives a single 429, it keeps getting 429s for several minutes. They expected the limit to reset after a second or two.
tickets.resolution_notes: The script ignored the Retry-After header and retried immediately in a tight loop, and each rejected call still counted toward the sliding window, extending the throttle. Updated their client to honour Retry-After with jittered backoff. A load test showed it now recovers within the indicated wait time.

tickets.subject: Tooltip shows 0.27 for a percentage metric
tickets.description: Hovering over the return-rate line shows '0.27' rather than '27%', while the axis labels on the same chart are correct.
tickets.resolution_notes: Tooltips used the raw value formatter instead of the metric's percentage format, which only the axis applied. Made tooltips use the metric's configured format. Hovering now shows '27.0%'.

tickets.subject: Barely-used API key gets 429 responses
tickets.description: Customer's BI engineer points out that their key made fewer than 200 calls today but is still receiving 429 responses. They believe the limit is applied incorrectly.
tickets.resolution_notes: Limits apply to the organisation, not individual keys, and the org usage report showed a single key from a wallboard script responsible for 85% of requests through per-second polling. The customer throttled that script to once per minute. The BI key's requests have succeeded without throttling since.

tickets.subject: Accounts deleted in CRM months ago still listed
tickets.description: Accounts the customer deleted from their CRM during a cleanup months ago still appear in the account list and pipeline totals.
tickets.resolution_notes: Incremental sync only sees records that still exist, so hard-deleted records were never removed on our side. Enabled the CRM's deleted-records endpoint for this connection and ran a reconciliation that removed 741 accounts. Account totals now match the CRM.

tickets.subject: Label fix not visible until a hard refresh
tickets.description: The customer was told this week's release fixed overlapping labels on stacked bars, but their analysts still see the overlap. One analyst who pressed Ctrl+F5 sees the fix.
tickets.resolution_notes: The service worker kept serving the application bundle cached before the release until every tab of the app was closed. Shipped a service worker change that checks for a new version on each load and prompts users to reload, replacing the hard-refresh workaround. After the change the analysts got the reload prompt and saw the corrected labels.

tickets.subject: Promotion impact dashboard times out
tickets.description: The promotion impact dashboard joins promotions to products and has started timing out since the customer loaded their new loyalty campaign, which applies to thousands of products.
tickets.resolution_notes: Promotions and products are many-to-many, and the query joined both sides at line level before aggregating, creating around 2 billion intermediate rows; results were de-duplicated correctly but very slowly. Rewrote the model to aggregate through the promotion-product bridge before joining sales. The dashboard loads in 6 seconds and spot-checked totals were unchanged.

tickets.subject: Default product address still opens our workspace
tickets.description: The customer moved everyone to their custom domain and wants app.example.net links to stop being used, but old links still open the workspace there.
tickets.resolution_notes: 'Redirect default domain to custom domain' was disabled, so both addresses served the workspace. Enabled the redirect, which sends any default-domain request for this workspace to the custom domain. Old links now land on the branded address.

tickets.subject: Low-sales alerts on public holidays when stores are shut
tickets.description: On the last two public holidays, every store triggered a 'sales below 50% of forecast' alert, although the stores were closed by plan.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule's schedule did not know about public holidays, and the forecast it compared against was a normal-day forecast. Attached the customer's holiday calendar to the rule schedule so evaluation pauses on listed closure days. On the next holiday no alerts were sent, and normal trading days were unaffected.

tickets.subject: Black Friday campaign credited with more than the web store made
tickets.description: During Black Friday week the customer let shoppers stack a sitewide code with a loyalty code, and the campaign dashboard now credits the campaign with more revenue than the whole web store took.
tickets.resolution_notes: Orders with two codes fanned out in the join between orders and promotion codes, counting their revenue twice. As an immediate workaround we published a version of the campaign dashboard that counts each order once by distinct order ID; the permanent model change to allocate revenue across stacked codes was scheduled for the following release. The workaround dashboard's total matched web store revenue for the week.

tickets.subject: Alert says 412 orders but dashboard says 390 for the same hour
tickets.description: Customer compared an hourly order-volume alert with the dashboard and the numbers never match. They think one of them is miscalculating.
tickets.resolution_notes: The alert evaluates the 60 minutes ending at evaluation time (for example 10:07-11:07), while the dashboard shows calendar hours (10:00-11:00). Set the rule to align its window to the calendar hour and included the window start and end in the alert message. The next alerts matched the dashboard values exactly.

tickets.subject: Refunds inflated after moving to hourly syncs
tickets.description: Refund totals look too high on every day since the customer changed from daily to hourly syncs.
tickets.resolution_notes: The hourly schedule used a two-hour lookback buffer, and refund records had no unique key in the connector mapping, so overlapping windows inserted the same refunds again. Added the refund ID as the unique key so overlapping records update instead of insert, and deduplicated the affected period. Refund totals for those days now match the payments report.

tickets.subject: Order spike alert silent during flash sale
tickets.description: During a flash sale, the customer's dashboard later showed hourly orders four times the normal level, but the 'orders above 2,000 per hour' alert never went off.
tickets.resolution_notes: The hourly rule ran at :00 while the previous hour's orders were still loading, so each evaluation saw only a fraction of the hour and stayed below 2,000. Configured a 15-minute evaluation delay so the full hour is present. Replaying the flash-sale hours with the new delay triggered the alert for three of them.

tickets.subject: Extra pending charge appeared right after changing card
tickets.description: Immediately after replacing the card on file, the admin saw a pending 1.00 charge in their banking app next to this month's subscription payment and thought they were being billed twice.
tickets.resolution_notes: The 1.00 item was the verification authorization placed when a new card is saved; it is never captured, and the issuer releases it, usually within a few days. Showed the admin the voided authorization in our payment records and shared its reference for their bank. The customer later confirmed it had dropped off the statement.

tickets.subject: Import job picks up half-written export files
tickets.description: The customer's nightly import job sometimes loads a truncated CSV from the SFTP folder and misses thousands of rows.
tickets.resolution_notes: Large files were written directly under their final name, so the customer's job could pick them up mid-transfer. Enabled the delivery option that writes to a temporary name and renames on completion. Confirmed the import job only saw complete files over a week of runs.

tickets.subject: Brand colours missing on shared public links
tickets.description: Internal users see the customer's brand colours, but dashboards opened through public share links use the default theme.
tickets.resolution_notes: The setting 'Apply workspace branding to public links' was off, which is the default for new workspaces. Enabled it in Branding settings. Public links now show the customer's colours and logo.

tickets.subject: Credit note issued in a different currency from its invoice
tickets.description: After the account moved to GBP billing, a credit note for an old USD invoice was issued in GBP, and the customer's ledger cannot match it.
tickets.resolution_notes: Credit notes were generated in the subscription's current currency rather than the currency of the invoice being credited. Voided the GBP credit note and reissued it in USD against the original invoice. Confirmed accounts payable matched it to the invoice.

tickets.subject: Chart images blurry when pasted into slides
tickets.description: Charts exported as PNG look blurry when the merchandising team places them into presentation slides.
tickets.resolution_notes: PNG exports used screen resolution. Showed the team the 3x resolution and SVG options in the export menu. Confirmed the 3x PNG stayed sharp at full-slide size.

tickets.subject: End-of-day POS upload script fails with 'protocol version' alert
tickets.description: A scheduled script on the customer's POS back-office server that uploads end-of-day files started failing with 'SSL routines: tlsv1 alert protocol version'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The script's runtime defaulted to TLS 1.0, which the product no longer accepts. Configured the runtime to negotiate TLS 1.2 through its system setting and restarted the scheduled task. Uploads succeeded that evening.

tickets.subject: Dashboards treat Q1 as January to March; ours is February to April
tickets.description: The customer's fiscal year starts on 1 February, but every quarter on their dashboards follows calendar quarters.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace fiscal year start month was still January. Set it to February. Fiscal quarter filters and tiles now run Feb-Apr, May-Jul, Aug-Oct and Nov-Jan.

tickets.subject: Hourly sales double at 1 AM on the night clocks went back
tickets.description: On the Hourly Sales chart for 2 November, the 1:00 bar is roughly twice its usual height for every US store, and store teams insist that hour was quiet.
tickets.resolution_notes: Hourly aggregation keyed buckets by the local wall-clock label, so the two distinct 1:00-1:59 hours on the fall-back night were merged into one bucket. Changed hourly bucketing to UTC instants labelled with their local offset, which yields 25 buckets for that day, and reprocessed the date. The chart now shows separate 1:00 EDT and 1:00 EST entries, each matching register totals.

tickets.subject: Who changed our workspace time zone?
tickets.description: Every dashboard shifted to Pacific time this morning, and the admin wants to know who changed the setting and when.
tickets.resolution_notes: The settings audit log showed a workspace admin on the US team switched the time zone from America/New_York to America/Los_Angeles at 08:12 UTC while testing. Restored America/New_York, and the customer agreed to do future testing in their sandbox workspace. Dashboards returned to Eastern time.

tickets.subject: Personal token rejected in second workspace
tickets.description: An analyst's token works in the add-in for the head-office workspace but is refused with 'Unauthorized workspace' when pointed at the outlet-stores workspace.
tickets.resolution_notes: Personal tokens are scoped to the workspace where they are created, and this one was generated in head office. The analyst generated a second token from inside the outlet-stores workspace. Both workbooks refreshed with their respective tokens.

tickets.subject: Cumulative revenue chart gets slower every week
tickets.description: Customer reports that a daily chart of cumulative revenue keeps getting slower; it took 2 seconds at launch and now takes close to 30.
tickets.resolution_notes: The running total was defined over all history with no partition, so every point recomputed the sum from the first sale, and cost grew with the data. Changed it to a year-to-date running total partitioned by fiscal year, which matches how the chart is used, and added a precomputed cumulative column for the all-time variant. The chart loads in under 2 seconds.

tickets.subject: Burst of six alerts at once after data caught up
tickets.description: After a delayed data source caught up at 15:00, the customer's team received six 'low hourly sales' alerts in one minute, all for hours earlier that day.
tickets.resolution_notes: When the backlog loaded, the rule evaluated each newly completed hour and notified for every one, even though they were hours old. Enabled the rule option to skip notifications for periods older than two hours and to send a single summary instead. A replayed backfill produced one summary message.

tickets.subject: Nightly SFTP pull failing about half the time
tickets.description: Customer reports the nightly pull from their on-prem file server sftp.harborpine.example.com has failed on roughly every second run since last week with 'connection timed out after 30s'; manual retries sometimes succeed.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector worker pool had been expanded with a second egress range, 198.51.100.32/28, announced in the release notes, but the customer's perimeter firewall only allowed the original 198.51.100.0/28, so runs scheduled on new workers timed out. The customer's network team added the new range to the existing SFTP rule, port 22 only. Seven consecutive nightly pulls then completed without retries.

tickets.subject: Newly promoted store manager blocked from own store's data
tickets.description: A store manager promoted last week can open the Store Daily dashboard, but the row-level rule hides even their own store.
