tickets.resolution_notes: The account had been created by SSO just-in-time provisioning, which did not populate store_id. As a workaround, set the attribute manually on the user; mapping store_id from the identity provider permanently was planned with the customer's IT team for the following week. Confirmed the manager could see their store's figures.

tickets.subject: Logistics team locked out after folder reorganisation
tickets.description: Following a weekend folder reorganisation, the logistics team can no longer see four dashboards they use every day.
tickets.resolution_notes: The reorganisation moved the dashboards into the Operations folder, and the move discarded their dashboard-level grants in favour of the folder's permissions, which do not include logistics. Re-granted the logistics team view access on the four dashboards. Confirmed the team could see them.

tickets.subject: Scheduled report created three times via API
tickets.description: Customer's onboarding script set up a weekly report for a new region, and now three identical copies of the schedule exist, so managers receive the report three times.
tickets.resolution_notes: The script's retry wrapper repeated the create-schedule POST after client-side timeouts, and without an Idempotency-Key each retry created a new schedule. Removed the two extra schedules and updated the wrapper to send a stable Idempotency-Key per logical request. A re-run of the script against a test region created one schedule.

tickets.subject: Agency guests told 'Your guest access has ended'
tickets.description: Contacts at the customer's marketing agency suddenly get 'Your guest access has ended' on dashboards they have used for weeks.
tickets.resolution_notes: Guest invitations default to a 30-day expiry, and the inviter had not changed it. Extended the guests' access to the contract end date set by the admin. Confirmed the agency contacts could open the dashboards again.

tickets.subject: Dashboards using 'delivery date' field load slowly
tickets.description: Customer's delivery date arrives as text (DD/MM/YYYY) and they built a calculated field to convert it. Widgets that filter on that field take around 20 seconds.
tickets.resolution_notes: The conversion was parsed on every row and every query, and filtering on a parsed value prevented any index use. Added a typed date column populated during load from the same parsing rule, and switched the widgets to it. Spot checks showed the same dates and the widgets now load in about a second.

tickets.subject: Only some of the store team receive alerts
tickets.description: Customer added a 120-person 'All store leads' group to a rule. About half the people say they never get the alerts.
tickets.resolution_notes: A rule can notify at most 50 individual recipients, and the group was expanded and cut at that limit without a visible warning. Pointed the rule at the store leads' distribution list and chat channel instead, and the editor now warns when a group exceeds the limit. All store leads received the next alert.

tickets.subject: Text widget spills over the chart below
tickets.description: A long note in a text widget runs out of its box and covers the top of the chart underneath.
tickets.resolution_notes: Text widgets had no overflow handling, so content taller than the widget was drawn outside it. Text widgets now scroll internally when their content exceeds the widget height. The customer's note scrolls within its box and the chart below is fully visible.

tickets.subject: Order sync rejected: source API version no longer supported
tickets.description: Order sync from Northwind Commerce has failed since the start of the month with 'API version 2024-01 is no longer supported'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector was pinned to an API version the platform had announced for retirement, and we had not moved it in time. Upgraded the connector to the current API version, including a renamed discount field, and re-ran the failed days. Orders and discounts for the whole month are now present.

tickets.subject: Store tablets on IPv6-only network can't get live updates
tickets.description: On the customer's new IPv6-only store network, tablets load dashboards but live tiles never connect.
tickets.resolution_notes: The real-time host live.example.net had no AAAA record, and DNS64/NAT64 had not been enabled on the new store VLAN, so tablets could not reach it. As a workaround the customer enabled DNS64/NAT64 on that VLAN, which restored live tiles; publishing native IPv6 records for the real-time host is scheduled on our side. Live tiles updated on test tablets.

tickets.subject: Folder owner left; editors can't change who has access
tickets.description: The only owner of a shared folder has left the company, and the remaining editors cannot change its access list.
tickets.resolution_notes: Managing a folder's sharing is limited to its owners and workspace admins. A workspace admin assigned one of the remaining editors as the new owner. Confirmed the new owner could manage the folder's access.

tickets.subject: Buyer's saved views gone after company domain migration
tickets.description: A buyer at a homeware retailer says that since the company moved to a new email domain, signing in shows the welcome tour and none of their saved views or subscriptions.
tickets.resolution_notes: The identity provider now sends the buyer's new address, which did not match the login email on their existing account, so a second account was created at sign-in. Merged them by moving the new login email onto the original account and deleting the empty one. The buyer's saved views were back at their next sign-in.

tickets.subject: One large table widget always re-runs its query
tickets.description: Everything on the customer's assortment dashboard loads from cache quickly except the SKU detail table, which takes 18 seconds every single time.
tickets.resolution_notes: The SKU table result was about 9 MB, above the cache's 5 MB per-entry limit, so the cache silently skipped storing it. Switched the widget to server-side pagination so each cached page is small, and added a log warning when an entry exceeds the limit. The table now loads its first page in about a second.

tickets.subject: Admin gets 'Audit log requires Security Admin'
tickets.description: A workspace admin trying to open the audit log is shown 'Audit log requires Security Admin'.
tickets.resolution_notes: On Business plans, audit log access is a separate Security Admin permission. The account owner requested it for this admin under their security policy, and it was granted. Confirmed the admin could open the audit log.

tickets.subject: Invitations show 'already accepted' though nobody accepted
tickets.description: New staff at a garden centre chain open their invitation email and see 'This invitation was already accepted', yet they cannot sign in and have never set a password.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's mail security service opens links in inbound mail, and invitation acceptance was triggered by that request, leaving half-activated accounts with no password. Applied the confirm-before-redeem step already used for password reset links to invitation acceptance, and reset the affected accounts. All six new staff members activated their accounts from fresh invitations.

tickets.subject: Members of a deleted group still have access
tickets.description: Users from a group that was deleted last month can still open dashboards that had been shared with that group.
tickets.resolution_notes: Deleting the group removed it from the interface but left the share grants pointing to the orphaned group identifier, with memberships still resolved from cache. Removed the orphaned grants, and group deletion now removes its grants. Confirmed the former members lost access.

tickets.subject: 'Aggregates updating' banner still showing at 10am
tickets.description: Customer sees a yellow 'Aggregates updating - results may be slower' banner on all dashboards until about 10:00 each day. It used to clear before anyone logged in.
tickets.resolution_notes: The aggregate refresh had started reprocessing all partitions every night after a multi-year history import marked them as modified. Reset the partition change markers and confirmed only new days are refreshed. The banner now clears at about 2:45, well before business hours.

tickets.subject: Supplier portal embed survived contractor deprovisioning
tickets.description: The admin expected a dashboard embedded in the supplier portal to stop working once the contractor who set it up was deprovisioned, but it still shows live data.
tickets.resolution_notes: The share link stayed active after its creator was deprovisioned, because links were not tied to the creator's status. The supply chain team still needed the embed, so the link was re-issued under that team's owner and the contractor's link was revoked. Confirmed the old URL returns 'Link disabled' and the new one loads.

tickets.subject: Directory group changes take a day to apply
tickets.description: Users added to a group in the customer's identity provider only get the matching role the following day.
tickets.resolution_notes: Push provisioning had never been enabled, so the integration relied on a nightly pull of group memberships. Enabled SCIM push provisioning with the customer's IT team. Confirmed a membership change applied within two minutes.

tickets.subject: Rows overlap halfway down the SKU table when zoomed out
tickets.description: Area managers who zoom out to fit more of the SKU table on screen find rows drawn on top of each other partway down the list.
tickets.resolution_notes: The virtualized table assumed a fixed row height in screen pixels that no longer matched once the page was zoomed, so row positions drifted further the lower you went. Rows are now positioned from measured heights that account for zoom. The SKU table renders cleanly from 67% to 150% zoom.

tickets.subject: Store managers get two emails per alert, area managers get one
tickets.description: Agent summary: for the same rule, store managers receive duplicate emails while area managers receive one. The rule notifies both the 'Store Managers' group and several individual managers.
tickets.resolution_notes: Several store managers were listed both individually and through the group, and recipients were not de-duplicated by address. Removed the individual entries and deployed a change that de-duplicates recipients across groups and individuals at send time. Each manager now receives one email per alert.

tickets.subject: Opening a second workspace signs me out of the first
tickets.description: A consultant who supports two retail brands is signed out of brand A's workspace whenever they open brand B's in another tab.
tickets.resolution_notes: The session cookie was shared across workspaces, so signing in to the second workspace replaced the first session. As a workaround the consultant uses a separate browser profile per workspace; support for concurrent per-workspace sessions was tracked for a later release. The consultant confirmed both workspaces stayed signed in with separate profiles.

tickets.subject: Value in alert message much lower than the dashboard
tickets.description: Customer says the numbers quoted in their hourly sales alerts are often 30-60% lower than what the dashboard shows for the same hour later in the day.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule evaluated at the top of the hour, before the point-of-sale batch for that hour had finished loading, so the alert captured a partial total. Added a 15-minute evaluation delay aligned with the batch arrival. Alert values now match the dashboard for the same hour.

tickets.subject: Month-to-date growth shows -60% on the 10th
tickets.description: Every month the MTD revenue tile shows large negative growth during the first weeks, only recovering by month end.
tickets.resolution_notes: The month-to-date comparison used the full prior month as its base instead of the same number of elapsed days. Changed to-date comparisons to align on elapsed days (1st-10th against 1st-10th) and recomputed. On the 10th of the following month the tile showed +3.2%, consistent with the daily trend.

tickets.subject: Some users still see English after switching the workspace to French
tickets.description: The admin set the workspace language to French, but about a dozen users still get the English interface.
tickets.resolution_notes: Those users had set their personal language to English at some point, and personal preferences take precedence over the workspace default. Showed the admin the 'Members with overrides' report and, after checking with the users, reset their language to 'Workspace default'. All of them now see French.

tickets.subject: 'invalid_cursor' after pausing between pages
tickets.description: Customer's job pauses for about half an hour between pages to stay polite with their own database, then gets 400 'invalid_cursor' on the next request.
tickets.resolution_notes: Pagination cursors are valid for 10 minutes. Recommended processing pages promptly into a staging area, or recording an updated_since checkpoint and starting a fresh cursor after long pauses. Their reworked job completed with checkpoints and no cursor errors.

tickets.subject: 'Today' shifts when the regional manager travels
tickets.description: A regional manager says 'Today' figures change unpredictably when travelling between time zones.
tickets.resolution_notes: The user's profile had 'Follow device time zone' enabled, so relative dates followed the laptop's current zone. Disabled it and set the manager's home zone to Europe/London. 'Today' now stays on London time while travelling.

tickets.subject: CSV upload CLI fails only from branch offices
tickets.description: Customer's upload script using the command-line client works from HQ but fails from every branch office with 'SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Branch traffic passes through a TLS inspection gateway that HQ traffic does not, and the gateway presents certificates signed by the company's inspection CA, which the CLI's trust store lacked. Added the inspection CA to the CLI's trust configuration on branch machines through the customer's device management. Uploads from three branches succeeded.

tickets.subject: Two different charges on the same day for two brands
tickets.description: Customer sees two charges of different amounts from us on the same day and believes they were double charged; they run two brands but thought they had one subscription.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each brand had its own workspace with its own subscription on the same card, and both renewed on the same date. Explained the two subscriptions and, at the customer's request, placed both workspaces under one billing account with a combined invoice from the next cycle. Confirmed the next-cycle preview showed a single charge.

tickets.subject: Orders counted twice from live events and nightly sync
tickets.description: After switching on real-time order events, the customer sees some orders twice in the daily sales chart: once with the event's timestamp and again after the nightly sync.
tickets.resolution_notes: Event-ingested orders were stored with a key prefixed by the store ID, while the scheduled sync used the bare order number, so the nightly run did not recognize them. Normalized both paths to the same order key and deduplicated the affected days. Daily totals matched the store's own order count for the following week.

tickets.subject: Scheduled downgrade removed features immediately
tickets.description: The admin meant to downgrade from Business to Growth at renewal, but the Forecasting module disappeared the same day even though Business was paid through month-end.
tickets.resolution_notes: The downgrade dialog defaulted to 'Apply now' and the admin had not switched it to 'Apply at renewal'. Restored Business for the rest of the paid period at no cost and rescheduled the downgrade for the renewal date. Confirmed Forecasting was available again and the scheduled change appeared in Plan & Billing.

tickets.subject: Intermittent 'server not found' from validating resolvers
tickets.description: Several customers whose networks use DNSSEC-validating resolvers reported 'server not found' for the product for about two hours, while other customers were unaffected.
tickets.resolution_notes: A DNSSEC key rollover on the product's own zone was performed with too short an overlap, so validating resolvers holding the previous DS record treated new responses as bogus. Our operations team re-published both keys and extended the overlap to a full TTL cycle. Validation succeeded from public test resolvers and affected customers confirmed recovery.

tickets.subject: Embed works on test portal, not on production portal
tickets.description: The embedded store-performance dashboard appears on the customer's test intranet, but the same embed code shows an empty grey box in production.
tickets.resolution_notes: The production portal sends a stricter Content-Security-Policy header than the test portal, and its frame-src did not include the embed origin. After the portal team added https://embed.example.net to the production policy, the embed loaded identically in both environments.

tickets.subject: Slow Monday mornings after weekend maintenance
tickets.description: Customer reports that the first hour of every Monday is painfully slow across all dashboards; by mid-morning everything is normal again.
tickets.resolution_notes: Weekend maintenance restarts cleared the in-memory result cache, so Monday's first wave of users all hit the database cold. As a workaround we enabled a scheduled warm-up that pre-runs the customer's 20 most-viewed dashboards after maintenance; a persistent cache tier that survives restarts is scheduled for a later release. The following Monday's first-hour load times matched the rest of the week.

tickets.subject: Sunday stocktake mute ends before the stocktake does
tickets.description: Customer mutes stock alerts for their monthly Sunday stocktake from 18:00 to 23:00, but alerts start arriving around 21:00.
tickets.resolution_notes: The mute schedule had been stored in UTC, two hours off from the rule's local time zone, so it ended at 21:00 local. Re-saved the mute in the rule's time zone after the editor fix. During the next stocktake no alerts were sent until 23:00.

tickets.subject: Where to place the 53rd week this fiscal year
tickets.description: The customer's retail fiscal year has a 53rd week, and finance wants it counted in January rather than shown as a separate period.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace's 53-week handling was set to 'Show as separate period', so the extra week sat outside the fiscal months. Set 53rd-week placement to 'Add to final fiscal month', which puts it in January. The January period now contains five weeks and matches the finance calendar.

tickets.subject: Bulk import job shows 'running' for two days
tickets.description: Customer submitted a product attribute bulk import via the API on Monday and the job status still says 'running' on Wednesday.
tickets.resolution_notes: The file failed header validation in the first second, but a defect left the job status as 'running' instead of setting 'failed' with an error report. Fixed the status transition and backfilled the correct state for affected jobs. The customer's job now shows 'failed' with the missing-column error, and their corrected file imported successfully.

tickets.subject: Store offline all afternoon without any alert
tickets.description: All terminals in one store lost their connection on Saturday afternoon. The customer expected their low-sales alert to fire for that store, but it stayed green.
tickets.resolution_notes: No transactions arrived for the store, so its evaluation windows had no data, which the rule treated as OK by default. Set the rule's no-data state to alert for store groups during opening hours. A test with a store's sandbox feed paused triggered the alert within the configured window.

tickets.subject: 404 when fetching orders using IDs from the list endpoint
tickets.description: The customer's script lists orders, then fetches each one by ID. For recent orders the detail call returns 404 'order not found', although the order exists in the app.
tickets.resolution_notes: The script, written in JavaScript, parsed the list response with standard number handling, rounding large 64-bit IDs, so it requested IDs that do not exist. Switched the script to the string ID field. All detail lookups now succeed.

tickets.subject: Partially refunded orders show too little net value
tickets.description: In the order detail table, a $120 order with a $40 partial refund shows a net value of $40 instead of $80, and a few orders even show negative values.
tickets.resolution_notes: The net value calculation took the already-adjusted order total ($80) and then subtracted the refund record ($40) again. Switched the calculation to start from the original captured amount so each refund is deducted once, and reprocessed. The example order now shows $80 and no orders carry a negative net value.

tickets.subject: Units per transaction always a whole number
tickets.description: The customer's 'units per transaction' metric only ever shows 1 or 2, never values like 1.6.
tickets.resolution_notes: Both inputs were integer fields, and the calculation engine performed integer division when both operands were integers. Changed the engine to promote division to decimal and recomputed the metric. Units per transaction now shows 1.62 for last week, matching a manual calculation from the order lines.

tickets.subject: Invoiced in CAD although contract fixes USD
tickets.description: After the customer updated its billing address to Canada, the next invoice came in Canadian dollars at a converted price, contrary to the USD pricing in their contract.
tickets.resolution_notes: Changing the billing country triggered automatic currency localisation, which should be suppressed for contracts with a fixed currency. Reissued the invoice in USD and locked the subscription currency. Confirmed the following draft invoice stayed in USD.

tickets.subject: Rounded commission totals don't match finance's convention
tickets.description: Customer's finance team rounds commissions half-up, so 2.345 becomes 2.35, but the Staff Commission report gives 2.34 for the same value.
tickets.resolution_notes: The commission calculation used round-half-to-even, which sends exact halves to the nearest even digit. Changed the commission metric to round half-up, consistent with the customer's payroll rules, and recomputed the open period. Ten sample payslips now match finance's figures.

tickets.subject: Nonprofit discount missing after renewal
tickets.description: A charity-run chain of secondhand shops renewed its annual plan, and the invoice no longer includes the 30% nonprofit discount it has had for two years.
tickets.resolution_notes: The discount was attached to the original subscription record instead of the customer account, and the renewal created a new subscription without it. Reissued the renewal invoice with the discount and moved the discount to the account level so future renewals inherit it. Confirmed the corrected invoice showed the 30% reduction.

tickets.subject: Sell-through rate above 100% for several categories
tickets.description: Merchandising sees June sell-through of 140% for Swimwear and asks how they could sell more than they had.
tickets.resolution_notes: Sell-through was calculated as units sold divided by units received in the period, ignoring opening stock, so categories selling down earlier receipts exceeded 100%. Redefined it as units sold divided by opening on-hand plus units received, per the customer's merchandising definition, and recomputed. Swimwear June sell-through is now 71%, matching the planning team's spreadsheet.

tickets.subject: Closed stores trigger 'zero sales' alerts every day
tickets.description: Customer closed six stores in March, and the daily 'zero sales' alert has fired for each of them every day since.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule was scoped to a fixed list of store IDs created at setup, so closed stores stayed in scope. Changed the scope to the dynamic 'active stores' segment, which follows store status. The closed stores dropped out of the next evaluation and no further alerts were sent for them.

tickets.subject: Connections drop every few minutes since SD-WAN rollout
tickets.description: Since the SD-WAN rollout, store staff say the app 'kicks them out' every few minutes, and they assumed their sessions were expiring.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new SD-WAN policy sent outbound traffic over one link and return traffic over another, so the stateful firewall saw half-open connections and reset them. The network team corrected the routing policy to keep flows symmetric. Sessions were never expiring, and after the change staff stayed connected through a full shift.

tickets.subject: Repeat purchase rate jumped to 64% overnight
tickets.description: Loyalty team asks why the repeat purchase rate leapt from 28% to 64% on the day identity matching was switched on, with no campaign running.
tickets.resolution_notes: Walk-in purchases recorded with the same placeholder email were merged into a single profile, which removed thousands of one-time shoppers from the denominator and turned them into one very frequent buyer. Excluded placeholder addresses from matching and recomputed. The rate returned to 29%, in line with the loyalty program's own figure.

tickets.subject: Guest invite blocked: 'Domain not allowed'
tickets.description: An editor cannot invite a consultant from consultancy.example.net; the invite dialog says 'Domain not allowed'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace's guest domain allow-list was limited to two partner domains. After a review, the admin added the consultancy's domain. Confirmed the invitation was sent and accepted.

tickets.subject: Shared link opens without the sender's filters
tickets.description: A merchandising lead copies the browser address to share a filtered view with store managers, but recipients open the unfiltered dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: Filter state was kept only in the browser session, not in the URL, so the copied address carried no filters. Added a 'Copy link with filters' option that encodes the current filters in the link. Store managers who opened the new links saw the same filtered view as the sender.

tickets.subject: Monthly comparisons uneven because retail calendar isn't used
tickets.description: The customer's merchandisers plan by a 4-5-4 retail calendar, but the dashboards use calendar months, so month-over-month comparisons mix partial weeks differently from their plans.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace calendar type was 'Gregorian'. Switched it to 'Retail 4-5-4' with the customer's fiscal start week. Fiscal months now align to retail weeks and match the merchandise plan.

tickets.subject: No admin left after sole admin was deprovisioned
tickets.description: The customer's only admin left and was deprovisioned by IT through SCIM, so nobody can manage users or settings.
tickets.resolution_notes: Verified the request with the account's billing owner and the contract signatory, then assigned Admin to the nominated IT lead. Recommended keeping at least two admins, and the customer added a second one. Confirmed both admins could open user management.

tickets.subject: Best sellers list shows the same jacket five times
tickets.description: Customer says the Top 10 products widget lists 'Harbor Rain Jacket' five times with different revenue on each row and asked whether the product was duplicated.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each row was a size variant: the source sends variants as separate products, and the parent-product link field had not been mapped for this connector, so variants were not rolled up. Mapped the parent ID field and enabled rollup to parent for the best-sellers widget. The jacket now appears once with revenue equal to the sum of its five variants.

tickets.subject: 2FA codes only work occasionally since returning from travel
tickets.description: A regional manager says their codes work 'maybe one time in five' since they came back from a trip abroad. They have not changed phones or reinstalled anything.
tickets.resolution_notes: During the trip the manager had set the phone's date and time manually, which left the clock roughly 50 seconds out after returning, so most codes fell just outside the accepted window. Switching the phone back to automatic date and time removed the offset. Five consecutive sign-ins with codes then succeeded.

tickets.subject: Wide tables cut off at the right edge of the PDF
tickets.description: Wide tables in PDF exports are cut off after the eighth column.
tickets.resolution_notes: Page orientation defaulted to portrait and tables were not scaled to the page. Set the dashboard's PDF export to landscape with 'fit to width' scaling. Confirmed all 14 columns fit on the page.

tickets.subject: Margin chart blank for newly opened stores
tickets.description: Customer reports the gross margin line chart draws nothing at all when filtered to the three stores opened this quarter; other stores draw normally.
tickets.resolution_notes: Those stores have no cost data yet, so every margin point was null rather than absent, and the chart component treated an all-null series as invalid and drew nothing, not even axes. Changed the component to keep the axes and show 'No values for this selection' when a series is entirely null. The new stores now show that message, and the line fills in as cost data arrives.

tickets.subject: UK customer's invoices show no VAT but should
tickets.description: A UK-based customer says its invoices show no VAT at all; their accountant expects domestic VAT and wants compliant invoices.
tickets.resolution_notes: The account had been assigned to our EU billing entity, which applied reverse charge because the customer had supplied a VAT number. Moved the account to the UK billing entity and reissued the affected invoices with UK VAT. Confirmed the accountant accepted the reissued invoices.

tickets.subject: Friday report link expired before weekend staff opened it
tickets.description: Weekend store managers say the link in Friday's report has expired by Saturday afternoon.
tickets.resolution_notes: Report download links default to a 24-hour lifetime. The admin extended the lifetime to 72 hours in the delivery settings, within the policy maximum. Confirmed a Friday link still worked on Sunday.

tickets.subject: Store sync fails after store number became text
tickets.description: Since the customer changed 'store_number' to a text field in their ERP to support codes like 'S-014', the store sync fails with 'Invalid integer value'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Our destination column for store numbers was typed as an integer, so the new alphanumeric values were rejected. Migrated the column to text for this connection and re-ran the sync. All 63 stores imported, including those with the new lettered codes.

tickets.subject: Workspace name cut off at 40 characters
tickets.description: The admin can't save the full name 'Brightline Outfitters International Retail Group'; the name field simply stops accepting characters.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace name field was limited to 40 characters. The limit was raised to 80 in workspace settings, and long names are now truncated with a tooltip in the navigation bar. The full name was saved and appears in settings and emails.

tickets.subject: Embedded live board on store intranet never refreshes
tickets.description: The customer embeds a live sales board in their store intranet; it loads once and then never updates, unlike the same board opened directly in the app from home.
tickets.resolution_notes: Store traffic passes through the corporate proxy, which blocked the WebSocket upgrade the embedded board uses for live data, so the embed only ever showed its initial snapshot. Allowing WebSocket upgrades to live.example.net on the proxy resolved it; the embedded board updated continuously during a 30-minute test at two stores.

tickets.subject: Data rows overage for a store we disconnected
tickets.description: The customer disconnected a legacy e-commerce store in May, but June's invoice includes a data rows overage as if that store's history were still loaded.
tickets.resolution_notes: Rows from disconnected sources are retained for 30 days in case of reconnection, and the usage meter counted them during that window. Credited the overage and purged the legacy source's rows at the customer's request. Confirmed the meter fell below the plan allowance.

tickets.subject: Weeks appear to start on Sunday for an analyst abroad
tickets.description: An analyst working from Vancouver sees the weekly sales bars labelled as weeks starting on Sunday, while the team in Germany sees the same weeks starting on Monday.
tickets.resolution_notes: Weeks were bucketed correctly in the workspace's Berlin time zone, but the chart formatted each bucket start in the analyst's browser zone, where Monday 00:00 in Berlin is still Sunday. As a workaround the analyst set their profile time zone to Berlin, which the chart uses in place of the browser zone; labelling axes in the workspace zone for everyone was tracked as the permanent fix. The analyst's weekly bars now start on Monday.

tickets.subject: Alerts stopped posting to #store-ops
tickets.description: Customer reports no alerts have appeared in their #store-ops chat channel since Monday. The channel delivery log shows 'token_revoked'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's chat workspace admin reinstalled our app while troubleshooting another integration, which revoked the token we were using. Reconnected the chat channel from alert settings with the new installation. A test alert posted to #store-ops immediately, and pending alerts were re-sent.

tickets.subject: TV playlist mode becomes choppy after a day
tickets.description: Customer uses playlist mode to rotate eight dashboards on a screen every 60 seconds. Transitions are smooth at first but become choppy after about a day.
tickets.resolution_notes: Playlist mode kept every previously shown dashboard loaded in the background instead of unloading it on rotation. Changed it to unload dashboards when they rotate out and preload only the next one. Memory use is now constant across rotations and transitions stay smooth.

tickets.subject: Shop-floor leaderboard freezes by midday
tickets.description: The sales leaderboard on the shop-floor TV is right in the morning but frozen by midday, although the clock in the corner keeps ticking.
tickets.resolution_notes: TV mode refreshed on a timer, but a memory leak in chart redraws slowed the TV's browser until refreshes no longer completed. Fixed the leak by reusing chart instances on refresh and added a full page reload every 12 hours. The leaderboard stayed current through a three-day test.

tickets.subject: Newly opened outlet's sales missing everywhere
tickets.description: A new outlet opened two weeks ago and its sales are missing from every dashboard. The e-commerce connector lists only the original locations.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector syncs the locations selected at setup and did not add new ones automatically. Selected the new location, enabled 'Include new locations automatically', and backfilled from the opening date. The outlet's two weeks of sales now appear.

tickets.subject: API keys expired without anyone being warned
tickets.description: Several of the customer's integrations returned 401 on the same day. Their admin says no one received any notice that keys were about to expire.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace had enabled a 180-day key expiry policy, and expiry warnings were going to a shared mailbox nobody monitored. Rotated the affected keys, set the expiry notification recipients to the integration owners, and enabled the 14-day and 3-day reminders. The integrations recovered and the admin confirmed the test reminder reached the right people.

tickets.subject: Returns connector rejects internally issued certificate
tickets.description: Since the customer re-issued their returns system's certificate from their internal CA, the returns connector fails with 'self-signed certificate in certificate chain'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Connectors trust public CAs by default and could not build a chain to the customer's internal root. Uploaded the customer's root CA certificate to the connection's custom trust setting, so verification stays enabled but trusts that CA for this connection only. Runs succeeded and the trust setting is recorded in the connection notes.

tickets.subject: Checkout says 'Invalid VAT number' for a valid Belgian ID
tickets.description: A new customer cannot complete checkout without being charged VAT, because the VAT field shows 'Invalid VAT number' although the number is correct.
tickets.resolution_notes: The checkout validator rejected the dots the customer typed between digit groups. As a workaround, support stored the ID on the account in normalised form so checkout could proceed under reverse charge; accepting common separators in the validator was scheduled as the permanent fix. Confirmed the order completed with no VAT charged.

tickets.subject: First code after scanning QR is 'invalid' during enrollment
tickets.description: A new user scanning the 2FA setup QR code gets 'Invalid code' when confirming enrollment. They had left the setup page open while hunting for their phone.
tickets.resolution_notes: The enrollment secret expires after ten minutes, and the page had quietly generated a new QR code on refresh, so the scanned secret was out of date. The user deleted the old entry, scanned the current code and confirmed enrollment successfully. The setup page now shows a countdown and warns when the code is replaced.

tickets.subject: Dashboard shows yesterday's totals after the sync finished
tickets.description: The morning sync finished at 06:10, but at 08:00 the sales dashboard still shows yesterday's totals. Opening the same widget in the editor shows today's figures.
tickets.resolution_notes: Dashboard query results were cached for four hours and the cache was not cleared when a sync completed. Added cache invalidation on sync completion for the affected datasets. The next morning the dashboard reflected new data within a minute of the sync finishing.

tickets.subject: Map zooms to the ocean when a single store is filtered
tickets.description: Filtering the store map to one particular store recentres it on an empty patch of ocean off the African coast.
tickets.resolution_notes: That store had blank coordinates, which the map read as latitude 0, longitude 0 and zoomed to. The map now ignores missing coordinates and shows a 'Location unknown' badge, and the admin added the store's address so it could be placed. The store now appears in the right city.

tickets.subject: Inventory feed broke right after certificate renewal
tickets.description: The customer renewed the TLS certificate on their inventory endpoint on Friday; since then every scheduled run fails during the handshake.
tickets.resolution_notes: The renewal installed the new leaf certificate but not the issuing CA's intermediate bundle, so the chain could not be built to a trusted root. The customer reinstalled the certificate with the full chain file. The handshake now completes and the backlog of runs has processed.

tickets.subject: Purchasing card declined with 'do not honor'
tickets.description: The customer's corporate purchasing card is declined every time with 'Card declined - do not honor', although the same card works for other online purchases.
tickets.resolution_notes: The purchasing card program blocked the merchant category used for software subscriptions. The customer's card program administrator added that category to the card's allowed list, after which the charge succeeded. Confirmed the card is now the default method and the open invoice is paid.

tickets.subject: Delivery log says delivered but our system never got the events
tickets.description: Customer insists several dataset.refreshed events never reached them, but our delivery log shows every one as delivered with a 200 response.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their endpoint's framework caught an exception in the event handler and still returned 200 with an error message in the body, so our side correctly recorded successful delivery. Showed them the stored response bodies for the affected events, and they fixed the handler to return 500 on processing errors so retries happen. Replayed the affected events and the customer confirmed they were processed.

tickets.subject: Too many anomaly alerts for small fluctuations
tickets.description: Customer turned on anomaly alerts for every store and now gets dozens a day, many for differences of a few units.
tickets.resolution_notes: Sensitivity was set to 'high', and with low-volume stores small absolute changes registered as statistically unusual. Lowered sensitivity to 'medium' and added a minimum absolute deviation of 500 in sales value. Alerts fell to two or three per day, which the customer reviewed and agreed were meaningful.

tickets.subject: No reset email for user on SSO-enforced workspace
tickets.description: A merchandising analyst tried 'Forgot password' and was told an email was on its way, but nothing came. Their workspace requires single sign-on for everyone.
tickets.resolution_notes: Password reset is intentionally disabled for accounts in workspaces that enforce SSO, but the reset page showed the same generic 'check your email' message to everyone. Directed the analyst to their company identity provider's self-service reset and changed the page to tell SSO-enforced users to use their company login. The analyst signed in via SSO the same day.

tickets.subject: Web orders appear five hours earlier than they were placed
tickets.description: The ecommerce team says orders placed at 9 pm Eastern show in the order timeline at 4 pm, and orders placed just after midnight count toward the previous day.
tickets.resolution_notes: The storefront export sends order timestamps without a UTC offset, in store-local Eastern time, and the field was being interpreted as UTC. Set the connector's timestamp interpretation for that source to America/New_York and reprocessed six months of orders. Spot checks of 20 orders matched the storefront's order history to the minute.

tickets.subject: Heavily edited dashboard opens slowly
tickets.description: Customer's main planning dashboard has been edited almost daily for two years and now takes around 12 seconds to open. A copy of it opens quickly.
tickets.resolution_notes: The dashboard response included its full revision history, around 500 versions, every time it was opened; the copy had no history, which is why it was fast. Changed history to load only when the version panel is opened. The original dashboard now opens as fast as the copy.

tickets.subject: On-call paged 14 times overnight for the same order backlog
tickets.description: The customer's on-call engineer was paged 14 times between midnight and 6:00 by the unfulfilled orders alert. The backlog was around the threshold all night and never got worse.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule fired at 500 and resolved at 499 with no hysteresis, so small fluctuations created a page each time. Set a recovery threshold of 400 and required the breach to last 10 minutes before paging. The following night produced one page when the backlog genuinely rose.

tickets.subject: Upgrade landed on the wrong regional workspace
tickets.description: A retailer with separate EU and US workspaces upgraded what they thought was the US workspace; the EU one was upgraded and charged instead.
tickets.resolution_notes: Both workspaces had the same display name and the plan picker did not show their regions. Applied the upgrade to the US workspace, reversed the EU upgrade with a credit, and suggested the admin give each workspace a distinct name. Verified the US workspace showed Growth and the EU workspace was back on Starter.

tickets.subject: No anomaly alerts for the store that opened last week
tickets.description: Customer opened a flagship store last week and expected anomaly alerts to cover it from day one, but the rule shows it as 'learning'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Anomaly baselines need 14 days of history before they can judge what is unusual. As an interim measure we added a static threshold rule for the new store, set from the customer's opening forecast; the anomaly rule takes over automatically once learning completes. The static rule fired correctly during a slow opening-week afternoon.

tickets.subject: Nightly extract hitting 429s with unchanged volume
tickets.description: The customer's nightly extract job has started failing with 429 Too Many Requests. They say the job makes the same number of calls it always has.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rate limit is an organisation-wide bucket shared by all keys, and a new status-polling script from another team was calling the API once per second around the clock, using most of the quota. Helped the customer move that script to webhook events and confirmed the nightly job then completed without any 429s.

tickets.subject: Embedded chart blocked as mixed content
tickets.description: The customer's partner portal shows nothing where the embed should be, and the console reports 'Mixed Content: The page was loaded over HTTPS, but requested an insecure frame'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The embed snippet on the portal had been pasted with an http:// URL from an outdated guide. Updated the snippet to https://embed.example.net and the browser loaded the frame. The outdated guide was corrected.

tickets.subject: Users don't land on the default dashboard we set
tickets.description: The admin set a new workspace home dashboard, but most users still open whichever dashboard they viewed last.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace setting 'Open last viewed dashboard' was enabled, and it takes precedence over the home dashboard. Disabled it so everyone lands on the configured home dashboard at sign-in. Users now see the new home dashboard.

tickets.subject: Invoice includes a partner discount we never negotiated
tickets.description: The customer's finance team spotted a 'Partner 25%' discount on their invoice and asked us to correct it before they pay, to avoid an audit finding.
tickets.resolution_notes: During an account merge, a partner discount from a reseller's demo account had been copied onto the customer's subscription. Removed the discount, reissued the open invoice at the contracted price and checked other merged accounts for the same copy error. Confirmed the reissued invoice had no partner discount line.

tickets.subject: Duplicate 'Café' rows in the menu-item breakdown
tickets.description: A food-service customer sees two 'Café' rows in the menu breakdown that look identical on screen but carry different numbers.
tickets.resolution_notes: One source sends the label with a precomposed 'é' and another with 'e' plus a combining accent, and grouping compared the raw byte strings. Applied Unicode NFC normalisation to text dimensions on load and reprocessed. The breakdown now shows a single Café row.

tickets.subject: Connector shows 'Connected' but brings in no new data
tickets.description: The connector status page has a green 'Connected' tick, yet no new customer records have arrived for a week.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's CRM admin had reduced the connected app's permissions to profile-only, so token refreshes still succeeded but data requests returned empty results instead of errors. Re-authorized with the full read scope and added a check that flags a connection returning zero records for several consecutive runs. The next run imported 1,180 updated customer records.

tickets.subject: Buyers read-only after directory clean-up
tickets.description: Following a tidy-up of group names in the customer's directory, merchandise buyers can still sign in, but every assortment dashboard is read-only for them.
tickets.resolution_notes: The clean-up changed the capitalisation of the buyers' group, which broke the case-sensitive group-to-role mapping, so buyers dropped to the default role. Updated the mapping to the new group name. Confirmed buyers had Editor on assortment dashboards after signing in again.

tickets.subject: SSO works in the office, fails at home
tickets.description: Customer's staff can sign in through SSO at the office but get a browser timeout on the identity provider page when working from home without VPN.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's on-prem federation server was only reachable on the internal network, so browsers outside could not complete the redirect. The customer published the federation server through their reverse proxy for external access, protected by their usual MFA policy. Remote staff now complete sign-in without VPN.

tickets.subject: Reset emails deferred 40+ minutes for one customer domain
tickets.description: Customer's admin reports that reset emails to anyone at their company arrive 40 to 70 minutes after the request. Messages to other domains arrive normally.
tickets.resolution_notes: A DKIM key rotation on our transactional mail domain left the published DNS record with a truncated key, so the customer's strict mail server treated our messages as failing sender authentication and deferred them. Corrected the DKIM record and released the queued messages. A test reset email to the customer's domain arrived in under a minute with DKIM passing.

tickets.subject: Different gift cards missing each day
tickets.description: Gift card totals in the dashboard sit about 4% below the e-commerce platform's own report, and a different set of cards is missing every day.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector paged through gift cards sorted by last-used date, so cards used during a sync moved between pages and some were skipped. Changed the request to sort by the immutable card ID. Over the next three days imported gift card counts matched the platform exactly.

tickets.subject: Every page change feels like a first load since Tuesday
tickets.description: Several users at a customer report that since Tuesday, moving between dashboards takes 5-8 seconds of blank page each time, as if nothing is cached.
tickets.resolution_notes: Tuesday's release served front-end asset bundles without long-lived cache headers, so browsers re-downloaded about 6 MB of scripts on every navigation. Restored the correct cache headers for versioned assets. Repeat navigations now start rendering in under a second.

tickets.subject: Ad spend from the outlet brand's account missing
tickets.description: The marketing ROI dashboard shows spend only for the main brand. Spend for the outlet brand, which runs from a separate advertising account, is missing.
tickets.resolution_notes: The advertising connector was set up with the default account only, and the outlet brand's account was added to the customer's manager account later. Added the second account to the connection and backfilled 180 days. Combined spend now matches the totals in the advertising platform.

tickets.subject: Regional ingestion hostname returns NXDOMAIN on store servers
tickets.description: Store servers get 'NXDOMAIN' for ingest.eu.example.net, though ingest.example.net resolves fine from the same machines.
tickets.resolution_notes: The store network uses a filtering resolver that only answers for approved domains, and the regional hostname had not been added when the customer moved to the EU data region. The customer added ingest.eu.example.net to the resolver's approved list. Lookups succeed and the store servers resumed uploads.

tickets.subject: Store names starting with 'Ä' and 'Ö' sorted after Z
tickets.description: In dropdowns and tables, German store names such as 'Ägidienplatz' appear after the Z entries instead of with the A's.
tickets.resolution_notes: Sorting followed the workspace locale, English (US), whose collation placed accented capitals after Z for these lists. Set the workspace locale to German (Germany), which applies German collation rules. Store lists now sort the way German users expect.

tickets.subject: Search shows titles of dashboards in private HR folder
tickets.description: Global search returned titles and thumbnails of dashboards in a private HR folder to users outside the HR team.
tickets.resolution_notes: The search index did not apply folder permissions to titles and thumbnails. Search results are now filtered by the user's permissions, and the cached thumbnails were purged. Confirmed a non-HR user's search returned no HR content.

tickets.subject: Agent uploads failing after move to EU data region
tickets.description: Since the customer's workspace moved to the EU data region, the on-prem agent fails every upload with 'connection blocked' from their egress firewall.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's egress firewall allowed ingest.example.net but not the regional ingest.eu.example.net used after the move. The network team added the regional hostname to the egress allow-list. Uploads resumed and the backlog cleared.

tickets.subject: Sync stuck on 'Waiting for previous run' for three nights
tickets.description: Customer's nightly order sync hasn't run for three nights. Each scheduled run shows 'Waiting for previous run to finish', but nothing is actually in progress.
tickets.resolution_notes: A run the customer cancelled midway had not released its job lock, so every later run waited on it. Released the stale lock by hand as a workaround; making cancellation always clear the lock was tracked for a later release. The next scheduled sync completed and caught up all three nights of orders.

tickets.subject: Busiest stores' orders cut off partway through the day
tickets.description: For the two busiest stores, orders in the dashboard stop partway through each day, while smaller stores are complete. Every run reports success.
tickets.resolution_notes: The e-commerce API's page tokens expire after five minutes, and pages for the large stores took longer than that to process, so the next request returned an empty page that the connector read as the end. Changed the connector to fetch all pages before processing and to fail loudly on an expired token. Re-synced both stores, and daily order counts now match the platform.

tickets.subject: TV mode cuts off the bottom row of widgets
tickets.description: In TV mode the bottom row of the store dashboard falls off the 16:9 screen, yet the same dashboard fits in a normal browser window.
tickets.resolution_notes: TV mode kept the dashboard's tall layout and scaled to the screen width only. TV mode now scales to fit both width and height. The whole dashboard fits on the 16:9 screen.

tickets.subject: Two 'Accessories' categories merged into one
tickets.description: Women's Accessories and Men's Accessories show as a single 'Accessories' row in the category breakdown, so the customer cannot compare them.
tickets.resolution_notes: The category mapping joined products to categories by display name instead of category ID, collapsing different categories that share a name under different departments. Changed the join to the category ID and made labels show the department path when names collide. The breakdown now shows two rows whose sum equals the previous combined figure.

tickets.subject: All embedded widgets blank after intranet hardening release
tickets.description: Agent summary: after the customer's intranet security hardening release, every embedded widget is blank and the browser console reports 'Refused to frame ... because it violates the following Content Security Policy directive'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The hardening release introduced a default frame-src 'self' policy, which blocks frames from any other origin, including the product's embed host. The customer added the specific embed origin to the policy rather than loosening it globally. Widgets returned on all intranet pages.

tickets.subject: Reset emails routed to a moderated distribution list
tickets.description: A regional manager never sees their reset email. The customer's admin later found the messages waiting in the moderation queue of a team distribution list.
tickets.resolution_notes: The manager's login email was a team alias (regional-ops@retail.example.com) assigned during an early bulk import, so reset emails went to a moderated list. After the admin verified the manager's identity, we changed the login email to their individual mailbox. The next reset email arrived directly and the manager signed in.

tickets.subject: Our alert parser broke after changing a channel setting
tickets.description: Customer's script that reads alert webhooks started failing with 'KeyError: metric_value' right after an admin changed the payload format on the alert channel.
tickets.resolution_notes: The admin had switched the channel from the legacy payload to the current structured payload, where the value is nested under metric.value. Helped the customer update their parser to the structured format, which carries more context. Test alerts parsed correctly afterwards.

tickets.subject: Our status page shows datasets stuck on 'refreshing'
tickets.description: Customer mirrors dataset refresh status from webhook events. Some datasets stay 'refreshing' in their tool even though our app shows the refresh finished hours ago.
tickets.resolution_notes: Short refreshes produced started and completed events within milliseconds, and the completed event sometimes arrived first; the consumer then overwrote it with 'refreshing'. Advised comparing the event's occurred_at and sequence number before applying a status. Their mirror has matched our status since.

tickets.subject: Invoices rejected for missing PO number
tickets.description: Accounts payable keeps rejecting our invoices because they lack the purchase order number required on every supplier invoice.
tickets.resolution_notes: The PO number was on the signed order form but had never been entered in the account's invoice reference field. Added it and reissued the current invoice. Confirmed the PO appears in the invoice header.

tickets.subject: Channel colours swap when one store is selected
tickets.description: In the sales-by-channel chart, online is blue and in-store is green company-wide, but when a store with no online sales is selected, in-store turns blue.
tickets.resolution_notes: Colours were handed out by series position rather than by category value, so when one series was absent the remaining ones shifted colour. Changed colour assignment to key on the category value. In-store now stays green whatever the filter.

tickets.subject: CRM sync stops mid-afternoon with 'request limit exceeded'
tickets.description: The customer's CRM sync fails most afternoons with 'REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', and dashboards only have data up to the morning run.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's CRM enforces a daily API allowance shared by all connected apps, and a newly installed marketing tool was using most of it. Moved our sync to the CRM's bulk interface, which needs far fewer calls, and the customer capped the marketing tool's usage. Afternoon syncs have completed every day since.

tickets.subject: Slow dashboards even though nobody is using them
tickets.description: Customer is puzzled: overnight, when no staff are working, monitoring shows query load on their workspace stays high, and the first people in each morning find dashboards slow.
tickets.resolution_notes: A dozen browser tabs on office machines had been left open with 30-second auto-refresh, so dashboards kept refreshing all night while hidden. Enabled pausing of auto-refresh for hidden tabs and set a 2-minute minimum interval. Overnight query load dropped to near zero and morning load times were normal.

tickets.subject: Monthly sales target shows as $9.3M for a $310K store
tickets.description: On the Store Performance dashboard, each store's monthly target is roughly thirty times the figure finance loaded in the plan file.
tickets.resolution_notes: Monthly targets were joined to daily sales rows on store and month, so the target value repeated on every day and was then summed. Moved targets to their own monthly fact and blended them with sales at month grain. Targets now match the uploaded plan.

tickets.subject: Exports marked Failed with an empty details panel
tickets.description: Several exports from the same dashboard show status Failed, and the details panel gives no reason.
tickets.resolution_notes: A calculated field referenced a column that had been renamed in the data model; the validation error was logged but not surfaced in Export Center. Updated the calculated field to the new column name, and Export Center now displays validation errors. Confirmed new exports completed and a deliberately broken test export showed its reason.

tickets.subject: Contractor hired as staff still can't create dashboards
tickets.description: A former contractor who joined as staff was converted from guest to member but still cannot create dashboards.
tickets.resolution_notes: Converting the account changed its type but kept the guest's view-only role. Assigned the Editor role requested by the user's manager. Confirmed they could create dashboards.

tickets.subject: Week-to-date indicator red every Monday
tickets.description: Store managers say the week-to-date versus last week indicator is red every Monday and Tuesday, even for stores clearly trading ahead.
tickets.resolution_notes: The week-to-date tile compared the partial current week against the whole of last week, so early in the week it always looked behind. The elapsed-period alignment already applied to month-to-date was extended to week-to-date and quarter-to-date tiles. The following Monday, the indicator compared Monday against last Monday and showed green for the stores trading ahead of last week.

tickets.subject: Embedded dashboard in intranet keeps asking to sign in
tickets.description: Customer embedded a dashboard on their intranet homepage. Users see our login form inside the frame; after signing in it reloads and asks again.
tickets.resolution_notes: The browser blocks cookies set inside a cross-site iframe, so the session created in the frame was discarded on every reload. Workaround: the intranet tile now opens the dashboard in a new tab, where the session persists; token-based embedding for framed dashboards was tracked for a later release. Users confirmed the new-tab link kept them signed in.

tickets.subject: Export ignores the store filter I just applied
tickets.description: A regional manager filtered the dashboard to her 12 stores, but the CSV she exported contains all 140.
tickets.resolution_notes: Exports were generated from the dashboard's saved default filters, not the filters applied in the current session, and she had not saved her view. Showed her how to save the filtered view as a personal view; the exporter was later changed to use session filters. Confirmed an export from the saved view contained only her 12 stores.

tickets.subject: Alerts to store-ops distribution list bounce
tickets.description: Alerts addressed to the customer's store-ops@example.org list never arrive. Our delivery log shows 'rejected: sender not authorized to post to this list'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The distribution list only accepts posts from internal senders. The customer's mail admin added our alerts sending address to that list's permitted senders only, without changing any other mail policy. Test alerts reached all list members afterwards.

tickets.subject: Agent connections dropped a few times a day by IP-based rule
tickets.description: The customer's firewall lets the agent reach a fixed list of IP addresses for ingest.example.net, and a few times a day its connections are dropped.
tickets.resolution_notes: The ingestion endpoint is served from an anycast edge whose addresses vary, so the static IP list only matched some connections. The customer replaced the IP list with an FQDN-based rule for the ingestion hostname, as the network requirements recommend. Connections have been stable for two weeks.

tickets.subject: API call overage doubled in a month with no changes
tickets.description: The customer's invoice shows an API call overage at roughly twice their normal volume, for a month in which they changed nothing in their integration.
tickets.resolution_notes: During a period of 503 responses on our side, their client retried requests, and the usage meter counted both the failed and the retried calls. Credited the calls metered during the incident, and the meter was changed to count only successful requests. Confirmed the corrected usage figure was within their allowance.

tickets.subject: File pickup resets after the first few files
tickets.description: Each night the connector downloads three or four files from the customer's FTPS server, then every remaining transfer fails with 'connection reset by peer'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's intrusion prevention system interpreted the connector's parallel transfer connections as a scan and temporarily blocked the source address. The customer created an IPS exception for the product's published egress range scoped to the FTPS service, and we reduced the connector's parallel transfers for this source from 8 to 3. All 41 files transferred the following night.

tickets.subject: Store manager tablet app hangs on product list
tickets.description: Store managers using the tablet app say opening the product performance list hangs the app for 30+ seconds and sometimes closes it. The same list in the web app is fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The tablet app requested the full product list for the store in one response and built every row in memory, which older tablets could not handle. As a workaround, managers were pointed to the category summary view; the next app release added paged loading of 200 rows at a time. After updating, the list opened in about 2 seconds on the customer's oldest tablet model.

tickets.subject: Almost no customers mapped to New England
tickets.description: Customer analytics shows almost no customers in New England and a cluster of unrecognised postal codes such as '2108' and '1950'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Postal codes in the customer file were typed as numbers on import, so the leading zeros of codes like 02108 and 01950 were dropped and the region lookup failed. Forced the postal code column to text and re-imported. New England customers now map correctly and the unknown-region bucket fell from 4.6% to 0.1%.

tickets.subject: ERP inventory feed stalled since Tuesday
tickets.description: Agent summary: the inventory feed from the customer's on-prem ERP gateway has not completed since Tuesday, logs show TCP connections timing out, and the customer's change board needs a week to approve firewall changes.
tickets.resolution_notes: The feed was being scheduled on workers in the newer egress range, which the customer's firewall had not yet allowed. As a temporary workaround we pinned this connector to the original worker pool so its traffic came from the already-allowed 198.51.100.0/28; the permanent fix, adding 198.51.100.32/28 to the firewall rule, was approved and applied eight days later and the pin was removed. Feeds completed on schedule throughout.

tickets.subject: Inventory export ends with 'Partial results: query time limit reached'
tickets.description: Store operations exported inventory snapshots for 400 stores; the file stops with the footer 'Partial results: query time limit reached'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The export ran the whole inventory query in one pass and hit the 10-minute per-query limit for export jobs, so the file was written with whatever had returned. Enabled chunked export by store for the workspace, which keeps each chunk within the limit and assembles the file at the end. Confirmed the export completed for all 400 stores without the footer.

tickets.subject: Distribution centre staff get a block page from email links
tickets.description: Since notification emails switched to short links, staff at the customer's distribution centre who click a dashboard link get their gateway's 'Uncategorized site blocked' page.
tickets.resolution_notes: Email links now pass through the newer short-link host go.example.net, which the customer's web gateway treated as uncategorised and blocked by policy. The customer added go.example.net to the allow policy alongside the product's other documented domains. Links open the dashboards directly.

tickets.subject: Average parcel weight reported as 1,250 kg
tickets.description: Logistics manager says the fulfilment dashboard puts average parcel weight at over a tonne, which would make every parcel a pallet.
tickets.resolution_notes: The shipping integration supplies weights in grams, but the weight field was tagged as kilograms, so a 1.25 kg parcel was stored as 1,250 kg. Set the field's unit to grams so values are converted on load and reprocessed shipments. Average parcel weight now reads 1.25 kg, matching the carrier manifest.

tickets.subject: Every access request emails all 25 folder editors
tickets.description: Each access request on the Finance folder sends an email to all 25 of its editors.
tickets.resolution_notes: Folder requests notify everyone who can manage access, and all editors could because 'Editors can manage sharing' was on. Turned that setting off for the workspace with the admin's agreement, so only the two folder owners receive requests. Confirmed the next request notified only the owners.

tickets.subject: Embedded store scorecard slow inside customer's intranet
tickets.description: Customer embeds a store scorecard in their intranet home page. Employees report the intranet now takes noticeably longer to finish loading, waiting on the embedded frame.
tickets.resolution_notes: Embeds loaded the full application bundle, including the dashboard editor, even though embedded viewers cannot edit. Switched embeds to the lightweight viewer bundle, cutting the download from about 5 MB to 900 KB. The embedded scorecard now appears in about 1.5 seconds.

tickets.subject: Invitation emails arrive in English for a Spanish workspace
tickets.description: The workspace interface is in Spanish, but invitation emails sent by the regional admins arrive in English.
tickets.resolution_notes: The organisation email language was set to 'Sender's language', and the admins sending invitations had English as their personal language. Changed the email language setting to 'Workspace default'. New invitations arrive in Spanish.

tickets.subject: Scheduled report download links open a block page
tickets.description: Links in scheduled report emails open the customer's gateway block page 'File sharing sites are not permitted', although the reports themselves were generated.
tickets.resolution_notes: Report files are served from files.example.net, which the customer's gateway categorised as file sharing. The customer added files.example.net to the allow policy as a sanctioned business destination. Recipients now download reports normally.

tickets.subject: Renewal failed despite updating card the day before
tickets.description: Customer replaced the card on file the day before renewal, but the renewal still failed and the decline notice shows the old card's last four digits.
tickets.resolution_notes: The update never completed: the issuer's 3-D Secure challenge opened in a popup that was blocked, so the new card was never attached and the renewal fell back to the previous, expired card. The customer redid the update with popups allowed for the billing page, and we retried the renewal charge. Confirmed the payment succeeded and the subscription stayed active.

tickets.subject: Phoenix store hourly sales off by one hour all summer
tickets.description: Customer noticed the Phoenix store's hourly chart has been shifted one hour later since mid-March, while their Denver store looks correct.
tickets.resolution_notes: The store's location record supplied the abbreviation 'MST', which our parser mapped to America/Denver (observes daylight saving) instead of America/Phoenix (does not). Changed the mapping to prefer the explicit zone from the store profile, set the store to America/Phoenix and re-bucketed data since March. Hourly totals now line up with the store's register logs.

tickets.subject: Franchise owners asked to sign in when opening report link
tickets.description: Franchise owners who have no workspace accounts are sent to a sign-in page when they click the link in the monthly report email.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace policy requires sign-in for report links. Rather than making links public, configured the schedule to attach the PDF directly for those recipients, which the policy permits. Confirmed the franchise owners received the attachment.

tickets.subject: Mexican store managers want pesos alongside USD
tickets.description: The customer's store managers in Mexico want local currency on their dashboards, while head office keeps seeing USD.
tickets.resolution_notes: Enabled the 'Secondary display currency' workspace option and set MXN as the secondary currency for the Mexico store group. Store managers see MXN with USD in tooltips, and head office still sees USD.

tickets.subject: Export sort order differs from the table
tickets.description: The table is sorted by revenue descending on screen, but the export comes out in alphabetical order of store name.
tickets.resolution_notes: Interactive column sorting was not passed to the export query, which used the widget's default sort. Set the widget's default sort to revenue descending for the immediate need, and the exporter was then updated to respect the active sort. Confirmed the export order matched the screen.

tickets.subject: Repeated payment retries froze corporate card
tickets.description: The customer's bank froze their corporate card after our system retried the same failed renewal payment six times in two days.
tickets.resolution_notes: The retry schedule did not back off for the 'insufficient funds' decline code, and the repeated attempts tripped the issuer's fraud controls. As an immediate workaround we paused automatic retries on the account and collected payment through a one-time payment link once the card was unfrozen; a permanent change to vary retry timing by decline code was scheduled. Confirmed the invoice was paid and no further retries were queued.

tickets.subject: Outage service credit not deducted from April invoice
tickets.description: The customer was promised a service credit for a March outage, but April's invoice charges the full amount.
tickets.resolution_notes: The credit note had been linked to the already-paid March invoice instead of the account balance, so it was never applied. Applied the credit note to the April invoice. Confirmed the balance due dropped by the credited amount.

tickets.subject: Charged for August monthly fee and a full annual term
tickets.description: Customer switched from monthly to annual billing on 10 August and was charged the whole August monthly fee plus the annual amount starting 10 August.
tickets.resolution_notes: The switch was made from the legacy billing page, which created a new annual subscription instead of converting the monthly one, so the unused monthly days were never credited. Credited the 21 unused days and closed the orphaned monthly subscription. Confirmed only the annual subscription remains active.

tickets.subject: Dashboards freeze for ~15 minutes around 4:00
tickets.description: A customer with staff in another time zone reports dashboards hang for about 15 minutes at 4:00 our platform time every day, then recover.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rollup refresh replaced the summary table in place and held an exclusive lock during the swap, so queries waited until it finished. Changed the refresh to build into a shadow table and switch over atomically. Dashboards now stay responsive throughout the refresh.

tickets.subject: Daily bars labelled a day early for US viewers
tickets.description: Head office in London and the US buying team look at the same daily sales chart. For the US team, Monday's bar is labelled Sunday.
tickets.resolution_notes: Data was bucketed by day in the workspace time zone (London), but axis labels were formatted in each viewer's browser time zone, where London midnight falls on the previous day. This release formats time-axis labels in the workspace time zone for every viewer, replacing the per-user profile workaround. Both teams now see Monday's bar labelled Monday.

tickets.subject: Disputing seats charged for viewer accounts
tickets.description: Customer believed viewer-only users are free and is disputing 15 extra seats on the latest invoice, all of them store managers with view access.
tickets.resolution_notes: Free viewer accounts are a Business plan feature; on the customer's Starter plan every named user, including viewers, occupies a paid seat, so the invoice was correct. Shared the plan comparison, and the admin chose to remove six store managers who had not signed in for 90 days. Confirmed the next invoice draft listed six fewer seats.

tickets.subject: 'Maximum of 10 custom roles reached'
tickets.description: The admin cannot create another custom role and gets 'Maximum of 10 custom roles reached'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The Growth plan allows 10 custom roles, and four of the existing ones were near-duplicates. Helped the admin merge the duplicates into one role and move users across. Confirmed the new role could then be created.

tickets.subject: Values inside navy bars can't be read
tickets.description: Data labels printed inside the bars are dark text on the dark navy of the customer's brand palette, so nobody can read the numbers.
tickets.resolution_notes: Data labels used one fixed text colour whatever the bar's fill. Labels now pick light or dark text based on the contrast ratio with the fill. Values are readable on all of the customer's brand colours.

tickets.subject: Delivery log empty since 12 March
tickets.description: The customer's developer checked the webhook delivery log and found no attempts at all after 12 March, not even failures.
tickets.resolution_notes: The subscription had been auto-disabled on 12 March after three days of consecutive failures caused by an expired route on their side; once disabled, no attempts are logged. The disable notification had gone to a former employee. Re-enabled the subscription, replayed events, and set a team address for subscription alerts.

tickets.subject: Still seeing 'Request access' after owner approved
tickets.description: Minutes after the owner approved an access request, the requester still gets the 'Request access' page when opening the dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: The requester's browser had cached the access-denied page. A hard refresh loaded the dashboard, and the page's cache headers were corrected so denial pages are not cached. Confirmed a new approval took effect without a manual refresh.

tickets.subject: Email-marketing contacts stop at 20,000
tickets.description: The customer's email-marketing connector imports a steady 20,000 contacts out of about 55,000, and each run logs the warning 'Maximum page count reached'.
