tickets.resolution_notes: The connector had a 200-page safety limit set when contact lists were far smaller. Raised the limit for this connector, made it configurable, and changed reaching it into an error rather than a warning. The next sync imported all 55,410 contacts.

tickets.subject: Deprecation header appearing on dashboard list calls
tickets.description: Customer's API monitoring started flagging a 'Deprecation' response header on their dashboard listing calls and they want to know what will break and when.
tickets.resolution_notes: They were using the include=widgets expansion on the dashboard list, which is scheduled for removal in favour of the separate widgets endpoint. Shared the removal date and helped them switch to fetching widgets per dashboard. A week of their logs showed no remaining deprecation headers.

tickets.subject: Daily sales alert constantly firing for Tokyo stores only
tickets.description: Customer's 'daily sales above 2,000,000' alert, intended to flag unusually high days, fires every day for their Japanese stores and never for European ones.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule evaluated each store in its local currency, so a normal day in yen exceeded a threshold that was meant in US dollars. Set the rule to evaluate the converted reporting-currency amount. Japanese stores stopped triggering on normal days, and a replay of last month flagged only the two genuinely high days.

tickets.subject: Sales dashboard full of 'TEST ITEM' orders
tickets.description: The customer sees orders for products such as 'TEST ITEM DO NOT SHIP' in the sales dashboard, and their real sales are nowhere to be found.
tickets.resolution_notes: During setup the connector had been authorized against the customer's sandbox store instead of the production store. Reconnected to production, removed the sandbox data and backfilled 12 months of real orders. The sales dashboard now shows only production orders.

tickets.subject: Net revenue lower than finance after partial refunds
tickets.description: Finance says net revenue on the dashboard comes in below their figure, and the gap equals the total of partial refunds issued that month.
tickets.resolution_notes: For partially refunded orders the source updates the order total and also emits a refund record, and net revenue subtracted both, removing each partial refund twice. Changed netting to start from the original order amount and deduct refund records only, then recomputed the affected months. September net revenue now matches finance exactly.

tickets.subject: SSO users land in new, empty accounts after email format change
tickets.description: After the customer's IT team changed staff email addresses from first.last to first initial plus surname, users signing in via SSO see an empty home page and the product tour.
tickets.resolution_notes: SSO matched users by email address, so the new addresses created brand-new accounts through just-in-time provisioning instead of reaching the existing ones. We moved the existing accounts to the new addresses, removed the empty duplicates, and switched this workspace's SSO matching to the identity provider's immutable user ID. Saved dashboards and views reappeared for users at their next sign-in.

tickets.subject: Users in two mapped groups end up with the lower role
tickets.description: Category managers belong to both the Buyers group, mapped to Editor, and All Staff, mapped to Viewer, and keep ending up as Viewers.
tickets.resolution_notes: Mapping precedence was set to 'last processed group wins' rather than 'highest role wins'. Switched the precedence setting. Confirmed category managers resolved to Editor and staff-only users stayed Viewer.

tickets.subject: Conversion alert triggered by a handful of sessions
tickets.description: The web team gets 'conversion rate 0%' alerts in the early morning. They say these are meaningless because hardly anyone is on the site at that time.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule evaluated 15-minute windows with no minimum sample size, so three sessions with no orders produced 0%. Added a condition requiring at least 50 sessions in the window before evaluating. Early-morning false alerts stopped, and a daytime test with low conversion still fired.

tickets.subject: Only reports involving loyalty members are slow
tickets.description: Customer notes that any report joining sales to the loyalty member list now crawls, while sales-only reports are unaffected. They recently loaded five years of member history.
tickets.resolution_notes: The member table's statistics still reflected the pre-import size, so the planner looped over it row by row when joining. Refreshed statistics for the member and sales tables and confirmed the improved plan. Loyalty reports dropped from around 70 seconds to 4.

tickets.subject: Month-end opportunity updates partly missing
tickets.description: At every month-end the pipeline dashboard lacks the last day's opportunity updates. The connector log shows the run stopping early with a quota message.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's month-end reporting tools used up the CRM's shared daily API allowance, and the connector stopped when it ran out. Scheduled our sync ahead of the reporting jobs and enabled resuming from the last checkpoint once the allowance resets. The following month-end synced completely.

tickets.subject: Order tables show '3 days ago' instead of dates
tickets.description: The customer wants exact timestamps in order tables, but they show relative times such as '3 days ago'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace 'Timestamp display' setting was 'Relative'. Changed it to 'Absolute' so tables show the date and time in the workspace format. Order tables now show exact timestamps.

tickets.subject: Leaderboard screen goes black after ten minutes
tickets.description: The leaderboard screen on the shop floor turns black after roughly ten minutes unless someone nudges the mouse.
tickets.resolution_notes: The display device's power saving blanked the screen because the page never asked to stay awake. TV mode now requests a screen wake lock where the device supports it, and we gave the customer's IT team the device setting for older models. The screen stayed on through a full trading day.

tickets.subject: Tablet app product search very slow in stores
tickets.description: Store staff using the tablet app say product search takes 20-30 seconds on first use each day. Searching the same products on the web app is quick.
tickets.resolution_notes: The tablet app downloaded the full product catalogue (about 40 MB) to search locally, and the cached copy was discarded daily. Switched the app to the server-side product search endpoint, keeping a small cache of recent results. First searches now return in about a second on store Wi-Fi.

tickets.subject: 502 Bad Gateway when filtering by many stores
tickets.description: Customer's request to the metrics endpoint filtered to about 900 store IDs in the query string returns 502 Bad Gateway. Smaller lists work.
tickets.resolution_notes: The URL exceeded the 8 KB limit at our edge, which returned a misleading 502 instead of a clear error. As a workaround the customer moved to the POST /v2/metrics/query endpoint with the store list in the body, which works for any size. A permanent change to return 414 with guidance for oversized URLs is scheduled.

tickets.subject: Tokyo store revenue 100 times too small
tickets.description: After the customer's Japanese stores went live, the dashboard shows ¥18,500 for a day when the registers took about ¥1.85 million.
tickets.resolution_notes: The amount parser applied a two-decimal minor-unit conversion to every currency, but JPY has no minor unit, so amounts were divided by 100. Changed the parser to use each currency's ISO 4217 exponent (zero for JPY and KRW) and reprocessed the Japanese stores. Daily totals now match the register reports.

tickets.subject: Webhook deliveries time out after receiver moved
tickets.description: Since the customer moved their webhook receiver behind a new firewall, every delivery in the webhook log shows 'timeout after 10s'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new firewall only admitted known partner addresses, and the product's webhook sender range 198.51.100.128/28 was not on the list. The customer added the sender range to the receiver's inbound rule for port 443. Redelivered events arrived and new events now land within seconds.

tickets.subject: Escalation to regional manager never happens
tickets.description: Customer's alerts should escalate to the regional manager if not acknowledged within 30 minutes. Store staff say they never acknowledge them, yet escalations never fire and the log shows each alert acknowledged within seconds.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's email security scanner opened links in incoming emails, including the one-click 'acknowledge' link, so alerts were acknowledged automatically. Changed acknowledge links to open a confirmation page that requires a button press. Acknowledgement times now reflect real actions, and an unacknowledged test alert escalated after 30 minutes.

tickets.subject: One misconfigured gauge turns the whole dashboard white
tickets.description: After an editor added a gauge widget, the entire dashboard became a white page with no widgets at all.
tickets.resolution_notes: The gauge's minimum was higher than its maximum, which threw an error that nothing contained, so the whole page failed. Each widget now has its own error boundary that shows an error card, and the editor validates gauge ranges. The dashboard loaded with the gauge showing 'Invalid range', and the editor then corrected it.

tickets.subject: Notification emails show the old logo after rebranding
tickets.description: The app header shows the new logo, but invitation and notification emails still carry the old one.
tickets.resolution_notes: Emails use a separate 'Email header logo' field in Branding settings, which still held the old image. Uploaded the new logo to that field. New emails show the current logo.

tickets.subject: Sales trend chart with annotations loads slowly
tickets.description: Customer's team annotates their daily sales chart with promotions and store events. The chart now takes 10 seconds to show up, and the customer suspects the annotations.
tickets.resolution_notes: All 12,000 annotations ever created for the chart were sent with every load, regardless of the date range shown. Changed annotations to load only for the visible range and fetch more as the user scrolls or zooms. The chart now appears in about a second.

tickets.subject: Dutch customer charged VAT despite VAT number
tickets.description: A customer based in the Netherlands entered their VAT number at signup, but the invoice still adds 21% VAT.
tickets.resolution_notes: The number had been entered without the 'NL' country prefix, so validation failed silently and the account was taxed as a non-business buyer. Corrected the format, revalidated the ID and reissued the invoice under reverse charge. Confirmed the reissued invoice shows zero VAT and the reverse-charge note.

tickets.subject: Custom domain stopped working after our edge change
tickets.description: Customer's branded address stopped responding after our edge network change, although they say their DNS setup was 'never touched'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer had configured an A record pointing to an edge IP address instead of the documented CNAME, so it broke when edge addresses changed. Replaced the A record with a CNAME to the documented target. The domain resolves again and will follow future edge changes.

tickets.subject: Agent handshake fails with 'no shared cipher'
tickets.description: After hardening their server build, the customer's on-prem agent fails to connect with 'handshake failure: no shared cipher'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The hardened build's policy only enabled RSA key-exchange CBC suites, none of which the product's endpoints accept. The customer enabled the ECDHE-GCM suites already approved in their own security standard. The agent connected over TLS 1.2 with an approved suite.

tickets.subject: Charts ignore the parentheses style for negative numbers
tickets.description: The workspace is set to show negative numbers in parentheses. Tables follow it, but chart labels and tooltips still show a minus sign.
tickets.resolution_notes: The setting was stored correctly, but the chart formatting library was initialised without it. Passed the negative-number style through to chart formatters. Chart labels and tooltips now show (1,240) just like the tables.

tickets.subject: UK staff misreading dates as month/day
tickets.description: UK store managers read 03/04 as 3 April, but the dashboards mean 4 March, which has caused rota mistakes.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace date format was MM/DD/YYYY. Changed it to DD/MM/YYYY. Dates across dashboards and filters now show the day first.

tickets.subject: Only the first person on the list can open the report link
tickets.description: On a 12-person distribution list, whoever clicks first can download the report and everyone else sees 'Link no longer valid'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The schedule was sent to a single distribution-list address, so all 12 people shared one single-use token and the first click consumed it. Changed the schedule to individual recipients so each person gets their own link. Confirmed several recipients downloaded the next report.

tickets.subject: Contribution margin equals revenue after a metric rename
tickets.description: An admin renamed the base metric 'COGS' to 'Cost of goods'; since then the custom 'Contribution margin' metric equals revenue, as if cost were zero.
tickets.resolution_notes: The calculated field referenced the base metric by name, and after the rename the reference resolved to null, which the formula coalesced to zero. Rebound the field to the metric's ID and changed the editor to store ID-based references and flag broken ones instead of substituting zero. Contribution margin is back to its pre-rename values.

tickets.subject: New user sees no workspace after accepting invite
tickets.description: A newly hired buyer accepted their invitation and signed in, but the app says 'You don't belong to any workspace yet'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The buyer had chosen 'Sign up' with a different alias address instead of accepting while signed in as the invited address, creating a separate account unconnected to the invitation. Removed the stray account at the customer's request and resent the invitation, which the buyer accepted with the invited address. They now see the workspace and its dashboards.

tickets.subject: Quarterly AOV differs from the same quarter built from monthly rows
tickets.description: Customer notices Q3 AOV is $54.10 in the quarterly view but $52.80 when they drill to months and compute it themselves from the monthly revenue and order columns.
tickets.resolution_notes: The quarterly view averaged the three monthly AOV values instead of recalculating revenue over orders for the whole quarter, overweighting the month with fewer orders. Ratio metrics now re-aggregate from their components at every time grain. Q3 shows $52.80 in both views.

tickets.subject: Emailed reports undownloadable since new inbound mail filter
tickets.description: Since the customer's IT team rolled out a new inbound mail filter, store managers cannot download any emailed reports; the page shows 'Invalid or used token'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new filter pre-fetches URLs in incoming mail, using up the one-time tokens. Moved the workspace to reusable sign-in links and gave IT our sender details so they could recognise report emails; the filter itself was left unchanged. Confirmed downloads worked for the next scheduled send.

tickets.subject: One region grey on the sales map despite having sales
tickets.description: The sales-by-region map leaves one region grey with 'No data', yet the region table beside it shows sales for that region.
tickets.resolution_notes: The region was written 'Île-de-France' in the data and 'Ile-de-France' in the map's boundary file, so name matching failed on the accent. Changed the map to match regions by code instead of name. The region is now shaded with its sales.

tickets.subject: Stacked area chart blank in weeks with negative net sales
tickets.description: The 'net sales by channel' stacked area chart shows nothing for weeks where outlet returns exceed outlet sales. Weeks without negative values render normally.
tickets.resolution_notes: The stacked area renderer could not compute a baseline when a series contained negative values and abandoned drawing the whole chart. Negative values in stacked charts now draw below the axis on a diverging baseline, with a hint suggesting a bar chart for mixed-sign data. Those weeks now display with the outlet channel below zero.

tickets.subject: Back-office kiosk needs restarting every afternoon
tickets.description: Store back-office PCs show the stock dashboard in kiosk mode. Staff say by around 15:00 the PC is crawling and they restart it daily.
tickets.resolution_notes: The kiosk dashboard refreshed every 5 minutes and leaked chart tooltip and listener objects on each refresh, the same chart defect already under investigation. The cleanup fix that disposes of old instances was deployed on 30 July, and afterwards the kiosks ran a full trading day without slowing down.

tickets.subject: Unexpected refund received from us
tickets.description: The customer's finance team noticed a refund from us that they never requested and asked whether their subscription had been cancelled.
tickets.resolution_notes: The refund came from a bulk correction for accounts that had been overcharged when mid-cycle seat additions were prorated from the start of the billing period; the subscription itself was unaffected. Sent the breakdown of the corrected proration. Confirmed the subscription status remained Active.

tickets.subject: Webhook delivery log: 'could not resolve host'
tickets.description: Customer configured webhooks to https://events.corp.northwind.example.com/hooks and every delivery fails with 'could not resolve host'.
tickets.resolution_notes: That hostname exists only in the customer's internal DNS, so the product's senders on the public internet could neither resolve nor reach it. The customer published the receiver through their external reverse proxy under a public hostname with a valid certificate and updated the webhook URL. Deliveries succeeded and were confirmed in the receiver's logs.

tickets.subject: Clicking a region doesn't filter the other widgets
tickets.description: Cross-filtering stopped working on the regional dashboard: clicking a region in the bar chart highlights it, but the table and map next to it stay unchanged.
tickets.resolution_notes: The table and map had been switched to a different dataset whose region field was not linked to the bar chart's, and cross-filters only pass between widgets sharing a field reference. Linked the two region fields in the dashboard's filter mapping. Clicking a region now filters the table and the map.

tickets.subject: Dashboards open on 'Last 7 days' instead of month-to-date
tickets.description: Finance wants every dashboard to open on month-to-date, but they always open on the last 7 days.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace default date range was 'Last 7 days'. Changed it to 'Month to date'; dashboards with their own saved range keep it. Dashboards without a saved range now open on month-to-date.

tickets.subject: POS connector needs re-authorizing every 30 days
tickets.description: The customer's point-of-sale connection fails about once a month with 'Credentials expired', and the store operations team has been reconnecting it by hand each time.
tickets.resolution_notes: The POS platform issues access tokens that expire after 30 days, and our connector for that platform never used its refresh flow, so monthly reconnection was the only workaround. Released a connector update that refreshes the token automatically before expiry. The connection has stayed valid through two expiry cycles since.

tickets.subject: Dashboards slow until late morning since history backfill
tickets.description: Since the customer loaded six years of historical sales last week, their dashboards are slow every morning until about 11:00, then fast for the rest of the day.
tickets.resolution_notes: After the backfill the nightly rollup refresh rebuilt every historical partition instead of only changed ones, so it ran until late morning and dashboards fell back to raw tables meanwhile. Corrected change tracking so only modified partitions are rebuilt. The refresh now finishes by 3:30 and morning dashboards use rollups again.

tickets.subject: Closed-quarter EUR revenue changes every week
tickets.description: The customer's finance lead says Q2 revenue converted to EUR in the Finance pack shows a different total each Monday, although no Q2 orders have been added or edited since July.
tickets.resolution_notes: The conversion step looked up the exchange rate for the report run date instead of each order's transaction date, so a closed quarter was silently re-priced at the latest rate. Switched conversion to transaction-date rates and recomputed the workspace's historical aggregates. The Q2 EUR total stayed identical across three consecutive weekly runs and matched the finance ledger within 0.02 EUR.

tickets.subject: Workspace slows down when the operations centre is staffed
tickets.description: Customer says the whole workspace gets noticeably slower during operations centre shifts. The ops centre has 25 screens each showing a dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each ops screen was set to auto-refresh every 30 seconds and refreshed all widgets regardless of whether the data had changed, generating thousands of queries per hour. Raised the minimum refresh interval to 2 minutes for those dashboards and enabled refresh-only-when-data-changed. Workspace query volume dropped by about 75% and other users' load times returned to normal.

tickets.subject: Orders from the repeated daylight-saving hour missing
tickets.description: Orders placed during the second 01:00 to 02:00 hour on the night the clocks went back are absent from the dashboard. The source system shows 84 orders in that hour.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector stored its cursor as local time without an offset, so after the first pass through the repeated hour it treated the second pass as already synced. Changed cursors to be stored in UTC and reloaded that night. All 84 orders are now present.

tickets.subject: Agency analysts lost access after dashboard moved to folder
tickets.description: After an editor moved the Promotions dashboard into the Marketing folder, the agency analysts it had been shared with could no longer open it.
tickets.resolution_notes: Moving content into a folder replaced the dashboard's explicit permissions with the folder's inherited ones, which do not include the agency group. Restored the agency group's grant on the dashboard. Confirmed the analysts could open it again.

tickets.subject: Dashboard shared with a mailing-list address is inaccessible
tickets.description: An analyst shared a dashboard with the store-managers@example.com list, and none of the managers can open it.
tickets.resolution_notes: A mailing-list address is not a user, so the share created a pending invitation that nobody could accept. Removed the invitation and shared the dashboard with the Store Managers team instead. Confirmed managers could open it.

tickets.subject: Some widget types missing on managed browsers
tickets.description: On laptops with the customer's managed browser profile, three widget types never appear and leave gaps on dashboards; unmanaged browsers show everything.
tickets.resolution_notes: The managed profile includes a content-blocking extension whose filter list blocks script paths containing '/analytics/', which matched the bundle for those widget types. As a workaround the customer's IT team added the product's domains to the extension's allow-list for that profile; our front-end team is renaming the asset path in an upcoming release so it no longer matches common filter lists. Widgets display on managed laptops.

tickets.subject: Async query job results only contain part of the data
tickets.description: Customer runs a large async query through the API and the downloaded result has about a fifth of the expected rows.
tickets.resolution_notes: Large async query results are split into several files listed in a manifest, and the client downloaded only the first file. Updated the client to iterate over all files in the manifest. The combined result now has the full row count reported in the job summary.

tickets.subject: Wants to pay annual invoices by bank transfer
tickets.description: Customer wants to stop paying by card and settle annual invoices by bank transfer, but Plan & Billing only shows card fields.
tickets.resolution_notes: Bank transfer is offered only with invoiced billing, which requires an annual plan above the minimum contract value; the customer qualified. Switched the account to invoiced billing on 30-day terms and removed the card at their request. Confirmed the next invoice was issued with remittance instructions and no card on file.

tickets.subject: OIDC sign-in returns 401 though nothing was changed
tickets.description: Since this morning the SSO button sends people back to the login page with 'Identity provider rejected the request (401)'. The customer insists nobody touched the configuration.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their IdP app registration enforces a 180-day secret lifetime, and the secret had lapsed overnight, so our token request failed authentication. The admin issued a new secret and updated the workspace; the SSO settings page now lets admins record the secret's expiry date and shows a banner 14 days ahead. Users signed in successfully within ten minutes.

tickets.subject: Users stuck in 2FA enrollment loop after enforcement
tickets.description: Since the admin turned on 'Require two-factor authentication', some users finish enrolling, sign in, and are asked to enroll all over again. It seems to hit people who started on their phones.
tickets.resolution_notes: Users who began enrollment in the mobile app and finished in the browser had the enrollment saved against a temporary session that was discarded at sign-in. Changed the flow to store enrollment on the account immediately and cleared the incomplete enrollment state for the affected users. All 14 users enrolled once and were not prompted again.

tickets.subject: Store kiosks can't open dashboards; back-office PCs can
tickets.description: All in-store kiosks show 'This site can't be reached' for the product since Monday, while back-office PCs in the same stores work normally.
tickets.resolution_notes: The kiosk image contained a static hosts-file entry from an earlier pilot that pinned app.example.net to an address we retired over the weekend. The customer removed the entry from the image and redeployed it to all kiosks. Kiosks now resolve through normal DNS and load dashboards.

tickets.subject: Grand total row missing from export
tickets.description: The on-screen table shows a grand total row, but neither the CSV nor the Excel export includes it.
tickets.resolution_notes: Totals rows are computed in the display layer and were excluded from data exports by default. Enabled 'Include totals row' in the widget's export settings. Confirmed both formats included the row labelled 'Total'.

tickets.subject: 'Something went wrong' only for the Nordics region
tickets.description: The basket analysis widget displays 'Something went wrong' when filtered to the Nordics region and works for every other region.
tickets.resolution_notes: One product in that region had an invisible control character in its name, and the chart's text measurement crashed on it. The renderer now strips control characters from labels before drawing. The widget renders for the Nordics region.

tickets.subject: Region field with huge CASE statement slows every widget
tickets.description: Customer maps 600 store codes to regions using one long CASE expression in a calculated field. Every widget split by region is slow.
tickets.resolution_notes: The 600-branch expression was evaluated sequentially for every row. Replaced it with a small store-to-region mapping table joined to sales, which the customer can now edit directly. Region widgets went from about 18 seconds to under 2, with identical regional totals.

tickets.subject: store_code is null after upgrading to v2
tickets.description: After switching their client from v1 to v2, the customer's mapping shows store_code as empty on every record.
tickets.resolution_notes: In v2 the field was renamed to location_code because it now covers stores, distribution sites and online channels. Updated the customer's field mapping per the migration guide. Records now carry the expected codes.

tickets.subject: Unknown small transaction from us on a new card
tickets.description: The finance lead found a small transaction from our company on a newly issued card that has not been used for any renewal yet, and suspects fraud.
tickets.resolution_notes: It was the verification authorization made when the card was added on the billing page; it is reversed automatically and never settles. The timing matched the card change in the audit log, and we sent the void record to the customer. Their bank confirmed the authorization had been released.

tickets.subject: Saved reports still in USD after currency change
tickets.description: After the workspace reporting currency changed to EUR, dashboards switched but about 20 saved reports still show USD.
tickets.resolution_notes: Those saved reports had an explicit currency set when they were created, which overrides the workspace default. Bulk-updated them to 'Use workspace currency'. All saved reports now show EUR.

tickets.subject: Widgets overlap at 125% display scaling
tickets.description: Users whose Windows display scaling is set to 125% see the bottom row of widgets drawn over the row above it. At 100% the layout is fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: Widget heights were calculated in device pixels while positions used CSS pixels, so rows overlapped at any scaling other than 100%. Corrected the calculation to use CSS pixels throughout. Dashboards rendered without overlap at 100%, 125% and 150% scaling in testing and on the customer's machines.

tickets.subject: Uploaded SVG logo appears as an empty box
tickets.description: The customer's new logo uploads without error, but the header shows an empty rectangle where the logo should be.
tickets.resolution_notes: The SVG drew its text with an externally linked web font, and the logo sanitiser removes external references for security, leaving nothing visible. The customer re-exported the logo with text converted to outlines. The header now shows the logo in every browser.

tickets.subject: Pie slice colours change through the day
tickets.description: On a store's category-mix pie chart the slice colours seem to change between morning and afternoon. The legend always matches, but staff keep misreading it.
tickets.resolution_notes: Slices were sorted by size and coloured by position, so when categories changed rank during the day their colours moved with them. Colour is now assigned by category value regardless of rank. Category colours stayed fixed across the next day's refreshes.

tickets.subject: Finance script error: 'This API version is no longer available'
tickets.description: The customer's finance team says the script they use to pull the month-end report pack broke overnight with the message 'This API version is no longer available'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The script called the v1 report download endpoint, which was retired on its published sunset date. Provided the v2 request mapping, including the new report_id parameter name, and the customer's developer updated the script. The month-end pack downloaded successfully the next morning.

tickets.subject: Northern region alerts stopped after region rename
tickets.description: Customer renamed the region 'North' to 'Northern' in their store hierarchy. Since then, none of the region's sales alerts have fired, even on clearly bad days.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rules filtered on the literal value 'North', which no longer matched any store, so they evaluated an empty population. Updated the rules to filter by the region's ID rather than its name and added a warning when a rule filter matches nothing. The rules evaluated the region's stores again and one fired the next day for a real dip.

tickets.subject: Webhook deliveries rejected with 403 and an HTML page
tickets.description: Webhook deliveries started returning 403 Forbidden with an HTML error page after the customer put a web application firewall in front of their receiver.
tickets.resolution_notes: A WAF rule flagged the JSON body, which contains URLs and escaped product names, as possible injection and blocked it. The customer added a rule exception limited to the webhook path and the product's sender range and kept signature verification on the receiver. Deliveries succeed, and the WAF still inspects other traffic to that path.

tickets.subject: Session ends right after successful login
tickets.description: One user signs in, sees the dashboard for a split second, and is returned to the login page. Other users on the same network have no problem.
tickets.resolution_notes: The user's laptop clock was set a day ahead, so the browser treated the session cookie's expiry date as already past. The user corrected the clock, and we changed the session cookie to a relative max-age so client clock errors can no longer expire it early. The user stayed signed in normally.

tickets.subject: Same store appears twice in the store ranking
tickets.description: The store ranking lists 'Oakbrook' and 'Oakbrook ' (with a trailing space) as separate rows, each holding part of the store's sales.
tickets.resolution_notes: Store labels from two sources differed by trailing whitespace and were grouped on the raw label rather than the store ID. Trimmed and normalised labels on load and grouped by store ID, taking the label from the store master. The ranking now shows one Oakbrook row with the combined total.

tickets.subject: Contact totals rose after a CRM dedupe project
tickets.description: The customer's marketing team ran a deduplication project in their CRM, and contact counts in our dashboards went up instead of down.
tickets.resolution_notes: Merging in the CRM gave surviving contacts new IDs, so the connector re-ingested them as new while never receiving deletions for the records that were merged away. Enabled processing of merge and delete events for the connection and ran a cleanup that removed 4,870 stale contacts. Contact totals now match the CRM within the sync interval.

tickets.subject: Store comparison widget slow right after onboarding migration
tickets.description: A newly onboarded retailer says the store comparison widget was quick during their trial but became very slow the day their historical data migration finished.
tickets.resolution_notes: The migration bulk-loaded several years of history without triggering a statistics update, so row estimates were off by a factor of thousands and the planner chose a poor join order. Refreshed statistics and added an automatic statistics update at the end of every bulk import. The widget now loads in about 3 seconds.

tickets.subject: Large CSV uploads fail at around 1 GB
tickets.description: Uploads of the customer's monthly 2.3 GB transactions file fail with 'connection reset' at about the 1 GB mark, while smaller files upload fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The inspection appliance has a 1 GB maximum inspected object size and resets connections that exceed it. As a workaround the customer switched the upload tool to multipart mode with 256 MB parts, each sent as a separate request; the network team scheduled a policy update for the ingestion host in their next change window. The 2.3 GB file uploaded successfully in parts.

tickets.subject: On-prem agent fails with 'unable to get local issuer certificate'
tickets.description: Since last Friday the customer's on-prem data agent refuses to connect to ingest.example.net and logs 'unable to get local issuer certificate'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's new inspection appliance re-signs outbound TLS with an internal root CA that was not in the agent's bundled trust store. Imported the corporate root CA through the agent's documented CA bundle setting, leaving certificate verification on. The agent reconnected and the queued uploads completed.

tickets.subject: Products showing as 'Unknown product' after CSV upload
tickets.description: After uploading the weekly sales CSV, about a fifth of the rows show 'Unknown product' even though every SKU exists in the catalogue.
tickets.resolution_notes: The CSV importer inferred the SKU column as numeric, stripping leading zeros so '004512' became '4512' and no longer matched the catalogue. Set the SKU column type to text in the upload template so the original strings are preserved and reprocessed the file. All rows now match a catalogue product.

tickets.subject: Alerts for store 112 still go to the manager who left
tickets.description: Customer's new store manager isn't receiving alerts for her store. The alerts are still being emailed to the previous manager's address.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule listed the previous manager's email address directly as a recipient, so it was not affected by the account changes. Replaced individual addresses with the role-based recipient 'Store manager of {store}', which follows the store's assigned manager. The new manager received the next test alert.

tickets.subject: 'Your browser blocked a required cookie' on managed laptops
tickets.description: On the customer's managed laptops the login page shows 'Your browser blocked a required cookie'. Staff signing in from personal devices are not affected.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's browser policy allows cookies only for listed sites, and the list still named our previous app domain from before the domain move. Their IT team added the current app domain to the policy's cookie allow list. Once the policy refreshed, users on managed laptops signed in normally.

tickets.subject: New team member sees dashboards in mobile app but not in browser
tickets.description: A store manager added to the Store Ops team can see the team's dashboards in the mobile app, but the desktop browser still shows an empty list.
tickets.resolution_notes: The browser session had started before the team membership was added and was still using cached permissions, while the mobile app had signed in afresh. Ending the browser session refreshed permissions, and the 5-minute refresh released shortly afterwards removed the need for this. Confirmed the dashboards appeared in the browser.

tickets.subject: Cohort retention chart never finishes
tickets.description: Customer opened the cohort retention template with weekly cohorts from their first year of trading. The chart spins until it shows 'Query timed out'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Weekly cohorts over five years created a cohort-by-week matrix of roughly 68,000 cells, each needing a self-join on shopper history. Limited the default to the most recent 104 weekly cohorts, offered monthly cohorts for longer history, and added a nightly precomputed cohort table. The chart now renders in about 7 seconds.

tickets.subject: Order API connector: 'unable to verify the first certificate'
tickets.description: The connector to the customer's on-prem order API fails with 'unable to verify the first certificate', yet the customer can open the same URL in their browser without any warning.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's server presented only its leaf certificate without the intermediate; browsers filled the gap from cached intermediates, but the connector validates strictly. The customer installed the full chain on the server. An external chain check showed the complete chain and the next connector run succeeded.

tickets.subject: Invited analysts land as viewers although invite said Editor
tickets.description: The admin invited four analysts with the Editor role, but once they accepted they could only view dashboards.
tickets.resolution_notes: Joining the Analytics team applied that team's join rule, which sets members to Viewer and overrode the role chosen on the invitation. Set the four users to Editor and changed the team's join rule to 'keep invitation role'. Confirmed the analysts could edit and a test invitation kept its Editor role.

tickets.subject: 'Request sent' but nobody ever receives it
tickets.description: Users click Request access on the supplier performance dashboard and see 'Request sent', but nobody receives anything.
tickets.resolution_notes: Requests were addressed to the dashboard's original owner, whose account had been deactivated, and the dashboard sat at the workspace root, so there was no folder owner to fall back to. Transferred ownership to the category lead and re-sent the pending requests. Confirmed the category lead received the next request.

tickets.subject: EU store revenue overstated by roughly the VAT rate
tickets.description: The customer's German and French stores show revenue about 19-20% above their statutory net sales reports, while the US stores reconcile.
tickets.resolution_notes: Prices from the EU POS source are VAT-inclusive, but the source was configured with tax mode 'exclusive', so VAT was never removed from revenue. Switched the EU sources to tax-inclusive mode so VAT is split out per line and reprocessed since January. Net revenue for both countries now matches the statutory reports to the euro.

tickets.subject: Anomaly alerts flag normal January sales as unusually low
tickets.description: Since 2 January, the customer's anomaly alerts fire almost daily saying store sales are unusually low. Their merchandising team says January trading is perfectly normal for them.
tickets.resolution_notes: The anomaly baseline was trained on the previous eight weeks, which included the holiday peak, so the expected level for January was far too high. Excluded the holiday period from training and retrained using the same weeks of the prior year as a seasonal reference. The daily alerts stopped and a replay of the period flagged only one genuinely weak day.

tickets.subject: Store map export contains only headers
tickets.description: Exporting data from the store map widget returns a CSV containing only the header row.
tickets.resolution_notes: The map widget's export filtered by the current map viewport, and exports started from the widget menu sent no viewport, so no stores matched. The export now defaults to the full dataset when no viewport is supplied. Confirmed the export listed all 212 stores.

tickets.subject: Obsolete custom role can't be deleted: 'Role in use'
tickets.description: The admin wants to delete an obsolete custom role but gets 'Role in use', though no active user seems to have it.
tickets.resolution_notes: The role was still assigned to two deactivated users and referenced by one group mapping. Reassigned the deactivated users to the default role and removed the mapping with the admin's approval. Confirmed the role could then be deleted.

tickets.subject: Muted alert stayed muted for three weeks
tickets.description: Customer muted an inventory variance alert 'until resolved' expecting it to come back in a few days. They only realised three weeks later that it was still muted.
tickets.resolution_notes: 'Mute until resolved' stays active while the condition remains breached, and the variance had never dropped below the threshold. Replaced it with a 72-hour mute and enabled the weekly 'muted rules' summary for the admin. The rule is active again and the admin received the first summary.

tickets.subject: Admin told 'Plan change requires billing owner approval'
tickets.description: A workspace admin trying to upgrade gets 'Plan change requires billing owner approval' and assumes their admin role is broken.
tickets.resolution_notes: Invoiced contract accounts require plan changes to be approved by the named billing owner, and that person had left the company. The customer's authorised signatory nominated a new billing owner through our verification process, who then approved the upgrade. Confirmed the plan changed and the order confirmation went to the new billing owner.

tickets.subject: KPI tile shows 12.4K but export says 12,388
tickets.description: A store lead says the KPI tile shows 12.4K orders while the exported value is 12,388, and asks which figure is wrong.
tickets.resolution_notes: Neither is wrong: the tile displays a compact rounded value, while exports contain the exact figure. Explained the difference and showed the tile setting that displays full numbers. Confirmed the tile then read 12,388.

tickets.subject: User listed twice on folder: inherited Viewer and explicit Editor
tickets.description: A user appears twice in a folder's access list, as Viewer through inheritance and as Editor through a direct grant, and the admin asks which one applies.
tickets.resolution_notes: The most permissive grant applies, so the user had Editor. The admin intended Viewer, so the explicit Editor grant was removed. Confirmed the user could view but not edit.

tickets.subject: 'Continue with SSO' fails with invalid_client
tickets.description: Customer using OpenID Connect sign-in reports that every attempt now ends on an error page reading 'invalid_client'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The client secret in the customer's identity provider app registration had reached its 12-month expiry, so the token exchange was rejected. The admin generated a new secret and entered it in the workspace SSO settings. Sign-in worked for all users immediately.

tickets.subject: CSV opens in one column for French users
tickets.description: French users' spreadsheet application puts every row into a single column when opening our CSV, because it expects semicolons as separators.
tickets.resolution_notes: Exports always used a comma delimiter, and with comma decimal separators the file could not be split correctly in that locale. Set the workspace's CSV delimiter option to semicolon. Confirmed the file opened in separate columns with decimals intact.

tickets.subject: Dashboard only fast on the second view
tickets.description: Customer says the merchandising dashboard takes about 25 seconds for each person the first time they open it, then loads instantly if they reload. Colleagues opening it a minute later still wait the full time.
tickets.resolution_notes: The widget result cache key included the viewer's session identifier, so cached results were never shared between users or across new sessions. Removed the session component from the key while keeping the row-level permission scope in it so users only share results they are allowed to see; the change was enabled for this customer's workspace first. A second user now gets cached results in under 2 seconds.

tickets.subject: PDF export stuck at 'Preparing' since morning
tickets.description: A PDF export of the regional performance dashboard has shown 'Preparing...' in Export Center for hours and never finishes.
tickets.resolution_notes: The export job crashed on a text widget embedding an image from a URL that now returns 404, and the job status was never moved off Preparing. Removed the broken image reference with the author and re-ran the export; engineering added failure reporting for widget render errors. Confirmed the PDF was produced in under a minute.

tickets.subject: SSO broke after the IdP rotated its signing certificate
tickets.description: All SSO sign-ins began failing with 'invalid signature' on the day the customer's identity team rotated the SAML signing certificate, even though metadata refresh is enabled.
tickets.resolution_notes: Metadata refresh had been failing silently because the metadata URL was only reachable inside the customer's network, so the workspace never picked up the new signing certificate. Moved the metadata to a publicly reachable URL and triggered a refresh, which loaded the new certificate. Sign-ins succeeded immediately.

tickets.subject: HTTP 431 after SSO for users in many groups
tickets.description: Some users see 'Request header fields too large (431)' immediately after OIDC sign-in. All of them belong to well over a hundred directory groups; users with few groups are fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The ID token listed every group membership, and keeping it in the session cookie pushed request headers past the server limit. The customer filtered the groups claim to the groups assigned to our app, and we moved token storage server-side so cookie size no longer depends on the claim. Affected users signed in without errors.

tickets.subject: Repeated reset requests appear to do nothing
tickets.description: A store manager clicked 'Forgot password' six times in ten minutes and says no emails came at all, although the page showed the normal confirmation every time.
tickets.resolution_notes: The five emails that were sent had been filed into an archive folder by a mailbox rule, and the sixth request was silently dropped by the five-per-hour limit. With the customer's admin we found the emails through message tracking; the manager used the newest one, since each request invalidates the previous link, and signed in. The reset page now tells users when the hourly request limit has been reached.

tickets.subject: Initial load stopped at 18 months of history
tickets.description: Customer connected their POS expecting five years of history, but transactions only go back 18 months.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connection was created with the default 18-month backfill start date, and the setup screen did not make that obvious. Extended the start date to five years and ran the historical load in yearly chunks. All five years loaded over two nights, and the year-over-year charts now include prior years.

tickets.subject: Daily sales file rejected: 'Expected 9 columns, found 1'
tickets.description: Since a new finance PC was set up at the customer, the daily sales file fails validation with 'Expected 9 columns, found 1'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The new PC uses European regional settings, so the spreadsheet tool saves its CSV files with semicolons between fields. Set the upload connection for this feed to auto-detect the delimiter. That day's file and the two rejected days imported with all nine columns.

tickets.subject: Two workspaces with the same name after acquisition
tickets.description: Following an acquisition, users belong to two workspaces both called 'Meadowgate', and they keep making changes in the wrong one.
tickets.resolution_notes: Both workspaces had the same display name and no distinguishing label. Renamed the acquired workspace to 'Meadowgate – Garden Centres', set an 'Acquired' environment badge in a different colour and gave each workspace its own icon. Users confirmed the switcher now clearly tells them apart.

tickets.subject: Closed public holidays drawn as drops to zero
tickets.description: Stores closed on public holidays show sharp dips to zero on the daily trend line, which the regional director keeps reading as a sales collapse. They want closed days skipped.
tickets.resolution_notes: Line charts filled missing dates with zero by default, which is misleading for days when stores are shut. Added a 'Gaps for missing dates' option and turned it on for the customer's trend charts. Holidays now appear as breaks in the line rather than drops.

tickets.subject: Alert webhook to incident tool returns 401
tickets.description: Critical alerts stopped opening incidents in the customer's on-call tool on Thursday. The alert delivery log shows 401 Unauthorized for every attempt.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer had rotated the integration routing key in their on-call tool as part of a quarterly key rotation but had not updated it in our alert channel settings. Updated the stored key in the webhook channel and re-sent the failed alerts. Incidents were created for all of them and new alerts deliver normally.

tickets.subject: 'No data' alerts every Sunday for stores that are closed
tickets.description: Customer's store managers get 'no sales data' alerts every Sunday, but most of their stores are closed on Sundays.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule fired on missing data at all hours and did not know store opening hours. Linked the rule to the store opening-hours schedule so no-data is evaluated only while a store is open. The following Sunday produced alerts only for the two stores that trade on Sundays, and none of them were missing data.

tickets.subject: Footfall heatmap peaks at 3 am for Singapore stores
tickets.description: In the Store Traffic module, the hourly visitor heatmap for the Singapore stores puts the busiest hours in the middle of the night, eight hours away from what store staff see on the floor.
tickets.resolution_notes: The traffic module shares the aggregation job that grouped hourly counter readings by UTC hour instead of the store's local zone (UTC+8). After moving the job to per-store time zones and reprocessing, the peak sits at 11:00-13:00 local time, matching the door counters' own hourly report.

tickets.subject: Transferred store manager still sees old region
tickets.description: A store manager who moved from the North to the South region two weeks ago can still open North region dashboards.
tickets.resolution_notes: Besides team membership, the manager had been granted direct access to the North region folders, and the internal transfer process only changed the team. Removed the direct grants at the admin's request. Confirmed the manager now sees only South region content.

tickets.subject: Five scheduled reports stopped after a manager left
tickets.description: Five scheduled reports stopped going out in the same week that a regional manager left the company.
tickets.resolution_notes: Schedules run with their owner's permissions, and deactivating the owner paused all of that person's schedules. Transferred the schedules to the new regional manager at the admin's request, which reactivated them. Confirmed all five were sent on their next run.

tickets.subject: Mid-June upgrade invoiced from the 1st
tickets.description: Paraphrasing the finance contact: 'We moved from Starter to Growth on 18 June, but the upgrade line on our invoice covers 1 to 30 June.'
tickets.resolution_notes: The upgrade was prorated from the beginning of the billing period instead of the upgrade date, adding 17 days of Growth pricing. Issued a credit note for the overlapping days. After the proration fix was deployed, a re-rated preview showed the upgrade line covering 18 to 30 June.

tickets.subject: Admin cannot find option to reset a user's 2FA
tickets.description: A user lost their phone and has no recovery codes. The admin who handles access requests opened the user's profile but sees no way to reset two-factor authentication.
tickets.resolution_notes: Resetting another user's second factor is limited to workspace owners, and the requesting admin held the editor-admin role. The workspace owner verified the user's identity through the customer's helpdesk process and reset 2FA for that one account. The user enrolled a new device and signed in.

tickets.subject: Old agent version blocked on port 8443
tickets.description: An agent installed years ago at a distribution centre cannot connect after the customer tightened egress rules to port 443 only.
tickets.resolution_notes: Older agent versions upload over port 8443, which the new egress policy blocked. Upgraded the agent to the current version, which uses 443. The agent connected and uploads resumed.

tickets.subject: Invoices need the new legal entity name after acquisition
tickets.description: Following an acquisition, the customer's legal entity name and registered address changed, and their invoices must now show both.
tickets.resolution_notes: Updated the legal name and registered address in the billing profile. Issued invoices cannot be edited, so we credited and rebilled the open invoice to carry the new details. Confirmed the rebilled invoice showed the new entity name and address.

tickets.subject: Half of webhooks rejected after rotating signing secret
tickets.description: After the customer rotated their webhook signing secret, roughly half of their events started failing verification. They run two consumer services behind a load balancer.
tickets.resolution_notes: Only one of the two consumer services had been updated with the new secret. Showed them how to use the 24-hour rotation grace period, during which each event carries signatures for both the old and new secret, and they updated the second service. All events verified on both services after the update.

tickets.subject: Guest can browse the full member directory
tickets.description: A guest noticed they could browse the list of all workspace members along with their email addresses.
tickets.resolution_notes: The directory setting 'Guests can see members' was turned on. Turned it off at the admin's request, so guests now see only the people on dashboards shared with them. Confirmed the guest's directory view was limited accordingly.

tickets.subject: Role change stuck on 'Pending approval' for days
tickets.description: An admin promoted a user to Admin, and the change has shown 'Pending approval' for four days.
tickets.resolution_notes: Dual approval for privileged role changes was enabled, and the second approver had notifications turned off. Showed the approver the pending approvals queue, and they approved the change. Confirmed the user became Admin and the approver re-enabled notifications.

tickets.subject: Wants dashboards owned by a team instead of individuals
tickets.description: After a third painful handover this year, the BI lead wants core dashboards owned by the BI team rather than by any one person.
tickets.resolution_notes: Team ownership was available on their plan but had not been enabled. Enabled it and converted the 40 core dashboards to BI team ownership. Confirmed any BI team member could manage them and that removing one member would not orphan them.

tickets.subject: Report links expired seconds after delivery
tickets.description: Every link in the customer's scheduled report emails shows 'expired', even when clicked moments after the email lands.
tickets.resolution_notes: Delivery logs showed each link was fetched within a second of delivery from the customer's mail filtering service, which marked the one-time token as used. Enabled sign-in-protected reusable links for the workspace. Confirmed in the logs that the next delivery's links were opened by the recipients themselves.

tickets.subject: Oversized annual export keeps restarting and slowing other reports
tickets.description: A customer's analyst scheduled an export of all line items for three years. It never completes, and other reports for the workspace have been late since it was created.
tickets.resolution_notes: The export hit the 60-minute worker time limit and was automatically re-queued, running three times per night and occupying a worker each time. As an immediate workaround we split it into twelve monthly exports that each finish within the limit; a permanent change to cap automatic retries for timed-out jobs is scheduled. The other reports were back on time the next morning.

tickets.subject: Every alert email now arrives twice
tickets.description: Since Thursday, the customer's regional team receives two identical emails for every sales alert, a few seconds apart.
tickets.resolution_notes: On Thursday the team cloned their regional dashboard to make a draft version, and cloning also copied the alert rules attached to its widgets, so each rule now existed twice. Deleted the cloned rules after confirming they were unchanged copies, and dashboard cloning now asks whether to copy alert rules (default: no). The next alerts arrived once each.

tickets.subject: Subsidiary brand needs its own branded address
tickets.description: The customer added a second custom domain for a subsidiary brand, but every link still uses the parent brand's domain.
tickets.resolution_notes: A workspace can use only one custom domain for links, so the second domain could not become active alongside the first. Created a separate workspace for the subsidiary, moved its dashboards there and assigned the second domain to it. Links from the subsidiary workspace use its own domain.

tickets.subject: Invoices bill fewer seats than people using the product
tickets.description: The customer's controller is reporting under-billing ahead of an audit: around 60 people use the workspace daily, yet the last three invoices charged for 48 seats.
tickets.resolution_notes: Twelve users had been provisioned through the customer's identity provider into a child workspace that was never linked to the parent billing account, so they were not counted. With the controller's approval, linked the child workspace to the parent subscription and issued a true-up invoice for the agreed period. Confirmed the billing account now reports 60 seats.

tickets.subject: Older orders show 'Unknown customer' after onboarding
tickets.description: Five years of orders loaded during onboarding, but every order older than two years shows 'Unknown customer'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer backfill kept the default 24-month window while the order backfill used five years, so older orders referenced customers that were never imported. Aligned the customer backfill with the orders and reloaded customers back to the earliest order. 'Unknown customer' rows dropped from 41,000 to zero.

tickets.subject: Embedded dashboard cut off with no scrollbar
tickets.description: The customer embedded the store performance dashboard on an intranet page. Only the top third is visible and the frame has no scrollbar.
tickets.resolution_notes: The intranet page set a fixed 600-pixel frame height, and our embed did not report its content height. Enabled the auto-resize option, which posts the content height to the host page, and gave the customer the two-line script for their intranet. The frame now grows to show the whole dashboard.

tickets.subject: New API key rejected right after creating it
tickets.description: Customer generated a key minutes ago and every call to api.example.net returns 401. They suspect key creation is broken.
tickets.resolution_notes: The key had been created in the customer's sandbox workspace, and sandbox keys only work against the sandbox base URL. Pointed the integration at the sandbox host for testing and created a separate production key for go-live. Both keys authenticated against their matching hosts.

tickets.subject: Month-end PDF board pack delayed
tickets.description: The customer's finance lead says the board pack PDF that normally arrives at 6:00 on the first business day came after lunch this month.
tickets.resolution_notes: The board pack job was queued behind a very large ad-hoc export that occupied workers for hours, since the queue had no separation between short scheduled jobs and long exports. As an immediate workaround we moved the board pack to the front of the queue and it was delivered at 13:10; engineering started work on a dedicated pool for long exports with a per-workspace share of workers. Verified the following month-end board pack, after that change shipped, arrived at 6:02.

tickets.subject: CRM sync stuck on 'Fetching activity history'
tickets.description: For two days the CRM sync has sat on the 'Fetching activity history' step. The customer recently imported ten years of call logs into one key account.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector requested that account's whole activity history in a single call with no timeout, and the source never finished responding. Added request timeouts and changed activity fetching to monthly chunks. The sync completed overnight, including about 410,000 activities for the large account.

tickets.subject: Leaving a slow dashboard doesn't free anything up
tickets.description: Customer noticed that if a user gives up on a slow dashboard and opens another one, the second one is also slow, as if the first is still running in the background.
tickets.resolution_notes: Widget queries were not cancelled when users navigated away, so abandoned queries kept occupying concurrency slots until they finished. Added cancellation of in-flight widget queries on navigation and tab close. Query logs confirmed abandoned queries now stop within a second and slot usage dropped about 30% at peak.

tickets.subject: Strict client fails to deserialize store response
tickets.description: Customer's typed client throws 'missing required property closing_date' on some store records. Other stores deserialize fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The API omits properties whose value is null by default, so open stores have no closing_date property. Recommended the include_nulls=true parameter for strict clients and marking optional fields as optional in their model. Every store record now deserializes.

tickets.subject: 8:00 scheduled reports now take 20 minutes to generate
tickets.description: Customer noticed their 8:00 regional reports, which used to arrive by 8:02, now arrive around 8:20. Nothing changed in the report definitions.
tickets.resolution_notes: The reports were querying raw tables because the nightly rollup refresh was still running, a consequence of the recent historical backfill causing full rebuilds of every partition. Fixed partition change detection so the refresh is incremental again. Reports returned to arriving by 8:02 the next day.

tickets.subject: Business-day metrics using US holidays for UK stores
tickets.description: The UK workspace's 'Sales per trading day' counts the August bank holiday as a trading day and treats US Thanksgiving as a holiday.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace holiday calendar was set to United States. Switched it to United Kingdom (England and Wales). Trading-day counts and per-day metrics now follow UK bank holidays.

tickets.subject: Average basket alert never fires
tickets.description: Customer set up an alert for average basket value dropping below 35 across all stores. Their dashboard showed it at 31 on several days, but no alert was sent.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule's aggregation was set to 'sum' across stores, so it compared the total of all stores' averages (in the thousands) with 35. Changed the aggregation to a transaction-weighted average to match the dashboard tile. Replaying the past month, the rule fired on the same three days the dashboard showed below 35.

tickets.subject: Year-over-year growth for Canadian stores can't be reproduced
tickets.description: Customer's analyst rebuilt CAD year-over-year growth from the raw order export and got 4.1%, while the Store Performance dashboard shows 7.8% for the same stores and dates.
tickets.resolution_notes: Prior-year USD-priced orders were converted at the current CAD rate rather than the rates on their transaction dates, which shifted the comparison base. Corrected conversion to transaction-date rates for both periods and backfilled the aggregates. The dashboard now reports 4.1%, matching the analyst's independent calculation.

tickets.subject: Dashboard list thumbnails weeks out of date
tickets.description: Preview thumbnails on the dashboard list page are weeks old; one still shows a chart that was deleted long ago.
tickets.resolution_notes: Thumbnails were regenerated only when a dashboard's title changed, not when its widgets changed. They now regenerate after any layout or widget edit, and we regenerated all of the customer's existing thumbnails once. The list showed current previews immediately and stayed current after later edits.

tickets.subject: New column in source table broke the daily file import
tickets.description: The customer's import job started rejecting the daily SFTP file after a dashboard author added a column to the source table.
tickets.resolution_notes: The delivery exported the widget's live column list, so any added column changed the file layout. Pinned the delivery to a fixed column template matching the customer's import specification. Confirmed the next file matched the template and imported cleanly.

tickets.subject: Parent folder editors can open a 'Restricted' subfolder
tickets.description: Editors of the parent Finance folder can still open a subfolder marked Restricted.
tickets.resolution_notes: The subfolder used 'Restrict viewers', which does not affect inherited editor grants. Changed it to 'Break inheritance' with explicit grants for the controllers group only. Confirmed parent folder editors were blocked and controllers could still open it.

tickets.subject: Embedded view fine in Chrome, sign-in loop in Safari
tickets.description: The customer's embedded store dashboard works for staff on Chrome but loops back to the login form for anyone using Safari, including all iPads.
tickets.resolution_notes: Safari blocks third-party cookies by default, so the framed session was never stored there, while the customer's Chrome configuration still accepted them. Moved the customer's embed to signed embed links, which do not depend on cookies inside the frame. iPad and Safari users loaded the embedded dashboard without a loop.

tickets.subject: City filter slow after choosing a region
tickets.description: Customer has cascading filters: region then city. Choosing a region makes the city list take 8-10 seconds to update.
tickets.resolution_notes: The city filter had 'only show values with data in the selected period' enabled, which ran a query over transactions each time the region changed. With the customer's agreement, switched the city list to use the location hierarchy instead. The city list now updates instantly; cities with no sales in the period simply show no data when selected.

tickets.subject: Number format change ignored for part of the finance team
tickets.description: After the workspace switched to German number format, three finance analysts still see 1,234.56.
tickets.resolution_notes: The analysts had personal number-format preferences left over from an earlier trial, which override the workspace setting. Reset their number format to 'Workspace default'. They now see 1.234,56.

tickets.subject: Headquarters locked out Monday after weekend circuit upgrade
tickets.description: Following a weekend circuit upgrade at HQ, nobody at headquarters can reach dashboards, and the block message appears right after login.
tickets.resolution_notes: The upgraded circuit came with a new public IP block that was not on the workspace allow-list. The customer's admin, signing in from a branch office already on the list, added the new block. HQ users regained access.

tickets.subject: Early-shift users get 'queue wait exceeded' errors
tickets.description: Store supervisors starting at 6:00 see 'Query cancelled: queue wait exceeded 90s' on the opening checklist dashboard. By 6:15 it works.
tickets.resolution_notes: 120 store-opening reports were scheduled for 6:00 and occupied all workspace query slots, so the supervisors' interactive queries waited past the 90-second queue limit. Reserved interactive capacity and moved the opening reports to start at 5:45 with the customer's approval. Supervisors loaded the checklist without errors the following morning.

tickets.subject: Monday report now arrives at 9:00 instead of 8:00
tickets.description: Since the clocks changed in spring, the Monday sales summary reaches the European store managers an hour later than scheduled.
tickets.resolution_notes: The schedule stored a fixed UTC offset (+01:00) rather than the workspace's named time zone, so it did not follow the daylight saving change. Converted the schedule to the named time zone. Confirmed the next Monday delivery arrived at 08:00 local time.

tickets.subject: Charts go blurry on an external 4K monitor
tickets.description: When analysts drag the browser window from their laptop screen to an external 4K monitor, the charts turn blurry, while table text stays sharp.
tickets.resolution_notes: Charts sized their canvas from the pixel ratio detected at page load and never updated when the window moved to a screen with a different ratio. Charts now redraw whenever the pixel ratio changes. Moving the window between screens keeps charts sharp.

tickets.subject: Invitation links expired before new hires used them
tickets.description: The customer's admin invited new store staff on a Friday; on Monday every link showed 'This invitation has expired'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Invitations were valid for 48 hours, which a weekend easily exceeds. The admin resent the invitations, and we extended invitation validity to seven days, with expired links now offering a 'Request a new invite' button. All the new staff activated their accounts from the resent links.

tickets.subject: Order count higher than the order management system
tickets.description: Agent summary: the customer sees about 6% more orders on the dashboard than in their order management system and suspected double-loaded data, but row counts in the raw tables match the source.
tickets.resolution_notes: Orders split across several shipments arrive as one record per shipment sharing the parent order number, and the order count metric counted shipment records instead of distinct order numbers. Changed the metric to count distinct parent order numbers and recomputed. Daily order counts now match the order management system exactly.

tickets.subject: Custom sales-per-labour-hour metric wrong since editor update
tickets.description: The customer's operations analyst says the custom sales-per-labour-hour metric changed on the day the new formula editor shipped, though nobody touched it.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their expression 'net_sales / (scheduled_hours + overtime_hours)' was migrated without the parentheses, so it divided by scheduled hours only and then added overtime hours to the result. Restored the grouping and confirmed the corrected migration now preserves parentheses for all formulas. Values for the last four weeks match the analyst's manual calculation.

tickets.subject: Loyalty API pulls only get through occasionally
tickets.description: Customer says the loyalty platform connector worked throughout their pilot but now fails most nights with timeouts, while the odd run still gets through.
tickets.resolution_notes: During the pilot the customer's firewall rule had been created for a single address seen in their logs, 198.51.100.5/32, rather than the published 198.51.100.0/28 range, so only runs that happened to use that worker succeeded. Replaced the single-host entry with the published ranges. Ten consecutive runs succeeded across different workers.

tickets.subject: Names still corrupted with 'UTF-8 with BOM' enabled
tickets.description: Even with 'UTF-8 with BOM' switched on, accented letters in some customer names come out as question marks in CSV exports, so 'Renée' appears as 'Ren?e'.
tickets.resolution_notes: A previous admin had enabled the 'ASCII-safe output' sanitiser on the export profile, which replaces every non-ASCII character with '?'. With the current admin's agreement, turned the sanitiser off. Confirmed accented names exported intact.

tickets.subject: March doubled after re-uploading a corrected sales file
tickets.description: Customer uploaded a corrected store-sales CSV for March to replace an earlier file that had errors. The dashboard now shows March at roughly twice its real value.
tickets.resolution_notes: The file upload connection was in append mode, so the corrected file was added on top of the original. Switched the connection to 'replace by date range', removed the earlier upload and reprocessed the corrected file. March totals now match the customer's corrected spreadsheet.

tickets.subject: Connector Pack added after connecting a fifth source
tickets.description: The Connector Pack add-on appeared on the invoice after the customer connected a fifth data source; they believed the Growth plan includes unlimited connectors.
tickets.resolution_notes: Growth includes four connectors, and connecting a fifth adds the Connector Pack, as stated in the confirmation dialog. The customer disconnected a source they no longer used, and we removed the add-on with a prorated credit. Confirmed the next invoice preview had no Connector Pack line.

tickets.subject: Custom domain certificate expired; renewal didn't happen
tickets.description: Users opening analytics.fernway.example.com see an expired-certificate warning, although the product normally renews it automatically.
tickets.resolution_notes: Automatic renewal relies on a DNS validation CNAME that the customer's DNS team deleted during a record cleanup, so renewal could not complete. The record was restored and the certificate reissued within minutes. Browsers show a valid certificate and renewal checks pass.

tickets.subject: Certificate warning for the app on office Wi-Fi only
tickets.description: Users on the office network get 'NET::ERR_CERT_WEAK_SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM' when opening app.example.net; the same laptops on home Wi-Fi are fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's inspection appliance was re-signing traffic with an intermediate CA signed using SHA-1, which current browsers reject. The network team issued a new SHA-256 inspection CA and deployed it to devices. The warning no longer appears on the office network.

tickets.subject: Custom domain record 'added' but verification never completes
tickets.description: The customer added the CNAME for reports.starling.example.org a week ago, but verification still fails and lookups return nothing.
tickets.resolution_notes: The record had been created at the domain registrar, while the domain's nameservers are delegated to a separate DNS hosting provider, so it was never published. The customer created the CNAME in the authoritative zone and confirmed it with a query against the authoritative nameserver. Verification completed within minutes.

tickets.subject: Same query runs twelve times on one dashboard
tickets.description: Agent summary: query logs for a customer's category dashboard show the identical sales-by-week query executing twelve times per page load, once for each chart that visualises it differently.
tickets.resolution_notes: Widgets sharing the same underlying query were not deduplicated within a page load. Enabled per-load query deduplication so widgets with an identical query fingerprint share one execution. The dashboard now issues one query instead of twelve and loads about four times faster.

tickets.subject: Cancelled orders still counted as sales
tickets.description: Orders cancelled in the e-commerce admin keep appearing as completed sales in the dashboard.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector only requested orders with status 'open' or 'fulfilled', so a change to 'cancelled' was never fetched. Added cancelled orders to the sync filter and re-synced the last 90 days. The 186 cancelled orders now show as cancelled and drop out of revenue.

tickets.subject: Duplicate store targets after network blip
tickets.description: During a brief network outage at the customer's office, their planning tool uploaded store targets and now several stores show doubled targets on the attainment dashboard.
