tickets.resolution_notes: The planning tool retried each create-target request that had timed out on its side, without an Idempotency-Key, so targets that had already been created were created again. Deleted the duplicates via the API and enabled the tool's idempotency setting, which sends a stable key per target. A simulated timeout test produced no further duplicates.

tickets.subject: Back-office PCs at franchise stores lost access to the app
tickets.description: Twelve franchise stores whose back-office PCs run an older operating system can no longer load the app, and the franchisee says their OS upgrade is months away.
tickets.resolution_notes: Those PCs' built-in browser cannot negotiate TLS 1.2, which the product now requires. As a workaround the franchisee installed the company's managed current browser package, which brings its own TLS 1.2 support; the OS upgrade remains scheduled as the permanent fix. All twelve stores regained access the same day.

tickets.subject: Amounts labelled 'XXX' in a newly provisioned workspace
tickets.description: A workspace the customer created through the provisioning API shows every amount with the code 'XXX'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace was created without a reporting currency, so it fell back to the ISO placeholder code XXX. Set the reporting currency to GBP and asked the customer to add it to their provisioning request template. Amounts now display in GBP.

tickets.subject: Zurich team expects apostrophe thousands separators
tickets.description: Users in Zurich say amounts like 1,234.50 look foreign to them and want 1'234.50.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace number format was English (UK). Set it to German (Switzerland), which uses an apostrophe for thousands and a point for decimals. Amounts display as 1'234.50.

tickets.subject: Custom metric names stay in English for German users
tickets.description: German users see translated menus, but the customer's own metric and dashboard names remain in English.
tickets.resolution_notes: Only system labels are translated automatically; custom names use the localisation fields on each metric and dashboard, which were empty. Showed the admin the label translation table, and they added German labels for 34 metrics. German users now see those names in German.

tickets.subject: Percentages display with three decimal places
tickets.description: Every percentage KPI shows values like 12.345%, which the customer finds noisy on executive dashboards.
tickets.resolution_notes: A previous admin had set the workspace default precision for percentages to three decimals. Changed it to one decimal; metrics with their own precision override were left unchanged. KPIs now show 12.3%.

tickets.subject: Average selling price tile shows three decimals
tickets.description: The average-selling-price KPI tile displays values like '$24.567', while prices elsewhere in the product have two decimals.
tickets.resolution_notes: The tile was created before the metric had a format and kept 'automatic' precision, which shows up to three decimals. Applied the metric's currency format to existing tiles and made new tiles inherit it. The tile now reads '$24.57'.

tickets.subject: Embedded dashboard on intranet says 'refused to connect'
tickets.description: The customer's intranet page shows 'embed.example.net refused to connect' where the embedded sales dashboard should appear.
tickets.resolution_notes: The intranet portal's Content-Security-Policy frame-src directive listed only internal origins, so the browser blocked the frame. The portal team added https://embed.example.net to frame-src. The dashboard displays in the portal in every browser tested.

tickets.subject: Regional dashboards need their own local time
tickets.description: The customer runs stores in Sydney and Los Angeles and wants each regional dashboard to use that region's days, not head office's.
tickets.resolution_notes: All dashboards inherited the workspace time zone, Europe/London. Set dashboard-level time-zone overrides on the APAC and Americas dashboards (Australia/Sydney and America/Los_Angeles). Each regional dashboard now uses local days while group dashboards keep London time.

tickets.subject: Workspace went read-only with 'payment overdue' banner
tickets.description: Store managers suddenly cannot create or edit dashboards and see a banner reading 'Account on hold - payment overdue'. The admin says nobody received any payment failure emails.
tickets.resolution_notes: The renewal charge had failed three times and every dunning email went to the billing contact address of an employee who had left. The customer paid the overdue invoice, we lifted the hold, and the admin changed the billing contact to a shared finance mailbox. Confirmed editing worked again and the banner cleared.

tickets.subject: Renewal invoiced in USD after asking for euros
tickets.description: The customer asked to be invoiced in euros from renewal onward, but the renewal invoice arrived in US dollars.
tickets.resolution_notes: Currency can change only at renewal and requires assigning a new price book to the subscription; the request had been logged, but the price book was not switched before the renewal job ran. Voided the USD invoice and reissued it in EUR at the agreed euro price. Confirmed the subscription currency now reads EUR.

tickets.subject: Custom domain shows 'workspace not found'
tickets.description: The customer's branded URL now shows a generic 'workspace not found' page, while their workspace is reachable at app.example.net.
tickets.resolution_notes: The CNAME pointed to the legacy target domains.example.net, which was retired after its migration notice period. The customer updated the CNAME to the current target shown in the custom-domain settings. The branded URL loads their workspace.

tickets.subject: Regional holidays not reflected for Bavarian stores
tickets.description: Stores in Bavaria close on regional public holidays, but working-day metrics count those days as normal trading days.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace used the national calendar for Germany, which omits state-level holidays. Assigned the Bavaria regional calendar to the Bavarian store group. Working-day metrics for those stores now exclude the regional holidays.

tickets.subject: Reset link rejected after requesting several resets
tickets.description: A user clicked 'Forgot password' four times because the first email seemed slow, then opened the first email and got 'This reset link is no longer valid'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each new reset request invalidates every earlier link for the account, so only the most recent email could work; the first email had simply arrived late. The user opened the newest email and reset successfully, and we updated the email wording to state that only the latest link is valid.

tickets.subject: Last month's net sales keep shrinking as returns come in
tickets.description: The customer closes the books on the 5th, but net sales for the closed month keep decreasing on the dashboard for weeks afterwards.
tickets.resolution_notes: Returns were attributed to the original sale date, so every return processed after close reduced an already-closed month. Configured the Finance pack's net sales to attribute returns to the date they were processed, matching the customer's accounting policy, while Merchandising views keep sale-date attribution for return-rate analysis. Over the following month the closed period's net sales did not change after the 5th.

tickets.subject: Distributor guest denied on drill-through dashboard
tickets.description: A distributor guest can open the summary dashboard, but clicking through to the detail dashboard gives 'Access denied'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Drill-through targets need their own access, and the detail dashboard had not been shared with the guest. The owner shared it, with the existing row-level rule limiting the guest to the distributor's own products. Confirmed the drill-through worked and showed only that distributor's products.

tickets.subject: Removed folder access still works for about an hour
tickets.description: The customer's security team removed a user from a sensitive folder as a test, and the user could still open it for roughly an hour.
tickets.resolution_notes: Folder permissions were cached per session with a 60-minute lifetime. As an immediate measure, ended the user's active sessions, which forces permissions to be re-evaluated; a shorter refresh interval was scheduled as the permanent fix. Confirmed the user lost access as soon as their sessions ended.

tickets.subject: Whole office gets 'Access restricted by your organization's network policy'
tickets.description: Everyone at the customer's Leeds office sees 'Access restricted by your organization's network policy' straight after signing in.
tickets.resolution_notes: The office's public address changed when their ISP contract switched, and the workspace IP allow-list still contained the old address. A workspace admin connecting from an allowed location added the new 203.0.113.64/28 range. Office users signed in normally.

tickets.subject: Returns alert constantly in 'no data' state for small stores
tickets.description: Customer's 'returns above 10 per day' rule shows 'No data' for most small stores and sends no-data notifications several times a week.
tickets.resolution_notes: Small stores often have no returns at all, which produces no rows rather than a zero. Set the rule to treat missing data as zero for this metric, since an absence of returns is a real value. The no-data notifications stopped, and a test store with 12 returns still triggered the threshold.

tickets.subject: Revenue cells flagged 'Number stored as text'
tickets.description: Every revenue cell in the XLSX export shows the 'Number stored as text' warning, and SUM returns 0.
tickets.resolution_notes: The revenue field was a calculated field with string output because it concatenated a currency symbol. Changed the calculated field to return a number and applied currency formatting in the widget instead. Confirmed the exported cells summed correctly.

tickets.subject: Store manager missing from ownership transfer list
tickets.description: The admin wants to transfer a dashboard to a store manager, but the manager does not appear in the transfer list.
tickets.resolution_notes: Ownership can only go to users with Editor or above, and the manager is a Viewer. Rather than upgrade the manager's role, the admin transferred ownership to the regional lead, an Editor, and shared view access with the manager. Confirmed the transfer and the share were in place.

tickets.subject: Monthly report says a store holds 30 times its capacity
tickets.description: Per the customer's inventory planner: 'The monthly report says Store 12 has 1.4 million units on hand; it physically fits about 50,000.'
tickets.resolution_notes: Monthly on-hand was produced by adding each day's stock snapshot, so a 30-day month multiplied stock by roughly 30. Changed the time aggregation for on-hand measures to closing balance and backfilled. Store 12 now shows 46,800 units at month end, matching the store's count.

tickets.subject: All chart areas empty for one user only
tickets.description: One user sees every chart area empty while tables and KPI tiles display normally. Colleagues opening the same dashboard see charts.
tickets.resolution_notes: A content-blocking browser extension matched the word 'analytics' in our chart library's file path and blocked the script. The user allowed our domain in the extension as an interim step, and we renamed the chart bundle path so it no longer matches common blocklist patterns. After the release the user's charts loaded with the extension fully enabled.

tickets.subject: Daily SFTP sales file overwrites the previous day
tickets.description: Finance expected one sales file per day in their SFTP folder but only ever finds a single sales_export.csv containing the latest day.
tickets.resolution_notes: The delivery's filename template had no date token, so each run replaced the previous file. Changed the template to sales_export_{date}.csv. Confirmed two consecutive runs left two separate files.

tickets.subject: Newly invited store staff can open the labour-cost dashboard
tickets.description: The admin discovered that store staff invited this month can open the labour-cost dashboard, which should be limited to regional leads.
tickets.resolution_notes: The dashboard was shared with the 'All members' group, which every new user joins automatically. Replaced that share with the Regional Leads team. Confirmed a newly invited test user could no longer see the dashboard while regional leads still could.

tickets.subject: IdP key endpoint returns an HTML login page to the product
tickets.description: OIDC sign-in fails with 'invalid JWKS response'; fetching the key URL from outside the customer's network returns their access portal's login page instead.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's web access gateway redirected unauthenticated requests from unknown networks to its portal, including machine requests for public signing keys. The customer added a gateway rule letting the product's auth egress range reach the JWKS path without redirection. The product now receives the key set and sign-ins work.

tickets.subject: Intermittent 'assertion not yet valid' errors
tickets.description: Roughly a third of SSO sign-ins fail with 'Assertion is not yet valid'; they succeed if the user waits a few minutes and tries again.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's on-premises identity provider server clock was running about four minutes fast, so assertion validity windows started in the future. The customer resynchronized the server with their time source and enabled automatic time sync. No further validity errors appeared over the following two days of sign-ins.

tickets.subject: Event push requests rejected with 413 at month end
tickets.description: Customer pushes in-store events to our ingest endpoint in batches. At month end some batches fail with 413 'batch exceeds 1000 events or 5 MB'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their batching was time-based, so busy periods produced batches of several thousand events. Changed their client to cut batches at 1,000 events or 4 MB, whichever comes first. The following month end had no rejected batches and event counts matched their source.

tickets.subject: Orders missing when paging through the orders API
tickets.description: Customer's reconciliation script pages through GET /v2/orders with offset and limit during the trading day and finds a handful of orders missing every run.
tickets.resolution_notes: Offset pagination over a collection that changes while it is being read shifts rows between pages, so some orders slid into pages the script had already passed. Switched the script to cursor pagination ordered by a stable key, with an updated_since checkpoint for incremental runs. Three consecutive runs reconciled exactly.

tickets.subject: March export missing sales from 31 March
tickets.description: An export for the custom range 1 to 31 March ends on 30 March; sales from the 31st are not in the file even though the dashboard includes them.
tickets.resolution_notes: The range picker passed the end date to the export query as an exclusive boundary at 00:00 on 31 March, while the dashboard treats the end date as inclusive. The export request was fixed to use the end of the last day. Confirmed a March export now includes 31 March sales.

tickets.subject: Table values drift under the wrong headers when scrolling
tickets.description: In the store ranking table, values slide under the wrong column headers after scrolling down. The buyer says it only happens on their own laptop.
tickets.resolution_notes: The virtualized rows calculated column widths assuming 100% zoom, while the buyer's browser was at 90%, so row cells and header cells rounded differently. Rows and headers now share one set of computed widths. Columns stayed aligned at every zoom level we tested, including the buyer's.

tickets.subject: Every dashboard spins for two minutes right on the hour
tickets.description: The customer's admin noticed that at the top of each hour, every dashboard in the workspace sits on a spinner for around two minutes, then loads normally. Between hours there is no problem.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's hourly store reports all ran at :00 and consumed every concurrency slot in the workspace, so interactive queries queued behind them. Separated scheduled and interactive workloads with reserved slots and spread the hourly reports across the first ten minutes. Monitored three hourly cycles and saw no interactive queuing.

tickets.subject: Year-end order line export missing everything after mid-November
tickets.description: Finance noticed the XLSX export of the year's order lines stops partway through November; nothing after that point appears in the file.
tickets.resolution_notes: The export was sorted by date ascending and exceeded the worksheet row limit, so every row past the cap was dropped without notice. Split the export into two half-year files for the immediate need, and once multi-sheet output was released, re-ran the full-year export. Confirmed it spanned two sheets and ended on 31 December.

tickets.subject: All times off by one hour since the clocks changed
tickets.description: Since the March clock change, every time on the customer's dashboards and schedules is an hour behind.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace time zone was set to the fixed offset 'UTC-06:00' rather than America/Chicago, so it never followed daylight saving time. Changed it to America/Chicago. Times are correct and will follow future clock changes.

tickets.subject: Dashboard catalogue search takes 20 seconds
tickets.description: In a workspace with about 9,000 dashboards, searching the catalogue for a title takes around 20 seconds. Admins get results noticeably faster than regular members.
tickets.resolution_notes: The search checked view permission separately for each candidate result, issuing thousands of permission lookups for members (admins skip the check). Replaced this with a single batched permission evaluation per search. Members now get correct results in under a second.

tickets.subject: Revenue totals from API script are absurdly large
tickets.description: A customer's spreadsheet macro sums daily revenue pulled from the API and produced a total with dozens of digits.
tickets.resolution_notes: Monetary amounts are returned as decimal strings to avoid floating-point rounding, and the macro concatenated the strings instead of adding numbers. Updated the macro to convert amounts to decimal before summing. The weekly total now matches the dashboard to the cent.

tickets.subject: Sync log: 'No matching role mapping for group FINANCE-ANALYSTS'
tickets.description: The provisioning log shows 'No matching role mapping for group FINANCE-ANALYSTS', and finance users are getting the default Viewer role.
tickets.resolution_notes: The mapping had been created as 'Finance-Analysts', and group matching was case-sensitive. Re-entered the mapping with the exact casing as an immediate fix; making the comparison case-insensitive was scheduled for the next release. Confirmed finance users received the Analyst role after the next sync.

tickets.subject: Logo invisible in the mobile app's dark mode
tickets.description: In the mobile app with dark mode on, the header logo disappears; it is fine in light mode and in the web app.
tickets.resolution_notes: Only a dark-coloured logo had been uploaded, so it vanished against the dark header. Uploaded a light variant to the 'Dark mode logo' slot in Branding settings, which the mobile and web apps use automatically in dark themes. The logo is visible in both modes.

tickets.subject: Store daily totals occasionally off by one cent
tickets.description: On random days a store's daily revenue differs by exactly $0.01 from the POS end-of-day total, and it never hits the same store twice in a row.
tickets.resolution_notes: Daily revenue was summed with binary floating-point arithmetic, and accumulated representation error occasionally tipped the final rounding by a cent. Moved currency aggregation to fixed-point decimal arithmetic and recomputed the past year. A full comparison of 30 days across all stores shows zero mismatches.

tickets.subject: SFTP files moved to 'rejected': header row not recognized
tickets.description: Files the merchandising team drops on the SFTP folder are being moved to the 'rejected' subfolder with 'Header row not recognized'.
tickets.resolution_notes: A team member had opened and re-saved the shared template on a laptop with German regional settings, which switched the separator to semicolons and turned the header into a single field. Enabled delimiter detection for this feed and asked the team to keep the template unchanged on the shared drive. The rejected files were reprocessed and the next three daily drops imported normally.

tickets.subject: 85 bulk-imported users have no team membership
tickets.description: After uploading 85 users through the CSV user import, none of them appear in any team and they cannot open team dashboards.
tickets.resolution_notes: The import file's team column was headed 'Team Name' instead of 'team', so the importer ignored it. Re-ran the import in update mode with the corrected header. Confirmed all 85 users were placed in their teams and could open team dashboards.

tickets.subject: 'Waiting for capacity' message at 9:00 on Mondays
tickets.description: Customer reports that at 9:00 every Monday their dashboards show 'Waiting for capacity...' for one to three minutes before loading.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer has about 150 reports scheduled for 9:00 on Mondays, and scheduled renders shared the same workspace concurrency slots as people opening dashboards. Reserved a portion of slots for interactive queries so scheduled work can no longer take all of them. Next Monday interactive waits stayed under 5 seconds while reports still completed by 9:12.

tickets.subject: Card update spins, then 'Verification incomplete'
tickets.description: When saving a new company card, the form spins for about a minute and then shows 'Verification incomplete. Your card was not saved.'
tickets.resolution_notes: The issuer required a 3-D Secure challenge, which the payment form opened in a popup that the customer's browser blocked without any notice. Had the customer allow popups for the billing page and retry; the bank challenge appeared and the card saved. Confirmed the new card shows as the default payment method.

tickets.subject: First full sync fails after exactly six hours
tickets.description: The first full sync of a large grocery chain's e-commerce data fails after six hours every time with 'Run exceeded maximum duration'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The initial load tried to import eight years of orders in a single run, hit the six-hour limit and discarded its progress. Split the backfill into monthly segments that run back to back and keep their progress. The backfill finished in 31 hours across segments with 9.6 million orders.

tickets.subject: Three charts empty in PDF export
tickets.description: The PDF export of the store performance dashboard contains titles and tables, but three chart areas are empty boxes; on screen the charts look fine.
tickets.resolution_notes: The PDF renderer took its snapshot before lazy-loaded widgets below the fold had finished loading. The renderer was changed to wait for each widget's ready signal before capturing. Confirmed all charts appeared in the next PDF.

tickets.subject: Chat channel gets each stock alert two times
tickets.description: The store operations channel in the customer's chat tool shows every low-stock alert posted twice by our app.
tickets.resolution_notes: The alert rules list showed two identical rules for each product family, one attached to the original stock dashboard and one to a copy an analyst created last week; copying a dashboard duplicated its attached rules. Removed the copies and pointed the analyst to the new clone option that leaves rules behind. Single posts confirmed on the next three alerts.

tickets.subject: Chinese store names show as boxes in PDF
tickets.description: Store names written in Simplified Chinese appear as empty rectangles in PDF exports, though the browser displays them correctly.
tickets.resolution_notes: The PDF renderer's font set had no CJK glyphs. Added a CJK-capable font to the renderer's fallback list. Confirmed the names rendered correctly in a new PDF.

tickets.subject: Several charts stuck on 'last 30 days'
tickets.description: Store operations staff report that a handful of charts always show the last 30 days whatever range they choose, and it varies between dashboards built by different colleagues.
tickets.resolution_notes: The affected dashboards had all been cloned from one original whose widgets had a 30-day range pinned, so every copy inherited the override. Showed the admin the 'Fixed range' badge and bulk-cleared the pinned ranges on the copies they selected. Those charts now respond to the dashboard filter.

tickets.subject: Stores get 'Access denied by policy' while HQ works
tickets.description: All store staff see 'Access denied by policy: Business Applications' when opening the app, while HQ uses it normally.
tickets.resolution_notes: A recent network change applied the guest Wi-Fi filtering policy to the store staff network, and that policy blocks the business-applications category. The customer reassigned the staff network to its correct policy. Store staff regained access.

tickets.subject: Connector to legacy loyalty server fails after connector upgrade
tickets.description: Following the connector framework upgrade, pulls from the customer's ten-year-old loyalty server fail with 'unsupported protocol'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Upgraded connectors require TLS 1.2 or later for outbound connections, and the loyalty server only supported TLS 1.0. The customer enabled TLS 1.2 on the server's web front end. Pulls resumed with no change to credentials.

tickets.subject: API returns wrong figures for one store
tickets.description: Customer says API results for their 'Harbor & Pine' store don't match the dashboard at all, while every other store matches.
tickets.resolution_notes: The client built the query string without URL-encoding, so the ampersand split the filter and the API received store='Harbor ' plus a stray parameter, returning a partial match. Updated the client to encode query parameters. Results for that store now match the dashboard.

tickets.subject: Self-made password flagged as breached
tickets.description: A customer's user insists their new password is unique, yet the form rejects it with 'This password has appeared in a data breach'.
tickets.resolution_notes: Breach screening compares new passwords with a list of known exposed passwords, and the user's choice was a common keyboard pattern with a year appended, which is on that list. Explained the check and suggested a passphrase generated by their password manager. The new passphrase was accepted.

tickets.subject: Stricter password rule not applied to existing users
tickets.description: Admin raised the minimum password length to 14 characters, yet staff with shorter passwords keep signing in without being asked to change them.
tickets.resolution_notes: New policy rules apply when a password is next set, not to existing passwords, by design. The admin used 'Require password change at next sign-in' for all password-based users, and the policy page now explains this behaviour. Within a week the policy report showed every password user compliant.

tickets.subject: Accented store names garbled in CSV
tickets.description: Store names such as 'Café du Marché' appear as 'CafÃ© du MarchÃ©' when the CSV export is opened in a spreadsheet application.
tickets.resolution_notes: The CSV was UTF-8 encoded without a byte-order mark, so the spreadsheet application assumed a legacy encoding. Enabled the 'UTF-8 with BOM' export option for the workspace. Confirmed the names displayed correctly when the file was opened by double-clicking.

tickets.subject: Refund to a closed card bounced back
tickets.description: A refund for a cancelled add-on was returned to us because the original card had been closed.
tickets.resolution_notes: The processor cannot redirect a card refund once the card is closed. After verifying the request with the billing owner, issued the refund by bank transfer instead. Confirmed the transfer completed and the refund shows as settled.

tickets.subject: Quarter-to-date tile resets on 1 April instead of 1 May
tickets.description: Per the customer: 'Our Q2 starts in May, but the QTD tile reset to zero on April 1.'
tickets.resolution_notes: Fiscal year start month was set to January, so quarter boundaries followed calendar quarters. Set it to February to match the customer's fiscal calendar. The QTD tile now accumulates from 1 May.

tickets.subject: One rule can't follow opening hours across four time zones
tickets.description: Customer operates stores in four time zones and wants a single 'no sales in first trading hour' rule. With one active-hours window, some regions are always checked at the wrong time.
tickets.resolution_notes: A rule's active hours can only use one time zone. As a workaround we split the rule into four copies, each scoped to one time zone's stores with matching hours; a single rule that follows each store's local opening hours is scheduled for a future release. Each regional copy fired correctly in tests at its local opening time.

tickets.subject: API extract total differs from dashboard by a few dozen rows
tickets.description: Customer compared returns pulled through the API with the returns dashboard and found the API extract short by 30-40 rows on busy days, but exact on quiet days.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their extract used offset pagination while new returns were still being recorded, so rows shifted between pages and some were never read. Moved the extract to cursor pagination and ran it after the business day closed. The next week's extracts matched the dashboard exactly.

tickets.subject: Category stock lower than the sum of its stores
tickets.description: Agent summary: for Home & Kitchen, category-level stock on hand is about 18% lower than adding up the same category across all stores on the same day.
tickets.resolution_notes: Stores send inventory snapshots at different times of day, and the category rollup took the latest snapshot timestamp across the whole category rather than the latest snapshot per store, dropping stores that had reported earlier. Changed the end-of-period logic to select each store's last snapshot before summing. Category totals now equal the sum of store totals.

tickets.subject: One 'customer' with $2.3M lifetime spend
tickets.description: Customer success noticed the Top Customers list is headed by a single profile with 48,000 orders and $2.3M spend that nobody recognises.
tickets.resolution_notes: The profile was an artefact of email-only matching: store associates enter a shared fallback email when a shopper declines to give one, and every such order merged into one identity. Excluded the shared fallback address from matching and re-resolved identities. The Top Customers list now shows real accounts, the largest with 61 orders, consistent with the CRM.

tickets.subject: Charged when trial ended, no reminder received
tickets.description: A customer who entered a card at trial signup was charged on day 15 and says they never got a reminder that the trial was ending.
tickets.resolution_notes: Trials with a card on file convert automatically, as the signup page states, but the trial-ending reminder was suppressed because the user had unsubscribed from product emails, which wrongly also blocked this transactional message. Refunded the charge and cancelled at the customer's request, and the reminder was reclassified as transactional. Confirmed the refund was issued.

tickets.subject: 400 invalid_date on metrics query
tickets.description: Customer's request to the metrics endpoint with from=11/03/2026 returns 400 'invalid_date: expected ISO 8601'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The API only accepts ISO 8601 dates, and 11/03/2026 is also ambiguous between March and November. Updated their client to send 2026-03-11 with an explicit time zone offset where times are used. Queries now return the expected data.

tickets.subject: Loyalty sync succeeds only every other night
tickets.description: Loyalty transactions only update every second day. On the alternate nights the connector log shows 'Daily request allowance exhausted' within minutes of starting.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's loyalty platform plan allows 50,000 API calls in a rolling 24 hours, and our connector re-read the entire member list nightly, using about 70,000 calls, so each run left too little allowance for the next. Changed the connector to fetch only members changed since the last run, which needs about 6,000 calls. Runs have completed every night for the following two weeks.

tickets.subject: Axis labels read '1000K' instead of '1M'
tickets.description: Y-axis labels on the sales trend chart go 900K, 1000K, 1.1M. The customer's finance director called it sloppy.
tickets.resolution_notes: The abbreviation logic picked the unit before rounding, so 999,600 was labelled in thousands and then rounded up to 1000K. Changed it to round first and choose the unit afterwards. The axis now reads 900K, 1M, 1.1M.

tickets.subject: 70-widget dashboard loads in waves
tickets.description: Customer's all-in-one regional dashboard has about 70 widgets. They load a few at a time over 40 seconds, top to bottom.
tickets.resolution_notes: Each widget made its own request and the browser allows only a handful of parallel connections per host, so widgets queued in the browser. Enabled batched widget queries so the dashboard sends a few combined requests, and suggested splitting the board into tabs that load on demand. The board now completes in about 9 seconds.

tickets.subject: Discount codes blank on every synced order
tickets.description: Every synced order shows an empty discount code, including orders the customer knows used promo codes.
tickets.resolution_notes: The app installation in the customer's e-commerce admin had never been granted the 'read discounts' scope, so discount details were left out of order data. The store owner approved the additional scope from the connector settings. Re-syncing the last 30 days filled in discount codes on 3,940 orders.

tickets.subject: Emails still come from the product domain after setting our sender
tickets.description: The admin configured notifications@orchidlane.example.com as the sender address, but emails still arrive from the product's own address.
tickets.resolution_notes: The custom sender domain was in 'Pending verification' because the DKIM record shown in settings had not been published. The customer published the record, verification completed and the sender switched. A test notification arrived from the customer's address and passed DKIM.

tickets.subject: Order and refund syncs block each other
tickets.description: After the customer enabled hourly syncs, the order sync and the refund sync for the same store both sit at 'In progress' and neither finishes.
tickets.resolution_notes: Both jobs wrote to the same order rows, and when the refund job started before the hourly order job finished they waited on each other's row locks. Serialized jobs per connection so the refund sync waits for the order sync. Both jobs have completed every hour since the change.

tickets.subject: Order sync failing with 'invalid_grant' since staff offboarding
tickets.description: The Northwind Commerce connector log shows 'invalid_grant: refresh token revoked' on every run since Monday, the day the customer offboarded several staff.
tickets.resolution_notes: One of the removed staff accounts was the store-owner login used to authorize the connection, and removing it invalidated the grant. The customer reconnected with a service account not tied to an individual, and the connector page now shows which user authorized the connection. Sync resumed and backfilled the 2,310 orders from the gap.

tickets.subject: Threshold reset to 0 after renaming a rule
tickets.description: Customer renamed several inventory variance rules to follow a new naming scheme, and those rules immediately started firing for almost every store.
tickets.resolution_notes: A defect in the rule editor saved the threshold as 0 when only the name was edited, and because these rules alert on variance above the threshold, any store with even one unit of variance matched. Fixed the editor to preserve unchanged fields and restored the original thresholds from rule history. Renaming a test rule now leaves its threshold intact, and the false alerts stopped.

tickets.subject: Shared store tablet signs next user into previous account
tickets.description: On a shared store tablet, after one manager signs out, the next person taps 'Sign in with SSO' and lands straight in the previous manager's account without entering any credentials.
tickets.resolution_notes: Signing out ended the app session but left the identity provider session alive in the in-app browser, so the next SSO attempt silently reused it. The app now uses an ephemeral browser session for SSO and calls the identity provider's logout endpoint on sign-out. The customer tested two consecutive managers on the same tablet and each had to authenticate separately.

tickets.subject: Sync silently paused for two weeks
tickets.description: The customer only noticed stale data when a regional director asked why last week's numbers looked flat. The connector page reads 'Paused after 5 consecutive failures'.
tickets.resolution_notes: A brief source outage caused five failed runs and the connection paused itself; the failure emails went to an admin who had left the company. Resumed the schedule and backfilled the two weeks, and the admin changed the notification recipient to a shared operations address. Data is current, and a test failure notice reached the shared address.

tickets.subject: Late-arriving POS transactions missing for days
tickets.description: Transactions from stores with unreliable internet are missing from the dashboard even days later. Those registers upload their transactions in batches once the connection returns.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connector's cursor used the transaction time, and offline registers uploaded transactions timed before the cursor, so they were skipped. Switched the cursor to the POS platform's 'received at' timestamp. The past two weeks of missing transactions were backfilled and new offline batches now appear on the next sync.

tickets.subject: Events missing after our planned maintenance
tickets.description: The customer took their integration endpoint offline for a six-hour maintenance window on Sunday. When it came back, events from the first two hours of the window never arrived.
tickets.resolution_notes: Our retry schedule stops after about four hours, so events from early in the window exhausted their retries and were marked dropped. Used the event replay endpoint to redeliver everything from the window and showed the customer how to self-serve replays. Their endpoint confirmed receipt of all 3,412 replayed events; an optional 24-hour retry window was enabled for their subscription.

tickets.subject: Embedded chart flickers for ten seconds on load
tickets.description: Embedded charts on the customer's intranet flash and redraw several times a second for about ten seconds before settling down.
tickets.resolution_notes: The intranet's own resize handler and our embed's height messages triggered each other, so every height change caused another resize. The embed now reports only changes larger than a few pixels and ignores changes it caused itself. Embedded charts draw once and stay still.

tickets.subject: Alert webhooks fail for rules with multi-line descriptions
tickets.description: Agent summary: since the customer's team started writing longer rule descriptions with line breaks, alerts from those rules never reach their automation endpoint. Rules with one-line descriptions work.
tickets.resolution_notes: The webhook payload template placed the description into a JSON string without escaping, so raw line breaks made the body invalid and the endpoint rejected it. Changed the template to use escaped variables and re-sent the failed alerts. All rules now deliver regardless of description formatting.

tickets.subject: October revenue about 2% lower than the ERP
tickets.description: Finance flagged that October revenue on the Executive Summary is around 2% below the ERP figure, and November is overstated by almost exactly the same amount.
tickets.resolution_notes: Monthly totals were built from UTC-bucketed days, so evening sales on 31 October in the Americas stores were counted in November. After switching aggregation to each store's local business day and reprocessing, October matched the ERP to the dollar and November's overstatement disappeared.

tickets.subject: Daily alert digest arrives at 3am
tickets.description: Customer wanted a morning digest of yesterday's alerts at 08:00, but it reaches the team at 03:00 local time.
tickets.resolution_notes: The digest channel's send time had no time zone set and defaulted to UTC, five hours ahead of the team. Set the channel's time zone to the team's local zone. The next digest arrived at 08:00 local time.

tickets.subject: Checkout errors alert arrives two hours late
tickets.description: Customer's alert for payment failures above 5% should trigger after the condition lasts 30 minutes, but last Saturday it arrived about two hours after failures started.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule evaluated only once an hour, and a 'for 30 minutes' condition needs two consecutive breaching evaluations, so the earliest possible alert was over an hour after onset and longer depending on timing. Changed evaluation frequency to every 5 minutes. A simulated failure spike produced an alert 31 minutes after onset.

tickets.subject: 422 'idempotency_key_reused' on target uploads
tickets.description: Customer's daily upload of store sales targets fails with 422 'idempotency_key_reused' on most days except the first of the month.
tickets.resolution_notes: The client used the target month as its Idempotency-Key, so each day's upload reused the key with a different body, which the API rejects to prevent ambiguity. Changed the key to a UUID generated per upload attempt and reused only for retries of that same attempt. Daily uploads have succeeded since.

tickets.subject: Year-over-year chart won't follow the date picker
tickets.description: The customer's buyer complains that changing the dates at the top of the trading dashboard has no effect on the year-over-year comparison chart.
tickets.resolution_notes: The chart came from a template that fixed its range to the current calendar year, overriding the date picker, and the override badge was hidden because the widget was in compact mode. Removed the fixed range and made the badge appear on compact widgets too. The comparison chart now changes with the date picker.

tickets.subject: Inventory feed to ERP stopped, API says key revoked
tickets.description: The customer's ERP stopped receiving daily inventory positions. Their middleware log shows our API answering 'api_key_revoked'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The audit log showed the key was revoked automatically when the contractor who created it was deactivated at the end of their engagement. Created a dedicated integration service account with read-only inventory scope and rotated the middleware to its key. The next scheduled feed delivered successfully.

tickets.subject: Store server uploads stopped after data residency change
tickets.description: Scheduled uploads from the customer's store server cluster have failed since last weekend's data residency change, with the error 'proxy denied: destination not in policy'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The proxy policy listed only the global ingestion hostname; after the move, uploads target ingest.eu.example.net, which was missing from the policy. Added the regional hostname to the proxy destination policy. Uploads completed on the next schedule.

tickets.subject: Two seats added late in the month billed almost a full month
tickets.description: Customer added two seats on the 24th and the prorated charge for each was close to a full month's price instead of about a week.
tickets.resolution_notes: The proration routine used the start of the billing cycle, rather than the time of the change, as the start date for mid-cycle seat additions. Credited the overcharge for both seats, and the routine was corrected to use the change timestamp. Recalculated lines covered 7 days per seat.

tickets.subject: Gross margin alert fires every hour
tickets.description: Customer created a rule 'gross margin below 25' and has received an alert every hour since, even though their dashboard shows margin around 31%.
tickets.resolution_notes: Margin is stored as a fraction (0.31), so every value was below 25. Changed the threshold to 0.25 and we updated the rule editor to show the metric's unit next to the threshold field. The alert stopped, and a test with a 0.35 threshold fired once as expected.

tickets.subject: Only the reconnecting rep's own accounts sync
tickets.description: After the customer reconnected the CRM integration, only accounts owned by the person who reconnected it are imported, about 5% of the usual volume.
tickets.resolution_notes: The connection had been re-authorized with a sales rep's personal login, whose CRM visibility is limited to their own records. Re-authorized with the dedicated integration user, which can read all accounts. Account volume returned to the usual 23,000 on the next run.

tickets.subject: HMAC verification passes in staging, fails in production
tickets.description: Customer's developer reports the same receiver code verifies webhook signatures in their staging environment but rejects all events in production.
tickets.resolution_notes: Production had a global JSON parsing middleware enabled that rewrote the request body before the verification step; staging did not. Configured the webhook route to keep the raw body and verify against it before parsing. Production verification succeeded for a test event and for live traffic the next hour.

tickets.subject: Admins keep scheduling reports at the wrong hour
tickets.description: Admins pick 8:00 for report schedules, but recipients get the reports at 3:00 or 4:00 in the morning local time.
tickets.resolution_notes: Schedule times are interpreted in the workspace time zone, which was still the UTC default because it was never set during setup. Set the workspace time zone to America/New_York and adjusted the existing schedules. Reports now arrive at 8:00 local time.

tickets.subject: Two integrations overwriting each other's dashboard changes
tickets.description: Customer has two automation jobs updating the same dashboard's settings. Changes from one job randomly disappear after the other job runs.
tickets.resolution_notes: Both jobs read the dashboard, modified it and wrote it back with PUT, so the later write replaced the earlier one. Updated both jobs to send the ETag in an If-Match header and to re-read and retry on 412 Precondition Failed. Running both jobs concurrently now preserves both sets of changes.

tickets.subject: Webhook events arriving 20-40 minutes late
tickets.description: The customer's order-sync integration normally gets order events within seconds, but on Black Friday many arrived 20-40 minutes after the order was placed.
tickets.resolution_notes: Deliveries for several tenants shared one ordered delivery queue, and one tenant's very slow endpoint held up others during the traffic spike. Moved webhook delivery to per-subscriber partitions so a slow receiver only delays its own events. During the next high-traffic weekend the customer's delivery delay stayed under 10 seconds.

tickets.subject: Why weren't we alerted when the web shop stopped reporting orders?
tickets.description: After the web shop's order events stopped arriving for four hours, the e-commerce lead asked why the 'orders below 20 per hour' alert never went off.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rule only evaluates when data points exist and treats empty windows as OK, so a complete stop never crossed the threshold. Switched the no-data behaviour to fire after one empty hour and added a separate data freshness rule on the order source. Both rules fired in a simulated outage test.

tickets.subject: On-call tool rejects some alert webhooks as invalid JSON
tickets.description: Customer's incident tool rejects a few of our alert webhooks with 400 'malformed JSON body'. It only seems to happen for one store, named The "Corner" Shop.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer's custom payload template inserted the store name with plain text substitution, so the double quotes in the name broke the JSON. Switched the template fields to the JSON-escaped variable form and added template validation with a sample containing special characters. Alerts for that store are now accepted by the incident tool.

tickets.subject: Goodwill credit consumed by the wrong workspace's invoice
tickets.description: A goodwill credit granted for the customer's EU workspace was used up by the US workspace's invoice instead.
tickets.resolution_notes: Credits sit at the billing-account level and apply to the earliest due invoice regardless of workspace. Reversed the application, applied the credit to the EU invoice and restricted it to the EU subscription. Confirmed both invoice balances matched what the customer expected.

tickets.subject: Nightly POS sync runs before stores close
tickets.description: The nightly POS sync is supposed to run after closing, but the history shows it starting at 20:00 store time, so the last two hours of trading are missing until the following night.
tickets.resolution_notes: The 02:00 schedule was saved while the admin's profile time zone was UTC, and the stores are six hours behind UTC, so the run started at 20:00 local time. Set the schedule's time zone explicitly to the stores' zone. The next run started at 02:00 local time and included the full day's sales.

tickets.subject: Resized chart snaps back to its original width
tickets.description: An analyst drags a chart wider, and the moment they let go it springs back to its original size. Other widgets resize normally.
tickets.resolution_notes: The chart's saved properties had identical minimum and maximum widths, left over from the template it was built from. Cleared the size constraints and stopped templates from saving equal minimum and maximum widths. The analyst could then resize the chart freely.

tickets.subject: Small CSV export stuck on 'Queued' for hours
tickets.description: Customer requested a 2,000-row CSV export at 10:15 and the export panel still said 'Queued' at 13:30. Nothing appeared to be wrong with the export settings.
tickets.resolution_notes: Their tiny export was waiting behind an exceptionally large full-history export on the shared first-in-first-out queue. Released the stuck job by moving it ahead of the large export while the planned separate lane for large exports was still being built. Once started, the 2,000-row export completed in under a minute.

tickets.subject: Shared dashboard opens but widgets lack data source access
tickets.description: A dashboard shared with the marketing team opens for them, but every widget says they do not have access to the 'Online Orders' data source.
tickets.resolution_notes: Sharing a dashboard does not grant access to the datasets behind it, and the marketing team had no use permission on Online Orders. With the data owner's approval, granted the team use permission on that dataset only. Confirmed the widgets loaded for a marketing user.

tickets.subject: Refunds showing as thousands instead of tens of dollars
tickets.description: Per the customer, a $49.99 refund appears as $4,999.00 on the Returns dashboard, and only for orders from their mobile app storefront.
tickets.resolution_notes: Refund events from the app storefront's payments feed carry amounts in cents, but the refund amount field was configured as decimal dollars. Corrected the unit for that feed and reprocessed refunds since the app storefront launched. The sample refund now shows $49.99 and the refund total matches the payment processor's report.

tickets.subject: Clicking a bar to cross-filter takes 15 seconds
tickets.description: When the customer clicks a region bar to cross-filter their dashboard, everything grays out for 15 seconds, including widgets that don't use region at all.
tickets.resolution_notes: Cross-filter clicks refreshed all 40 widgets on the dashboard, even those not linked to the region field. Changed cross-filtering to refresh only widgets connected to the clicked field. A cross-filter click now updates the eight relevant widgets in about 2 seconds.

tickets.subject: Order data hours behind during weekend promotion
tickets.description: During a big weekend promotion, order data in the dashboard lagged three to four hours behind the storefront.
tickets.resolution_notes: The e-commerce platform throttled our connector to its standard request rate, and promotion volume exceeded what could be fetched at that rate. Switched the connection to the platform's order events so new orders arrive as they happen, with the scheduled sync kept as a catch-up. During the next promotion order data lagged by less than five minutes.

tickets.subject: Returning-customer rate stuck near 0%
tickets.description: Since connecting their new storefront, the customer's returning-customer rate has fallen below 1%, which they know is wrong because the loyalty program shows thousands of repeat buyers.
tickets.resolution_notes: The customer identifier for the storefront source was mapped to the checkout session ID, which is unique per visit, so every order looked like a new customer. Remapped it to the storefront account ID, with email as fallback for guest checkouts, and recomputed customer metrics. The returning-customer rate settled at 31%, consistent with the loyalty program's repeat-purchase report.

tickets.subject: Shared exploration defaults to 'All time' and crawls
tickets.description: A saved exploration that the whole buying team uses takes over a minute to open. The customer noticed the date picker on it says 'All time'.
tickets.resolution_notes: The exploration had been saved without a date bound, so every open scanned eight years of transactions. Set its default to the last 13 months with the option to widen it, and added a warning when someone saves a shared exploration with an unbounded range. It now opens in about 4 seconds.

tickets.subject: Yen invoices printed with decimals
tickets.description: A customer in Japan reports invoice amounts printed as '¥54,000.00'; their accounting software rejects decimal yen values on import.
tickets.resolution_notes: The invoice template applied two decimal places to every currency instead of each currency's own minor units. The template was corrected to print yen without decimals and the affected invoices were reissued. Confirmed the reissued PDF shows ¥54,000.

tickets.subject: Renewal invoice ignores three-year price lock
tickets.description: The annual renewal invoice is 18% higher than last year's, although the customer's contract locks the price for three years.
tickets.resolution_notes: The contracted price had been entered as an override covering only the first term, so the renewal reverted to list price. Re-rated the renewal at the locked price, reissued the invoice and extended the override to the full contract. Confirmed the override's end date now matches the contract.

tickets.subject: Excel asks to repair every exported workbook
tickets.description: Opening Excel exports triggers 'We found a problem with some content... Do you want us to try to recover as much as we can?'
tickets.resolution_notes: A product description column contained vertical-tab control characters, which are not allowed in the workbook's XML. The writer now strips invalid XML characters. Confirmed the regenerated workbook opened without the repair prompt.

tickets.subject: Closed stores flagged as 0% conversion
tickets.description: On Boxing Day, every store that was closed shows 0% conversion on the store leaderboard, and the 'stores below conversion target' tile jumped from 3 to 41.
tickets.resolution_notes: The conversion formula returned 0 instead of null when the visitor count was 0, so closed stores looked like open stores with no sales. Changed division by zero to return null so those stores drop out of leaderboards and target counts, and recomputed the holiday dates. The tile now shows 2 stores below target for that day, both of which were open.

tickets.subject: 'Yesterday' filter cuts off at 7 pm
tickets.description: The customer's New York team says the 'Yesterday' filter stops at about 7 pm and pulls in the late evening of the day before instead.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace time zone had never been set after onboarding and defaulted to UTC, so relative date filters used UTC days. Set the workspace time zone to America/New_York. 'Yesterday' now covers midnight to midnight Eastern time.

tickets.subject: SSO error: audience restriction does not match
tickets.description: Every SSO attempt fails with 'AudienceRestriction mismatch' right after the customer's admin rebuilt the SAML app in their identity provider.
tickets.resolution_notes: The rebuilt app sent the entity ID with a trailing slash, while the workspace expects the exact value shown on its SSO settings page. The admin corrected the audience value in the identity provider app. Test sign-ins by the admin and two pilot users succeeded.

tickets.subject: Password login works but SSO says 'No account found'
tickets.description: Employees of the customer's subsidiary (retail-group.example.com) cannot use SSO, although the parent company's domain works and the same employees can still sign in with a password.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace SSO configuration listed only the parent company's verified domain, so SSO lookups for the subsidiary domain found no workspace. The admin verified the subsidiary domain with the DNS TXT check and added it to the SSO configuration. Subsidiary employees signed in through SSO the same day.

tickets.subject: Embedded dashboard in partner portal slow for every visitor
tickets.description: The customer embeds a supplier scorecard in their partner portal. Suppliers report it takes 15-20 seconds to appear on each visit, while the same dashboard opened directly in the app feels quicker for internal staff.
tickets.resolution_notes: Embedded views create a fresh short-lived session for each visit, and the embed rendering path built its own result cache key that still included the session ID, so embedded traffic never got a cache hit. Changed that key to the query fingerprint and the embed's permission scope. Embedded loads dropped to around 2 seconds after the first visitor of each supplier scope.

tickets.subject: No currency on exported revenue for multi-currency stores
tickets.description: Revenue values in exports carry no currency, so a customer with stores in several countries cannot tell euro rows from pound rows.
tickets.resolution_notes: Exports wrote amounts as raw numbers and left out the currency attribute shown on screen. Enabled the 'Include currency code column' option for the dataset. Confirmed each exported row now carries its ISO currency code.

tickets.subject: TV-mode text unreadable on a new 4K screen
tickets.description: On the new 4K screen in the distribution centre office, TV-mode text is too small to read from more than a metre away.
tickets.resolution_notes: TV mode took the TV browser's reported 1:1 pixel ratio at face value, so the layout was drawn for a 3840-pixel-wide screen. Added a scale setting to TV mode and set it to 200% for this screen. The text is now readable from across the office.

tickets.subject: Refund confirmed but not on card statement yet
tickets.description: Terse report: refund confirmation received four days ago, nothing on the card statement yet.
tickets.resolution_notes: The refund had settled on our side; card refunds take 5 to 10 business days to post depending on the issuer. Shared the refund's acquirer reference number so the customer's bank could trace it. The customer confirmed it posted on day seven.

tickets.subject: Revenue exported as 1,234.56 for German users
tickets.description: German users see revenue as 1.234,56 on screen, but the CSV export writes 1,234.56, which their spreadsheet reads as text.
tickets.resolution_notes: CSV exports always used the invariant number format. Enabled 'Use workspace number format' for CSV exports together with a semicolon delimiter. Confirmed the numbers imported as numeric values.

tickets.subject: TV rotation skips the returns dashboard
tickets.description: The customer set TV mode to rotate through four dashboards, but the returns dashboard never appears; the screen goes from the third straight back to the first.
tickets.resolution_notes: The returns dashboard took longer to load than the 30-second rotation interval, and the rotation skipped any dashboard that had not finished loading. Rotation now waits for a dashboard to load before starting its timer. All four dashboards appeared in turn over an afternoon of testing.

tickets.subject: City-centre store pins pile into one blob
tickets.description: Twelve stores in one city centre are drawn as a single blob of overlapping pins, so the area manager cannot click any of them.
tickets.resolution_notes: Clustering was switched off for this map. Enabled clustering with a count badge that expands on zoom, and spread out pins that share identical coordinates. The manager can now zoom in and click each store.

tickets.subject: Automation user counted as a paid seat
tickets.description: The admin created a user named reporting-bot for a scheduled script and noticed it takes up a seat. They asked whether non-human accounts should be billed at all.
tickets.resolution_notes: Users created on the Users page are named seats regardless of who operates them, while the plan's service credentials are not billed. Helped the admin create a read-only service credential, move the script to it and deactivate the reporting-bot user. Confirmed the seat counter dropped by one.

tickets.subject: OIDC sign-in bounces back to login with no message
tickets.description: After authenticating at their identity provider, users are returned to our login page with no error. It began after the admin edited the SSO settings to add a group claim.
tickets.resolution_notes: While editing, the admin had accidentally removed 'email' from the requested scopes, so the ID token carried no email address and the sign-in was discarded. Restored the email scope and added validation that blocks saving an OIDC configuration without it. Users signed in normally afterwards.

tickets.subject: Returns history starts on the day the connector was installed
tickets.description: The returns-rate dashboard only has returns from the date the connector was installed; every earlier month shows zero returns.
tickets.resolution_notes: The backfill job covered orders but not returns, because returns were added to the connector after the job's object list was fixed. Added returns to the backfill configuration for all connections and reloaded this customer's return history. Returns now appear back to the start of the order history.

tickets.subject: Old company name in report footers despite new workspace name
tickets.description: The customer changed the workspace name months ago after re-registering the company under a new name, but the footer of every PDF report still reads 'Quillbrook Hardware Ltd' instead of the new registered name.
tickets.resolution_notes: Report footers use the separate 'Organisation legal name' field, not the workspace display name, and only the display name had been updated. Updated the legal name field to the newly registered name. The next scheduled PDF carried the correct footer.
